recommendations.speaker: Joe Cornish

recommendations.item: Tomato bruschetta
recommendations.venue: Private island off the Amalfi Coast (Li Galli, Nureyev's villa)
recommendations.reason: Served at a lunch hosted by film producer Aurelio De Laurentiis; the tomatoes and olive oil were the best he has tasted.
recommendations.quote: they were chopped into a bruschetta with some amazing olive oil, and it was just the most beautiful thing I've ever tasted.
recommendations.speaker: Joe Cornish

recommendations.item: Fresh grilled fish with chips and salad
recommendations.reason: A tiny family restaurant by the sea on holiday with incredible fresh fish and a bill that was almost nothing; he could never find it again.
recommendations.quote: they just serve you this incredible, fresh, grilled, fried yumminess. And then the bill comes and it's like almost nothing.
recommendations.speaker: Joe Cornish

recommendations.item: Cold grated carrot with crumbly nutty topping
recommendations.reason: He is not a side-dish person, but wants carrot made delicious with crumbs, nuts and bacon flecks.
recommendations.quote: somebody to say, 'I've grated some carrot and put something nice on it.'
recommendations.speaker: Joe Cornish

recommendations.item: Coke Zero
recommendations.reason: He doesn't drink tea or coffee and gets his caffeine from Coke Zero, which he discovered in a writers' room.
recommendations.quote: it tastes really good, Coke Zero. Really good.
recommendations.speaker: Joe Cornish

recommendations.item: Yorkie biscuit and raisin duo (eaten hours later instead of pudding)
recommendations.reason: He skips pudding and buys sweets later, arguing confectionery beats dessert.
recommendations.quote: two and a half hours later I'm having a Yorkie biscuit and raisin duo.
recommendations.speaker: Joe Cornish

episodes.title: Ep 183: Motsi Mabuse
episodes.summary: Motsi Mabuse picks sparkling water with lemon, dark German Vollkornbrot, a shared Italian antipasti platter, a wafer-thin schnitzel and rösti from the Kempinski hotel near her home, Chocolate Block wine and a chocolate fondant (plus crema catalana to share).

recommendations.item: Sparkling water with lemon, ice cubes and glitter
recommendations.reason: She finds still water joyless; sparkling feels like something is happening, the 'Strictly of waters'.
recommendations.quote: Sparkling. Still water is death guys.
recommendations.speaker: Motsi Mabuse

recommendations.item: German Vollkornbrot (dark wholegrain bread) with butter, from a German bakery selection
recommendations.reason: She loves the heavy dark German breads and the huge choice in German bakeries.
recommendations.quote: Healthy, nice, thick and then you have some butter on it. That's amazing when it's freshly done.
recommendations.speaker: Motsi Mabuse

recommendations.item: Italian antipasti platter: tomato and mozzarella, salami, mushrooms, melon with prosciutto, sun-dried tomatoes, fried courgette
recommendations.reason: She loves a house platter she can mix and share with her husband (and all the Strictly judges).
recommendations.quote: Yes, antipasti, exactly but a yummy one.
recommendations.speaker: Motsi Mabuse

recommendations.item: Wafer-thin pork schnitzel with cucumber salad, lingonberry sauce and fries
recommendations.location: Falkenstein, Königstein im Taunus, near Frankfurt, Germany
recommendations.reason: A proper thin, crunchy schnitzel; she wants it from the hotel restaurant near her home, which she says does everything brilliantly.
recommendations.quote: Like, it's thin, thin, thin, thin, thin, and then it's crunchy
recommendations.speaker: Motsi Mabuse

recommendations.item: Potato rösti with fresh truffle to grate over
recommendations.location: Falkenstein, Königstein im Taunus, near Frankfurt, Germany
recommendations.reason: Her favourite rösti comes from this hotel restaurant, which has views over Frankfurt; she adds truffle because she loves anything truffle.
recommendations.quote: So, there's a Kempinski Hotel there and in the Kempinski there's a nice restaurant
recommendations.speaker: Motsi Mabuse

recommendations.item: The Chocolate Block (South African red wine)
recommendations.reason: Her beloved South African wine, rich like drinking velvet; she used to fly bottles over in her suitcase.
recommendations.quote: It's rich and it feels like you're drinking velvet.
recommendations.speaker: Motsi Mabuse

recommendations.item: Chocolate fondant with ice cream, plus crema catalana shared with her husband
recommendations.reason: She sticks with chocolate, and splits a crema catalana with her husband, who always orders an extra pudding.
recommendations.quote: Yes, yes, yes, and he'll probably order something on top, because he does that.
recommendations.speaker: Motsi Mabuse

recommendations.item: Ribs and boozy takeaway daiquiris
recommendations.reason: After missing out on tacos, James ate ribs there late at night that he'd make the side of his US tour dream menu.
recommendations.quote: if I was to make a dream menu of that tour that I had in America, they would be my dream side was these ribs.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Banana pudding
recommendations.reason: James always gets the banana pudding in New York because of Sex and the City.
recommendations.quote: I go to Magnolia Bakery and get the banana pudding all the time
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Artisan chocolate (including Marmite chocolate and brownies)
recommendations.reason: Ed praises the chocolatier's amazing chocolate; James loved his Marmite brownie.
recommendations.quote: He makes amazing chocolate. You should absolutely seek him out
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

episodes.title: Ep 184: Nick Mohammed
episodes.summary: Nick Mohammed builds a very home-style menu: squash water, poppadoms, homemade Doritos tortilla lasagna, an everything-on-the-plate Christmas roast, Riesling with Coke, and a microwaved chocolate fondant stuffed with Terry's Chocolate Orange.

recommendations.item: Still water with ice and Robinson's Orange and Mango squash
recommendations.reason: He drinks squash constantly at home and on set and insists on Robinson's rather than Hi Juice or double concentrate.
recommendations.quote: Still water with ice, with a bit of orange squash on the top of it.
recommendations.speaker: Nick Mohammed

recommendations.item: Poppadoms with dips and onion salad
recommendations.reason: He loves poppadoms because they are close to crisps and you can never fill up on them, with raita and the onion salad from a curry takeaway.
recommendations.quote: I love crisps and popadoms are very close to crisps, and you can never fill up on popadoms, I don't think.
recommendations.speaker: Nick Mohammed

recommendations.item: Tortilla lasagna (layered Doritos, cheese, jalapenos, sour cream); deep-fried mozzarella if eating out
recommendations.reason: A lazy homemade Doritos-and-cheese bake that he and his wife love and the kids refuse. He would order deep-fried mozzarella in a restaurant.
recommendations.quote: It's what I call tortilla lasagna. So, it's basically, it's Doritos.
recommendations.speaker: Nick Mohammed

recommendations.item: Christmas dinner roast with rice, dry lamb, minty Yorkshires, sloppy stuffing and leftover Chinese takeaway
recommendations.reason: It is modelled on the Christmas dinners at his parents' house in Leeds, with Greek and Trinidadian touches and rice alongside everything.
recommendations.quote: I have all of them with rice... my dad's from Trinidad.
recommendations.speaker: Nick Mohammed

recommendations.item: Cauliflower cheese or macaroni cheese
recommendations.reason: He says the main already holds every side, but he'd add cauliflower cheese or macaroni cheese (the kids will eat it too).
recommendations.quote: If I was eating out and it was a roast, I would order, like, cauliflower cheese on the side.
recommendations.speaker: Nick Mohammed

recommendations.item: Very cold Riesling alternated with a glass of Coca-Cola
recommendations.reason: He and his wife found their favourite Riesling (a New Zealand off-dry one) at a tasting run by The Good Wine Shop, and now order Riesling with Coke.
recommendations.quote: We went to a wine tasting at The Good Wine-, they do, like, pop up things in their shops, and it was great.
recommendations.speaker: Nick Mohammed

recommendations.item: Microwaved chocolate fondant with Terry's Chocolate Orange segments in the middle
recommendations.reason: A shop-bought microwave melt-in-the-middle pudding upgraded at home with chocolate orange that melts in the centre.
recommendations.quote: A couple of slices of chocolate orange, shove it in the middle so it melts in the middle of it.
recommendations.speaker: Nick Mohammed

recommendations.item: Sausage, chips and beans (with cheese)
recommendations.reason: The Durham late-night takeaway near Klute where Nick and Ed ended student nights with sausage, chips and beans, garlic sauce included.
recommendations.quote: You'd come out of the club, you'd be very hungry... you'd order sausage, chips and beans, it's the only way to end a night.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

episodes.title: Ep 185: Florence Pugh
episodes.summary: Florence Pugh, a non-water-drinker raised around her dad's Oxford restaurants, picks elderflower presse, a freezing dry Martini, sourdough with tzatziki, a childhood tomato tart, a trio of mains (Greek rabbit stifado, granny's goose, dad's confit duck), Greek salad, tiramisu and a Pret banana cake.

recommendations.item: Elderflower presse with smashed mint (instead of water)
recommendations.reason: She doesn't like water, so swaps in the green, mint-smashed elderflower presse from her dad's restaurant, which she used to order while envying the cocktail drinkers.
recommendations.quote: the way that they make elderflower presses in Café Coco is they smash all the mint in with it and, so, it goes green.
recommendations.speaker: Florence Pugh

recommendations.item: Dry Belvedere vodka Martini, twist, no vermouth, glass from the freezer, with a bowl of olives
recommendations.reason: Pre-meal Martini at a buzzy New York-style bar, with an extra-cold glass and the shaker finished before the glass comes out.
recommendations.quote: a dry Belvedere vodka Martini with a twist, no Vermouth, in an extra cold glass taken from the freezer.
recommendations.speaker: Florence Pugh

recommendations.item: Sourdough with salted butter (visible salt crystals) and proper Greek tzatziki
recommendations.reason: Fresh-from-the-oven sourdough with house-made butter and garlicky tzatziki, as she'd order in Greece.
recommendations.quote: I'll do a sourdough with a salted butter. I hope the restaurant has made their own.
recommendations.speaker: Florence Pugh

recommendations.item: Tomato tart (puff pastry, basil and pine nut pesto, thin sliced tomatoes)
recommendations.location: Oxford, UK (her dad's former restaurant, now closed)
recommendations.reason: A childhood-memory starter from her dad's white-tablecloth restaurant, so simple it shouldn't be that good; she has never found its equal. The restaurant is no longer around.
recommendations.quote: it was, like, a rectangle of puff pastry... a mixture of this basil mush butter with pine nuts... thinly sliced these tomatoes on top
recommendations.speaker: Florence Pugh

recommendations.item: Stifado (rabbit stew) with thin chips, in a big ceramic bowl
recommendations.reason: A homely rabbit stew made by the mother and grandmother of a family taverna that grows its own produce; she wants chips in it like her dad does.
recommendations.quote: it's just come from someone's heart and I like it for those reasons.
recommendations.speaker: Florence Pugh

recommendations.item: Granny's Christmas Day goose
recommendations.reason: Her grandmother's crispy, dark goose is the family favourite.
recommendations.quote: my granny's Christmas Day goose, just the meat of it, because it's our favourite thing and she does it perfectly
recommendations.speaker: Florence Pugh

recommendations.item: Dad's confit duck with creamy mash, raisin red cabbage and dark gravy
recommendations.reason: Her dad sous-vided leftover restaurant confit duck and served it with mash, red cabbage and a winey gravy moat.
recommendations.quote: he sous vide-, it was insane, he was like a mad scientist.
recommendations.speaker: Florence Pugh

recommendations.item: Greek salad with a thick slab of feta, red onion, olives, oregano
recommendations.reason: Traditional Greek salad in a white lipped bowl, undressed so she controls the olive oil, with a big slab of feta rather than cubes.
recommendations.quote: I want real Greek tomatoes, real Greek cucumber. I want olives. I want red onion that burns my face off, and I want a massive slab of feta.
recommendations.speaker: Florence Pugh

recommendations.item: Barolo or Pinot Noir with duck, ice-cold beer with the stifado, another Martini after
recommendations.reason: She pairs a drink with each main, including a beer from the freezer for the stew.
recommendations.quote: with the stifado I think I'm going to do a beer in an iced glass.
recommendations.speaker: Florence Pugh

recommendations.item: Tiramisu, then an affogato with a Lotus biscuit
recommendations.reason: Tiramisu has been her favourite since she was four, homemade or fancy; the affogato needs very cold ice cream so the coffee crisps on top.
recommendations.quote: My favourite dessert is Tiramisu... it's literally been my favourite since I was four-years-old
recommendations.speaker: Florence Pugh

recommendations.item: Espresso Martini, not too sweet
recommendations.reason: Dessert cocktail, with little sugar syrup.
recommendations.quote: I just want, like, a coffee with vodka with a little bit of sugar
recommendations.speaker: Florence Pugh

recommendations.item: Banana cake
recommendations.reason: The one treat her mum allowed; she loves the texture and licking the Pret tissue paper on top.
recommendations.quote: she would let me have a Pret banana cake... Insane. Amazing.
recommendations.speaker: Florence Pugh

recommendations.item: Martinis
recommendations.location: The Connaught Hotel, Mayfair, London, UK
recommendations.reason: Ed and James celebrated James's birthday with about six Martinis and endless bowls of olives here.
recommendations.quote: every time you get a drink they bring a bowl of olives and a bowl of crispy things.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Martinis
recommendations.location: Dukes Hotel, St James's, London, UK
recommendations.reason: Florence recommends it for Martinis (they cap you at two) and the group plans a future trip.
recommendations.quote: I'd love to go and get a Martini.
recommendations.speaker: Florence Pugh

episodes.title: Ep 186: John Kearns
episodes.summary: John Kearns builds a low-lit, booth-filled dream restaurant with tap water in a jug, nineties Sainsbury's focaccia, French onion soup and aubergine parmigiana, butler's steak and poulet au champagne, Pacifico, and kebab-shop baklava with a mum-made profiterole.

recommendations.item: Still tap water in a nice jug
recommendations.reason: He just likes a pint of tap water with food, a habit that amused his Irish nan, and wants it served in a nice jug.
recommendations.quote: My nan couldn't believe how much water me and my brothers drank.
recommendations.speaker: John Kearns

recommendations.item: Warm focaccia with sun-dried tomatoes and rosemary, with Anchor butter
recommendations.reason: The foil-tray focaccia Sainsbury's sold in the nineties, which only appeared when his parents entertained and felt posh, served warm and doughy with lots of salty butter.
recommendations.quote: I'd like the one they sold in Sainsbury's in the nineties... it felt posh, it felt crazy, it would come out the oven warm.
recommendations.speaker: John Kearns

recommendations.item: French onion soup
recommendations.reason: Slow-sweated sweet onions, croutons and melted cheese, eaten with bread dipped in, in a dream restaurant where he can peek at chefs through a door ajar.
recommendations.quote: These onions have been sweated and I'm not talking, like, five minutes. Hour.
recommendations.speaker: John Kearns

recommendations.item: Aubergine parmigiana (small plate)
recommendations.reason: One of his own signature dishes, layered with tomato sauce, basil and loads of parmesan, as a little square beside the soup.
recommendations.quote: Layer it up like a lasagne, like a jigsaw.
recommendations.speaker: John Kearns

recommendations.item: Medium-rare butler's steak with chips
recommendations.reason: A flavourful, quick-cooking flat iron cut with chips served standing up in a tin for grabbing.
recommendations.quote: It's flat iron steak. So, it's from the shoulder... Cheaper cut, but very flavourful.
recommendations.speaker: John Kearns

recommendations.item: Poulet au champagne
recommendations.reason: Chicken thighs in a creamy champagne and mushroom sauce, mainly for dipping the chips.
recommendations.quote: I'm dipping the chips in that little champagne sauce.
recommendations.speaker: John Kearns

recommendations.item: Creamed spinach
recommendations.reason: Rich, salty spinach reminiscent of his nan's vegetable patch; Ed notes Hawksmoor does a great one.
recommendations.quote: My other nan, she had great-, a great vegetable patch, and growing up all I'd eat is spinach.
recommendations.speaker: John Kearns

recommendations.item: Pacifico lager
recommendations.reason: Crisp, light Mexican lager he picked by scrolling the Sainsbury's beer list, to go with the meal.
recommendations.quote: it's Mexican, it's crisp, it's light, and I thought that might be quite nice with this meal.
recommendations.speaker: John Kearns

recommendations.item: Baklava, dripping with syrup
recommendations.venue: His local kebab shop (the 'boys with tongs')
recommendations.reason: The tub of four syrupy, chewy, nutty baklava at his local kebab shop, which he and his friend Ian visit as a naughty treat; shop not named.
recommendations.quote: I just like it oozing with syrup, chewy, nutty.
recommendations.speaker: John Kearns

recommendations.item: Plain profiterole with whipped cream and hot chocolate poured over
recommendations.reason: His mum's homemade profiteroles that he and his brothers helped assemble, finished with hot chocolate poured at the table like the posh Florence restaurant.
recommendations.quote: my mum used to make her own profiteroles
recommendations.speaker: John Kearns

recommendations.item: Black Americano
recommendations.reason: Black coffee alongside dessert.
recommendations.quote: I'd like the black coffee with my dessert please.
recommendations.speaker: John Kearns

recommendations.item: Remy Martin cognac with the receipt
recommendations.reason: A cognac to see him off, recalling a sip from a hip flask at the Remy Martin visit in France when he was sunburnt aged thirteen.
recommendations.quote: With the receipt, nice Cognac to see you on your way.
recommendations.speaker: John Kearns

recommendations.item: Creamed spinach
recommendations.reason: Ed says Hawksmoor does a fantastic creamed spinach; John agrees it is heavy with cream (though his steak order there was a costly surprise).
recommendations.quote: I tell you where does a fantastic creamed spinach John... Hawksmoor.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Stained glass booths
recommendations.location: Great Victoria Street, Belfast, Northern Ireland
recommendations.reason: John wants booths like those at the Northern Irish pub; James had hoped to visit it for its reputation.
recommendations.quote: Like, there's a pub in Northern Ireland which has-, ... Yes, the stained glass booths.
recommendations.speaker: John Kearns

episodes.title: Ep 187: Lily Allen
episodes.summary: Lily Allen's chicken-heavy high-low menu: weak peach Robinson's barley water, poppadoms with all the dips, Dorian's chicken liver parfait soldiers, a Harrods food hall chicken tikka wrap, chicken and yoghurt with moong dal and pumpkin from Afghan Kitchen, The Ivy's cauliflower gratin, a Hendrick's G&T and McDonald's soft serve with chocolate sauce.

recommendations.item: Robinson's peach barley water squash, made weak (still, room temperature)
recommendations.reason: Still because bubbles upset her digestion; the peach barley squash is the only thing she'll drink to hydrate and she has it shipped to the US.
recommendations.quote: It's that Robinson's Barley Water squash with the peach flavouring in... So good.
recommendations.speaker: Lily Allen

recommendations.item: Poppadoms with mango chutney, onions, lime pickle and mint sauce on a mini lazy Susan
recommendations.reason: She prefers ordinary, non-posh poppadoms that disintegrate in your hand, with all the dips.
recommendations.quote: I'd prefer just like, you know, those ones that just disintegrate in your hand.
recommendations.speaker: Lily Allen

recommendations.item: Chicken liver parfait piped onto toast soldiers (amuse-bouche)
recommendations.reason: A restaurant she's been to whenever in London since it opened; the rich parfait on a soldier is a pre-starter.
recommendations.quote: they have these delicious chicken liver parfait... They put it onto a soldier.
recommendations.speaker: Lily Allen

recommendations.item: Chicken tikka wrap with pomegranate, coriander, onions and extra green chillies
recommendations.reason: Her post-gym treat from a counter in the food hall, made in front of her and eaten on the steps outside.
recommendations.quote: there's this little counter where they do chicken tikka wraps... they're absolutely delicious and they feel very naughty.
recommendations.speaker: Lily Allen

recommendations.item: Chicken and yoghurt with rice, moong dal and pumpkin with yoghurt
recommendations.reason: Probably her favourite London restaurant; owner-chef Habib, who gave her bus money as a schoolgirl, still makes the same few dishes daily.
recommendations.quote: you'll eat and it will be one of your favourite places you've ever been and you'll think, 'Why the hell didn't I do this ten years ago?'
recommendations.speaker: Lily Allen

recommendations.item: Cauliflower gratin (cauliflower cheese)
recommendations.location: West Street, Covent Garden, London, UK
recommendations.reason: She loves cauliflower cheese in her weekly roasts, and orders The Ivy's breadcrumbed gratin when she's in theatreland.
recommendations.quote: I sometimes go to The Ivy... They have cauliflower gratin, which is cauliflower cheese, basically.
recommendations.speaker: Lily Allen

recommendations.item: Hendrick's gin and tonic with a swirl of cucumber
recommendations.reason: As a recovering alcoholic she misses the taste most - thirst-quenching and classic with cucumber.
recommendations.quote: Hendricks gin and tonic with a bit of, like, a swirly bit of cucumber.
recommendations.speaker: Lily Allen

recommendations.item: Soft-serve ice cream with hot chocolate fudge sauce
recommendations.reason: The one fast food she'll eat, usually on road trips; she likes its reliable consistency and simplicity after a heavy meal.
recommendations.quote: Soft-serve ice cream with the chocolate sauce.
recommendations.speaker: Lily Allen

episodes.title: Ep 188: Alex Jones
episodes.summary: Alex Jones has a gin and tonic with Signet gin and blood orange, a chip butty, prawn cocktail, her mum's corned beef pie, dauphinoise potatoes from Bob Bob Ricard, a Bloody Mary and Bread & Butter Chardonnay, then Eton Mess.

recommendations.item: Gin and tonic with Signet gin, blood orange slice and lots of ice
recommendations.reason: She skips water for a botanical Swansea-made gin and tonic, thirst-quenching and best with plenty of ice and a slice of blood orange.
recommendations.quote: it's made in Swansea and I'm not just saying that because I'm born there. It's called Signet gin, that's very nice, very botanical.
recommendations.speaker: Alex Jones

recommendations.item: Chip butty (fresh bread with salty butter, originally)
recommendations.reason: She adores plain fresh bread with salty butter, and ends up swapping in a chip butty as her bread course.
recommendations.quote: there's nothing nicer in the world than fresh bread with salty butter. What's not to love?
recommendations.speaker: Alex Jones

recommendations.item: Prawn cocktail with Marie Rose sauce, iceberg, paprika and triangle toast
recommendations.reason: A proper 1970s prawn cocktail, which she makes every Christmas Day as the family starter.
recommendations.quote: Crispy iceberg lettuce, proper, proper 70s. Triangle bread, toast. Paprika on top.
recommendations.speaker: Alex Jones

recommendations.item: Corned beef pie
recommendations.reason: Her mum's comforting corned beef, onion and mash pie in pastry, served with veg and gravy or cold with ketchup the next day.
recommendations.quote: this is comfort food personified.
recommendations.speaker: Alex Jones

recommendations.item: Dauphinoise potatoes
recommendations.reason: She had delicious creamy dauphinoise at the Soho restaurant famous for its champagne button on every table.
recommendations.quote: I had some delicious dauphinoise potatoes there.
recommendations.speaker: Alex Jones

recommendations.item: Bloody Mary, no lemon
recommendations.reason: A Bloody Mary as a snack-like aperitif after the gin and tonic, only when hungry.
recommendations.quote: I only order a Bloody Mary if I'm hungry
recommendations.speaker: Alex Jones

recommendations.item: Bread & Butter Chardonnay
recommendations.reason: A Californian Chardonnay she was given for her birthday after Michelle Keegan recommended it on the podcast; she'd want a spare bottle in reserve.
recommendations.quote: It's a Chardonnay. I think it's Californian, Bread & Butter, it's delicious.
recommendations.speaker: Alex Jones

recommendations.item: Eton Mess
recommendations.reason: She loves cream, crunch and berries together, and a good Eton Mess has all of it.
recommendations.quote: it's got crunch, it's got berries... but it's got masses of cream
recommendations.speaker: Alex Jones

recommendations.item: Rissole, chips and curry sauce
recommendations.reason: Cardiff's late-night chip shop strip is where she'd get rissole, chips, curry sauce and loads of vinegar at 3am.
recommendations.quote: rissole, chips, curry sauce, tonnes of vinegar, oh, my mouth is watering.
recommendations.speaker: Alex Jones

recommendations.item: Cut-up sausages with sauerkraut and crispy onions
recommendations.reason: James loves a box of chopped sausage with sauerkraut and crispy onions as a quick bite after gigs.
recommendations.quote: All cut-up, crispy onions on there too. Delicious.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Eclairs
recommendations.reason: Recommended by Jay Rayner, their eclairs had a firmer creme patissiere filling; the shop has since closed.
recommendations.quote: it was a place in Soho, it's gone now.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

episodes.title: Ep 189: Róisín Murphy
episodes.summary: Róisín Murphy goes for classics: sparkling Vichy water, German bread and sourdough with Irish butter, courgette flowers and risotto Milanese, steak tartare with French fries, Krug and a Gavi-area red, and a Paris chocolate mousse.

recommendations.item: Sparkling Vichy water
recommendations.reason: She likes the saltiness and how bubbles cut through the dirt on the tongue and ready the palate.
recommendations.quote: it cuts the, let's say, dirt off of your tongue and your mouth before you start eating
recommendations.speaker: Roisin Murphy

recommendations.item: German bread selection and sourdough with grass-fed Irish butter
recommendations.reason: She loves bread and butter, especially grass-fed Irish butter, with a wide German selection plus sourdough.
recommendations.quote: I like German selections of bread, they do a great selection... but I do obviously love a good sourdough
recommendations.speaker: Roisin Murphy

recommendations.item: Fried courgette flowers stuffed with ricotta, with honey
recommendations.reason: Delicate crisp batter around ricotta-stuffed flowers, with a little honey drizzle.
recommendations.quote: the flower, and stuffed, and dipped in and out of the fry, it's good
recommendations.speaker: Roisin Murphy

recommendations.item: Risotto alla Milanese
recommendations.reason: A classic saffron risotto, a nod to her Milanese partner; she once had a gold-topped version in Madrid.
recommendations.quote: It's a classic of classics.
recommendations.speaker: Roisin Murphy

recommendations.item: Steak tartare with egg yolk and pickles
recommendations.reason: A classic she loves, with raw egg yolk and pickles, ideally made table side.
recommendations.quote: Oh god I love it, a bit of egg as well and the pickle
recommendations.speaker: Roisin Murphy

recommendations.item: French fries (pommes frites)
recommendations.reason: Classic fries with tartare, a little thicker than McDonald's; the best she has had were in Paris.
recommendations.quote: Probably in France, in Paris.
recommendations.speaker: Roisin Murphy

recommendations.item: Krug champagne
recommendations.reason: She had a meal with vintage Krug and found it worked with everything, with no hangover.
recommendations.quote: it worked with everything
recommendations.speaker: Roisin Murphy

recommendations.item: La Chiara Dolcetto red wine from her partner's stepfather's vineyard in Gavi
recommendations.reason: A light red from the family vineyard to go with the steak tartare, where you can almost pick a meal off the trees and vines.
recommendations.quote: It's the Dolcetto grape, which is similar to Barbera.
recommendations.speaker: Roisin Murphy

recommendations.item: Simple chocolate mousse
recommendations.reason: The best dessert she has had, in a classic old Parisian canteen-style restaurant Jarvis Cocker took her to; she cannot remember its name. Perfect texture and temperature.
recommendations.quote: it made me cry. It was perfect consistency
recommendations.speaker: Roisin Murphy

episodes.title: Ep 190: Kiell Smith-Bynoe
episodes.summary: Kiell Smith-Bynoe orders still water with cucumber, Jamaican hard dough bread, P.F. Chang's dynamite shrimp, confit duck leg with dauphinoise and honey-roast veg, creamed spinach, a cherry vanilla Old Fashioned and an M&S Black Forest gateau on his birthday.

recommendations.item: Still water with cucumber slices
recommendations.reason: He thinks sparkling water is 'bullshit' after being ambushed by it at a Ghosts cast lunch; someone showing him cucumber in water changed his world.
recommendations.quote: Still. Sparkling's bullshit.
recommendations.speaker: Kiell Smith-Bynoe

recommendations.item: Jamaican hard dough bread with butter
recommendations.reason: Dense, slightly sweet, buttery-tasting bread from his childhood, great with butter, corned beef and hot pepper sauce or a Jamaican breakfast.
recommendations.quote: Favourite bread is hard dough bread. Ever heard of hard dough bread? You've got to get into that man.
recommendations.speaker: Kiell Smith-Bynoe

recommendations.item: Dynamite shrimp in a big cocktail glass
recommendations.reason: Shrimp in a creamy, spicy, five-spice sauce he's tried and failed to recreate; he picks it over Busaba's calamari so as not to copy Edgar Wright.
recommendations.quote: They do a dynamite shrimp and it comes in a cocktail glass, a big cocktail glass
recommendations.speaker: Kiell Smith-Bynoe

recommendations.item: Confit duck leg with dauphinoise potatoes, honey-roast carrots and parsnips
recommendations.reason: His rule is to order duck whenever it's on a menu; this plate combines all his favourite foods.
recommendations.quote: Duck and dauphinoise, I can't ignore that on a menu.
recommendations.speaker: Kiell Smith-Bynoe

recommendations.item: Creamed spinach
recommendations.reason: Normally he'd choose mac and cheese, but with cheesy dauphinoise that would be too much, and cheese late at night gives him nightmares.
recommendations.quote: I think I would go cream spinach because, usually, in any other scenario, my dream side will always be mac and cheese.
recommendations.speaker: Kiell Smith-Bynoe

recommendations.item: Cherry vanilla Old Fashioned
recommendations.reason: He loves sweet drinks and had this at a nice new bar in Wanstead that has since become a pizza place; he's never seen it anywhere else.
recommendations.quote: I really hope that somewhere will do them again because I've never seen a cherry vanilla old fashioned anywhere.
recommendations.speaker: Kiell Smith-Bynoe

recommendations.item: Tequila and apple juice ('The KSB')
recommendations.reason: A special mention for a sweet drink he claims as his own invention.
recommendations.quote: Tequila, apple juice, it's the one. London Hughes will say that she invented it, she's full of shit.
recommendations.speaker: Kiell Smith-Bynoe

recommendations.item: M&S Black Forest gateau, on his birthday
recommendations.reason: Since about age 13 his mum made it his birthday tradition, and he couldn't wait for it every year.
recommendations.quote: My mum was like, 'This is his thing. One his birthday, it's an M&S black forest gateau,' and I could not wait for that.
recommendations.speaker: Kiell Smith-Bynoe

recommendations.item: Krispy Kreme doughnut burger with bacon, cheese and egg (his 'death row meal')
recommendations.reason: A former girlfriend made one for him on Valentine's Day; it's what he'd eat going out all guns blazing.
recommendations.quote: That's my death row meal.
recommendations.speaker: Kiell Smith-Bynoe

recommendations.item: Thai calamari
recommendations.reason: He calls it the best calamari out there, a view James shares.
recommendations.quote: I love calamari. I think the best calamari out there has got to be Busaba.
recommendations.speaker: Kiell Smith-Bynoe

recommendations.item: Confit duck with mash
recommendations.reason: One of the best restaurants he's ever been to, by the castle in Lisbon; the duck meal is in his top five ever.
recommendations.quote: It was Chapito A Mesa in Lisbon and it was in a castle.
recommendations.speaker: Kiell Smith-Bynoe

recommendations.item: Surf and turf (whole Mexican lobster and beef fillet)
recommendations.reason: The best surf and turf, lobster and steak he's ever had, though it cost $300.
recommendations.quote: surf and turf, that surf and turf I had in Taboo, in Cancun, wow.
recommendations.speaker: Kiell Smith-Bynoe

recommendations.item: Dinner and rum Old Fashioneds
recommendations.reason: Angela Hartnett's restaurant where he ate with the hosts; the food was great and the rum Old Fashioneds greater.
recommendations.quote: No, the food was great, and the rum old fashioneds greater.
recommendations.speaker: Kiell Smith-Bynoe

recommendations.item: Creamed spinach (lockdown delivery box)
recommendations.reason: Ed calls it the best steak restaurant, and its finely chopped, nutmeg-heavy creamed spinach phenomenal; James ate a whole box in one go.
recommendations.quote: they would put in the boxes, their creamed spinach, which you just warmed up in a pan, and it is phenomenal.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Pulled pork and nduja doughnut
recommendations.reason: A barbecue hatch in Hackney whose pulled pork doughnut with nduja and crackling is one of the best things Ed has ever tasted.
recommendations.quote: had their del pierro pulled pork doughnut, which is one of the best things I have ever tasted in my life.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Thai prawn crackers
recommendations.reason: James was so excited by the prawn crackers there that he texted everyone he knew.
recommendations.quote: I was like, 'You've got to go to Tao Tao Ju, the crackers here are fucking off the chain, they're amazing.'
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

episodes.title: Ep 191: Paul Feig
episodes.summary: Paul Feig opens with a lemon-twist gin martini, then sparkling water, tortilla chips and salsa, aubergine parm from Capri, garlic shrimp from Gardens of Taxco, Cocotte ratatouille, a Sgroppino and a butterscotch sundae on a Bridesmaids-style plane.

recommendations.item: Gin martini with a lemon twist (made with his own Artingstall's gin)
recommendations.reason: His pre-meal drink: gin with a few drops of dry vermouth, very cold, with a bright lemon twist rather than olives.
recommendations.quote: I like a lemon twist on top because I like a bright martini versus, I think olives sort of drag it down sometimes.
recommendations.speaker: Paul Feig

recommendations.item: Sparkling water (aggressively fizzy New York seltzer)
recommendations.reason: He wants proper aggressive bubbles, not anaemic sparkling water.
recommendations.quote: I like good old fashioned like, New York seltzer water. That's like super aggressive, you know, just makes your tongue kind of come alive.
recommendations.speaker: Paul Feig

recommendations.item: Tortilla chips and salsa
recommendations.reason: Longtime favourite Mexican restaurant with no written menu; the waiter recites it with the same jokes every visit, which he loves.
recommendations.quote: their big thing was they had no written menus. The guy would come over and would recite this menu to you but it had jokes in it
recommendations.speaker: Paul Feig

recommendations.item: Eggplant (aubergine) parmigiana in thin ribbons
recommendations.reason: Discovered on his 60th birthday trip; the aubergine was cut into micro ribbons, layered lasagne-style and incredibly light.
recommendations.quote: they had an eggplant parm that was unbelievable... they had cut the eggplant into these ribbons, like, micro ribbons. So, the whole thing was so light
recommendations.speaker: Paul Feig

recommendations.item: Garlic shrimp
recommendations.reason: Curled shrimp in a thick, tomato-based garlic sauce, and generous portions.
recommendations.quote: They make a garlic shrimp that is unbelievable... in this very kind of thick garlic sauce that's tomato based, and it's just so amazingly good.
recommendations.speaker: Paul Feig

recommendations.item: Ratatouille
recommendations.reason: Chunky, tender, spicy ratatouille in a rich tomato sauce, served hot; the chips are his backup side.
recommendations.quote: it's the sauce that it's in... very flavourful, extra flavourful... it's just tender and, you know, it always arrives really hot
recommendations.speaker: Paul Feig

recommendations.item: Chips with herbs
recommendations.reason: His secondary side choice; they are herby and weirdly travel well for delivery.
recommendations.quote: their chips are fantastic. You know, they put herbs on top of them
recommendations.speaker: Paul Feig

recommendations.item: Sgroppino (vodka, lemon sorbet, cream)
recommendations.reason: He picked the Sgroppino over a Grasshopper and a Perfect Manhattan; he says Lucio makes a great one.
recommendations.quote: Actually, you know where they make a great one is at Lucio on Fulham Rd.
recommendations.speaker: Paul Feig

recommendations.item: Butterscotch sundae on a plane with the Bridesmaids cast
recommendations.reason: Inspired by first-class sundaes on American Airlines: vanilla ice cream and hot butterscotch, on a film-set plane.
recommendations.quote: I would just want like a butterscotch sundae. Just a straight up, you know, great vanilla ice cream, really good hot butterscotch.
recommendations.speaker: Paul Feig

recommendations.item: Frogs' legs Provencal style
recommendations.reason: Considered as a starter: graphic Provencal frogs' legs cut off at the waist.
recommendations.quote: from a place called Chez L'Ami Louis in Paris, and they make them Provencal style
recommendations.speaker: Paul Feig

recommendations.item: Passion fruit souffle and frogs' legs
recommendations.reason: Frogs' legs in New York, and an amazing passion fruit souffle he considered for dessert.
recommendations.quote: they make this amazing passion fruit souffle that's so good, and then they pour this, like, passion fruit, you know, syrup in the middle of it.
recommendations.speaker: Paul Feig

recommendations.item: Tortilla soup
recommendations.reason: Considered as a starter: unbelievable tortilla soup.
recommendations.quote: at The Polo Lounge, in LA, they have this tortilla soup, which is unbelievable.
recommendations.speaker: Paul Feig

recommendations.item: Polo Burger and seared corned beef sandwich starter
recommendations.reason: Considered for main and starter: the big thick Polo Burger with fries, and a pan-seared corned beef sandwich with hot deli mustard.
recommendations.quote: at the Polo Bar in New York they have the Polo Burger, which is just this amazing hamburger.
recommendations.speaker: Paul Feig

recommendations.item: Stuffed pepper
recommendations.reason: Family-run restaurant in a sea cave, reached by walking across the island, with mama's stuffed pepper.
recommendations.quote: there's another place in Capri that I love called Le Grotelle, which is you walk all the way over the island and it's up like in a sea cave, it's gorgeous.
recommendations.speaker: Paul Feig

recommendations.item: Littleneck clams and oysters
recommendations.location: Grand Central Terminal, New York, USA
recommendations.reason: Small littleneck clams soaked in hot cocktail sauce.
recommendations.quote: like at the Oyster Bar in Grand Central Station in New York, they're great because it's small
recommendations.speaker: Paul Feig

recommendations.item: Martinis (head bartender Alessandro Palazzi)
recommendations.reason: Famous for theatrical martinis; Paul is friends with the head bartender.
recommendations.quote: my friends Alessandro Palazzi, who's the head bartender at Duke's
recommendations.speaker: Paul Feig

episodes.title: Ep 192: Helen Bauer
episodes.summary: Helen Bauer's dream menu: medium sparkling Gerolsteiner, fladenbrot with melted butter from a draught pump, prawn puri (Apollo Banana Leaf), customised Domino's stuffed-crust pizza, fattoush, Diet Coke from the fountain, and a warm choc chip muffin with Split gelato and a Maltesers Bunny.

recommendations.item: Medium sparkling Gerolsteiner water in a returnable glass bottle
recommendations.reason: Having lived in Germany she loves the standard German sparkling water culture, with levels of fizz and returnable glass bottles.
recommendations.quote: let's go for the proper Gerolsteiner, like classic fucking, big glass bottle that I can put back in and get money back for.
recommendations.speaker: Helen Bauer

recommendations.item: Fladenbrot (soft sesame Turkish bread, as with German doner kebabs) with melted clarified butter from a draught pump, plus crumpets with Marmite
recommendations.reason: She wants soft, pillowy bread that needs no effort, dipped in hot melted butter rather than spread.
recommendations.quote: I like soft bread. I don't want to have to work for it.
recommendations.speaker: Helen Bauer

recommendations.item: Prawn puri
recommendations.reason: A Sri Lankan place with a loose, improvised menu and guessed bill, where she has never been refused a prawn puri; she loves it as the ultimate greedy starter of curry plus fried bread.
recommendations.quote: There's an amazing one in South London called Apollo Banana Leaf. It's like a Sri Lankan restaurant... I have never been turned away with a prawn puri there, ever.
recommendations.speaker: Helen Bauer

recommendations.item: Large stuffed crust pizza with canned pineapple, olives, jalapenos and Parma ham, with garlic and herb dip
recommendations.reason: Domino's was a forbidden treat growing up and she is hopelessly addicted to the stuffed crust and the garlic and herb dip, though she customises it with nicer toppings.
recommendations.quote: I medically can't be without it... I'm a stuffed crust baby until I die. I want the double mozzarella cheese.
recommendations.speaker: Helen Bauer

recommendations.item: Fattoush
recommendations.reason: A fresh, herby salad to cut through the pizza, inspired by the piled-high takeaway fattoush from Lebanese restaurants in Berlin where she used to live; she did not name the specific place.
recommendations.quote: Fattoush is so fresh. I love it.
recommendations.speaker: Helen Bauer

recommendations.item: Diet Coke from the fountain
recommendations.reason: Fizzy drinks cut through the Domino's grease; she ranks fountain above can above bottle.
recommendations.quote: I need to cut through the grease somehow, I need to cut through it.
recommendations.speaker: Helen Bauer

recommendations.item: Bottle of Rioja with four rolled Golden Virginia cigarettes rolled by her friend Francis
recommendations.reason: She wants to be a bit drunk throughout the meal on a Spanish red.
recommendations.quote: Spanish red, like, a Rioja.
recommendations.speaker: Helen Bauer

recommendations.item: Warm choc chip muffin topped with pistachio and hazelnut gelato and a crushed Maltesers Bunny, with a sparkler
recommendations.reason: She found the best ice cream of her life here in Split and went three times with a friend, later vindicated when Stanley Tucci visited; the muffin sundae idea comes from the old BB's Muffins chain in her hometown.
recommendations.quote: I want the pistachio ice cream, and hazelnut ice cream, and I want that on top of the muffin, and I want to leave it for a bit and have it melted in.
recommendations.speaker: Helen Bauer

recommendations.item: Skillets of brioche-style bread with melted butter and bacon or shrimp
recommendations.reason: Ed recommends its bread served with skillets of melted butter, which matches Helen's dream of dipping bread in butter.
recommendations.quote: they do a bread that comes in a skillet and it's like, brioche type bread... then they bring another skillet with just melted butter in it with loads of bacon in it as well.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: The Bruce cake
recommendations.reason: Ed raves about this huge Bruce Bogtrotter-style chocolate cake sold by the slice.
recommendations.quote: it's insane. It's brilliant but it took me about four to five settings to eat the whole slice.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

episodes.title: Ep 193: Arlo Parks
episodes.summary: Arlo Parks picks a sunny LA-and-Mexico menu: sparkling water with lime, rosemary focaccia, burrata and tomato salad from Speranza, carnitas tacos from Guisados, elote, fresh orange juice and pumpkin pie from House of Pies.

recommendations.item: Sparkling water, no ice, with a wedge of lime to squeeze herself
recommendations.reason: She hated sparkling water for half her life, then woke up one day loving the little tingle; she wants to squeeze the lime herself.
recommendations.quote: I feel like I just like the little tingle it gives me.
recommendations.speaker: Arlo Parks

recommendations.item: Warm focaccia with rosemary, salt and black pepper
recommendations.reason: Her favourite bread, warm with rosemary and seasoning.
recommendations.quote: Warm with, like, a bit of rosemary on top, and, like, some-, Yes, some salt and black pepper.
recommendations.speaker: Arlo Parks

recommendations.item: Tomato and burrata salad with basil, black pepper and olive oil
recommendations.reason: She loves simple, comforting Italian food and Speranza's homemade pasta and Italian cooking.
recommendations.quote: There's a restaurant in LA called Speranza that is really really good Italian food, and I love that, and all the pasta's home made.
recommendations.speaker: Arlo Parks

recommendations.item: Slow-cooked carnitas tacos with guacamole, black beans, coriander and pico de gallo
recommendations.reason: A hole-in-the-wall taco spot with tortillas made fresh every morning; she eats there for lunch at the studio almost daily.
recommendations.quote: they make the tortillas fresh every morning and it's just, like, a nice little hole in the wall spot, my favourite one's the one at Echo Park
recommendations.speaker: Arlo Parks

recommendations.item: Elote (Mexican street corn) on the cob
recommendations.reason: Corn with cheese, coriander, crema and butter, a little spicy.
recommendations.quote: They've got, like, coriander and they've got crema fresca and butter and it's just a nice little side
recommendations.speaker: Arlo Parks

recommendations.item: Fresh orange juice
recommendations.reason: She just wants fresh orange juice, ideally in the sun.
recommendations.quote: My dream drink, I feel like I would just go for, like, fresh orange juice, that's it.
recommendations.speaker: Arlo Parks

recommendations.item: Pumpkin pie with vanilla ice cream
recommendations.reason: Open until 3am with around 55 pies; she has pie after nights out and even schedules deliveries for when she gets home.
recommendations.quote: There's this place called House of Pies where you can get pies till, like, 3:00am, that's after a night out
recommendations.speaker: Arlo Parks

recommendations.item: Avocado baby rolls
recommendations.reason: Her go-to order, since she is allergic to fish; it was what she had on the day of recording.
recommendations.quote: I always have just the avocado baby rolls, because I can't have fish, I'm allergic.
recommendations.speaker: Arlo Parks

episodes.title: Ep 194: Tim Minchin
episodes.summary: Sparkling water, warm baguette, chicken liver pate with onion jam, rare fillet steak with tenderstem and sprouts, mac and cheese, heavy Australian red, apricot crumble then cheese and a lager.

recommendations.item: Sparkling water
recommendations.reason: Marks the start of a proper dinner ritual and cleanses the palate.
recommendations.quote: It marks that you're embarking on a ritual.
recommendations.speaker: Tim Minchin

recommendations.item: Warm fluffy-crusty baguette
recommendations.reason: White, very fluffy, crispy baguette served warm.
recommendations.quote: White, very fluffy, really crispy, like a baguette
recommendations.speaker: Tim Minchin

recommendations.item: Chicken liver pate with caramelised onion jam and baguette
recommendations.reason: Buttery, simple liver pate with sticky onion jam, his one meaty indulgence.
recommendations.quote: really buttery pate, no complexity... caramelised onion jam and then, yes, just a baguette
recommendations.speaker: Tim Minchin

recommendations.item: Rare fillet steak with tenderstem broccoli and fried Brussels sprouts
recommendations.reason: A fist-sized, high-quality fillet, medium rare, lightly charred, no sauce.
recommendations.quote: a fist of meat, and quite rare, but not too rare, really high-quality fillet
recommendations.speaker: Tim Minchin

recommendations.item: Mac and cheese
recommendations.reason: Slightly burnt on top, runny and saucy underneath, maybe with a little blue cheese.
recommendations.quote: slightly burnt on the top and crunch your way through. But when you scoop it out it's all runny
recommendations.speaker: Tim Minchin

recommendations.item: Heavy dry Australian red (Shiraz or Cabernet)
recommendations.reason: Likes heavy, high-alcohol Aussie reds to make the feelings go.
recommendations.quote: I like heavy reds with high alcohol content to make the feelings go.
recommendations.speaker: Tim Minchin

recommendations.item: Apricot crumble with ice cream, then cheeseboard, sticky wine and a lager
recommendations.reason: Oaty, slightly burnt crumble; his mum used to make one.
recommendations.quote: my Mum used to make an apricot crumble.
recommendations.speaker: Tim Minchin

episodes.title: Ep 195: Judi Love
episodes.summary: Judi Love's fancy dream menu: sparkling water, soft sourdough with President butter, a seafood platter, venison and lobster surf and turf with fondant potatoes and spinach, rose champagne and Chapel Down sparkling, and The Ivy's thin apple tart.

recommendations.item: Sparkling water
recommendations.reason: She is a sparkling water girl, though she gets tangled on how to pronounce it.
recommendations.quote: Oh, sparkling. I am a sparkling girl.
recommendations.speaker: Judi Love

recommendations.item: Soft, fresh-baked sourdough or Turkish-shop bread with President salted butter
recommendations.reason: Wants soft, thick, freshly baked bread (like from a Turkish shop) with a nice crust and salty President butter, not tooth-breaking crispy sourdough.
recommendations.quote: I like bread that's just baked, you usually get them in a nice Turkish shop, and it's got a nice crust to it. Oh, with a good bit of butter.
recommendations.speaker: Judi Love

recommendations.item: Seafood platter: pan-baked scallops, king prawns, yellowtail ceviche, caviar, with pickled cucumber and beetroot
recommendations.reason: A luxurious shellfish platter with butter, a big portion rather than bite-sized starters.
recommendations.quote: Paid my money, I want my food. Don't want some bite sized starters.
recommendations.speaker: Judi Love

recommendations.item: Surf and turf: venison with lobster
recommendations.reason: Venison cooked medium-well so it's soft and melts like butter, with a bit of lobster on the side.
recommendations.quote: it's got to be soft, melt in your mouth like butter.
recommendations.speaker: Judi Love

recommendations.item: Sauteed spinach and fondant potatoes (plus heritage carrots)
recommendations.reason: Buttery vegetables and fondant potatoes to go with the venison.
recommendations.quote: I'd like that with some vegetables, some sauteed spinach.
recommendations.speaker: Judi Love

recommendations.item: Rose champagne
recommendations.reason: Rich food deserves something fruity and expensive; she can't remember the brand but picks it up at Majestic.
recommendations.quote: there's certain food that's so nice that it just has to be washed down with something that is fruitful and expensive.
recommendations.speaker: Judi Love

recommendations.item: Chapel Down Bacchus sparkling white wine
recommendations.reason: The English wine she really likes: light, appley, refreshing and easy to drink, great with fish or on a summer afternoon.
recommendations.quote: it's light, it's smooth... it's great with fish and all the rest of it, but you definitely could have it just on a summer afternoon
recommendations.speaker: Judi Love

recommendations.item: Thin apple tart with honeycomb popping candy, vanilla ice cream and flamed brandy
recommendations.location: West Street, Covent Garden, London, UK
recommendations.reason: She had it the day before and it was so good she wants to go back: thin pastry, caramelised apple, popping candy and flambeed brandy that recalls toffee apples and childhood.
recommendations.quote: It was absolutely divine, and it was very thin pastry, beautiful caramelised apple... and then they had some brandy or something and they flamed it and poured it over.
recommendations.speaker: Judi Love

recommendations.item: Guinness (stout) punch ice cream
recommendations.reason: Her own Celebrity MasterChef creation based on Jamaican Guinness punch, with rum and cream; added alongside the apple tart.
recommendations.quote: Yes, with my Guinness punch ice cream.
recommendations.speaker: Judi Love

episodes.title: Ep 196: Toheeb Jimoh
episodes.summary: Toheeb Jimoh picks still water, soft Nigerian agege bread with salted butter, gizdodo from Enish, his mum's tomato-stew penne with assorted meats, truffle beef ragu mac and cheese from Balan's, bottled Nigerian Fanta and a carrot cake his dad used to bring home from work.

recommendations.item: Still water
recommendations.reason: He passionately prefers still water and finds sparkling water baffling.
recommendations.quote: Still water to the death, man. Sparkling water's one of the worst things on the planet
recommendations.speaker: Toheeb Jimoh

recommendations.item: Agege bread with salted butter
recommendations.reason: Nigerian soft loaf, soft all the way through, that he ate growing up; he is only recently converted to salted butter.
recommendations.quote: agege bread is, like, the gold standard of bread for me.
recommendations.speaker: Toheeb Jimoh

recommendations.item: Gizdodo (plantain and chicken gizzard in spicy tomato sauce)
recommendations.reason: His staple starter at this small Nigerian restaurant with Afrobeats playing, where he goes on his birthday; it inspired the vibe of Sam's restaurant in Ted Lasso.
recommendations.quote: There's a Nigerian restaurant that I go to a lot called Enish, and that's my staple starter at Enish
recommendations.speaker: Toheeb Jimoh

recommendations.item: Penne in spicy tomato stew with assorted meats and fish
recommendations.reason: His mum's Saturday-lunchtime pasta that takes him back to childhood Xbox sessions with his brother.
recommendations.quote: that's my meal because it's transporting me back to 08, back when life was good, no bills, no taxes.
recommendations.speaker: Toheeb Jimoh

recommendations.item: Mac and cheese with beef ragu and truffle
recommendations.reason: A cheesy truffle and beef ragu mac and cheese, the ultimate food-coma side; the hosts confirm it is from Balans in Soho, a late-night favourite.
recommendations.quote: Mac N Cheese is like-, that's the food coma food.
recommendations.speaker: Toheeb Jimoh

recommendations.item: Coleslaw
recommendations.reason: Added as an extra side with the Nigerian dishes.
recommendations.quote: Jollof rice. Gizdodo. Fanta. Maybe some coleslaw on the side as well.
recommendations.speaker: Toheeb Jimoh

recommendations.item: Bottled Nigerian Fanta
recommendations.reason: Glass-bottle Fanta from Nigeria, deeper orange and made with real sugar, a childhood favourite.
recommendations.quote: Bottled Fanta is my number one drink.
recommendations.speaker: Toheeb Jimoh

recommendations.item: Carrot cake
recommendations.reason: A moist, perfectly soft carrot cake his dad used to bring home from work, thought to be from Caffe Nero; he'd always eat it whoever it was meant for.
recommendations.quote: It was just the most succulent thing I've ever eaten.
recommendations.speaker: Toheeb Jimoh

recommendations.item: Late-night food and Mac and cheese
recommendations.reason: James says the late-opening Soho spot saves nights out, with a proper big meal at 2am.
recommendations.quote: I think Balan's is what saves us from having an evening that doesn't end well.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

episodes.title: Ep 197: Jenny Eclair
episodes.summary: Jenny Eclair dreams of a snowy Orient Express meal with sparkling water and ginger beer, a Scandi crispbread basket, a boneless seafood platter, spaghetti bolognese, Ottolenghi-style rhubarb and burrata, endless chardonnay slush and a Babybel cheeseboard.

recommendations.item: Sparkling water with ice and lemon in a thin-rimmed glass, plus tap water and ginger beer (Fentiman's / Old Jamaica style)
recommendations.reason: She is fussy about glassware and wants a thin rim, plus an endless supply of fiery cloudy ginger beer on the side.
recommendations.quote: Very clean glass. Good glass. Thin rim. I don't like a thick rimmed glass or mug or anything really.
recommendations.speaker: Jenny Eclair

recommendations.item: Scandi basket of crispbreads, pumpernickel and dark breads with Philadelphia Light
recommendations.reason: Inspired by big round crispbreads at Scandinavian hotel breakfasts; no butter, so low-fat cream cheese instead.
recommendations.quote: I like a dark bread, I like a pumpernickel, I like that sort of thing
recommendations.speaker: Jenny Eclair

recommendations.item: Boneless fish platter: 70s-style poached salmon, chargrilled octopus, shelled lobster, huge loose-shelled prawns, Hellmann's Light, radish crudites
recommendations.reason: A bone-free seafood spread she can eat with her fingers while painting a watercolour still life of the lobster shell.
recommendations.quote: I want a fish platter but without any bones.
recommendations.speaker: Jenny Eclair

recommendations.item: Spaghetti bolognese with plenty of tomato, parmesan and a blob of mayonnaise
recommendations.reason: She is allergic to tomatoes in real life, so she craves a slow-cooked, rich red bolognese she would make herself with lots of love.
recommendations.quote: Spaghetti bolognese. And it's dull, and I'm really sorry, and it's not exciting and it's not foodie.
recommendations.speaker: Jenny Eclair

recommendations.item: Ottolenghi rhubarb and burrata with pink peppercorn oil (plus celeriac remoulade)
recommendations.reason: A dish she saw on Instagram and has never tasted; she likes savoury rhubarb and the pink colour.
recommendations.quote: it involved rhubarb and burrata... with a pink peppercorn drizzly oil apparently
recommendations.speaker: Jenny Eclair

recommendations.item: Chardonnay slush from a crushed-ice fridge, then port and a Gaviscon chaser
recommendations.reason: She drinks chardonnay with ice every night and wants it extra cold, capped at three large glasses.
recommendations.quote: Every single night, I have a glass of chardonnay, and I put ice in it... because drink's never cold enough for me.
recommendations.speaker: Jenny Eclair

recommendations.item: Cheeseboard with surprise Babybels, mature cheddar, fig chutney and Pink Lady apples
recommendations.reason: She skips pudding but loves cheese; she adores peeling a Babybel and wants Marks & Spencer-quality Pink Lady apples.
recommendations.quote: I just find the peeling of a Babybel one of the most satisfying things that an adult can do.
recommendations.speaker: Jenny Eclair

recommendations.item: Ottolenghi restaurant food (chefs sent out extra dishes)
recommendations.reason: James enjoyed lunch there and thanks the team for the generous extra dishes he was sent.
recommendations.quote: thank you to the people at ROVI for sending me that food when I went in. I very much enjoyed it
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Buy-the-chefs-a-beer option on the menu
recommendations.reason: James likes that this restaurant lets diners buy a round of beers for the chefs.
recommendations.quote: At Kricket, they give you the option of buying a round of beers for the chefs. It's on the menu.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

episodes.title: Ep 198: Graham Coxon
episodes.summary: Graham Coxon dreams of still water sucked from a hillside, French bread and salted butter on a plane, an American seafood-shack shrimp cocktail, his dad's nasi goreng, a chip butty, an alcohol-free Erdinger and school toffee pie.

recommendations.item: Still water straight from a hillside spring
recommendations.reason: He thinks sparkling is for caners and wants still water as close to the source as possible, drunk straight from a hillside.
recommendations.quote: I like to have it as close to sauce as possible, I'd be out there sucking on a hillside if I could.
recommendations.speaker: Graham Coxon

recommendations.item: Crusty white French bread with butter and a pinch of good salt
recommendations.reason: A favourite plane-tray pastime of wine, bread, butter and salt; for the dream meal it is crusty French bread eaten on a plane.
recommendations.quote: I'm full on butter, usually a pinch of some decent salt upon the butter as well.
recommendations.speaker: Graham Coxon

recommendations.item: Shrimp cocktail with horseradish sauce on lettuce with lemon
recommendations.venue: Unnamed seafood shack near Redondo Beach, Los Angeles
recommendations.reason: After cycling from Santa Monica along the coast he'd reach an old seafood shack for lobster and a shrimp cocktail whose horseradish-heavy sauce he loved. The shack is never named.
recommendations.quote: you put a blob of horseradish in there, and that was really, really good.
recommendations.speaker: Graham Coxon

recommendations.item: Nasi goreng with chicken satay, peanut sauce and fried egg
recommendations.reason: Tied to his dad's memories of an old woman cooking it nightly in Malaya; his best version was in Jakarta, and he wants her to cook it, rudely.
recommendations.quote: the best one I ever had was in Jakarta. It had, sort of, the chicken on sticks thing.
recommendations.speaker: Graham Coxon

recommendations.item: Chip butty with butter, brown sauce, ketchup, vinegar and lots of salt
recommendations.reason: A chip butty is his luxury; he names Toff's in Muswell Hill as a current good chippy, and a school friend's parents' chippie in Spondon was a childhood favourite.
recommendations.quote: Well, Cannons from Crouch End. That's gone, sadly. There's Toff's in Muswell Hill
recommendations.speaker: Graham Coxon

recommendations.item: Erdinger alcohol-free beer
recommendations.reason: He doesn't drink now; he'd have a 0% Erdinger while cycling to the shrimp shack, since it works as an isotonic sports drink. In a dream scenario he'd have a 1962 Amarone.
recommendations.quote: I'd have an Erdinger or something like that that has 0%, which is actually a sports drink if you read it.
recommendations.speaker: Graham Coxon

recommendations.item: School dinner toffee pie/tart with squirty cream
recommendations.reason: A gooey condensed-milk-like toffee pie from his junior school dinners that he has never found since.
recommendations.quote: it's, sort of, that toffee tart and I've never found it ever since.
recommendations.speaker: Graham Coxon

episodes.title: Ep 199: Celya AB
episodes.summary: Celya AB builds a Sips-and-Bites menu of many small tastes: poppadoms and Paris bread, a lamb bap, soups, wings, bao and lasagne, a mystery peach cocktail, and Paris-Brest and Sachertorte, with Happy Hippo afterwards.

recommendations.item: Walkers ready salted crisps dipped in soy sauce
recommendations.reason: An hour before the meal she wants a plain packet of Walkers dipped in soy sauce, a habit from a coach trip in 2018, as a light pre-meal snack.
recommendations.quote: I've started dipping them in soy sauce so it's extra salty.
recommendations.speaker: Celya AB

recommendations.item: Very bubbly sparkling water with ice, then topped-up tap water
recommendations.reason: She wants big-bubble sparkling water before the meal that feels like a spa day for her teeth, then tap water refilled without having to ask.
recommendations.quote: It feels like a little spa day for the teeth.
recommendations.speaker: Celya AB

recommendations.item: Poppadoms with dips
recommendations.location: Next to Snow Hill station, Birmingham, UK
recommendations.reason: She used to go every week to this Indian restaurant near Snow Hill station and sometimes went just for the little sauces served with the poppadoms.
recommendations.quote: they had the best little sauces that you get with the poppadoms. And sometimes, I'd just go there for that.
recommendations.speaker: Celya AB

recommendations.item: Dark seeded loaf with salted and unsalted butter
recommendations.reason: Found via Anthony Bourdain's travels, it is the best bread she has ever had: rich, almost meaty, still delicious a day later after a flight home.
recommendations.quote: by far the best bread I've ever had in my life. It tastes so rich.
recommendations.speaker: Celya AB

recommendations.item: Bite of lamb bap
recommendations.reason: From the pub where she used to work; their lamb roast dinner in a bap with gravy and mint sauce was a staff favourite from the leftover 'scraps'.
recommendations.quote: They used to do a lamb bap which was like lamb roast dinner covered in gravy with mint sauce.
recommendations.speaker: Celya AB

recommendations.item: Bread dipped in the bottom-of-the-pot mussel sauce
recommendations.reason: A touristy-looking Paris restaurant by a bridge whose mussel broth she loves for dunking bread (venue name forgotten).
recommendations.quote: I'm not bothered about the mussels... that sauce was delicious.
recommendations.speaker: Celya AB

recommendations.item: Sip of vegetable soup
recommendations.reason: The best vegetable soup she has ever had, in a Rotherhithe pub whose name she forgot, despite usually hating veg soup.
recommendations.quote: the best vegetable soup I've had in my life, and I usually hate vegetable soup
recommendations.speaker: Celya AB

recommendations.item: Two sips of Chorba (Algerian soup)
recommendations.reason: Her mum's mild, satisfying Algerian soup traditionally eaten around Ramadan.
recommendations.quote: It's quite mild but it's very satisfying and you have it around Ramadam a lot.
recommendations.speaker: Celya AB

recommendations.item: Pork ramen with rich spicy broth, thick noodles and tea-stained eggs (Studio Ghibli style)
recommendations.reason: Inspired by the food in Studio Ghibli films (Ponyo), she wants a rich spicy pork ramen with thicker noodles.
recommendations.quote: I want a bowl of ramen with pork at the top of it, and I want the broth to be rich and spicy
recommendations.speaker: Celya AB

recommendations.item: Chicken wings
recommendations.reason: Sticky Korean-style wings, wished to be magically non-messy; a group favourite despite the mess.
recommendations.quote: I want the chicken wings from Shack Fuyu.
recommendations.speaker: Celya AB

recommendations.item: Square of lasagne
recommendations.reason: The best lasagne she has had, made by a former housemate who was a comedy club tech trained as a chef.
recommendations.quote: this is the best lasagne I've ever had.
recommendations.speaker: Celya AB

recommendations.item: Pork bao buns
recommendations.reason: She loves bao as 'food on a cloud' and would have them as a side.
recommendations.quote: It's like food on a cloud.
recommendations.speaker: Celya AB

recommendations.item: Shredded sweet crispy seaweed
recommendations.reason: Crispy seaweed with sugar from Bao in Borough.
recommendations.quote: They've got shredded seaweed and it's crispy and they've put, like, sugar on it and it's delicious.
recommendations.speaker: Celya AB

recommendations.item: Chilli beef noodles (dropped from menu but shouted out)
recommendations.reason: Those noodles got her through many Edinburgh Fringes; Ed calls it one of the best restaurants in Edinburgh.
recommendations.quote: those noodles have got me through a lot of Edinburgh fringes and I love them so much.
recommendations.speaker: Celya AB

recommendations.item: Peachy, orangey cocktail with sugar rim
recommendations.reason: A delicious peachy cocktail from a fashion runway event in Digbeth; venue and recipe unknown.
recommendations.quote: It was peachy and-, I like it in cocktails when there's a layer of sugar around the glass
recommendations.speaker: Celya AB

recommendations.item: Liquorice and chamomile (or peppermint and liquorice) tea
recommendations.reason: A sweet herbal liquorice tea to finish the meal.
recommendations.quote: There's a liquorice one that I really like... It's really sweet by itself.
recommendations.speaker: Celya AB

recommendations.item: Reconstructed tiramisu
recommendations.reason: Disliked the deconstructed tiramisu at a fancy London restaurant but loved its elements, so wants it put back together.
recommendations.quote: I want it reconstructed but with the same elements.
recommendations.speaker: Celya AB

recommendations.item: Paris-Brest
recommendations.reason: A French choux pastry with praline cream and almonds tied to her childhood.
recommendations.quote: choux pastry but it's cut in half and there's praline cream in it, crushed almonds
recommendations.speaker: Celya AB

recommendations.item: Sachertorte
recommendations.reason: A dry chocolate and apricot Viennese cake served with cream from this Islington bakery.
recommendations.quote: a lovely bakery in London, in Islington... Sachertorte
recommendations.speaker: Celya AB

recommendations.item: Kinder Happy Hippo (an hour after the meal)
recommendations.reason: Her go-to treat after a bad gig, like an accessible cannoli.
recommendations.quote: I like that it's, like, a cannoli but accessible.
recommendations.speaker: Celya AB

recommendations.item: Cannoli
recommendations.reason: James and Celya rave about this place's cannolis, hazelnut tasting like Nutella.
recommendations.quote: The cannolis from that place are incredible.
recommendations.speaker: Celya AB

episodes.title: Ep 200: Ed Gamble and James Acaster (with special guest genie Rylan Clark)
episodes.summary: For episode 200 Ed Gamble and James Acaster each redo their dream menus with guest genie Rylan Clark, stretching it to chef's welcome, aperitif, amuse-bouche, pasta, cheese, pre-dessert, petit four and digestif courses drawn from restaurants around the world.

recommendations.item: Haggis taco (chef's welcome)
recommendations.reason: James goes to this family-run taco place every time he plays Newcastle; a special haggis taco was the most flavourful thing he had.
recommendations.quote: Every time I go and do a show in Newcastle I go to Chucho's.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Bowl of chicken skins with spicy seasoning (chef's welcome)
recommendations.reason: Ed has been three times in two weeks; the crispy, fatty, spicy chicken skins are the star of an otherwise very spicy Thai menu.
recommendations.quote: It's like pork crackling, but chicken flavour. It's the most chickeny thing you've ever tasted. It's crispy, it's fatty, it's crunchy.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Custardo (espresso shot topped with hot custard), as aperitif
recommendations.reason: James has never tried it but the idea of an espresso mixed with real hot custard is the thing he thinks about most.
recommendations.quote: It's a shot, but it's got like, espresso, and they top it up with custard. It's delicious.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Rhubarb negroni, as aperitif
recommendations.reason: Tommy Banks's restaurant sent Ed a bottled rhubarb negroni; it is less bitter and slightly sweeter than a normal negroni.
recommendations.quote: Normal negronis taste like retching. But, this is, it's slightly sweeter. And it takes the edge off the retch taste.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Lime and sea salt kombucha with kombucha crushed ice
recommendations.reason: James's current obsession; he drinks it all the time and buys out the only shop that stocks it.
recommendations.quote: it's a lime and sea salt kombucha made by a company called You and I. And I drink it all the time. I absolutely love it.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Vintage Krug champagne that tastes like the first drink after a wedding ceremony
recommendations.reason: Ed wants the celebratory feeling of the first glass of fizz after a wedding ceremony.
recommendations.quote: I want it to taste like champagne or any fizzy wine does, after a wedding ceremony.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Berkswell pudding (croissant, Berkswell cheese, birch sap and stout vinegar), as amuse-bouche
recommendations.reason: One of the most delicious mouthfuls James has ever eaten; he moves it from side dish to amuse-bouche this time. Also served at Aulis in Soho.
recommendations.quote: it's one of the most delicious things I've ever had, one of the most delicious mouthfuls of food I've ever had.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Pork dumpling, as amuse-bouche
recommendations.location: Rupert Street, Soho, London, UK (now closed; site is Speedboat Bar)
recommendations.reason: A beautiful Taiwanese tea-house restaurant whose juicy pastry-style pork dumpling Ed misses.
recommendations.quote: It was so juicy and so delicious.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Bread with salted butter from Ed's wedding
recommendations.reason: James can't remember exactly what it was but it was perfectly soft inside, crisp outside and a meal in itself; supplied by wedding caterers.
recommendations.quote: perfectly soft and fluffy on the inside, perfectly crisp and crunchy on the outside.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Bake-to-order bread served in a skillet with two melted butters (bacon and herb, and shrimp)
recommendations.reason: Ed thinks this tear-and-dip bread with pools of melted butter is a meal in itself and smashes it out of the park at the top of the night.
recommendations.quote: you literally just tear bits of the bread off, dip it in the melted butter and eat it. And it's the best bread-, it's, like, again, a meal in itself.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Cheeseburger spring rolls
recommendations.location: Magic Kingdom, Walt Disney World, Orlando, Florida, USA
recommendations.reason: From a spring roll cart near the castle; hot, crispy, filled with chopped burger, processed cheese and gherkin, with burger sauce dip. James planned his Disney trip around them.
recommendations.quote: Really crispy on the outside. Inside is just, like, chopped up-, it's just exactly what it sounds like, without the bread.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Kull yaw (aged mutton) kofte with schmaltz
recommendations.reason: A Turkish restaurant now run by the founder's sons doing experimental food; the kofte is smoky and nutty, served with a mayo-like sauce of chicken fat and egg yolk.
recommendations.quote: this just so smokey and, like, nutty tasting. It's fantastic.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Pickleback (bourbon shot with pickle brine chaser)
recommendations.reason: Ed's starter drink, made with a nice bourbon such as Bulleit or Maker's Mark.
recommendations.quote: Shot of bourbon and then a chaser of a shot of pickle brine.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Mom's crab fat noodles (pasta course)
recommendations.reason: Fine black noodles in a rich crab fat sauce with crispy toppings; James ate it before a gig and couldn't stop.
recommendations.quote: Delicious pasta course. I could have just kept on eating it and eating it.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Potato and pecorino ravioli with prosciutto crudo (pasta course)
recommendations.reason: Ed ate alone at the bar while on tour; the huge pillowy ravioli tucked under a blanket of prosciutto was the one dish they couldn't do in half portions.
recommendations.quote: Pillowy soft potato and a lot of cheese in the middle, and then just like I'd say the equivalent of a pack and a half of prosciutto just laid over the top.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Beef Wellington for two
recommendations.reason: James's main from his episode 100 menu, which he returned to eat again and found just as perfect: superb beef, crisp buttery pastry and the right amount of sauce.
recommendations.quote: it's the most delicious thing I've ever tasted. Everything is cooked to perfection.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Pint of Timothy Taylor Landlord with a sparkler
recommendations.reason: The creamy, sparkler-poured pint James and Ed had while lying low there during their run; the best pint he has had.
recommendations.quote: It's the best pint I've ever had, it was so-, it was creamy.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Skate wing tacos
recommendations.reason: High-end Mexican restaurant where a big spiced skate wing comes to the table to comb off the bone into warm tortillas.
recommendations.quote: it's such a delicious fish. So moist.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Frozen yuzu margarita
recommendations.reason: Ed's frozen margarita to go with the main; he specifies the yuzu one from this Soho restaurant (transcribed as 'Shak Fu Yu').
recommendations.quote: I'd like the frozen Yuzu margarita from Shak Fu Yu
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Cold sesame roasted carrots
recommendations.reason: The bakery's daily set lunch is always delicious; once it included cold roast carrot batons with sesame that blew James's mind every time he ate them.
recommendations.quote: I'd eat them again, have my mind blown all over again.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster
