recommendations.item: Houdini 18-cut scallop sushi
recommendations.reason: Chef Chris takes over his parents' sushi restaurant on certain nights for an omakase; the raw scallop scored 18 times melts in the mouth and is the highlight.
recommendations.quote: it's called the Houdini because it disappears in your mouth.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Mouraria cocktail (gin, lemon, bubbles, basil, fermented strawberries)
recommendations.reason: James wrote it straight off the menu because he knew immediately it was his dream drink; salty, fruity with a hint of basil, and he went back for another.
recommendations.quote: it was this salty but fruity drink with a hint of basil to it.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Aged off-dry Riesling from JJ Prum
recommendations.reason: Ed's favourite Riesling producer; he likes a bit of age, peach and citrus notes and lower alcohol.
recommendations.quote: JJ Prum is one of my favourite Riesling producers.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Cheese course: St James cheese with boozy prunes, walnut cracker and raw honeycomb
recommendations.reason: James calls it the best mouthful of food he has ever had.
recommendations.quote: The cheese course is the best mouthful of food I have ever had in my life.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Pre-dessert: caviar popsicle (pecan and Jerusalem artichoke ice cream, caviar, white chocolate)
recommendations.reason: From a 15-course dessert tasting menu that plays with savoury; the salty caviar coating blew James's mind.
recommendations.quote: they mess around with savoury stuff
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Lemon French toast with dulce de leche ice cream
recommendations.reason: A scoopable, brulee-topped lemon-soaked cube of French toast that James and Joe Lycett danced over while filming Travel Man.
recommendations.quote: we are dancing as we're eating it because it tastes that good.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Smash chocolate-covered salty snacks, as petit four
recommendations.reason: A packet of salty Bugle-type crisps covered in chocolate sold in any shop in Scandinavia.
recommendations.quote: these salty Bugle type crisps covered in chocolate that you can buy at any shop in Scandinavia, they're absolutely delicious.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Truffle Baron Bigod (cheese course)
recommendations.reason: From the cheese trolley: English Brie layered with minced truffle off-cuts; one of the best cheeses Ed has had.
recommendations.quote: It is one of the best cheeses I've ever had
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Truffle cheese toastie with smoky campfire ice cream (pre-dessert)
recommendations.reason: The pre-dessert there carried on the truffle and cheese flavours into a smoked-custard ice cream.
recommendations.quote: truffle cheese toastie with a smoky campfire ice cream was what they called it.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Olive oil ice cream
recommendations.reason: Served with a pour of excellent olive oil; Ed ate it outside just after lockdown and got goosebumps, the closest he has come to crying over food.
recommendations.quote: it's the closest I've come to crying over food.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Christmas pudding gelato
recommendations.reason: Ed's favourite gelato in London, opposite Bocca di Lupo; the Christmas pudding flavour is full of candied fruit.
recommendations.quote: it's my favourite gelato in London.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Chilled Fernet Branca Menta (digestif)
recommendations.reason: A minty herbal digestif Ed likens to boozy Gaviscon.
recommendations.quote: It is like boozy Gaviscon essentially.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Keralan fried chicken (for the table, denied by the genie)
recommendations.reason: James wanted it as a shared starter and insisted it be on record even though Rylan refused.
recommendations.quote: Keralan Fried chicken from Kricket for the table.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Crispy yuzu duck legs/wings (for the table, denied)
recommendations.reason: They went with Ronnie Chieng and ordered a second bowl because they were so good.
recommendations.quote: we ordered a second bowl of them because they were so good.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

episodes.title: Ep 201: Angela Barnes
episodes.summary: Angela's menu is a salt-fat-sugar tour of Newfoundland, Edinburgh and Berlin: sparkling water, toutons, deep-fried haggis, Berlin calves' liver and cabbage, Ziggy Peelgood's poutine, a chilli margarita and school chocolate sponge with mint custard.

recommendations.item: Sparkling water
recommendations.reason: Loves the fizz as a dopamine hit and, with hearing aids, enjoys being able to hear it.
recommendations.quote: It's fizzy. It's joy. It gives you a little dopamine hit.
recommendations.speaker: Angela Barnes

recommendations.item: Toutons (fried bread dough with butter and molasses)
recommendations.reason: Her mum's family are Newfoundlanders and this hiking-trail cafe makes the best homemade toutons, fried and served with butter and black molasses.
recommendations.quote: they are the best homemade toutons. They are not worried about cholesterol in the Mad Rock Café.
recommendations.speaker: Angela Barnes

recommendations.item: Deep-fried haggis supper with salt and sauce
recommendations.reason: A late-night Edinburgh chippy-style place with a huge amount of haggis, cheap and, to her, beautiful; the same woman has worked there since 1995.
recommendations.quote: It's disgusting, and beautiful, and there's so much haggis in it.
recommendations.speaker: Angela Barnes

recommendations.item: Berliner Leber (calves' liver with apples and onions) with Grunkohl cabbage
recommendations.reason: Hot food from a cash-only stall at a Berlin Christmas market with gluhwein; slow-cooked, tender and warming.
recommendations.quote: in the right environment, it's the best taste. It's so warming, and Christmassy, and your cheeks are cold
recommendations.speaker: Angela Barnes

recommendations.item: Deluxe poutine with dressing
recommendations.location: George Street, St. John's, Newfoundland, Canada
recommendations.reason: The late-night poutine truck on George Street, where she gets fries, cheese curds, gravy and sage-and-onion 'dressing' after the pub.
recommendations.quote: instead of getting a kebab or whatever, you go to the poutine truck. And it's called Ziggy Peelgood's.
recommendations.speaker: Angela Barnes

recommendations.item: Hot apple pie
recommendations.reason: Eaten in memory of comedian Phil Jerrod, who hated them and would rant about them.
recommendations.quote: If I'm eating a hot apple pie I can hear a Phil Jerrod rant in my head and I miss it.
recommendations.speaker: Angela Barnes

recommendations.item: Chilli margarita (husband's recipe, salt rim, no ice)
recommendations.reason: Beer now gives her hangovers, so 100% agave tequila margaritas made by her husband have taken over; the chilli one is his best.
recommendations.quote: his best is his chilli margarita.
recommendations.speaker: Angela Barnes

recommendations.item: Hot chocolate sponge with green mint custard
recommendations.reason: A school dinner pudding served in a plastic bowl; she says she has never had a chocolate sponge as good.
recommendations.quote: They were the best days at school.
recommendations.speaker: Angela Barnes

recommendations.item: Haggis pie
recommendations.reason: The pie shop across the road is her fallback when she crosses the road to avoid City Restaurant.
recommendations.quote: so I end up with a haggis pie instead.
recommendations.speaker: Angela Barnes

episodes.title: Ep 202: Jimi Famurewa
episodes.summary: Food critic Jimi picks sparkling water, Babur and BiBi poppadoms, a trio of slider sandwiches, his mum's Nigerian ewa riro, beef suya, Orangina and peanut milk, a many-sourced sundae and a custardo coffee.

recommendations.item: Sparkling water with ice and lemon
recommendations.reason: Sparkling feels like a little treat and a bit of fun compared with tap water at home.
recommendations.quote: it feels like a treat, put you in that, kind of, mindset. That little bit of effervescence.
recommendations.speaker: Jimi Famurewa

recommendations.item: Poppadoms with mango chutney
recommendations.location: Forest Hill, South East London, UK
recommendations.reason: Legendary 30-year-old local Indian with great poppadoms and a proper chunky mango chutney.
recommendations.quote: there's one near me in South East London, Babur. ... absolutely legendary Indian restaurant, it's been going like over 30 years now and their poppadoms are great.
recommendations.speaker: Jimi Famurewa

recommendations.item: Cheese papad (giant Quavers)
recommendations.reason: Fancy high-end Indian whose cheese poppadoms are essentially giant Quavers.
recommendations.quote: BiBi in London which is, like, really good high end Indian and they do, like, these cheese poppadoms that are essentially giant Quavers.
recommendations.speaker: Jimi Famurewa

recommendations.item: Mackerel pide (slider-sized)
recommendations.reason: Pillowy Turkish bread, charred mackerel and dill mayo; he loved the scarcity of the pandemic takeaway version.
recommendations.quote: Amazing, pillowy Turkish bread, beautifully charred piece of mackerel. A dill mayo in there as well, outrageously good
recommendations.speaker: Jimi Famurewa

recommendations.item: Dexter cheeseburger (slider-sized)
recommendations.reason: The greatest burger he has had: a nostalgic smash burger with crackly edges and Wimpy-like burger sauce.
recommendations.quote: The greatest burger I've ever had, I think. ... it's got, like, a wimpy quality to it. ... It's a smash burger so it's got the crackly edges
recommendations.speaker: Jimi Famurewa

recommendations.item: Zinger Tower burger (mini)
recommendations.reason: Nostalgia for post-work KFC at Bluewater; he loves the odd wrongness of the hash brown and cheese.
recommendations.quote: There's something about the hash brown and the cheese. There's just this, sort of, wrongness to it that I just absolutely love.
recommendations.speaker: Jimi Famurewa

recommendations.item: Ewa riro (Nigerian stewed beans) with fried plantain
recommendations.reason: Comforting Yoruba stewed beans like his mum's, which he could never match himself.
recommendations.quote: I just don't think I could get even close to, like, my mum cooking them. ... it is such a good combo.
recommendations.speaker: Jimi Famurewa

recommendations.item: Beef suya
recommendations.reason: Addictively fiery barbecued beef in peanut yaji spice; this Peckham spot delivers nationally and gives an extra bag of spice.
recommendations.quote: there's a place that delivers nationally actually called Alhaji Suya which I would massively recommend. They're in Peckham
recommendations.speaker: Jimi Famurewa

recommendations.item: Ice cold Orangina
recommendations.reason: Nostalgic childhood soft drink, brought by a beloved uncle.
recommendations.quote: just something about an ice cold Orangina.
recommendations.speaker: Jimi Famurewa

recommendations.item: Peanut milk
recommendations.reason: A pre-pudding drink that echoes the peanuts in the suya.
recommendations.quote: Really, really good. ... it's, kind of, a drink that's basically a, sort of, pre-pudding as well.
recommendations.speaker: Jimi Famurewa

recommendations.item: Toasted rice soft-serve gelato in sundae
recommendations.reason: Unbelievable toasted rice gelato from Brooks Headley's punk-spirited vegetarian burger place.
recommendations.quote: the toasted rice gelato from a place called Superiority Burger ... It was like rice crispy cereal milk but ... even better than that sounds.
recommendations.speaker: Jimi Famurewa

recommendations.item: Frosty in sundae
recommendations.reason: Childhood memory of visiting family in America and discovering Wendy's square burgers and the Frosty.
recommendations.quote: a Frosty which I was also fascinated that it wasn't-, there wasn't a flavour, it was just the Frosty
recommendations.speaker: Jimi Famurewa

recommendations.item: Brown butter custard tart (crumbled over sundae)
recommendations.reason: Their brown butter custard tart gives crunch and flavour to the sundae.
recommendations.quote: maybe we'll crumble a bit of the Marksman's brown butter custard tart in there.
recommendations.speaker: Jimi Famurewa

recommendations.item: Malted ice cream sandwich (crumbled in sundae)
recommendations.reason: One of the most perfect puddings; he and his wife had to stop buying them.
recommendations.quote: genuinely one of the most perfect, kind of, puddings that you can get.
recommendations.speaker: Jimi Famurewa

recommendations.item: Custardo (espresso with frozen custard)
recommendations.reason: Espresso over house-made frozen custard, what an affogato should be, tasting like eggnog.
recommendations.quote: a custardo feels like what an affogato should be like it's amazingly creamy, sweet, rounded custard with this beautiful intense shot of coffee in it
recommendations.speaker: Jimi Famurewa

recommendations.item: Fine-dining plantain and jollof
recommendations.reason: Two-Michelin-star West African influenced restaurant with jollof rice and an amazing plantain dish.
recommendations.quote: Ikoyi, which I mention in Settlers, they've got jollof rice on their menu and it's a two Michelin star restaurant now.
recommendations.speaker: Jimi Famurewa

recommendations.item: Suya-spiced bavette steak
recommendations.reason: Acclaimed restaurant by Joke Bakare with a bougie version of suya on bavette steak.
recommendations.quote: she does, like, really nice bavette steak with the spicing on top.
recommendations.speaker: Jimi Famurewa

recommendations.item: Thai food
recommendations.reason: Pulse-pounding spicy Thai that Ed returned to the following week.
recommendations.quote: the one dish at Speedboat Bar ... It's the Chinese sausage and the mustard green salad. Oh, it's amazing.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Thai food
recommendations.location: Arcade Food Hall, Centre Point, London, UK
recommendations.reason: Intensely spicy Thai, served with pink milk shots to tame the heat.
recommendations.quote: Plaza Khao Gaeng, ... in Arcade below Centre Point ... they'd bring out little, sort of, ... shots of pink milk that are, kind of, meant to tame the spice
recommendations.speaker: Jimi Famurewa

episodes.title: Ep 203: Paul Foot
episodes.summary: Paul Foot's surreal menu: still water, poppadoms with every dip plus a cherry cola poppadom sauce, quail and flat champagne aspic, wagyu fillet, Dover sole sashimi from a Tokyo restaurant, twelve drinks and a shape-shifting fruit souffle.

recommendations.item: Still water
recommendations.reason: Sparkling water makes him bloated, as he has never been able to burp.
recommendations.quote: the last thing I need is more bubbles inside me
recommendations.speaker: Paul Foot

recommendations.item: Poppadoms with all the dips and a cherry cola sauce
recommendations.reason: He loves poppadoms with mango chutney, lime pickle, raita and the chopped onion, and invents a cherry cola dip.
recommendations.quote: The little pickles and there's always one that no one likes. The onion... I like the chopped onion one.
recommendations.speaker: Paul Foot

recommendations.item: Quail and flat champagne aspic soup
recommendations.reason: He likes soup because it gives the flavour with no chewing, and wants quail and champagne together in a jelly.
recommendations.quote: you get the flavour of what the soup is, but without having to actually eat whatever the thing is.
recommendations.speaker: Paul Foot

recommendations.item: Wagyu fillet steak, rare, with poppadom sauce
recommendations.reason: He hates gristle and fat but loved tender wagyu he recently tried; fillet has none.
recommendations.quote: wagyu fillet steak and then not only do you have the tenderness of the wagyu, no gristle at all.
recommendations.speaker: Paul Foot

recommendations.item: Dover sole sashimi
recommendations.reason: He remembers a three-Michelin-star yet unpretentious Tokyo restaurant, named after the grunt fish, where sole sashimi and a perfect carrot were among his best meals ever.
recommendations.quote: I had, like, some of the best food ever there. I had, like, a carrot and it was the best carrot I've ever tasted my whole life.
recommendations.speaker: Paul Foot

recommendations.item: Pornstar Martini on arrival, then Pineau des Charentes, Campari and soda, sherry, Chardonnay, Riesling, red wines, Chartreuse, Chambord, milk
recommendations.reason: A twelve-drink tasting-menu pairing reflecting his love of sweet, bitter and sour flavours.
recommendations.quote: I like sweet. I like bitter. I like sour. I like umami.
recommendations.speaker: Paul Foot

recommendations.item: Souffle that changes fruit flavour every mouthful
recommendations.reason: Inspired by exotic fruits he ate in Penang, with rambutan, lychee, passion fruit, dragon fruit, violet, rose, bubblegum and sour cherry.
recommendations.quote: So, each mouthful, it changes.
recommendations.speaker: Paul Foot

episodes.title: Ep 204: Carol Vorderman
episodes.summary: A Richard Whiteley-style long lunch: sparkling water with fresh lime juice, bread with Welsh butter, scallops and giant butterflied prawns instead of a main, tomatoes, mash and microwaved sprouts, Margaux and Bollinger, and a dry-ice afternoon tea of minis.

recommendations.item: Sparkling water with a jug of fresh lime juice
recommendations.reason: Her standard restaurant order: sparkling for a sense of occasion plus a splash of lime juice to liven up bland water.
recommendations.quote: Can I have a sparkling water please? And can I have a jug of fresh lime juice?
recommendations.speaker: Carol Vorderman

recommendations.item: Artisan bread with yellow Welsh butter and salt crystals
recommendations.reason: Chooses bread over poppadoms, with Welsh butter nodding to her farming family roots.
recommendations.quote: it would have, like, yellow Welsh butter with, like, salt crystals on it.
recommendations.speaker: Carol Vorderman

recommendations.item: Three scallops in the shell with garlic butter and onions
recommendations.reason: Loves the 70s-style scallops with roe, served in the shell with garlic butter and onions, eaten slowly over an hour.
recommendations.quote: I like it, you know, in that very '70s way, when it's in the shell.
recommendations.speaker: Carol Vorderman

recommendations.item: Big butterflied prawns with onions (second starter in place of a main)
recommendations.reason: She does not like main courses, so takes a second starter of giant prawns.
recommendations.quote: I am going for the big prawns, that they're, like, butterfly chopped.
recommendations.speaker: Carol Vorderman

recommendations.item: Tomatoes and red onion; mashed potato and microwaved sprouts with butter
recommendations.reason: Sprouts are her favourite vegetable, microwaved in the bag and loaded with Welsh butter, salt and pepper.
recommendations.quote: I will often buy a bag of sprouts a day.
recommendations.speaker: Carol Vorderman

recommendations.item: Chateau Margaux red wine, plus a bottle of Bollinger champagne
recommendations.reason: Tied to a memorable date in America with an astronaut; Bollinger is her champagne of choice.
recommendations.quote: We had a Margaux, and that was very expensive red wine. I remember that, and oh God, it was good.
recommendations.speaker: Carol Vorderman

recommendations.item: Dry-ice afternoon tea tier of minis: Eton mess, trifle, lemon meringue, ice cream, Viennese whirl
recommendations.reason: Not a pudding person, so wants lots of little tastes presented with theatrical dry ice, as she has seen in Bristol.
recommendations.quote: Again, it's about the performance of the food.
recommendations.speaker: Carol Vorderman

recommendations.item: Long lunches
recommendations.reason: She and Richard Whiteley held records for some of the longest lunches there.
recommendations.quote: we held the record... for quite a few of the longest lunches in various restaurants including The Wolseley.
recommendations.speaker: Carol Vorderman

recommendations.item: Post-theatre late night hangout
recommendations.reason: Theatre-crowd restaurant where they ended a long lunch and met Bianca Jagger.
recommendations.quote: all the actors after the theatre go down there
recommendations.speaker: Carol Vorderman

episodes.title: Ep 205: Jordan Gray
episodes.summary: Jordan Gray picks sparkling water, banana naan, Gaucho's burrata caprese, a teenage-gig chicken kebab with chips, burger sauce and cheeseburger from a burnt-down Orsett van, Bombay potatoes, a Jagerbomb with Pussy energy drink, and a pound's worth of lemon sherbet.

recommendations.item: Sparkling water
recommendations.reason: She can get still water from the tap at home, so going out calls for bubbles, like a party in her mouth.
recommendations.quote: I can't imagine why anyone would go out and order anything but sparkling because I can have still at home on tap.
recommendations.speaker: Jordan Gray

recommendations.item: Plain banana naan
recommendations.reason: An invented bread (a plain naan with a built-in pun); she loves the topography of naan and wants to sleep on a pillow of warm bread.
recommendations.quote: I'll say banana naan for bread.
recommendations.speaker: Jordan Gray

recommendations.item: Burrata caprese salad
recommendations.reason: Gaucho's burrata caprese, with a reduced balsamic jus and a whole burrata, may be the best thing she has eaten, a surprise from a steak restaurant.
recommendations.quote: They do a burrata Caprese in Gaucho's in Soho that is the best Caprese, perhaps the best thing I've ever eaten.
recommendations.speaker: Jordan Gray

recommendations.item: Chicken kebab with chips, burger sauce and a cheeseburger
recommendations.reason: The kebab van outside her family's pub fed her band for free after gigs; nostalgic, fresh salad, tons of burger sauce. The van has since burnt down.
recommendations.quote: They lived up to their name of Orsett Best Kebab... The salad was always fresh.
recommendations.speaker: Jordan Gray

recommendations.item: Bombay potatoes
recommendations.reason: Takeaway-style Bombay potatoes in a foil tray with a cardboard lid, eaten messily on a white carpet.
recommendations.quote: Bombay potato and I don't mind a cheap one in an aluminium rectangle with a bit of paper on top.
recommendations.speaker: Jordan Gray

recommendations.item: Jagerbomb made with Pussy energy drink (the 'Pussy Pig'/'Percybomb')
recommendations.reason: Her old favourite drink, now eleven years sober; Jagermeister with Pussy energy drink tastes like a fizzy Percy Pig.
recommendations.quote: If you pair it with Jagermeister in the Jagerbomb, it tastes exactly like a Marks and Spencer's Percy Pig.
recommendations.speaker: Jordan Gray

recommendations.item: A pound's worth of lemon sherbet in a paper bag
recommendations.reason: Childhood pick-and-mix memory: she once showed off to a babysitter by ordering only lemon sherbet and shovelling it with a spoon.
recommendations.quote: I'll have a pound of lemon sherbet.
recommendations.speaker: Jordan Gray

episodes.title: Ep 206: AJ Odudu
episodes.summary: AJ's dream menu is very home-rooted: Blackburn tap water from her mum's kitchen, tuna mayo poppadoms, homemade cheese on toast, Nigerian starch with ogbono soup, Dean Street Townhouse creamed spinach, a rum and coke at an airport Wetherspoons, and custard and cake from her dad.

recommendations.item: Blackburn tap water
recommendations.reason: She swears Blackburn tap water (Pennine water) is far nicer than London's and always brings bottles back from her mum's kitchen tap.
recommendations.quote: Blackburn tap water. It's got to be from my mum's kitchen's tap.
recommendations.speaker: AJ Odudu

recommendations.item: Poppadoms with tuna mayo and cucumber
recommendations.reason: Chose light, crisp poppadoms over bread so she doesn't fill up, then invented topping them with tuna mayo and sliced cucumber.
recommendations.quote: I'm going poppadoms because it's lighter. It's crispier and before a main meal, I'm very against the notion of filling myself up with loads of bread.
recommendations.speaker: AJ Odudu

recommendations.item: Homemade cheese on toast with tomato
recommendations.reason: Thick seeded brown toast with salted butter, 3mm of mature cheddar, topped with cold sliced tomato; sometimes her whole dinner.
recommendations.quote: my dream starter is home made cheese on toast.
recommendations.speaker: AJ Odudu

recommendations.item: Starch with ogbono soup
recommendations.reason: A Delta State Nigerian staple from her childhood, a jiggly yellow starch dipped in rich soup with lamb and fish, ideally cooked at her mum's place in Nigeria.
recommendations.quote: it would need to be cooked in Nigeria on my mum's veranda.
recommendations.speaker: AJ Odudu

recommendations.item: Creamed spinach
recommendations.reason: Her favourite creamed spinach, a rich GBP5 pot that makes her feel posh, first discovered at a TV meeting there.
recommendations.quote: my favourite creamed spinach at the moment is on Dean Street Town House.
recommendations.speaker: AJ Odudu

recommendations.item: Rum and coke (or Prosecco) before a flight
recommendations.reason: The thrill of a rum and coke at 11am in an airport Wetherspoons makes the holiday start early; she also loves margaritas with a full salt rim.
recommendations.quote: nothing says a holiday like popping into the airport Wetherspoons and getting a little glass of fizz
recommendations.speaker: AJ Odudu

recommendations.item: Custard and plain sponge cake
recommendations.reason: Hot custard poured over plain sponge, brought to her by her dad at midnight when she lived in his living room.
recommendations.quote: 'Do you want some custard and cake?' And it'd be like, midnight, and I'd go, 'Yes.'
recommendations.speaker: AJ Odudu

recommendations.item: Broken biscuits with hot Ovaltine
recommendations.venue: her mum's cleaning job staff room
recommendations.reason: Honourable munchion: broken biscuits and Ovaltine with her mum's cleaner friends at school, as a child.
recommendations.quote: my mum's contribution was always broken biscuits, which I absolutely loved.
recommendations.speaker: AJ Odudu

recommendations.item: Creamed spinach
recommendations.reason: Ed regularly raves about Hawksmoor's rich, nutmeg-heavy creamed spinach.
recommendations.quote: I always bang on about this the Hawksmoor creamed spinach.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

episodes.title: Ep 207: Nick Frost
episodes.summary: Nick Frost builds a home-cook's Sunday lunch: lime-spiked sparkling water, bread from a Danish beach restaurant, Heston's meat fruit, slow-roast pork belly with all the trimmings, cheesy leek gratin, Fanta Zero and a heavy apple crumble.

recommendations.item: Sparkling water with a squeeze of (loose-skinned Japanese) lime
recommendations.reason: He likes the feel of fizz in the mouth and wants lime squeezed in, which he can eat whole to amuse his kids.
recommendations.quote: I'm going to have sparkling. I like the way it feels in my mouth. And I'm going to probably have some lime.
recommendations.speaker: Nick Frost

recommendations.item: Small crusty loaves (sourdough and a dark sweet one) with salted butter
recommendations.location: Beach north of Copenhagen, Denmark (Klampenborg area)
recommendations.reason: A tiny ten-seat lunch place in a beach forest north of Copenhagen served whole mini loaves baked in their own moulds; he says it was amazing (he thinks it may have since closed).
recommendations.quote: they served up these breads, which had obviously been made in their own tiny little bread moulds and they served them whole, like tiny little loaves. And it was, like, amazing.
recommendations.speaker: Nick Frost

recommendations.item: Meat fruit
recommendations.reason: A restaurant he's been going to for years that makes him feel special; the mandarin-lookalike chicken liver parfait is magic and something he'd never try to make himself.
recommendations.quote: It looks like an orange, a mandarin, and you cut it inside and it's meat.
recommendations.speaker: Nick Frost

recommendations.item: Slow-roast belly of pork with bubbly crackling, roast potatoes, carrots, gravy, apple sauce and Yorkshire pudding
recommendations.reason: His own Sunday roast, with pork chosen for dream-crackling and six or seven hours of slow cooking.
recommendations.quote: I'm having slow-roasted belly of pork with a fucking ton of great crackling on.
recommendations.speaker: Nick Frost

recommendations.item: Cheesy leek gratin
recommendations.reason: His own recipe: leeks in butter under a cave-aged cheddar béchamel, tasty and naughty and great mopped up with gravy.
recommendations.quote: it just feels so tasty and naughty and it just goes with everything else
recommendations.speaker: Nick Frost

recommendations.item: Fanta Zero
recommendations.reason: He loves Coke Zero but his head has been turned by Fanta Zero, which tastes properly orangey without chemicals.
recommendations.quote: Just really orangey and doesn't taste like chemicals, and I like it a lot
recommendations.speaker: Nick Frost

recommendations.item: Heavily crumbled apple crumble with ice cream on the side
recommendations.reason: Made with caramelised apples, cinnamon and a one-and-a-half to two inch crumble; the kids recently asked for it.
recommendations.quote: I am going to have a heavily crumbled apple crumble.
recommendations.speaker: Nick Frost

episodes.title: Ep 208: Izuka Hoyle
episodes.summary: Izuka Hoyle imagines an end-of-the-world conservatory with magic doors to every country: Highland Spring, Irish soda bread, Italian bruschetta and pasta, Nigerian jollof with assam goat, friends' side plates, strawberry daiquiri and Cab Sav/Rioja, and a giant American pick and mix with Fanta Fruit Twist.

recommendations.item: Still Highland Spring water straight from the waterfall
recommendations.reason: Firmly still water; she picks Highland Spring from Scottish glens and loves Scottish tap water.
recommendations.quote: Highland spring, straight from the waterfalls, straight from the glens.
recommendations.speaker: Izuka Hoyle

recommendations.item: Irish soda bread with Irish butter (Kerrygold)
recommendations.reason: Through the Irish magic door, she prefers soda bread over sourdough.
recommendations.quote: Soda bread, because I was tempted to go sourdough bread, soda bread's better.
recommendations.speaker: Izuka Hoyle

recommendations.item: Bruschetta (plus a chorizo and tomato pasta course)
recommendations.reason: A simple fresh tomato and basil bruschetta from a family in an Italian door, followed by a rich red pasta.
recommendations.quote: You just can't go wrong with some good bruschetta... you get the freshness of the tomatoes and the basil.
recommendations.speaker: Izuka Hoyle

recommendations.item: Nigerian jollof rice, assam goat, porridge yam, puff puff and plantain
recommendations.reason: She is half Nigerian and has recently become obsessed with Nigerian food, especially the very spicy goat.
recommendations.quote: I am half Nigerian, and recently I've been eating a lot of Nigerian food... I would go for some assam goat meat, which is incredibly spicy.
recommendations.speaker: Izuka Hoyle

recommendations.item: Picking from friends' plates: Sienna's herb salad and Renee's prawn tempura sushi
recommendations.reason: She is a picker who likes to try a bit of everything, so her sides come from her friends' trolleys.
recommendations.quote: I'm a real picker, me. That's why tapas is a great thing, I like to kind of just have everything.
recommendations.speaker: Izuka Hoyle

recommendations.item: Strawberry daiquiri (with a strawberry lace), then Californian Cab Sav and a Rioja
recommendations.reason: Her daiquiri comes from a version at Enish, a Nigerian restaurant in London, served with a Sainsbury's fizzy strawberry lace on a cocktail stick. She says the whole Nigerian main is also a meal she would get there.
recommendations.quote: I had a really good one in a place called Enish, which is the Nigerian restaurant in London... a glass of sugary goodness.
recommendations.speaker: Izuka Hoyle

recommendations.item: Giant American pick and mix with Fanta Fruit Twist Frozen
recommendations.reason: Sour fizzy sweets and gummies, washed down with a frozen raspberry Fanta, recalling childhood paper-shop Sundays.
recommendations.quote: Anything with, like, sour, sugary flakes on the outside... anything sour and gummy.
recommendations.speaker: Izuka Hoyle

recommendations.item: Goat belly samosas
recommendations.reason: James and his partner ate goat belly samosas here and found them absolutely amazing.
recommendations.quote: They were goat belly samosas at Brigadiers, they were absolutely amazing.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Custardo
recommendations.reason: Ed put the custardo on his own menu unseen after a previous guest's rave, then tried it and said it lived up to the hype.
recommendations.quote: I'm pleased to report that the custardo from Forza Vin tastes every bit as...
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

episodes.title: Ep 209: Dr Maggie Aderin-Pocock
episodes.summary: Dr Maggie Aderin-Pocock, who has a dairy allergy, picks crusty bread, Nigerian jollof rice with fried plantain, a roast dinner inside a giant Yorkshire pudding, tomato consomme, Prosecco and a remembered supermarket lemon meringue pie from Chile.

recommendations.item: Really cold still water
recommendations.reason: Still because fizzy water makes her burp, and served very cold.
recommendations.quote: this has to be still because sparkling water makes me burp.
recommendations.speaker: Dr. Maggie Aderin-Pocock

recommendations.item: Really crusty bread with loads of good salted butter
recommendations.reason: She misses butter because of her dairy allergy, so the dream version is crusty bread slathered in it.
recommendations.quote: A really crusty bread, slathered with pure salted butter.
recommendations.speaker: Dr. Maggie Aderin-Pocock

recommendations.item: Jollof rice with dodo (fried plantain)
recommendations.reason: A Nigerian childhood dish from her parents' heritage, with plantain fried at the sweet, slightly overripe stage.
recommendations.quote: to me this as a child, this was the nectar of the gods.
recommendations.speaker: Dr. Maggie Aderin-Pocock

recommendations.item: Roast pork with crackling, apple sauce, roast potatoes, parsnips, sprouts and pigs in blankets, served inside a giant Yorkshire pudding
recommendations.reason: A Sunday roast with Christmas touches, piled into a huge Yorkshire pudding, which she can no longer make properly without dairy.
recommendations.quote: the roast inside, and so I can chip away at the corners.
recommendations.speaker: Dr. Maggie Aderin-Pocock

recommendations.item: Tomato consomme
recommendations.reason: She had it once at a pricey restaurant a friend took her to, and it tasted like an explosion of tomato despite looking like coloured water.
recommendations.quote: it's like just slightly coloured water, but when you taste it, the explosion of tomato was fantastic.
recommendations.speaker: Dr. Maggie Aderin-Pocock

recommendations.item: Prosecco, lightly chilled
recommendations.reason: Her go-to throughout the meal; she prefers it to Champagne for a meal like this and says it doesn't make her burp.
recommendations.quote: I think Champagne for special occasions but a meal like this, I think I might prefer Prosecco.
recommendations.speaker: Dr. Maggie Aderin-Pocock

recommendations.item: Lemon meringue pie (with a glass of Chilean champagne to toast the moon)
recommendations.location: Chile (town near the telescope she worked at; exact town unclear)
recommendations.reason: While installing an instrument on a Chilean telescope she'd buy a huge Costco-style lemon meringue pie once a week as a treat. She can't eat it now but plans to take her daughter back to find it.
recommendations.quote: they had the ultimate lemon meringue pie... the meringue stood up to the lemons.
recommendations.speaker: Dr. Maggie Aderin-Pocock

episodes.title: Ep 210: Paapa Essiedu
episodes.summary: Picky-eater actor Paapa Essiedu picks still water, warm herby bread, Mexico City al pastor tacos, Ghanaian red red cooked by an auntie, Bar Tomas patatas bravas, a Forza Wine Sgroppino and a Percy Ingle doughnut on Romeo & Giulietta ice cream.

recommendations.item: Still water
recommendations.reason: Plain still water, downed quickly; he finds sparkling water has the texture of Fanta without the flavour.
recommendations.quote: Absolutely still water. No conversation about it, move on, next.
recommendations.speaker: Paapa Essiedu

recommendations.item: Warm bread with herby salted butter (focaccia, rosemary, garlic)
recommendations.reason: Warm bread with butter, salt and herbs such as rosemary or garlic, rather than poppadoms.
recommendations.quote: warm bread, butter, a little bit of salt, what do they put on butter sometimes like rosemary and stuff.
recommendations.speaker: Paapa Essiedu

recommendations.item: Tacos al pastor
recommendations.venue: A street vendor in Mexico City
recommendations.reason: From a day of eating tacos around Mexico City; corn tortilla, vivid red pork, coriander, onion, hot sauce and guacamole from a stall, finishing with an almost buffet-style pastor stand.
recommendations.quote: So, my starter is a taco el pastor, Mexican street vendor. Mexico City.
recommendations.speaker: Paapa Essiedu

recommendations.item: Red Red (Ghanaian black-eyed bean stew with fried plantain)
recommendations.reason: A Ghanaian black-eyed bean stew with fried sweet plantain, which he wants cooked by an auntie in a kitchen with a 30-year-old pot, loud music and a smell that stays in the sofa.
recommendations.quote: It has to be cooked by an auntie in a kitchen with a pot that's, like, 30 years old, the music is loud, you can smell it for days.
recommendations.speaker: Paapa Essiedu

recommendations.item: Patatas bravas with a little beer and a small sausage
recommendations.reason: A local joint where the patatas bravas come with no tomato sauce, fried in chilli garlic oil, ultra crunchy outside and fluffy inside, for about three euros with a tiny beer.
recommendations.quote: they make these patatas bravas, and there's no tomato sauce, which I think actually elevates it. It's fried in this, like, chilli, garlicy oil.
recommendations.speaker: Paapa Essiedu

recommendations.item: Sgroppino (lemon sorbet, vodka, prosecco/champagne)
recommendations.reason: A sorbet cocktail he loves on the rooftop with a view of London, though it goes down too easily and ruined one night out; he thinks it may have been taken off the menu.
recommendations.quote: it's basically a lemon sorbet with vodka and champagne in it... it is absolutely delicious.
recommendations.speaker: Paapa Essiedu

recommendations.item: Freshly made sugar ring doughnut
recommendations.reason: An unpretentious old-school East London bakery whose plain sugar ring doughnut he wants fresh, with no filling or topping.
recommendations.quote: old-school baker, East London, there's one in Broadway Market... very un-pretentious... What you see is what you get, but perfect.
recommendations.speaker: Paapa Essiedu

recommendations.item: Biscock rock ice cream (hazelnut, chocolate, vanilla, Biscoff with biscuit bits)
recommendations.reason: A gelateria in an unglamorous spot that he considers the best ice cream in London; the biscuity ice cream sits under the warm doughnut.
recommendations.quote: the ice cream is, like, I would say the best in London, it's amazing.
recommendations.speaker: Paapa Essiedu

recommendations.item: Plantain tacos
recommendations.reason: Paapa asks about plantain tacos; Ed and James say Wahaca does a fantastic sweet-savoury plantain taco.
recommendations.quote: From Wahaca? Yes... Fantastic.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Frozen lagerita / frozen cocktails
recommendations.reason: James and Ed recall a frozen beer-and-spirit cocktail there that James would have drunk all night.
recommendations.quote: I was drinking it all night... they were so delicious.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

episodes.title: Ep 211: Steve Coogan
episodes.summary: Steve Coogan, with help from his chef daughter, picks room-temperature Northern tap water, Irish soda bread, chunky pea soup with white pepper, her broccoli anchovy pasta, fresh tomatoes with white bread, a pint of room-temperature bitter and a rhubarb dessert (or trifle).

recommendations.item: Room-temperature Northern tap water
recommendations.reason: He prefers soft Northern tap water at room temperature, which is better for warming up the vocal cords.
recommendations.quote: I prefer Northern tap water to this lime-scaley Southern tap water
recommendations.speaker: Steve Coogan

recommendations.item: Warm Irish soda bread with butter
recommendations.venue: Made by his mum or sister
recommendations.reason: Simple warm soda bread straight from the oven with butter, as his Irish mum made it with soured milk.
recommendations.quote: I like Irish soda bread with butter. Simple. Warm, straight from the oven.
recommendations.speaker: Steve Coogan

recommendations.item: Chunky pea soup with white pepper
recommendations.reason: He wants a lumpy, half-broken-down pea soup rather than a blitzed one, finished with white pepper.
recommendations.quote: I like lumps of stuff.
recommendations.speaker: Steve Coogan

recommendations.item: Broccoli, garlic, chilli and anchovy pasta
recommendations.reason: His daughter, a chef, makes it with blitzed anchovy; it is simple, inexpensive food that tastes amazing and has no showing off.
recommendations.quote: She does this thing where she just, like, blitzes anchovy and puts it in with like broccoli and garlic and chilli and pasta. It just tastes amazing.
recommendations.speaker: Steve Coogan

recommendations.item: Chopped fresh tomatoes with olive oil, salt, pepper and fresh white bread (maybe mozzarella)
recommendations.reason: Good tomatoes, ideally home grown, simply dressed, as he loved in Italy.
recommendations.quote: in Italy, I love good tomatoes.
recommendations.speaker: Steve Coogan

recommendations.item: Pint of room-temperature hand-pumped bitter
recommendations.reason: The drink he misses most since giving up alcohol: low-strength, flat, cellar-temperature bitter from a pub hand pump.
recommendations.quote: Room temperature Bitter, hand-pumped from a pub. Not chilled.
recommendations.speaker: Steve Coogan

recommendations.item: Rhubarb dessert done four ways
recommendations.location: Cowan Bridge, near Kirkby Lonsdale, Cumbria, UK
recommendations.reason: A layered rhubarb dessert (jelly, blitzed and sliced rhubarb) he ate while filming The Trip and has never forgotten; he searches every menu for rhubarb.
recommendations.quote: Hipping Hall had this rhubarb dessert that had rhubarb done about four different ways, all within the same thing.
recommendations.speaker: Steve Coogan

recommendations.item: Trifle
recommendations.reason: As an alternative dessert he is a huge trifle fan and buys the M&S one on the way to the Lake District.
recommendations.quote: Trifle, I'm a huge trifle person.
recommendations.speaker: Steve Coogan

recommendations.item: Country pub food
recommendations.location: Whitewell, Forest of Bowland, Lancashire, UK
recommendations.reason: A real inn used in The Trip; he still goes there to eat and finds it lovely.
recommendations.quote: I do go to that hotel to eat the food. It's a nice country pub and it's lovely.
recommendations.speaker: Steve Coogan

recommendations.item: Fine dining
recommendations.reason: He has eaten there several times and rates Simon Rogan's cooking, including simple dishes done brilliantly.
recommendations.quote: I do like a posh L'enclume. I ate at L'enclume and I'd been there a few times
recommendations.speaker: Steve Coogan

recommendations.item: Ham sandwich
recommendations.reason: Ed thanks the Windmill for a delicious meal while they photographed the menu, and recommends the ham sandwich.
recommendations.quote: I would recommend getting the ham sandwich. That was my favourite
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

episodes.title: Ep 212: Garth Marenghi
episodes.summary: Horror author Garth Marenghi, in character, refuses water, wants five poppadoms, a huge prawn cocktail, beef from every part of the carcass, turducken, a potion, and curried kedgeree for dessert, all slaughtered by his personal slaughterer.

recommendations.item: Beer or wine instead of water
recommendations.reason: He distrusts water, claiming it can never die and remembers what has been done to it.
recommendations.quote: Beer or wine, I don't want water I want beer or wine.
recommendations.speaker: Garth Marenghi

recommendations.item: Poppadoms, five each, with all the dips
recommendations.reason: Curry is the horror-writing community's food of choice; he and his wife Pam race through poppadoms.
recommendations.quote: Five for me, five for Pam.
recommendations.speaker: Garth Marenghi

recommendations.item: Very large prawn cocktail with lobster and crab
recommendations.reason: Big prawns he has selected himself while alive, with lots of jarred Marie Rose sauce and little lettuce.
recommendations.quote: I want to see the prawns and pick them.
recommendations.speaker: Garth Marenghi

recommendations.item: Beef from every part of the carcass (not the balls)
recommendations.reason: Heart, guts and a left rump cut, after meeting the animal first as a mark of respect.
recommendations.quote: A piece from every part of the carcass please. Heart, guts. Not the balls though.
recommendations.speaker: Garth Marenghi

recommendations.item: Turducken, very well cooked
recommendations.reason: His tip to avoid ordering regret is to order a second dish as a side.
recommendations.quote: order one as a side dish.
recommendations.speaker: Garth Marenghi

recommendations.item: Goblet of potion that expands time, plus beer or wine
recommendations.reason: He wants a potion to give him more time to write.
recommendations.quote: I would like it to expand time.
recommendations.speaker: Garth Marenghi

recommendations.item: Very curried kedgeree, then Pepto Bismol and an after-dinner mint
recommendations.reason: He loves heavily curried kedgeree and treats it as a treat.
recommendations.quote: I think kedgeree for dessert sounds lovely, what a treat.
recommendations.speaker: Garth Marenghi

episodes.title: Ep 213: Harriet Kemsley
episodes.summary: Harriet Kemsley (vegetarian, allergic to raw veg) picks sparkling tap water, focaccia with oil and balsamic, scallops, a Pizza Express Padana pizza, a waffle from Utter Waffle, a can of Hun sauvignon blanc on a train, and chocolate Guinness cake with cherry Garcia.

recommendations.item: Sparkling tap water
recommendations.reason: Sparkling is just more fun, and on tap so there is no guilt.
recommendations.quote: we're going to sparkling please, it's just more fun. Water I will have tap
recommendations.speaker: Harriet Kemsley

recommendations.item: Warm focaccia with rosemary and flaky salt, with olive oil and a dot of balsamic
recommendations.reason: Loves dipping bread in oil with a dot of balsamic in the middle, kept separate; fresh, bouncy and warm.
recommendations.quote: I like it when they have the olive oil and then when I learnt how to put that balsamic, you can put a dot in the middle. That was, it felt so glamorous.
recommendations.speaker: Harriet Kemsley

recommendations.item: Six pan-fried scallops with lemon, salt and chilli
recommendations.reason: Picked to sound more interesting than her real wish for dough balls; she likes that scallops have no brain and feels sharper eating them.
recommendations.quote: I wanted to have dough balls as my starter and then I thought people would be too cross and so I said scallops
recommendations.speaker: Harriet Kemsley

recommendations.item: Padana pizza (goat's cheese, spinach, caramelised onion), leggera-style with a hole and salad
recommendations.reason: Pizza Express is her comforting place for birthdays and celebrations; the Canterbury branch by the river is her ideal, with a smooth tomato sauce she can eat.
recommendations.quote: it all has to go back to Canterbury Pizza Express... It's by the river, it's lovely.
recommendations.speaker: Harriet Kemsley

recommendations.item: James Jules and the Giant Peach waffle (caramelised peach, cinnamon frosting, cream cheese, veggie bacon)
recommendations.reason: A really good waffle place she visits with her baby and dog; they are kind about the chaos and the waffles are sweet-savoury.
recommendations.quote: I'm not really a waffle person but this place is really good. It's called Utter Waffle and it's in Herne Hill
recommendations.speaker: Harriet Kemsley

recommendations.item: Can of Hun sauvignon blanc, from M&S, drunk on a train after a gig
recommendations.reason: The thrill of running for a cold can of wine after a gig and drinking it on the train home.
recommendations.quote: in the can it's still cold and it's just such an exciting feeling.
recommendations.speaker: Harriet Kemsley

recommendations.item: Chocolate Guinness cake with cherry Garcia ice cream, strawberry Quality Street and ice cream Chewits
recommendations.reason: She and friends used to go twice a week to a Streatham cafe for the cream-cheese-frosted chocolate Guinness cake, which sold out constantly.
recommendations.quote: there's this cafe in Streatham that we used to go to, like, twice a week and be like, 'Have you got the chocolate Guinness cake?'
recommendations.speaker: Harriet Kemsley

recommendations.item: Guinness bread and Guinness bread ice cream
recommendations.reason: James recommends it for Guinness bread and Guinness bread ice cream.
recommendations.quote: they do a Guinness bread... and then for dessert you can get Guinness bread ice cream... and that is so good.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Pizza
recommendations.reason: James's hometown pizza place he would choose over Pizza Express.
recommendations.quote: there was a Frank's Pizza, which is still there... I'd go to ahead of Pizza Express any day. Delicious Frank's Pizza.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Pancakes
recommendations.reason: James says their pancakes are so good he could eat one on its own.
recommendations.quote: That Ezra and Gill place... in Manchester, I could eat just one of their pancakes on its own. It's incredible.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Pizza
recommendations.reason: James would go to Franco Manca before Pizza Express for pizza.
recommendations.quote: I'd go to Franco Manca.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

episodes.title: Ep 214: Steve-O
episodes.summary: Steve-O goes for fizzy Thames water, carrots and hummus with his own hot sauce, vegan double-coated Pickled Onion Monster Munch, sea bass, mash with hot sauce, a Virgin Mary and either no dessert or every dessert.

recommendations.item: Sparkling Thames water
recommendations.reason: Having drunk tap water around the world to build his immune system, he picks the River Thames, carbonated.
recommendations.quote: How about this? I'll go for a glass of Thames... But could we carbonate the Thames?
recommendations.speaker: Steve-O

recommendations.item: Carrots and hummus topped with Steve-O's Hot Sauce for Your Butthole
recommendations.reason: He avoids flour, so he swaps bread for crudites and hummus smothered in his own hot sauce.
recommendations.quote: I'm actually, avoiding, flour... some carrots and hummus, that sounds pretty killer. But the hummus has to be covered with Steve-O's Hot Sauce
recommendations.speaker: Steve-O

recommendations.item: Vegan, double-coated Pickled Onion Monster Munch
recommendations.reason: His all-time favourite snack, so beloved he has the mascot tattooed on his leg; he wants a dairy-free, more evenly coated version.
recommendations.quote: all of my rules go out of the window when it comes to Pickled Onion Monster Munch.
recommendations.speaker: Steve-O

recommendations.item: Sea bass (Chilean)
recommendations.reason: As a pescatarian he chooses sea bass, reasoning the fish lived a natural life and his body recognises it as food.
recommendations.quote: So, I eat fish, and we're going to go with sea bass.
recommendations.speaker: Steve-O

recommendations.item: Pureed mashed potato with Steve-O's Hot Sauce for Your Butthole
recommendations.reason: Smooth mash drenched in his own hot sauce, which he admits he's addicted to.
recommendations.quote: I get high on my own supply, man, that shit is good.
recommendations.speaker: Steve-O

recommendations.item: Virgin Mary (Bloody Mary mix, no alcohol)
recommendations.reason: He loves Bloody Mary mix and, being sober, insists on no alcohol at all.
recommendations.quote: I am a humongous fan of Bloody Mary mix, with no alcohol.
recommendations.speaker: Steve-O

recommendations.item: No dessert, or every dessert in the world (salted caramel, creme brulee)
recommendations.reason: A recovering sugar addict, he skips dessert, but if he relapses he wants everything, especially salted caramel and a creme brulee with a liquid caramel centre.
recommendations.quote: if I am in relapse mode, I want every single god-damn dessert on your menu.
recommendations.speaker: Steve-O

recommendations.item: Cakes and pies display at Costa Coffee
recommendations.reason: He was blown away by how tempting the cake and pie selection was when he popped in for a flat white.
recommendations.quote: I went into Costa to get a flat white, and I looked at their display of desserts, and every damn one of them I was just like, 'Man, if I didn't care, every one of…
recommendations.speaker: Steve-O

episodes.title: Ep 215: Paul Rudd
episodes.summary: Still water, hot bread rolls, Caesar salad, his mum's roast beef with a stack of Yorkshire puddings, thick-cut chips, a perfectly poured Guinness, and cheesecake with black coffee, plus sour Santas.

recommendations.item: Still water
recommendations.reason: Perfect as it is; no need to mess with perfection.
recommendations.quote: It's perfect, you don't need to mess with perfection.
recommendations.speaker: Paul Rudd

recommendations.item: Unexpectedly hot bread roll with butter (also bagel with cream cheese)
recommendations.reason: Loves the surprise of a hot roll from the basket with melting butter; bagel with cream cheese is a close rival.
recommendations.quote: when it's hot and you weren't expecting it? That's the greatest.
recommendations.speaker: Paul Rudd

recommendations.item: Caesar salad
recommendations.reason: Classic, simple Caesar with not-too-fishy dressing, few croutons, ideally made table-side.
recommendations.quote: I will always go for a Caesar salad if it's there, and I love it.
recommendations.speaker: Paul Rudd

recommendations.item: Mum's roast beef with twelve Yorkshire puddings, roast potatoes, veg and gravy
recommendations.reason: His mum's Sunday roast is his death-row meal; reminds him of growing up and his English family.
recommendations.quote: my mom's, roast beef, Yorkshire pudding and roast potatoes. Sunday roast.
recommendations.speaker: Paul Rudd

recommendations.item: Thick-cut chips
recommendations.reason: Great thick chips served plain, no sauce.
recommendations.quote: The thick cut, truly, like, great chips, that's it.
recommendations.speaker: Paul Rudd

recommendations.item: Pint of Guinness poured by the Guinness Brew Master
recommendations.reason: Brown, perfectly poured with the proper settle, ideally in Ireland.
recommendations.quote: It would be a pint of Guinness.
recommendations.speaker: Paul Rudd

recommendations.item: Perfect slice of cheesecake with strong black coffee, then sour Santas and Clodhoppers
recommendations.reason: Light cheesecake with thick graham-cracker crust and a good consistency, with black coffee; sweets from his shop on the side.
recommendations.quote: my dream dessert would be the perfect slice of cheesecake.
recommendations.speaker: Paul Rudd

recommendations.item: Sweets, sour Santas, Clodhoppers and coffee
recommendations.reason: Paul co-owns this Rhinebeck sweet shop with Jeffrey Dean Morgan; he loves the seasonal sour Santas and Clodhoppers.
recommendations.quote: my favourite thing is a seasonal candy. There are these sour Santas
recommendations.speaker: Paul Rudd

recommendations.item: Chilli dogs
recommendations.reason: Ed recalls ordering two chilli dogs and then two more at this Washington DC institution.
recommendations.quote: I ordered two, ate them, and then ordered two more.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Indian food (sauces)
recommendations.reason: Paul says everything he ate at Asma Khan's restaurant was delicious.
recommendations.quote: anything at Asma's restaurant was delicious
recommendations.speaker: Paul Rudd

episodes.title: Ep 216: Dawn French (Christmas Special)
episodes.summary: Dawn French's comfort-led Christmas menu: sparkling water, cheese bread, pear with ham, her mum's Cornish pasty, Christmas Eve beans on toast, string chips, Fowey Valley Cider and an assiette of desserts.

recommendations.item: Sparkling water
recommendations.reason: She enjoys the gassiness and burping, and it feels posh.
recommendations.quote: I quite enjoy the gassiness and I quite enjoy the burping that follows... And also it feels posh doesn't it?
recommendations.speaker: Dawn French

recommendations.item: Cheese bread (from the deli) / warm focaccia-style bread
recommendations.reason: A deli cheese bread broke her year without bread and cheese; she also likes posh warm focaccia from a basket.
recommendations.quote: I gave up bread for a year and I gave up cheese the same year. And then Satan who works at my deli made cheese bread and then I was lost.
recommendations.speaker: Dawn French

recommendations.item: Thinly sliced ripe pear with Iberico-style ham and balsamic drizzle (walnuts optional)
recommendations.reason: A starter she had once in a restaurant and never forgot; paper-thin ham, ripe pear and a balsamic drizzle.
recommendations.quote: thinly sliced ripe pear with really excellent ham. With a balsamic drizzle on the top, it's posh... it was so divine.
recommendations.speaker: Dawn French

recommendations.item: Traditional Cornish pasty (beef skirt, swede, potato, onion; no carrot) made by her mother
recommendations.reason: Made with love by her late mum, giant battleship-sized and traditional with no carrot.
recommendations.quote: my own mother's pasty made with your own mother's love and that's the whole principal folded in.
recommendations.speaker: Dawn French

recommendations.item: Christmas Eve beans on toast with grated cheddar, Marmite and salad cream
recommendations.reason: Her family's Christmas Eve tradition: easy, comforting, and the start of Christmas for her.
recommendations.quote: Every Christmas Eve, that's what we have in our family... And honestly, I long for it.
recommendations.speaker: Dawn French

recommendations.item: Very thin string chips with ketchup and mayo mixed
recommendations.reason: She loves tiny thin chips that are impossible to make at home, dipped in a builder's Marie Rose.
recommendations.quote: I like the very, very thin-, the little tiny thin ones that are very bad for you.
recommendations.speaker: Dawn French

recommendations.item: Castledore Fowey Valley Cider
recommendations.reason: Made by her best friend's husband from Fowey Valley apples; light, not rough, neither sweet nor dry, and goes with everything.
recommendations.quote: it's not rough, it's beautiful and light, and oh, it's heavenly... it just goes with everything, it's absolutely divine.
recommendations.speaker: Dawn French

recommendations.item: Assiette of mini desserts (tiramisu, lemon meringue, chocolate mousse, pistachio cannoli) with black coffee and Terry's Chocolate Orange
recommendations.reason: Lots of small bites with a black coffee before bed.
recommendations.quote: a little tiramisu, a little coconutty thing, a little chocolatey thing. Lots of different-, I like that, because I like to have coffee at the same time
recommendations.speaker: Dawn French

recommendations.item: Ivor Dewdney's pasties
recommendations.reason: Plymouth pasties Argyle fans prefer to Ginsters, smuggled into matches down the front of her top to keep warm.
recommendations.quote: Ivor Dewdney's pasties are the ones we prefer to Ginsters, so what you do if you're going to an Argyle match is you get an Ivor Dewdney pasty, you stick it down your front and…
recommendations.speaker: Dawn French

episodes.title: Ep 217: Ross Noble (Christmas Special)
episodes.summary: Ross Noble (Christmas episode) chooses big-bubble sparkling water with lime cordial, poppadoms for the sauces, steak tartare, crispy duck pancakes, chicken wings, rhubarb Cawston Press, and a 'crumble roulette' dessert with Viennetta and a custard tap.

recommendations.item: Densely sparkling water with a drop of lime cordial
recommendations.reason: He likes big, thick bubbles rather than fine ones, with a little lime cordial.
recommendations.quote: the ultimate for me would be large bottle of densely sparkling water, just a little drop of lime cordial.
recommendations.speaker: Ross Noble

recommendations.item: Poppadoms (for the sauces, ideally syringed into the mouth)
recommendations.reason: He picks poppadoms mainly as a vehicle for the mint sauce and mango chutney.
recommendations.quote: the thing about poppadoms for me is they're only really the means of transporting the sauces into your mouth.
recommendations.speaker: Ross Noble

recommendations.item: Steak tartare with an egg on top, main-size portion
recommendations.reason: He likes good-quality hand-cut steak with the egg left on top so he can mix it himself; he hated a minced, table-side-mixed version at Sardi's in New York.
recommendations.quote: a really nice steak tartare there, an egg on the top for me to mix at my discretion.
recommendations.speaker: Ross Noble

recommendations.item: Crispy duck with pancakes
recommendations.reason: He loves the DIY element of assembling pancakes from a whole duck, with hoisin in a gravy boat.
recommendations.quote: I like the whole duck, you know when they bring the duck out
recommendations.speaker: Ross Noble

recommendations.item: Christmas dinner (turkey, chicken, Brussels sprouts, long pigs in blankets)
recommendations.reason: His Christmas dream plate has heavy sprouts and extra-long bacon-wrapped sausages; he recalls a childhood Christmas where strawberry jam was mistaken for cranberry sauce.
recommendations.quote: I'd like a full, almost like a bacon taco with a sausage centre
recommendations.speaker: Ross Noble

recommendations.item: Chicken wings
recommendations.reason: His favourite food, which gave him gout after a week of Dublin chicken wing crawling with Jason Manford.
recommendations.quote: my favourite food is chicken wings, right? But not fried chicken wings
recommendations.speaker: Ross Noble

recommendations.item: Cawston Press rhubarb
recommendations.reason: He is addicted to the rhubarb soft drink, describing it as tasting of the allotment; runner-up was Bundaberg lemon lime bitters.
recommendations.quote: I'm absolutely addicted to it
recommendations.speaker: Ross Noble

recommendations.item: Crumble roulette with crumble roulade, Viennetta, hot chocolate sauce and a custard tap
recommendations.reason: An invented dessert of 31 different crumbles on a roulette wheel plus Viennetta and endless hot custard.
recommendations.quote: I want 31 crumbles and the green thing, you know, the zero for the house, that can just be a little bit of cream.
recommendations.speaker: Ross Noble

recommendations.item: Carvery roast and endless custard
recommendations.reason: Ross enthuses about the chain for a massive plate of veg and endless custard when touring.
recommendations.quote: I absolutely love Toby Carvery because the great thing about it is you don't have to go for all the meats.
recommendations.speaker: Ross Noble

recommendations.item: Viennetta affogato
recommendations.reason: James recently had an espresso poured over Viennetta there and calls it brilliant.
recommendations.quote: they did a Viennetta affogato.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

episodes.title: Ep 218: Jada Pinkett Smith
episodes.summary: Jada Pinkett Smith picks still water with lemon and one ice cube, monkey bread with honey butter, a Cafe Gratitude green salad, a Houston's veggie burger, old-school McDonald's fries, lavender lemonade, and Dear Bella's vegan Taiwanese pineapple cake ice cream.

recommendations.item: Still water with a twist of lemon and a single ice cube (sparkling if it's a big night)
recommendations.reason: She dislikes glasses stuffed with ice and wants lemon and just one cube.
recommendations.quote: That's non negotiable. And a little-, just one cube of ice.
recommendations.speaker: Jada Pinkett Smith

recommendations.item: Monkey bread with melted honey butter (or sweet buttery pretzel bread)
recommendations.reason: Her favourite bread: tender, hot, buttery and pull-apart, usually found at Southern soul food restaurants.
recommendations.quote: my favourite bread of all... you go to, like, soul food restaurants. Monkey bread.
recommendations.speaker: Jada Pinkett Smith

recommendations.item: Green salad with mango vinaigrette (the Gratitude bowl)
recommendations.reason: She likes to start with greens to get things moving, and names this vegan LA spot as her go-to for salad.
recommendations.quote: There is a place in LA called Café Gratitude.
recommendations.speaker: Jada Pinkett Smith

recommendations.item: Veggie burger
recommendations.reason: Their veggie burger tastes like a juicy chargrilled beef burger, far better than Impossible burgers.
recommendations.quote: I got a veggie burger that tastes like a straight up grilled beef burger. Want to talk about magic?
recommendations.speaker: Jada Pinkett Smith

recommendations.item: Old-school McDonald's French fries
recommendations.reason: She loves French fries anywhere and misses the original McDonald's fries from her childhood, before the recipe changed; Houston's fries are also good.
recommendations.quote: Give me the OG McDonald's French fries any day. I miss them.
recommendations.speaker: Jada Pinkett Smith

recommendations.item: Lavender lemonade with vodka, one ice cube each
recommendations.reason: She got addicted to lavender lemonade at an unnamed New Orleans restaurant while Will was filming there, and loves its gentle floral balance.
recommendations.quote: there was a restaurant that I used to go to in New Orleans... that's when I got really addicted to the lavender lemonades.
recommendations.speaker: Jada Pinkett Smith

recommendations.item: Taiwanese pineapple cake vegan ice cream
recommendations.reason: Handmade vegan ice cream so creamy you would never know; she throws ice cream parties with flavours like Vietnamese coffee and gingerbread.
recommendations.quote: you've got to go to Dear Bella. Best... ice cream. It's vegan but... you would never know that it's vegan.
recommendations.speaker: Jada Pinkett Smith

recommendations.item: Kentucky fried mussels in garlic butter
recommendations.reason: James had crispy fried mussels in garlic butter there that week and loved them.
recommendations.quote: They were so good. Really crispy mussels. But still flavourful... In this garlic butter as well.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Frickles (fried pickles)
recommendations.reason: Ed points to it as a UK place doing fried pickles.
recommendations.quote: MEATliquor do frickles.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

episodes.title: Ep 219: Jamelia (Live in Birmingham)
episodes.summary: Jamelia (live in Birmingham) picks sealed still Evian, warm rosemary-salted bread with oil and balsamic, curried chicken fried dumplings, Haidilao hot pot, fried plantain, sexy juice and carrot juice, and a deconstructed apple crumble.

recommendations.item: Still Evian in a sealed plastic bottle
recommendations.reason: She only drinks Evian and insists on a sealed bottle so nobody can pass off tap water as still.
recommendations.quote: Still water but in a bottle with the top screwed on.
recommendations.speaker: Jamelia

recommendations.item: Warm bread with rosemary and salt, with olive oil and balsamic to dip
recommendations.reason: She dislikes hard crusty bread and restaurant butter; she wants it warm, seasoned, with the oil and balsamic dipping ritual.
recommendations.quote: in a restaurant, the bread has to be warm. I do like it if it's got something else going on, like rosemary and salt
recommendations.speaker: Jamelia

recommendations.item: Curried chicken fried dumplings
recommendations.reason: A Jamaican fried dumpling stuffed with curried chicken that she cooked on MasterChef and can make with her eyes closed.
recommendations.quote: the fried dumpling that I made on MasterChef was like a curry chicken dumpling.
recommendations.speaker: Jamelia

recommendations.item: Hot pot cooked at the table (with prawn paste and hand-pulled noodles)
recommendations.reason: She loves the interactive hot pot where a robot brings the ingredients and you cook everything yourself; the kids are entertained and the prawn mash is a highlight.
recommendations.quote: it's the fact that I've cooked it myself so I know it's alright.
recommendations.speaker: Jamelia

recommendations.item: Fried plantain
recommendations.reason: Sweet fried banana-like plantain that goes with any savoury meal; her favourite way is fried.
recommendations.quote: You can cook plantain in so many different ways but I like it fried, that's my favourite way.
recommendations.speaker: Jamelia

recommendations.item: Sexy juice (pineapple juice, condensed milk, nutmeg, cinnamon) and carrot juice
recommendations.reason: Caribbean-style juice drinks blended with condensed milk and spices; she ends up asking for both.
recommendations.quote: It's pineapple juice, condensed milk, a bit of nutmeg, a bit of cinnamon. It's not fancy, but it's delicious
recommendations.speaker: Jamelia

recommendations.item: Deconstructed apple crumble with custard foam and sponge sugar inside a chocolate sphere with smoke
recommendations.reason: The over-ambitious dish she planned for the MasterChef final; in the dream restaurant she gets the skill to cook it herself.
recommendations.quote: a deconstructed apple crumble with a custard foam, with sponge sugar inside a chocolate sphere. And it was going to have, like, smoke coming out.
recommendations.speaker: Jamelia

episodes.title: Ep 220: Peter Capaldi
episodes.summary: Peter Capaldi picks Glasgow tap water, a bottomless bread basket, popcorn calamari, carbonara, rocket salad, a ginger and elderflower drink from Floral Hall, and panettone bread and butter pudding.

recommendations.item: Glasgow tap water, turned on by Paolo Nutini
recommendations.reason: He prefers tap water as a sign a restaurant is looking after you, and wants proper Glasgow water.
recommendations.quote: I think the water in Glasgow is great, so I'd have some Glasgow water, yes.
recommendations.speaker: Peter Capaldi

recommendations.item: Sourdough or crusty seeded rolls, big basket replaced without ceremony
recommendations.reason: Loves poppadoms with chutney but picks bread: a big basket that is quietly refilled.
recommendations.quote: Replace it and replace it without ceremony.
recommendations.speaker: Peter Capaldi

recommendations.item: Calamari (popcorn-sized)
recommendations.reason: He likes calamari, bar the annoying rubbery ping-back from rings, so James makes it bite-sized.
recommendations.quote: it's when you eat them... you get a whack as the rubbery ping hits you.
recommendations.speaker: Peter Capaldi

recommendations.item: Spaghetti carbonara
recommendations.reason: Simple Italian comfort food he loves, from his half-Italian background, though he has no particular restaurant for it.
recommendations.quote: I like Italian food, obviously. It would be between lasagne, spaghetti carbonara, or spaghetti bolognese.
recommendations.speaker: Peter Capaldi

recommendations.item: Rocket salad with parmesan shavings
recommendations.reason: A simple rocket salad with flake-sized parmesan shavings.
recommendations.quote: Flake size. Probably about one centimetre square.
recommendations.speaker: Peter Capaldi

recommendations.item: Ginger and elderflower drink (the 'Capaldi')
recommendations.reason: A non-alcoholic ginger and elderflower drink made to the owner's own recipe at his local tapas place, where they just bring him dishes without a menu.
recommendations.quote: she makes me a ginger and elder flower drink with her own recipe... it's wonderful
recommendations.speaker: Peter Capaldi

recommendations.item: Panettone bread and butter pudding with custard
recommendations.reason: His own recipe, layering sliced panettone with custard mix, baked and served with extra custard.
recommendations.quote: bread and butter pudding is one of the greatest dishes and I make it myself with Panettone
recommendations.speaker: Peter Capaldi

recommendations.item: Fine dining, old-school showbiz
recommendations.location: West Street, Covent Garden, London, UK
recommendations.reason: The old Ivy was the one restaurant where staff treated everyone, even his mother, warmly and without intimidation.
recommendations.quote: they treated you so well and so openly.
recommendations.speaker: Peter Capaldi

episodes.title: Ep 221: Elis James (Live in London)
episodes.summary: Elis James (live at the Royal Albert Hall) picks still water in a glass bottle, ultra-crusty French bread from a 1983 Tesco, a big plate of sausages plus salmon sashimi with pickled ginger, sea bass with dauphinoise and a 50p-sized steak, a box of Milk Tray, a James Hoffmann V60 coffee with Grolsch and Ribena, and Little Chef's Mississippi mud cake.

recommendations.item: Still water in a glass bottle
recommendations.reason: Sparkling water tastes like flat lemonade to him, whereas still water in a heavy glass bottle feels classy and is properly thirst quenching.
recommendations.quote: still water out of a glass bottle just feels classy, you know? When you think, 'This is living isn't it?'
recommendations.speaker: Elis James

recommendations.item: Very crusty French bread straight from the packet, no butter, eaten as a child in a trolley
recommendations.reason: A nostalgic memory of being pushed round Tesco in the 1980s as a kid, scooping out the dough then eating the crust; he says it is the happiest he has been eating bread.
recommendations.quote: It's got to be crust, French bread, that is so crusty it makes people laugh out loud when they bite into it.
recommendations.speaker: Elis James

recommendations.item: Big plate of Cumberland-style sausages for the table, cooked a minute less than Elvis burns them in Fireman Sam, with ketchup
recommendations.reason: Inspired by finishing his daughter's sausages at Betty's; he realised he wanted to eat them three times a day.
recommendations.quote: I just thought to myself, 'Why am I not eating these three times a day, every day?'
recommendations.speaker: Elis James

recommendations.item: Salmon sashimi with pickled ginger
recommendations.reason: His ginger obsession began with his 'project spice' to learn to like spicy food; he can never get enough pickled ginger.
recommendations.quote: there is no such thing as enough. Like, when I go to Wasabi, I will order maybe 25 packets of the little gingers.
recommendations.speaker: Elis James

recommendations.item: Sea bass with steamed greens (spinach with nutmeg, green beans, Tenderstem broccoli), dauphinoise potatoes and a 50p-sized disc of steak with English mustard
recommendations.reason: The dauphinoise comes from a steak and dauphinoise dinner at an unnamed Crystal Palace restaurant that he called the best thing he had ever eaten; the rest is light so he can go clubbing afterwards.
recommendations.quote: I had steak and dauphinoise potatoes in a place in Crystal Palace, and at the end I shook hands with the waiter to tell him that it's literally the best thing I've ever eaten in…
recommendations.speaker: Elis James

recommendations.item: Box of Milk Tray where the third tier is all Turkish delight
recommendations.reason: Pure indulgence; he loves the neglected Turkish delight ones and wants a whole layer, eaten in a ten-minute silent sabbatical.
recommendations.quote: I would have a whole tray of that one because there's never enough of it.
recommendations.speaker: Elis James

recommendations.item: V60 hand-brew coffee from Panamanian Geisha beans made by James Hoffmann, with a can of Grolsch and a pint of Ribena
recommendations.reason: He has become a coffee enthusiast and idolises YouTuber James Hoffmann, while Grolsch tastes simply like beer and Ribena is the childhood squash.
recommendations.quote: coffee is the one area where I get really pretentious, so I would like a pretentious coffee but then washed down with a nice can of Grolsch.
recommendations.speaker: Elis James

recommendations.item: Mississippi mud cake (served cold)
recommendations.location: St Clears, near Carmarthen, Wales, UK (closed)
recommendations.reason: A childhood treat at the Little Chef near Carmarthen, usually after the Olympic breakfast, with a barley sugar lolly at the till; the cold fondant icing has real heft.
recommendations.quote: I tended to have the Olympic breakfast when I was eating at Little Chef, followed by the Mississippi mud cake
recommendations.speaker: Elis James

recommendations.item: Sausage, beans and chips
recommendations.reason: Elis ate his daughter's sausages there at the weekend and was inspired by them; he also praises the Edwardian-style staff and the really nice cup of tea despite the 45-minute wait.
recommendations.quote: they make a really nice cup of tea
recommendations.speaker: Elis James

recommendations.item: Burger on a plate with finely diced onions
recommendations.reason: Nostalgic favourite burger of his childhood, which he still thinks beats McDonald's and Burger King.
recommendations.quote: My favourite burger would've been Wimpy, which I actually still think is better.
recommendations.speaker: Elis James

episodes.title: Ep 222: Nabil Abdulrashid
episodes.summary: Nabil's menu celebrates northern Nigerian (Hausa) food plus Indo-Malaysian roti canai: still water, roti canai with curry, mixed balangu/suya, miyan taushe, moi moi, zobo and shahi tukray.

recommendations.item: Still water
recommendations.reason: Distrusts sparkling water as regular water 'the Illuminati farted in'.
recommendations.quote: I can't drink sparkling because I believe it's regular water that the Illuminati farted in.
recommendations.speaker: Nabil Abdulrashid

recommendations.item: Roti canai with Indo-Malaysian curry
recommendations.reason: Fell in love with Indo-Malaysian food through a silat martial arts group; recommends Rasa Sayang in Chinatown for it. The roti canai is soft and pancake-like.
recommendations.quote: if you want to try good Indonesian, Indo-Malaysian food, Rasa Sayang, which is literally a straight line from Soho Theatre. It's in Chinatown. Amazing.
recommendations.speaker: Nabil Abdulrashid

recommendations.item: Mixed balangu and suya (lamb, chicken, fish) with masa rice cakes
