recommendations.reason: Northern Nigerian barbecue roasted for hours, served in newspaper with byadgi chilli powder and onions; he sends listeners to a Hausa-run place in Norbury.
recommendations.quote: there's a place called Baba Foundation in Norbury and he actually is a Hausa man like me ... especially when it comes to our BBQ stuff
recommendations.speaker: Nabil Abdulrashid

recommendations.item: Miyan taushe (pumpkin and peanut butter stew) with ground rice
recommendations.reason: A distinctly northern Nigerian sweet, nutty, spicy stew that aunties send him when he visits home.
recommendations.quote: it's a sweet, nutty, spicy dish. It's amazing.
recommendations.speaker: Nabil Abdulrashid

recommendations.item: Moi moi (steamed bean cake)
recommendations.reason: Steamed ground-bean cake, high in protein, with a boiled egg inside; also related to akara and Brazilian acaraje.
recommendations.quote: you get beans ground into a paste, and you can get put in like a boiled egg in there ... and steam it
recommendations.speaker: Nabil Abdulrashid

recommendations.item: Zobo (hibiscus drink)
recommendations.reason: Chilled hibiscus drink with ginger, cloves and cinnamon that he says is one of the best things he has tasted; he is teetotal.
recommendations.quote: that drink is probably one of the best things I have ever tasted in my life.
recommendations.speaker: Nabil Abdulrashid

recommendations.item: Shahi tukray (bread pudding)
recommendations.reason: His wife's auntie's Pakistani-style bread pudding with cinnamon and rose petals; chosen partly to represent his wife's culture.
recommendations.quote: Sweet, cinnamony, bready.
recommendations.speaker: Nabil Abdulrashid

recommendations.item: Nigerian Chapman drink
recommendations.reason: Says it is the only restaurant outside Nigeria making a proper Chapman and he suspects magic is involved.
recommendations.quote: only one restaurant anywhere outside of Nigeria makes it and it's called Enish.
recommendations.speaker: Nabil Abdulrashid

recommendations.item: Indo-Malaysian food
recommendations.reason: Ed Gamble suggests it as an Indo-Malaysian alternative to Rasa Sayang.
recommendations.quote: Or Uncle Lim's in Croydon.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

episodes.title: Ep 223: Mathew Baynton (Live in London)
episodes.summary: Mat Baynton (live at the Royal Albert Hall) has a Vieux Carre then bread by Bike sourdough, fennel and apple salad, cacio e pepe, vegan Ethiopian on injera, No Catch chips, Torrontes and a krapfen custard doughnut.

recommendations.item: Vieux Carre cocktail (pre-meal)
recommendations.reason: One of his favourite cocktails, like a smooth heavenly Manhattan with rye, cognac, vermouth and Benedictine.
recommendations.quote: It's just heaven. It's a bit like a Manhattan, you've got equal parts rye whiskey, cognac, sweet vermouth and then a little bit of Benedictine
recommendations.speaker: Mathew Baynton

recommendations.item: Still tap water (medium hard) or gin, elderflower liqueur and lime
recommendations.reason: Just tap water to measure out the booze, swapped for a gin and elderflower cocktail.
recommendations.quote: I'll have some gin, with some elderflower liqueur and a bit of lime squeeze in.
recommendations.speaker: Mathew Baynton

recommendations.item: Sourdough with hummus
recommendations.reason: Moist sourdough without big holes and a caramelised chewy crust, tied to a lovely family bike ride and park picnic with hummus.
recommendations.quote: it's the perfect sour dough. It's the best one I've ever had. ... the crust is, sort of, almost burnt in a way that's like, almost caramelised and sweet and chewy and beautiful.
recommendations.speaker: Mathew Baynton

recommendations.item: Fennel and apple salad
recommendations.reason: Finely shaved fennel and apple with a great dressing at a Scottish-Italian fusion local that closed after COVID.
recommendations.quote: the aniseed-y flavour of the fennel and the sweetness of the apple was incredible together
recommendations.speaker: Mathew Baynton

recommendations.item: Cacio e pepe
recommendations.reason: His first ever cacio e pepe, eaten on a dispiriting LA trip, was amazing and started a habit of ordering it everywhere.
recommendations.quote: it was just amazing and after that it became a, sort of, thing of anywhere where it was on the menu, I wanted it.
recommendations.speaker: Mathew Baynton

recommendations.item: Vegan Ethiopian feast on injera
recommendations.reason: First tried at a stall run by one lady years ago and mind-blowing; he wants to taste it for the first time again.
recommendations.quote: there was this stall there, it was just this one lady with this incredible array of stuff that smelled amazing
recommendations.speaker: Mathew Baynton

recommendations.item: Chips with salt, vinegar and mushy peas
recommendations.reason: Vegan fish and chip shop by the beach with crispy-outside, soft-inside chippy chips.
recommendations.quote: They're a little bit crispy on the outside, very soft on the inside, they're chippy chips.
recommendations.speaker: Mathew Baynton

recommendations.item: Torrontes white wine
recommendations.reason: First wine he truly loved, drunk as a student in a jazz bar; dry, crisp and floral.
recommendations.quote: this wine was the first one I had where I was like, 'That's fucking lovely.'
recommendations.speaker: Mathew Baynton

recommendations.item: Custard doughnut (krapfen con crema)
recommendations.reason: Nostalgic Italian holiday breakfast with his dad and brothers, giggling at the name.
recommendations.quote: I still just fucking love a custard doughnut. ... I could never, ever, ever say no to a custard doughnut.
recommendations.speaker: Mathew Baynton

recommendations.item: Amaro digestif
recommendations.reason: A shot of Italian bitter liqueur to finish.
recommendations.quote: It's an Italian bitter liqueur, that's Amaro.
recommendations.speaker: Mathew Baynton

recommendations.item: Masala dosa (vegetarian Indian)
recommendations.reason: Honourable mention: shabby, no-service vegetarian Indian where everything including the masala dosa is incredible.
recommendations.quote: everything is incredible. And there's a masala dosa that they do that's just incredible, amazing.
recommendations.speaker: Mathew Baynton

recommendations.item: Doughnut ice cream sandwich
recommendations.reason: A recent dessert: a halved doughnut with vanilla ice cream and hot chocolate sauce.
recommendations.quote: It was a doughnut cut in half with vanilla ice cream and then like, hot chocolate sauce.
recommendations.speaker: Mathew Baynton

episodes.title: Ep 224: CMAT
episodes.summary: CMAT's butter-heavy, French-leaning dream menu: still water, baguette with a flight of Bordier butter, fried artichoke and broccolini, salmon risotto from a Paris bistro, butter beans, Chablis and Cool Swan, and Nigella's Christmas bread and butter pudding.

recommendations.item: Still water
recommendations.reason: She dislikes fizzy water, which she says feels wrong in the mouth unless it has lemon in it.
recommendations.quote: Still. I'm not a psychopath. I want still water with my meal.
recommendations.speaker: CMAT

recommendations.item: French baguette with a flight of Bordier butter
recommendations.reason: She is obsessed with a video of Monsieur Bordier crying over his hand-made butter and has never managed to find it in Paris. She wants a plank with seaweed, chilli, salted and unsalted butters.
recommendations.quote: I think because this is my dream and I haven't had it yet, I'm going with the Bordier butter.
recommendations.speaker: CMAT

recommendations.item: Parmesan-battered deep-fried artichoke and broccolini
recommendations.reason: She had the battered, parmesan-dusted fried artichoke here in summer and loves a 'filthy vegetable'. The transcript spells it 'Lena Stores'.
recommendations.quote: I think something that's very important to me in this life is a filthy vegetable.
recommendations.speaker: CMAT

recommendations.item: Deep-fried parmesan-battered broccoli and broccolini
recommendations.reason: A Brighton restaurant near where she lives doing a similar fried, powdered-parmesan broccolini that she finds unbelievably good. Spelling is from the transcript.
recommendations.quote: it's genuinely unbelievably good.
recommendations.speaker: CMAT

recommendations.item: Risotto with poached salmon and mussels
recommendations.reason: The best main she ate that year: a chorizo-stock risotto finished with double cream, mussels and perfectly poached salmon with crispy skin, on a roughly 30-euro set menu found via the Michelin Guide app.
recommendations.quote: it was absolutely the best main course I've had this year, it was unbelievably good.
recommendations.speaker: CMAT

recommendations.item: Butter beans stewed in stock with vegetables
recommendations.reason: Served as a side to a mutton chop, the beans were arguably nicer than the chop. She also loved a home-cooked butter bean stew at a friend's mum's house in York.
recommendations.quote: the beans were arguably nicer than the chop.
recommendations.speaker: CMAT

recommendations.item: Chablis (with food), Kylie Minogue Provence rose, and Cool Swan over ice with dessert
recommendations.reason: A dry white goes with fish and veg, and she adores Cool Swan, a white chocolate Irish cream liqueur from County Waterford.
recommendations.quote: I love wine within the context of food.
recommendations.speaker: CMAT

recommendations.item: Nigella Lawson's Christmas bread and butter pudding with hot custard
recommendations.reason: She made it the week before, with mincemeat sandwiches layered in, and called it the best dessert of the year.
recommendations.quote: it is, like, the nicest dessert I've had all year.
recommendations.speaker: CMAT

recommendations.item: Pint of Guinness
recommendations.reason: Her local, which she says pours the best pint of Guinness she has ever had.
recommendations.quote: I've never had a better pint than in Brady's.
recommendations.speaker: CMAT

recommendations.item: Grasmere gingerbread
recommendations.reason: She bought boxes to calm the band and crew during rehearsals and calls it the nicest thing she has eaten.
recommendations.quote: the nicest shit I've ever had in my life.
recommendations.speaker: CMAT

recommendations.item: Challah with cinnamon raisin butter
recommendations.reason: A Jewish-Japanese restaurant serving mini challah with a sweet-savoury cinnamon raisin butter that blew her away, plus ramen with a matzo ball.
recommendations.quote: It was fucking great, would recommend
recommendations.speaker: CMAT

episodes.title: Ep 225: Susan Wokoma (Live in Bristol)
episodes.summary: Live Bristol show: sparkling water with lemon, warm bread with soft butter, unlimited rock oysters, truffle pasta from Paoli in Florence, her mum's okra soup, crackers with cheddar and ketchup, a tequila and pineapple Craig David, and a McFlurry with McDonald's chips.

recommendations.item: Sparkling water with a slice of lemon
recommendations.reason: Sparkling feels posh and worth paying for, with a decorative lemon slice.
recommendations.quote: It's like sexy water. I was like, 'I will part with money for that.'
recommendations.speaker: Susan Wokoma

recommendations.item: Warm soft bread with creamy melted butter, including fruit bread in a mixed basket
recommendations.reason: Loves a varied bread basket in a fancy place, with raisin bread among the selection and no sourdough or seeded loaves.
recommendations.quote: Warm, soft bread. We don't want anything too hard, and also, you need really, like, creamy, almost melted butter on it.
recommendations.speaker: Susan Wokoma

recommendations.item: Unlimited rock oysters with Tabasco, a little vinegar and lemon
recommendations.reason: Big meaty oysters, as many as she wants without sharing politely, served on a ruler.
recommendations.quote: my dream starter would be oysters, but as many as I f-ing want.
recommendations.speaker: Susan Wokoma

recommendations.item: Truffle spaghetti flamed in front of you
recommendations.reason: A friend took her here and the cheesy truffle pasta cooked with fire at the table was so good she cried and ordered three plates.
recommendations.quote: it was so good, I actually cried... I ordered three plates, and it was truffle pasta
recommendations.speaker: Susan Wokoma

recommendations.item: Okra soup (draw soup)
recommendations.reason: Her mum's Nigerian okra soup, stringy, spicy and grassy, made through her childhood; she likes it made by other people.
recommendations.quote: my mum was just King of making that all throughout my childhood
recommendations.speaker: Susan Wokoma

recommendations.item: Jacob's crackers with cheddar and ketchup
recommendations.reason: The only thing she kept from a bad ex: a cracker, cheese and ketchup sandwich she found gorgeous.
recommendations.quote: Jacob's crackers, slice of cheddar, just a couple of slices, ketchup, bish bosh, put in your mouth, gorgeous.
recommendations.speaker: Susan Wokoma

recommendations.item: A Craig David (tequila shot with pineapple juice chaser)
recommendations.reason: A drink she learned on her New Year's Eve birthday; she loves tequila and pineapple juice.
recommendations.quote: a Craig David is a shot of tequila, and then you have a chaser of orange, not orange juice, geez, no... pineapple juice.
recommendations.speaker: Susan Wokoma

recommendations.item: McFlurry (Crunchie) dipped with McDonald's chips
recommendations.reason: A stranger dropped chips into her and her sister's McFlurries as a teenager and the sweet-salty combo was delicious.
recommendations.quote: we ate it, and it was the most delicious thing I've ever tasted
recommendations.speaker: Susan Wokoma

episodes.title: Ep 226: Noel Fielding
episodes.summary: Noel Fielding picks liquefied 80s Party Rings from the tap, homemade garlic bread, a bowl of peeled lychees (with a boxing gerbil), the Ambrosia Burger at Nepenthe in Big Sur, his dad's mash in a hip flask made by Heston, the dregs of 10p ice poles, and a school Gypsy tart with butterscotch Angel Delight.

recommendations.item: Liquefied 1980s Party Rings coming out of the tap
recommendations.reason: He already has sparkling water on tap and is bored of it, so he wants the luminous Party Rings of his childhood liquefied instead.
recommendations.quote: I'd like to liquefy those and have them come out my taps. Liquid Party Rings.
recommendations.speaker: Noel Fielding

recommendations.item: Homemade garlic bread (about six cloves)
recommendations.reason: He loves toast and garlic, being half French, and makes it far too strong, claiming it sends you a few minutes into the future.
recommendations.quote: I really like toast, and I really like garlic. I'm half French... I like making my own garlic bread and I make it too strong, definitely.
recommendations.speaker: Noel Fielding

recommendations.item: Bowl of peeled lychees (washed through by a gerbil in lychee boxing gloves)
recommendations.reason: He likes clean, refreshing food and loves how lychees look, smell and feel; it becomes an absurd internal-cleansing fantasy.
recommendations.quote: I feel like it's clean, that food. I like clean food. Refreshing.
recommendations.speaker: Noel Fielding

recommendations.item: The famous Ambrosia Burger
recommendations.reason: A mountain-view restaurant where the Beat writers ate; the flat old-style burger was great and the Shaggy-like waiter was unforgettable.
recommendations.quote: He literally went, 'Well, little brother, we've been making them for 50 years, so it should be.' ... And then I did have the burger, and it was the greatest burger.
recommendations.speaker: Noel Fielding

recommendations.item: His dad's runny mashed potato in a Farley's Rusk hip flask, made by Heston Blumenthal
recommendations.reason: His dad's mash is the best he has had, and no restaurant matches it; he wants it drinkable.
recommendations.quote: My dad makes really good mashed potato... we'd always go, 'Let's see if the mash is as good as Dad's.' And it never would be.
recommendations.speaker: Noel Fielding

recommendations.item: A pint of the melted ends of 10p lemonade ice poles
recommendations.reason: Summer-holiday memory of cheap newsagent ice poles after tennis; the sweet juice at the bottom of the bag was the best bit.
recommendations.quote: There was the lemonade one. It was so good, the juice from that.
recommendations.speaker: Noel Fielding

recommendations.item: School Gypsy tart with butterscotch Angel Delight as a sauce
recommendations.reason: He loved the chewy-crunchy school dinner tart (the Bake Off version was not as good) and pairs it with Angel Delight, tied to bunking off school.
recommendations.quote: Gypsy tart, I loved... Maybe with Angel Delight as a sauce.
recommendations.speaker: Noel Fielding

recommendations.item: Miso burger
recommendations.reason: James and Ed recommend its miso burger as an excellent UK burger.
recommendations.quote: Should go to Black Bear in Brixton. Their miso burger... It might be the best burger I've ever had.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Baked beans and Polish food
recommendations.reason: Noel and friends used to go for the eccentric maitre d'; he thinks it has since closed.
recommendations.quote: We used to go there just for him, and he would just say obscure things like a stand-up.
recommendations.speaker: Noel Fielding

episodes.title: Ep 227: John Robins (Live in Bristol)
episodes.summary: Live Bristol Hippodrome episode: John Robins serves a nostalgic multi-course taster menu of foods he can never taste again, from banana antibiotics and Pickled Scrumion McCoy's to Schwartz's salt beef, 'The Cheese', and Heritage cafe's blonde bombshell gateau.

recommendations.item: Still water
recommendations.reason: Prefers still and says he does not trust people who like sparkling water.
recommendations.quote: I would like sparkling conversation. And still water, because I don't trust people who like sparkling water.
recommendations.speaker: John Robins

recommendations.item: Crusty focaccia with olive oil and balsamic
recommendations.reason: Wants a crusty, fluffy white focaccia, not too oily, with chunky salt and a hint of rosemary, dipped in bitter olive oil and thick sweet balsamic.
recommendations.quote: I just want a really crusty, doughy, white bread and-, like a focaccia, but not one that makes you feel like you've just, sort of, eaten a fried breakfast.
recommendations.speaker: John Robins

recommendations.item: Banana antibiotics (aperitif)
recommendations.reason: A childhood medicine flavour he can't have again as he is allergic to amoxicillin.
recommendations.quote: I remember the taste vividly. It was like pure, industrial banana flavour.
recommendations.speaker: John Robins

recommendations.item: Pickled Scrumion McCoy's crisps (hors d'oeuvre)
recommendations.reason: A limited-edition Rugby World Cup 2011 crisp flavour he found at a garage and ate in his car.
recommendations.quote: they were still the most delicious crisp I've ever tasted in my life.
recommendations.speaker: John Robins

recommendations.item: Stolen Portuguese breakfast buffet roll (amuse-bouche)
recommendations.reason: Cheese, onion, tomato, butter and mustard roll smuggled from the hotel buffet for his annual golf trip.
recommendations.quote: stolen Portuguese breakfast buffet roll, containing cheese, onion, tomato, butter and mustard.
recommendations.speaker: John Robins

recommendations.item: George Egg's cuppy egg on veggie haggis with Kismet's Mr Naga sauce and mocha pot coffee
recommendations.reason: Breakfast he shares with friend George Egg during the Edinburgh festival: microwaved mug egg, veggie haggis, cheese slice, hot sauce from Kismet curry house.
recommendations.quote: what we'd always have for breakfast together, which is George Egg's cuppy egg
recommendations.speaker: John Robins

recommendations.item: Mr Naga chilli sauce
recommendations.reason: The curry restaurant's hot sauce was so good they got a pot to take home; it is wonderful on eggs and melted cheese.
recommendations.quote: the hot sauce was so nice that we asked if we could take some home with us.
recommendations.speaker: John Robins

recommendations.item: Cured Alaskan salmon (fish course)
recommendations.reason: Jerky-textured Alaskan salmon eaten at the start of a romance while listening to the Rolling Stones.
recommendations.quote: the most delicious flavour, and I remember we were listening to the Rolling Stones Greatest Hits
recommendations.speaker: John Robins

recommendations.item: Auntie Anne's creme de menthe ice cream (palate cleanser)
recommendations.reason: Homemade ice cream by his mum's friend that he has never found elsewhere.
recommendations.quote: Auntie Anne used to make this crème de menthe ice cream, and it's good stuff.
recommendations.speaker: John Robins

recommendations.item: Salt beef sandwich, lean, on white with pickles
recommendations.reason: His first taste of salt beef on a trip to see his dad at age twelve; no London salt beef sandwich has matched that fist-thick stack.
recommendations.quote: it was the best flavour I think I'd encountered.
recommendations.speaker: John Robins

recommendations.item: 'The Cheese' (Maryland Farm mature cheddar wheel, cheese course)
recommendations.reason: A big black-waxed cheddar his stepdad brought back from Somerset that converted everyone who tasted it.
recommendations.quote: I thought I knew cheddar before I tasted "The Cheese".
recommendations.speaker: John Robins

recommendations.item: Fried salt cod with onions and Aunt May's Bajan hot pepper sauce
recommendations.reason: Crispy salty cod with onions and a fiery Bajan pepper sauce, discovered at a buffet breakfast.
recommendations.quote: I'd never had Bajan hot pepper sauce before, it's insane man.
recommendations.speaker: John Robins

recommendations.item: Coffee from a chilly bottle with pastries on Arthur's Seat
recommendations.reason: Coffee and pastries shared on a walk with the woman he met at the Edinburgh festival, a happy sober memory.
recommendations.quote: I would like to have that water bottle, full of coffee, and the pastries, as my drink.
recommendations.speaker: John Robins

recommendations.item: Blonde bombshell white chocolate gateau
recommendations.reason: A layered white and milk chocolate sponge dome he had every Saturday with his mum at Heritage coffee shop as a kid; no longer made.
recommendations.quote: as a kid, this was the highlight of the week.
recommendations.speaker: John Robins

recommendations.item: Focaccia and farinata
recommendations.reason: Ed and James had banging, fluffy focaccia and a complimentary chickpea farinata there the same day; James considered adding it to his menu.
recommendations.quote: We had some banging focaccia today, at Sonny Stores. What a restaurant.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Duck liver parfait with cocktail cherries
recommendations.reason: Ed raves about the amazing duck liver parfait served with whisky-sour style cherries.
recommendations.quote: I've since been to the wonderful restaurant Black Axe Mangal, and they had a duck liver parfait with the cherries... and it was amazing.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

episodes.title: Ep 228: Ray Winstone
episodes.summary: Ray Winstone's light fish-led feast: sparkling water with lemon, crispy bread with his own Sicilian olive oil, dressed crab with cockles, burnt artichokes, tempura Dover sole from a Sicilian restaurant, cauliflower cheese, vodka and coke and a classic creme brulee.

recommendations.item: Sparkling water with chunky ice and squeezed lemon
recommendations.reason: Sparkling is more interesting, and he likes to fancy it up with a big squeeze of lemon and big ice chunks.
recommendations.quote: You get a big half a lemon and squeeze it in there.
recommendations.speaker: Ray Winstone

recommendations.item: Light crispy bread or sourdough with olive oil
recommendations.venue: Ray's own olive oil from his Sicilian land
recommendations.reason: He wants something light and crispy to start, dipped in the olive oil he makes from his own trees in Sicily for the family.
recommendations.quote: I make my own olive oil. I've got olive trees in Sicily
recommendations.speaker: Ray Winstone

recommendations.item: Dressed crab with lemon, seafood sauce and a few cockles
recommendations.reason: Light and gets you in the flow; he recalls a one-off crab with baked cheddar on top at Smiths in Ongar that was unforgettable.
recommendations.quote: dressed crab with baked cheddar cheese on the top is different class.
recommendations.speaker: Ray Winstone

recommendations.item: Burnt roasted artichokes with olive oil, salt and pepper
recommendations.reason: An in-between course he's mad for: scrubbed, halved, oiled and roasted until burnt, and very good for you.
recommendations.quote: You've got to burn them... They are the governors, and they're very, very good for you.
recommendations.speaker: Ray Winstone

recommendations.item: Dover sole in tempura
recommendations.reason: He ordered Dover sole pan-fried, the chef misunderstood or ignored him and served it in tempura, and it turned out to be the best thing he's eaten.
recommendations.quote: it was the best thing I've ever eaten. It was so light, the tempura
recommendations.speaker: Ray Winstone

recommendations.item: Cauliflower cheese (two portions)
recommendations.reason: He has it with fish at his local seafood restaurant and has to order two because everyone at the table wants some.
recommendations.quote: They make it very good in Smiths in Ongar.
recommendations.speaker: Ray Winstone

recommendations.item: Vodka and coke with lots of ice and a slice of lemon (plus Nero d'Avola, Planeta rose, Amarone with the meal)
recommendations.reason: An easy drink that doesn't give him a hangover; he leaves the lemon slices in to count his drinks, and Sicilian reds and rose accompany the fish.
recommendations.quote: it's an easy drink and you don't get a hangover with it I've found, is a vodka and coke funnily enough.
recommendations.speaker: Ray Winstone

recommendations.item: Classic creme brulee
recommendations.reason: It's light so you don't leave the table stuffed, and he loves cracking the toffee top.
recommendations.quote: It's light, isn't it? ... It's that little bit of toffee.
recommendations.speaker: Ray Winstone

recommendations.item: Fish restaurant, Dover sole and seafood
recommendations.reason: His favourite fish restaurant, which he's been going to since he was a little kid, run by the same family throughout.
recommendations.quote: My favourite, favourite fish restaurant that I've been going to since I was a little kid is Smiths in Ongar.
recommendations.speaker: Ray Winstone

recommendations.item: Dover sole
recommendations.reason: He names it as another place to get a good Dover sole (transcribed as 'Scots').
recommendations.quote: I'll tell you where else you get a good Dover sole, Scots.
recommendations.speaker: Ray Winstone

episodes.title: Ep 229: Sam Campbell (Live in Nottingham)
episodes.summary: Live Nottingham episode: Sam Campbell, in a sausage-on-a-fork crash helmet, picks library sparkling water, poppadoms with plenty of yoghurt, a Pepper Crunch sandwich, biang biang noodles, fattoush and mujadara, Portino soft drink and his mum's sponge roll with vanilla ice cream.

recommendations.item: Sparkling water (free refills)
recommendations.reason: He got into sparkling water at this Sydney library, which offers free sparkling refills once you have your bottle.
recommendations.quote: You can get free refills of sparkling water, so once you get your first bottle, you hold onto that all day.
recommendations.speaker: Sam Campbell

recommendations.item: Poppadoms with plenty of yoghurt, lime pickle, mango chutney and raw onion
recommendations.reason: He likes to dip poppadoms in generously served yoghurt, usually when sharing with a group.
recommendations.quote: Listen, I'm going to go with poppadoms and don't be conservative with the yoghurt.
recommendations.speaker: Sam Campbell

recommendations.item: Pepper Crunch sandwich (roasted peppers, red onion, bechamel)
recommendations.reason: A sensational sandwich from a Brighton sandwich shop that he thinks deserves a higher Google rating.
recommendations.quote: Crunch & Co, in Brighton. 4.4 rating, but it deserves more.
recommendations.speaker: Sam Campbell

recommendations.item: Biang biang noodles with oil and bok choy
recommendations.location: Holloway, near the Emirates Stadium, London, UK
recommendations.reason: Extremely long, wide hand-pulled Shaanxi noodles that seem to go on forever. A fan in the audience said he'd ordered from there 23 times.
recommendations.quote: It's a delicious, long, flat noodle... You're like, 'I've been eating this same noodle for, like, twenty minutes.'
recommendations.speaker: Sam Campbell

recommendations.item: Fattoush salad with mujadara (lentils and caramelised onion)
recommendations.reason: He ate a lot of Middle Eastern food while living in Lakemba and remembers the mujadara there, which a businessman paid for.
recommendations.quote: I was eating a lot of Middle Eastern food for a while and that was a favourite of mine.
recommendations.speaker: Sam Campbell

recommendations.item: Portino (Australian soft drink)
recommendations.reason: A grape-and-berry soft drink from his Queensland childhood, drunk with a friend near the Mon Repos turtle beach.
recommendations.quote: We just loved drinking Portino.
recommendations.speaker: Sam Campbell

recommendations.item: Mum's sponge roll (Swiss roll) with vanilla ice cream
recommendations.reason: His mum bakes sponge rolls in huge quantities for the whole community, and vanilla ice cream finishes it.
recommendations.quote: I think vanilla is the best choice to go with the sponge roll.
recommendations.speaker: Sam Campbell

recommendations.item: Hell's Kitchen sushi and salmon tartare
recommendations.reason: His most-ordered Uber Eats takeaway; he reckons he is in the top one percent of customers.
recommendations.quote: I order from Sticks'n'Sushi a lot and I always get the Hell's Kitchen sushi and the salmon tartare stuff.
recommendations.speaker: Sam Campbell

episodes.title: Ep 230: Nisha Katona
episodes.summary: Nisha Katona, founder of Mowgli, picks a plum drinking vinegar from Ducksoup, a stretchy bread basket, Sicilian sea urchin spaghetti, a Pang Pang fish head hot pot, her own roast potatoes and KFC hot wings, a kinako latte from Tsujiri and Biscoff soufflé pancakes from Hefaure.

recommendations.item: Plum drinking vinegar (instead of still or sparkling water)
recommendations.reason: She dislikes both still and sparkling water and loves Ducksoup's crisp, fruity drinking vinegars served in a tumbler.
recommendations.quote: there are some drinks where you drink it and you feel your cells are putting their arms out and hugging whatever you've just put in your body... that's what these drinking vinegars are like in…
recommendations.speaker: Nisha Katona

recommendations.item: Bread basket of Brazilian cheese bread (pao de queijo), Irish soda bread and the stretchy inside of a croissant
recommendations.reason: She loves chewy, elastic breads, which were absent from her Hindu childhood; she dislikes sourdough.
recommendations.quote: it's like cheesy, bready, chewing gum. Oh God, it was heaven, so good.
recommendations.speaker: Nisha Katona

recommendations.item: Spaghetti ricci di mare (sea urchin spaghetti)
recommendations.reason: A simple dish of fine spaghetti, sea urchin, garlic and olive oil she ate after her husband's concert in Sicily, nutty and sweet without the iodine edge. She has never found it as good again.
recommendations.quote: It tastes of the sea though, and it's a tiny little bit, kind of, sweet... it didn't have that iodine-y flavour.
recommendations.speaker: Nisha Katona

recommendations.item: Fish head hot pot
recommendations.location: Upper St Martin's Lane, Covent Garden, London, UK
recommendations.reason: A fiery, textured, interactive Chinese hot pot with a DIY sauce bar; she says the silver carp head has some of the best fish flesh she has tasted.
recommendations.quote: the flesh from that fish, I have to say, honestly, is some of the best fish I've ever tasted. Please, please try it.
recommendations.speaker: Nisha Katona

recommendations.item: Her own roast potatoes (par-boiled, olive oil, brown sugar, garlic, a little turmeric)
recommendations.reason: Her own method gives a caramelised crunch that the hot pot lacks.
recommendations.quote: I love a bit of caramelised crunch.
recommendations.speaker: Nisha Katona

recommendations.item: Twenty KFC hot wings (drumstick wings)
recommendations.reason: Her beacon of hope living in Birkenhead: the right seasoning and a gentle background heat, available any time through the drive-through.
recommendations.quote: They have got exactly the right amount of seasoning. They've got the right amount of heat.
recommendations.speaker: Nisha Katona

recommendations.item: Kinako kuromitsu latte (date molasses and roasted soya bean) with oat milk
recommendations.location: Dessert Alley, Chinatown, London, UK (also Liverpool)
recommendations.reason: A slightly umami, layered, milkshake-like matcha-shop drink she loves; she also praises the brand for opening in Liverpool.
recommendations.quote: the depth of sweetness from the date molasses... it goes into your body, and your body again puts its arms around it.
recommendations.speaker: Nisha Katona

recommendations.item: Trappist banana beer (white beer)
recommendations.reason: Her one alcoholic weakness; a soft, soapy Belgian white beer with real banana flavour, which Belgo used to serve.
recommendations.quote: One of my Achilles heels... are those Trappist banana beers.
recommendations.speaker: Nisha Katona

recommendations.item: Japanese souffle pancakes with Biscoff sauce, Biscoff biscuits and tapioca balls
recommendations.reason: Hand-whipped, angelically airy pancakes made fresh in the cellar, worth the queue.
recommendations.quote: they are so angelically aerated inside, I can't tell you.
recommendations.speaker: Nisha Katona

recommendations.item: Tahini and date molasses ice cream
recommendations.reason: Her ice cream side, a savoury-sweet flavour she highly recommends.
recommendations.quote: the tahini and date molasses ice-cream from Honey & Co.
recommendations.speaker: Nisha Katona

recommendations.item: Gammon and pineapple (little side plate)
recommendations.reason: She wanted the classic Little Chef grilled gammon and pineapple as her 'dessert', so Ed allowed it as a side.
recommendations.quote: gammon and pineapple, that is my idea of a heavenly dessert.
recommendations.speaker: Nisha Katona

recommendations.item: Green prawn ceviche
recommendations.reason: Her honourable mention; Ed also loves the spicy, sweet raw prawns.
recommendations.quote: the green prawn ceviche at Speedboat Bar.
recommendations.speaker: Nisha Katona

recommendations.item: Aubergine and pork mince hot pot
recommendations.reason: Ed recommends its hot stone hot pots, having eaten there two days earlier.
recommendations.quote: Really amazing hot pots. Their aubergine and pork mince hot pot.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Hot pot with sauce bar
recommendations.reason: Nisha's northern hot pot recommendation, praising Liverpool's Chinese food scene.
recommendations.quote: Mr Zhang's is a great place to go for hot pot there
recommendations.speaker: Nisha Katona

recommendations.item: Pistachio guacamole
recommendations.reason: A near-miss side dish she singles out as an honourable mention.
recommendations.quote: KOL's pistachio guacamole.
recommendations.speaker: Nisha Katona

recommendations.item: Chat bombs and Cinnamon Cola
recommendations.location: Charlotte Street, London, UK (and Liverpool and elsewhere)
recommendations.reason: Nisha's own chain; Ed and James love the chat bombs and James orders the Cinnamon Cola.
recommendations.quote: if you ever take chat bombs off the menu, you are in trouble.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

episodes.title: Ep 231: Iain Stirling (Live in Glasgow)
episodes.summary: At the Glasgow live show, Iain Stirling picks no water (Sunny Delight), a Mother India keema naan with blended chicken pakora, truffle risotto from Es Pati, his mum's spag bol, haggis bon bons from Angels with Bagpipes, Bray Guinness and a cheeseboard on a Fat Duck-style floating pillow.

recommendations.item: None (Sunny Delight joke)
recommendations.reason: He does not drink water and passes on the course.
recommendations.quote: I don't drink it. So, it just sits there.
recommendations.speaker: Iain Stirling

recommendations.item: Keema naan with blended chicken pakora as a dip
recommendations.reason: He calls Mother India the best Indian in the UK and its keema naan like posh doner meat; Paul the tour manager found the chicken disappointing though.
recommendations.quote: The best Indian in the UK is in Glasgow. It's Mother India in Glasgow.
recommendations.speaker: Iain Stirling

recommendations.item: Cheesy truffle risotto
recommendations.reason: A five-course tasting menu near the Love Island villa where a cold watermelon gazpacho nearly ruined an early date, rescued by an incredibly creamy truffle risotto; run by a South African couple.
recommendations.quote: a mixture of one of the nicest things I've ever tasted plus that massive relief of like, 'Oh I've not messed up this date.'
recommendations.speaker: Iain Stirling

recommendations.item: Spaghetti bolognese (an offensive amount of pasta)
recommendations.reason: His mum's home-cooked spag bol with passata, Worcestershire sauce, dark chocolate and a little celery, that is undeniably familiar.
recommendations.quote: a proper home cooked spaghetti bolognese. You can't beat it. My mum, spag bol.
recommendations.speaker: Iain Stirling

recommendations.item: Haggis bon bons with chippy sauce
recommendations.reason: Crisp, bite-sized fried balls of haggis, ideally with a dipping sauce, from a pub-style spot linked to The Witchery on the Royal Mile.
recommendations.quote: there's a place in Edinburgh called Angels with Bagpipes, cool pub on the Royal Mile... they do good bon bons.
recommendations.speaker: Iain Stirling

recommendations.item: Guinness (poured in Ireland)
recommendations.reason: He insists Guinness is thicker and creamier in Ireland; the Harbour Bar has live music in different rooms and a great pint.
recommendations.quote: The Harbour Bar, it's an amazing pub, it's got live music on... And the Guinness is just next level.
recommendations.speaker: Iain Stirling

recommendations.item: Cheeseboard on a floating pillow (cheddar, Stilton, Manchego, Brie, Babybel)
recommendations.reason: He is not a dessert person, but remembers the floating pillow dish at the Fat Duck so wants it carrying a cheeseboard.
recommendations.quote: I want the floating pillow, but I want a cheeseboard on it.
recommendations.speaker: Iain Stirling

recommendations.item: Dairylea Dunker
recommendations.reason: Thrown in as an extra to cheer up the hosts after the cheeseboard.
recommendations.quote: I have a Dairylea Dunker, I'll have one of them as well.
recommendations.speaker: Iain Stirling

episodes.title: Ep 232: Stuart Laws
episodes.summary: Stuart Laws builds a day in an imaginary small American town: B&B water, Rickmansworth Aquadrome cafe toast, diner cherry pie, Malik's lamb madras, Gingerman sliders, an Olympic Hotel old fashioned and a build-your-own giant sundae; he was kicked out for saying Freddo.

recommendations.item: Tap water, then a bottle of still water left by the B&B owner
recommendations.reason: He has never liked sparkling water, so it is plain tap and still water, set in an imagined B&B.
recommendations.quote: I've never liked sparkling and it always puzzles me when people pick it.
recommendations.speaker: Stuart Laws

recommendations.item: Seeded sourdough toast with salted butter, marmalade and jam
recommendations.reason: The post-Parkrun toast is delicious sourdough with great butter, and it is the reason he runs.
recommendations.quote: The toasts they have at the Rickmansworth Aquadrome café are just a delicious sourdough, delicious butter. That's why I run it.
recommendations.speaker: Stuart Laws

recommendations.item: Warm slice of cherry pie with black coffee
recommendations.reason: He seeks out cherry pie in diners whenever he is in America, loving the romance of crumbling small-town Americana.
recommendations.quote: Any time I'm in America, I will go to a diner and have cherry pie.
recommendations.speaker: Stuart Laws

recommendations.item: Lamb madras with poppadoms, onion bhajis and rice
recommendations.reason: His favourite Indian: top-end, with a proper in-house chunky madras sauce and enough heat to make you sweat; his running friends go there to celebrate.
recommendations.quote: Malik's in Gerrards Cross is just great. It's top end.
recommendations.speaker: Stuart Laws

recommendations.item: Ice cold Pepsi in a glass bottle
recommendations.venue: A petrol station near Lake Victoria
recommendations.reason: A glass bottle of Pepsi from an incredibly cold fridge in a tiny petrol station on a very hot filming day in Uganda.
recommendations.quote: the fridge was the coldest fridge I've ever experienced. Couldn't believe my luck.
recommendations.speaker: Stuart Laws

recommendations.item: Buttermilk chicken sliders with hot sauce and pickles on roasted Brussels sprouts with balsamic reduction
recommendations.reason: He wants food that tears his mouth apart, with pickles and tangy balsamic Brussels; he thinks the bar may now have closed.
recommendations.quote: They had buttermilk chicken sliders with hot sauce and pickles
recommendations.speaker: Stuart Laws

recommendations.item: Bottle of prosecco with Chambord
recommendations.reason: He discovered Chambord and prosecco at an Everyman cinema screening of Hell or High Water, where they were celebrating Chambord Monday.
recommendations.quote: we're celebrating Chambord Monday.
recommendations.speaker: Stuart Laws

recommendations.item: Old fashioned with a massive ice cube
recommendations.reason: He splurged on a night in a fancy Seattle hotel using flight-delay money and had an old fashioned in the bar.
recommendations.quote: Take the book down, sit in the bar, have an old fashioned.
recommendations.speaker: Stuart Laws

recommendations.item: Giant build-your-own ice cream sundae
recommendations.reason: A beach-ball-sized communal sundae on a vanilla and raspberry ripple base, with honeycomb, marshmallows and brownie, shared with everyone celebrating his return.
recommendations.quote: We're talking raspberry ripple ice cream. That's going in there. We're talking vanilla ice cream.
recommendations.speaker: Stuart Laws

recommendations.item: Mocha chip ice cream
recommendations.reason: James tells Stuart to visit this great Seattle ice cream shop and get the mocha chip.
recommendations.quote: take a trip down to Molly Moon's, a great ice cream place in Seattle
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

episodes.title: Ep 233: Frankie Boyle (Live in Glasgow)
episodes.summary: Frankie Boyle picks sparkling water with Ribena, morning rolls, wonton soup, all the icing off a wedding cake, brown toast and marmalade, a Donegal Football Special, and discontinued Haagen-Dazs Choc Choc Chip ice cream.

recommendations.item: Sparkling water with a little Ribena
recommendations.reason: He refuses still water as a capitalist contradiction (bottled water poured over tap-water ice cubes).
recommendations.quote: You're paying for an expensive bottle of water to be brought to your table and poured over cubes of tap water.
recommendations.speaker: Frankie Boyle

recommendations.item: Soft Scottish morning rolls with butter
recommendations.reason: Hot morning rolls, the standard type rather than the 'well fired' burnt batch.
recommendations.quote: for the dream meal, I'd like little hot rolls with butter.
recommendations.speaker: Frankie Boyle

recommendations.item: Wonton soup
recommendations.reason: Hot pork dumplings that feel healthy, tied to late-night Soho Chinese meals after gigs as a young comic.
recommendations.quote: I just get flooded with a feeling of wellbeing when I have it. It's like an anaesthetic.
recommendations.speaker: Frankie Boyle

recommendations.item: All the icing off a wedding cake
recommendations.reason: About 3lbs of loose hard white icing on a plate with a spoon, a childhood treat brought home from weddings.
recommendations.quote: I would like to eat all of the icing off a wedding cake.
recommendations.speaker: Frankie Boyle

recommendations.item: Brown toast and marmalade
recommendations.reason: Thick-cut marmalade, no butter; his survival food in hotels.
recommendations.quote: I don't trust people with thin-cut
recommendations.speaker: Frankie Boyle

recommendations.item: Football Special
recommendations.reason: A fizzy kids' drink with a chemical head that looked like a pint, drunk in Donegal pubs on childhood summers.
recommendations.quote: made to, kind of, look like beer for a kid
recommendations.speaker: Frankie Boyle

recommendations.item: Haagen-Dazs Choc Choc Chip ice cream, straight from the freezer
recommendations.reason: A discontinued Belgian chocolate ice cream with small chocolate chips; he once spent three days searching for it.
recommendations.quote: Little tiny chocolate chips... But it was great.
recommendations.speaker: Frankie Boyle

recommendations.item: Dim sum
recommendations.reason: James recommends this Glasgow dim sum place near a train station; everything was incredible.
recommendations.quote: everything on the menu was incredible.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

episodes.title: Ep 234: Johannes Radebe
episodes.summary: Strictly dancer Johannes Radebe picks sparkling water, hot focaccia with a vanilla latte from his local baker, South African vetkoek, tripe with samp and beans, grilled calamari from Koi Koi in Cape Town, Prosecco with lychee or a pornstar martini, and malva pudding.

recommendations.item: Sparkling water
recommendations.reason: Still is his everyday choice, but sparkling is a treat when sitting down to dinner.
recommendations.quote: Sparkling when I'm sitting down and having dinner. I like to treat myself.
recommendations.speaker: Johannes Radebe

recommendations.item: Hot focaccia with olive oil and salt, plus a vanilla latte
recommendations.reason: His daily breakfast ritual at the baker next door, where one particular woman makes his vanilla latte; hot focaccia feels like heaven.
recommendations.quote: I literally walk into the baker and I just stand there and they make me my vanilla latte with my focaccia bread.
recommendations.speaker: Johannes Radebe

recommendations.item: Vetkoek (fried dough) with snoek fish and achar, or polony
recommendations.reason: Comfort food from home that he was reminded of on a recent visit; cheap, easy and feeds an army, eaten with mango achar, snoek or polony.
recommendations.quote: Cheap, easy to make and it can feed an army of people.
recommendations.speaker: Johannes Radebe

recommendations.item: Tripe with samp and beans
recommendations.reason: Comforting, cheap African food he eats at home, ideally with tripe cleaned by his mum and homegrown veg.
recommendations.quote: I prefer my mum to make the tripe, clean it, you know, when she's done it, then I will eat it.
recommendations.speaker: Johannes Radebe

recommendations.item: Grilled calamari (not battered)
recommendations.reason: A family-run place he found by fluke up a hill; the fish is very fresh, cooked in front of you, and he visits on every Cape Town trip.
recommendations.quote: I don't do Cape Town without going past Koi Koi. It's a must.
recommendations.speaker: Johannes Radebe

recommendations.item: Prosecco with a shot of lychee liqueur, or a pornstar martini
recommendations.reason: His agent introduced him to pornstar martinis at the O Bar in Soho, which he says are unlike anywhere else; Prosecco with lychee is his home version.
recommendations.quote: It's a very old place but looked after very well. The food is divine and their pornstar Martinis don't taste like anywhere I've been
recommendations.speaker: Johannes Radebe

recommendations.item: Malva pudding
recommendations.reason: Classic South African warm apricot-jam sponge pudding; he is not a sweet tooth but says you can never get it wrong.
recommendations.quote: Malva pudding has never hurt anybody... it's common, you find it everywhere, you can never get it wrong.
recommendations.speaker: Johannes Radebe

recommendations.item: Indian tasting dishes (Ed had brains here)
recommendations.reason: Ed had brains there and James calls it a great Indian restaurant.
recommendations.quote: Gymkhana's great, Indian restaurant here.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

episodes.title: Ep 235: Amelia Dimoldenberg (Live in Manchester)
episodes.summary: Amelia picks Manchester tap water from her grandparents' shower, a plain toasted bagel, Lemonia's tzatziki, pasta pomodoro from a Nara Italian, Morley's nuggets, an Aperol Spritz and a Cadbury Flake chocolate dessert pot.

recommendations.item: Manchester tap water from her grandparents' shower in Bury
recommendations.reason: She used to stand in her grandma's shower and drink the soft, sweet Manchester water.
recommendations.quote: I used to stand in the shower in my grandma's house and just drink the water... 'Woo! It tastes so good.'
recommendations.speaker: Amelia Dimoldenberg

recommendations.item: Plain (smooth) toasted bagel with Lurpak
recommendations.reason: She has a bagel every morning; she wants it plain, toasted and spread with Lurpak.
recommendations.quote: I want a smooth bagel, yes. It's perfect as it is, it doesn't need anything added to it.
recommendations.speaker: Amelia Dimoldenberg

recommendations.item: Tzatziki (dip) from Lemonia
recommendations.reason: A Greek restaurant where her family has held every celebration, including her parents' wedding reception.
recommendations.quote: I want it specifically from this restaurant that I love called Lemonia in London. It's a Greek restaurant... I go there for, like, every celebratory meal my family's had.
recommendations.speaker: Amelia Dimoldenberg

recommendations.item: Pasta pomodoro from an Italian restaurant in Nara
recommendations.reason: The best pomodoro she has had, eaten with her mum on a Japan trip; for her the vibe and occasion matter as much as the food. She'd grate her own parmesan.
recommendations.quote: the best pasta pomodoro I've had was in Japan... In this place called Nara, where there's, like, this huge deer park... it's the most amazing Italian restaurant there.
recommendations.speaker: Amelia Dimoldenberg

recommendations.item: Six Morley's chicken nuggets with ketchup
recommendations.reason: She loves boneless chicken and rates Morley's nuggets best, with McDonald's close behind.
recommendations.quote: I think Morley's has the best chicken nuggets. And also McDonald's do have really good nuggets as well.
recommendations.speaker: Amelia Dimoldenberg

recommendations.item: Aperol Spritz
recommendations.reason: A recent convert who finds it gets her pleasantly tipsy without making her tired.
recommendations.quote: I feel like it gets you the right amount of drunk... tipsy in a good way. It doesn't make you tired.
recommendations.speaker: Amelia Dimoldenberg

recommendations.item: Cadbury chocolate dessert pot (Flake/Freddo, tip-in)
recommendations.reason: Supermarket tip-in chocolate dessert pots, a small sweet finish she brings to dinner parties; she ranks Freddo number one.
recommendations.quote: I like to tip. Yes, and this is the thing that I always bring to a dinner party.
recommendations.speaker: Amelia Dimoldenberg

recommendations.item: Dagel (doughnut bagel with cream cheese and chives)
recommendations.reason: James raved about the savoury-sweet doughnut bagel with cream cheese and chives, which he ate twice in four days.
recommendations.quote: It's one of the nicest things I've ever had, it was absolutely delicious, I had it twice in four days.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

episodes.title: Ep 236: Finn Wolfhard
episodes.summary: Plain still water, sourdough from his hometown bakery, bone marrow, a Ted Sarandos taco course, Yokohama ramen, Parson's chicken nuggets and a Chi Chi Colada, Dairy Queen Dunbar Blizzard and a shot of Malort.

recommendations.item: Still water, plain, with ice
recommendations.reason: A plain-Jane water drinker; dislikes how sparkling feels.
recommendations.quote: I've never been a sparkling... I just don't like the way it makes me feel.
recommendations.speaker: Finn Wolfhard

recommendations.item: Sourdough with salted butter
recommendations.location: Vancouver, BC, Canada (near where he grew up; exact location unconfirmed)
recommendations.reason: Loves the freshly baked sourdough from the bakery near where he grew up; also rates their steak sandwich.
recommendations.quote: There's a bakery right by where I grew up called Baker Street Bakery that makes freshly baked sourdough bread. It's delicious.
recommendations.speaker: Finn Wolfhard

recommendations.item: Bone marrow on focaccia
recommendations.reason: Buttery, perfectly portioned bone marrow served in the bone and spread on focaccia at a tiny one-chef restaurant.
recommendations.quote: bone marrow, and it's so good... it's buttery, you put it on some bread as well.
recommendations.speaker: Finn Wolfhard

recommendations.item: Carnitas tacos and grapefruit Jarritos (the 'Ted Sarandos course')
recommendations.reason: Small, classic tacos he grew up eating, with pickled red onion and a Mexican grapefruit soda.
recommendations.quote: I would recommend... I grew up eating them.
recommendations.speaker: Finn Wolfhard

recommendations.item: Barbacoa tacos
recommendations.reason: Tiny barbacoa tacos sold by the pound, the most incredible thing he ate while filming in New Mexico.
recommendations.quote: they only sell Barbacoa tacos... it's the most incredible thing you've had.
recommendations.speaker: Finn Wolfhard

recommendations.item: Clear soy-broth ramen
recommendations.reason: Yokohama-style ramen with a buttery, umami-rich clear soy broth, two pieces of pork and scallions; the broth was the star. Venue not named.
recommendations.quote: the broth was the thing that was incredible about it.
recommendations.speaker: Finn Wolfhard

recommendations.item: Chicken nuggets with honey mustard and ranch
recommendations.reason: Crispy nuggets that taste of real fresh chicken, with house dips.
recommendations.quote: It's just good, fresh chicken.
recommendations.speaker: Finn Wolfhard

recommendations.item: Chi Chi Colada (blended lime, mezcal, orange bitters and pina colada mix)
recommendations.reason: Frozen slushie cocktail he calls the most delicious blended cocktail ever.
recommendations.quote: it's the most delicious blended cocktail ever.
recommendations.speaker: Finn Wolfhard

recommendations.item: Dunbar Blizzard (Oreo, Reese's and cookie dough)
recommendations.reason: Off-menu blizzard invented by the owner Simon at his childhood neighbourhood Dairy Queen; a hometown hero.
recommendations.quote: he's a legend amongst my neighbourhood because he was like the ice cream man in the neighbourhood.
recommendations.speaker: Finn Wolfhard

recommendations.item: Shot of Malort
recommendations.reason: A very bitter Chicago shot whose aftertaste turns grapefruity; he'd end the meal with it.
recommendations.quote: If I were to end my meal with something, I think it would be a shot of Mollort.
recommendations.speaker: Finn Wolfhard

recommendations.item: Bone marrow
recommendations.reason: Ed recommends it as the original London bone-marrow place.
recommendations.quote: go to St John, which is, like, the place that did it first pretty much.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Ramen
recommendations.reason: Ed says the original Soho branch is still very good.
recommendations.quote: The original Bone Daddy's on Peter Street in Soho is very good still.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Cosmic Blues cocktail and meal
recommendations.reason: Group dinner before ABBA Voyage; Finn and Ed both call it a really good restaurant.
recommendations.quote: Really good.
recommendations.speaker: Finn Wolfhard

episodes.title: Ep 237: Lucy Beaumont (Live in Manchester)
episodes.summary: Lucy Beaumont's chaotic live Manchester menu: still water with lemon, Jackson's bread with a butter candle, tiny Yorkshire puddings filled with cottage pie and soup, plane-food meatloaf and mash, a half-rim margarita, and banoffee pie with a posh Wagon Wheel and ice creams.

recommendations.item: Still water with a wedge of lemon
recommendations.reason: Sparkling fills her up too much; still with lemon is enough, and she thinks table water is mostly for show.
recommendations.quote: I would like still water, please... a bit of lemon in.
recommendations.speaker: Lucy Beaumont

recommendations.item: Cheap, soft Jackson's sliced bread (biting holes in the middle slices) with butter melted from a candle
recommendations.reason: The bread is a childhood love; the butter candle that melts into a dish for dipping is from a London restaurant (Ed identifies it as Restaurant Story) that she tried and failed to recreate at home.
recommendations.quote: the candle was made out of butter. And as it melted, all the melted butter ran into the holder and then you dipped your bread into the holder... I wanted to give a round of…
recommendations.speaker: Lucy Beaumont

recommendations.item: Tiny Aunt Bessie's-style Yorkshire puddings filled with intense cottage pie, gravy, and mushroom and red/yellow pepper soups
recommendations.reason: An amuse-bouche style starter built on deep savoury flavours and a love of gravy.
recommendations.quote: I really like, like, real, deep, savoury flavours. Like, I really, really like gravy.
recommendations.speaker: Lucy Beaumont

recommendations.item: Airline meatloaf with mash, green beans and creamy gravy
recommendations.reason: The best meal she's ever had, on a flight back from her first trip to America as a teenager, left sealed in its tray.
recommendations.quote: it was meatloaf, mash, green beans and then, like, a creamy gravy. And it was the nicest meal I have ever had in my life.
recommendations.speaker: Lucy Beaumont

recommendations.item: Pass (mash and green beans already with main)
recommendations.reason: Doesn't need a side because the main comes with mash and green beans.
recommendations.quote: Well, I don't need one because I've got green beans and I've got mash.
recommendations.speaker: Lucy Beaumont

recommendations.item: Margarita with a half salt rim
recommendations.reason: Her current drink of the month; she's into tequila and likes salt only on half the rim.
recommendations.quote: at the moment it's a margarita. I'd love a margarita. I'm really into tequila.
recommendations.speaker: Lucy Beaumont

recommendations.item: Banoffee pie with squirty cream, posh Wagon Wheel, and salted caramel, chocolate, raspberry ripple and vanilla ice creams with sprinkles
recommendations.reason: Banoffee pie is her favourite dessert, plus a smorgasbord of small puddings with lots of texture.
recommendations.quote: my favourite dessert in the world... it's the best pudding in the world and it's banoffee pie.
recommendations.speaker: Lucy Beaumont

recommendations.item: Pies (banoffee, caramel custard, key lime)
recommendations.reason: James praises the dessert pies and sweet flavours at this Manchester pie shop, though they had sold out on the hosts' visit.
recommendations.quote: I love the banana cream pie, the caramel custard pie there is great, the key-lime pie's great.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Set menu (starter and main)
recommendations.reason: The hosts ate a set menu there before the show and thought it excellent.
recommendations.quote: We went to Kala Bistro today. It's very, very good. It's an excellent restaurant.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

episodes.title: Ep 238: Katy Wix
episodes.summary: Katy Wix picks DASH lime water, Dean Street Townhouse bread with Welsh butter, nostalgic chip-shop chips from Ely in Cardiff, spaghetti carbonara from Florence, a small cold lasagne, Diet Coke from the can, and a three-tier dessert stand ending with her mum's apple crumble (plus a Trek bar as an amuse bouche).

recommendations.item: DASH lime sparkling water
recommendations.reason: She doesn't enjoy plain water but loves flavoured sparkling water with nothing nasty in it.
recommendations.quote: I'll only drink water if it's got a little bit of something extra in it to try and make you forget it's water, basically.
recommendations.speaker: Katy Wix

recommendations.item: Dense, brown, spongy rustic bread with Welsh salted butter
recommendations.reason: The bread there is the nicest she's had in ages, torn-apart rustic loaf; she pairs it with Welsh butter as a treat denied in childhood.
recommendations.quote: That's my favourite bread of all time, the Dean Street Townhouse bread.
recommendations.speaker: Katy Wix

recommendations.item: Chip shop chips (with a fishcake)
recommendations.reason: Fat fluffy chips from her family's Friday-night chippy tea in Ely, Cardiff, remembered with Bryan Adams on the car radio and the smell filling the car.
recommendations.quote: the chips in there were so incredible
recommendations.speaker: Katy Wix

recommendations.item: Trek bar (amuse bouche)
recommendations.reason: Her daily writing-day fuel with Diet Coke, in cocoa, lemon or raspberry white chocolate flavours.
recommendations.quote: Diet Coke and Trek bars are just the only thing that's keeping me going.
recommendations.speaker: Katy Wix

recommendations.item: Spaghetti carbonara
recommendations.reason: The best she's had was in a touristy place in Florence, valued for its creaminess and comfort.
recommendations.quote: it was very creamy and I think that's the key thing for me.
recommendations.speaker: Katy Wix

recommendations.item: Small cold lasagne
recommendations.reason: She loves lasagne and prefers it cold when the fat has congealed.
recommendations.quote: I would have it cold because when the fat has all congealed the next day, that is heaven.
recommendations.speaker: Katy Wix

recommendations.item: Diet Coke from the can with lemon and a little ice
recommendations.reason: Her favourite drink and associated with creative writing; she likes it straight from the can.
recommendations.quote: I love drinking it out the can.
recommendations.speaker: Katy Wix

recommendations.item: Three-tier stand: giant strawberry sweets and white chocolate buttons, plain cheesecake, mum's apple crumble
recommendations.reason: Childhood sweets from a village shop, a no-bake cheesecake she first learned to make, and her mum's apple crumble using apples from the neighbour's tree.
recommendations.quote: Creaminess means a lot to me. It really does.
recommendations.speaker: Katy Wix

recommendations.item: Plain chicken wrap
recommendations.reason: She is a big Nando's fan, ordering plain chicken wraps (James adds pineapple).
recommendations.quote: I had my first Nando's on Stath Lets Flats and it blew my mind. And I'm obsessed with it now.
recommendations.speaker: Katy Wix

episodes.title: Ep 239: Jessica Knappett (Live in London)
episodes.summary: Jessica Knappett (live at the Palladium) chooses Yorkshire tap water, poppadoms from the long-gone Shama in Bingley, a caviar-and-crisps amuse-bouche, posh prawn toast, her mum's 'bastard cake' pasta bake, Sichuan green beans, a spicy margarita and sticky toffee pudding followed by a cheese trolley.

recommendations.item: Yorkshire tap water
recommendations.reason: She is a tap-water person and rates Yorkshire's as the best.
recommendations.quote: Yorkshire's got really good tap water, so I am going to have Yorkshire tap water, because it's the best.
recommendations.speaker: Jessica Knappett

recommendations.item: Stack of spicy poppadoms with mixed pickle, lime pickle, mango chutney and raita, plus sugar-coated fennel seeds on leaving
recommendations.location: Bingley, West Yorkshire, UK (closed; was above a Safeway)
recommendations.reason: Her childhood family curry night spot, reached up grotty steps to a rooftop sanctuary with doilies on silver trays and upholstered chairs; it has since closed and moved.
recommendations.quote: I want to go back in time to the Shama Bingley, 1998, because it was my favourite.
recommendations.speaker: Jessica Knappett

recommendations.item: Amuse-bouche of sour cream with caviar and hand-cooked ready-salted crisps
recommendations.reason: The best starter she ever had was a surprise freebie of caviar on sour cream with crisps to dip, at a restaurant unhelpfully called The Restaurant.
recommendations.quote: I got this in a restaurant, disappointing named, The Restaurant, but it's really nice, the food's great.
recommendations.speaker: Jessica Knappett

recommendations.item: High-end sesame prawn toast with black sesame seeds, sweet chilli dip and crispy seaweed
recommendations.reason: Inspired by Chinese takeaway prawn toast, but a plusher, less greasy, puffed-up version from a high-end restaurant.
recommendations.quote: I just think the best starters are from Chinese takeaways... I want it from a high-end Chinese restaurant.
recommendations.speaker: Jessica Knappett

recommendations.item: Bastard cake (Jude Knappett's pasta bake: slow bolognese, rigatoni, bechamel)
recommendations.reason: Her mum's family-famous baked pasta, a lasagne-like comfort dish that is always waiting when they visit; the name came from an Australian relative mishearing 'pasta bake'.
recommendations.quote: in our house we call it bastard cake... She makes the bolognaise very slowly, over the course of a day as far as I can tell.
recommendations.speaker: Jessica Knappett

recommendations.item: Sichuan green beans with minced pork
recommendations.reason: She loves numbing Sichuan food, and these beans with chilli and minced pork pair with her main.
recommendations.quote: It's Sichuan green beans, which have a, kind of, minced pork on top of them.
recommendations.speaker: Jessica Knappett

recommendations.item: Spicy margarita
recommendations.reason: Her chosen dream drink, in keeping with her love of chilli and extreme flavours.
recommendations.quote: It's a spicy margarita.
recommendations.speaker: Jessica Knappett

recommendations.item: Sticky toffee pudding with ice cream, then a cheese trolley (blue, soft and hard cheeses)
recommendations.reason: Her only pudding pick because it is not just sweet; she buys Cartmel sticky toffee puddings and keeps a couple in the freezer.
recommendations.quote: it's sticky toffee pudding. It's served with ice cream, obviously, because hot and cold together is such a great combo.
recommendations.speaker: Jessica Knappett

recommendations.item: Fancy dinner where the food tasted like a Big Mac
recommendations.reason: She had an absolutely delicious dinner here and a friend noted the food reminded them of a Big Mac.
recommendations.quote: the food was absolutely delicious, everything that came out was absolutely amazing
recommendations.speaker: Jessica Knappett

recommendations.item: Vegan prawn toast and Chinese dishes
recommendations.reason: James's favourite prawn toast is the vegan one here, a very good Chinese restaurant where you can't believe it's vegan.
recommendations.quote: there's a vegan place called Facing Heaven, it's a very good Chinese restaurant... their prawn toast is really almost gelatinous.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Quarter Pounder with cheese meal (favourite branch)
recommendations.reason: Her favourite McDonald's branch, next to Hobbycraft, where she takes her daughter and orders her usual.
recommendations.quote: Yes, Guiseley.
recommendations.speaker: Jessica Knappett

episodes.title: Ep 240: Killer Mike
episodes.summary: Killer Mike builds an Atlanta Southern steakhouse feast: iced still water, Cajun shrimp and collards with cornbread, bone-in ribeye with garlic mash and baked potato, peach moonshine and Johnnie Walker Blue, then carrot cake, lemon meringue pie and his wife's peach cobbler.

recommendations.item: Still water with lots of ice and lemon
recommendations.reason: He likes still water loaded with ice and lemon, and thinks posh bars have better, slower-melting ice.
recommendations.quote: I'm a still water guy, I like iced water ... just lemons in my iced water.
recommendations.speaker: Killer Mike

recommendations.item: Cajun shrimp appetizer, done extra crispy (instead of bread)
recommendations.location: Virginia Avenue, near Atlanta airport, Georgia, USA
recommendations.reason: He skips bread and starts with meat; this dive bar by the airport does a Cajun shrimp appetizer he loves, medium-sized and cooked a bit crispy.
recommendations.quote: they have a Cajan Shrimp Appetizer, that's amazing. So, I like meat in the beginning
recommendations.speaker: Killer Mike

recommendations.item: Collard greens and starchy cornbread (plus thick bacon)
recommendations.location: Ponce de Leon Avenue, Atlanta, Georgia, USA
recommendations.reason: Southern collards with smoky meat and sugar-free cornbread is his ideal opener, and Mary Mac's does a great version with bacon bits in the cornbread.
recommendations.quote: Mary Mac's is a place that I like to go, if I'm not eating my own family's food at home
recommendations.speaker: Killer Mike

recommendations.item: Bone-in ribeye, medium, blackened seasoning
recommendations.reason: He loves a fatty bone-in ribeye and credits Bones, an Atlanta steakhouse that is relaxed about dress and where Andrew Young first took him, as a favourite.
recommendations.quote: there's a place called Bones in Atlanta, and there's a place called Chops Lobster Bar in Atlanta.
recommendations.speaker: Killer Mike

recommendations.item: Garlic mashed potatoes, big baked potato, sweet potato souffle
recommendations.reason: Classic steakhouse sides; he singles out Ruth's Chris's sweet potato souffle with pecans and sugar.
recommendations.quote: Ruth's Chris has a great, it's like a sweet potato souffle, so it's sweet potato, there's these pecan choppings on it
recommendations.speaker: Killer Mike

recommendations.item: Killer Peach, peach-infused corn moonshine from the Carolinas (and Johnnie Walker Blue)
recommendations.reason: A clear, smooth peach moonshine picked up off-market from a bearded maker; he'd also have Johnnie Walker Blue.
recommendations.quote: corn liquor that tastes like peaches infused.
recommendations.speaker: Killer Mike

recommendations.item: Lemon meringue pie
recommendations.reason: He loves the firm sweet meringue and cake-like lemon custard of Edwards pies; it ties with carrot cake as his favourite dessert.
recommendations.quote: the meringue is sweet, it's firm, it's not loosey goosey.
recommendations.speaker: Killer Mike

recommendations.item: Peach cobbler
recommendations.reason: His wife Shay's peach cobbler is so good he refuses to put it on a restaurant menu.
recommendations.quote: my wife makes an amazing peach cobbler. I'll get Shay to make you one.
recommendations.speaker: Killer Mike

recommendations.item: Steak (private speakeasy room)
recommendations.reason: He and his wife are members of the dimly lit Mafia-style private room behind the kitchen, and he likes the ribeyes there.
recommendations.quote: It's like watching a yakuza mob movie almost, you know what I'm saying?
recommendations.speaker: Killer Mike

recommendations.item: Steak and bacon
recommendations.reason: A good Atlanta steakhouse with great service and amazing thick bacon.
recommendations.quote: New York Prime in Atlanta, both have amazing bacon.
recommendations.speaker: Killer Mike

recommendations.item: Thick-cut bacon
recommendations.reason: Not the best steak in his view, but the bacon is superb; tip the concierge a folded $100 to get a table.
recommendations.quote: I don't think their steaks are the most amazing ... but their bacon, god damn, the bacon.
recommendations.speaker: Killer Mike

recommendations.item: Louisiana Creole and French-style food
recommendations.reason: A great Creole spot on the strip by the airport, in front of a Motel 6.
recommendations.quote: if you want great Louisiana style food, there's a place called Louisiana Bistro
recommendations.speaker: Killer Mike

recommendations.item: Southern food incl. collards
recommendations.reason: Kandi Burruss's restaurant, which he thinks serves collards and cornbread as a starter.
recommendations.quote: I think Kandi Burruss' restaurant, Old Lady Gang, I think they do that as a starter.
recommendations.speaker: Killer Mike

episodes.title: Ep 241: Mike Wozniak (Live in London)
episodes.summary: Mike Wozniak, alone in a revolving Chinook-watched restaurant, orders fizzy lifting water, a table-sized poppadom, a gooduckenouffle, fajitas with fanfare, Alphabites, Ouzo and Old Thumper, then the piece of shame.

recommendations.item: Fizzy lifting water
recommendations.reason: Sparkling water upgraded to Willy Wonka's fizzy lifting drink, taken alone so no one sees the undignified descent.
recommendations.quote: if you've got a bit of time to kill why not kill it flying.
recommendations.speaker: Mike Wozniak

recommendations.item: Maximum poppadom with maximum chutneys
recommendations.venue: The Maximum Popadom (Gosport curry house, possibly a myth)
recommendations.reason: A table-sized poppadom inspired by a schoolmate's tale of a Gosport curry house, probably invented, with chutneys fired in by nozzle.
recommendations.quote: the poppadom that would arrive if you ordered the maximum poppadom would be the size of the table.
recommendations.speaker: Mike Wozniak

recommendations.item: Gooduckenouffle surprise (chicken in a duck in a goose, souffled, with a toy inside)
recommendations.reason: His own invention, a goose version of turducken made light as a souffle with a Kinder-style toy at the centre.
recommendations.quote: I'm calling it the gooduckenouffle, the gooduckenouffle surprise.
recommendations.speaker: Mike Wozniak

recommendations.item: Whatever the dramatic dish at the next table is (Uncle Phil's fajitas)
recommendations.reason: He wants the sizzling, fanfare dish that always goes to someone else's table, settling on fajitas made by his brother-in-law 'Uncle Phil'.
recommendations.quote: I want what they're having, please.
recommendations.speaker: Mike Wozniak

recommendations.item: Lancashire hotpot with a sparkler in it (back-up)
recommendations.reason: His fallback main: a hotpot with sparklers for theatre.
recommendations.quote: I'd be quite happy to just have a Lancashire Hotpot with a sparkler in it.
recommendations.speaker: Mike Wozniak

recommendations.item: Alphabites
recommendations.reason: Alphabet-shaped potato snacks that were forbidden in his childhood, finally allowed, to be dipped in guacamole and spelled into rude words.
recommendations.quote: Never allowed them.
recommendations.speaker: Mike Wozniak

recommendations.item: Ouzo (and a pint of Old Thumper)
recommendations.reason: Ouzo to wash down the flaming main, plus Ringwood's Old Thumper bitter, his first pint of bitter as a teenager in a Portsmouth pub.
recommendations.quote: I was already inhabited by the spirit of a middle-aged man.
recommendations.speaker: Mike Wozniak

recommendations.item: The piece of shame (last slice of cake at a Ruby anniversary party)
recommendations.reason: The last, shamefully-coveted slice of cake at a party, tractor-beamed away from a Ruby anniversary by his floating restaurant.
recommendations.quote: the last bit of the cake... it feels shameful.
recommendations.speaker: Mike Wozniak

episodes.title: Ep 242: Carrie Brownstein
episodes.summary: Carrie Brownstein builds a nostalgic, Portland-heavy menu of still water, Dos Hermanos bread rolls, a wedge salad, homemade tacos with a side of bolognese, Bluefin toro nigiri, a rye old fashioned and a Ruby Jewel mint ice cream sandwich.

recommendations.item: Still water
recommendations.reason: She finds still water a more neutral partner for food and thinks the sparkling water lobby has overreached; she does love a very bubbly Topo Chico though.
recommendations.quote: I think the sparkling water lobby has really done one over on us. I think still water's perfectly fine.
recommendations.speaker: Carrie Brownstein

recommendations.item: Scored round loaf of pull-apart rolls with olive oil
recommendations.reason: A Portland bakery whose round pull-apart rolls dipped in olive oil are her perfect bread; she misses bread after living in bread-averse Los Angeles.
recommendations.quote: they make really amazing bread, and they do, I guess they're buns or rolls... with some olive oil, that's a perfect bread to me.
recommendations.speaker: Carrie Brownstein

recommendations.item: Wedge salad with blue cheese dressing, cherry tomatoes and bacon
recommendations.reason: A slightly old-fashioned steakhouse classic that connects to a basic childhood love of food: a cold iceberg wedge slathered in blue cheese dressing.
recommendations.quote: It's like, basically an ice sculpture, just slathered in dressing.
recommendations.speaker: Carrie Brownstein

recommendations.item: Eight to ten homemade tacos (heavy on cheese and sour cream) with a little side of spaghetti bolognese
recommendations.reason: Her childhood family dinner: tacos were what she and her sister picked from the family meal bowl every night, build-your-own and heavy on the dairy.
recommendations.quote: Just home-made tacos, which are absolutely inauthentic as my main meal. Because I really do love, you have all the ingredients out
recommendations.speaker: Carrie Brownstein

recommendations.item: Bluefin toro nigiri
recommendations.reason: A clean, perfect palate cleanser of buttery fatty tuna belly; she cites Sushi Park (or Nozawa) in Los Angeles, where omakase is eaten with little or no soy.
recommendations.quote: something that is clean and perfect and, sort of, melts in your mouth. I definitely need a palette cleanser with this meal.
recommendations.speaker: Carrie Brownstein

recommendations.item: Rye old fashioned
recommendations.reason: She loves spirit-forward old fashioneds, especially in autumn and winter, and says the co-owner bartender, Banjo (also her dog's name), makes a mean one.
recommendations.quote: there's a bar in Portland called the Pacific Standard... Anyway, he makes a mean old fashioned.
recommendations.speaker: Carrie Brownstein

recommendations.item: Mint ice cream sandwich with chocolate cookies
recommendations.reason: A Portland ice cream sandwich company; the mint one with soft chocolate cookies is just the right amount of sweet and she eats it often.
recommendations.quote: it's mint ice cream with chocolate cookies, a soft cookie, and then it's just the perfect dessert.
recommendations.speaker: Carrie Brownstein

recommendations.item: Mom's crab fat noodles
recommendations.reason: James recalls this Portland pasta dish from his 200th episode menu as part of an amazing meal there.
recommendations.quote: They did the Mama's Crab Fat Noodles... the whole meal was amazing
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

episodes.title: Ep 243: Joe Wilkinson (Live in Brighton)
episodes.summary: Joe's live Brighton menu is unapologetically home-style: tap water, crusty bread, his mum's prawn cocktail, Chicken Kiev with oven chips and peas, more peas, a Mango Magic drunk in a Canary Islands Chinese, and plain Viennetta.

recommendations.item: Tap water (from Ed's garden hose)
