recommendations.reason: Refuses to pay for bottled water and would happily drink straight from a garden tap.
recommendations.quote: Yes, 'I'm not paying.' Just to set the bar out to, you know.
recommendations.speaker: Joe Wilkinson

recommendations.item: Crusty bread that doesn't fill you up
recommendations.reason: Loves restaurant bread but always fills up on it.
recommendations.quote: I fucking love bread, but I fill myself up.
recommendations.speaker: Joe Wilkinson

recommendations.item: Prawn cocktail in an old Esso garage glass
recommendations.reason: His mum's simple 1970s-style prawn cocktail with frozen prawns, iceberg lettuce and marie rose sauce, which she makes when he visits on the way to football.
recommendations.quote: I don't think there is a fancy prawn cocktail. They're all quite, how do I say it, shit.
recommendations.speaker: Joe Wilkinson

recommendations.item: Chicken Kiev with oven chips and peas
recommendations.reason: Two supermarket Kievs cooked at home until the garlic butter has leaked out, eaten in the lounge in front of a drama.
recommendations.quote: It doesn't matter. It'll all seep out while it cooks.
recommendations.speaker: Joe Wilkinson

recommendations.item: Extra peas in a ramekin
recommendations.reason: Genuinely loves peas and sometimes drinks them out of the sieve.
recommendations.quote: No. When we have them, my other half doesn't really like peas.
recommendations.speaker: Joe Wilkinson

recommendations.item: Mango Magic
recommendations.reason: A bright yellow, ice-cold, hard-to-suck mango smoothie-juice drink he had on Christmas Day in a near-empty Chinese restaurant on holiday.
recommendations.quote: Well, it was ice cold.
recommendations.speaker: Joe Wilkinson

recommendations.item: Plain Viennetta
recommendations.reason: A freezer staple he loves and eats too hard, straight from the freezer with a cake slice.
recommendations.quote: I love Viennetta, genuinely.
recommendations.speaker: Joe Wilkinson

recommendations.item: Viennetta affogato
recommendations.reason: James recommends this Brighton pub's Viennetta affogato with hazelnut praline as a delicious thing he has had in town.
recommendations.quote: Genuinely a delicious thing, that I've had in this town, that involves Viennetta.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

episodes.title: Ep 244: Sara Barron
episodes.summary: Sara Barron picks sourdough with olive oil, her chef brother's nachos, Katz's pastrami on rye with a Belfast Holiday Inn seafood chowder, Otto's broccoli rabe, a daytime espresso martini and lemon-and-coconut ice cream in a lemon.

recommendations.item: Still water, or sparkling with ice and fresh lime
recommendations.reason: Water is there to hydrate and pace her drinking; sparkling only as a prop.
recommendations.quote: water is to hydrate ... Sparkling water is, like, to me, it's there as ... a prop, not a hydration device.
recommendations.speaker: Sara Barron

recommendations.item: Sourdough dipped in fine olive oil and sea salt
recommendations.reason: She cannot eat butter, so wants really good olive oil with expensive sea salt.
recommendations.quote: what I want is the finest of olive oils dipped into a little ramekin, and then some very expensive sea salt to sprinkle into that olive oil
recommendations.speaker: Sara Barron

recommendations.item: Home-made nachos with guacamole, salsa fresca, jalapeno and lots of sour cream
recommendations.reason: Her professionally trained brother made fresh fried chips and toppings for her 36th birthday.
recommendations.quote: He home-made the tortilla chips, they were like, freshly fried. ... what I love in nachos, is truly the sour cream.
recommendations.speaker: Sara Barron

recommendations.item: Pastrami on rye with sauerkraut
recommendations.location: Lower East Side, New York, USA
recommendations.reason: She only went once in 15 years in New York and wants to make up for it with a great sandwich.
recommendations.quote: Something in that, will be healed by sitting at Katz Deli and ordering a pastrami on rye.
recommendations.speaker: Sara Barron

recommendations.item: Seafood chowder (soup with the sandwich)
recommendations.reason: James had the best seafood chowder of his life from room service there in 2018, when a particular chef was working; Sara adopts it.
recommendations.quote: the best seafood chowder I have ever had.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Broccoli rabe with chilli, pressed ricotta salata and olive oil
recommendations.location: Greenwich Village, New York, USA (now closed)
recommendations.reason: Part of a menu of vegetables in ramekins at an Italian restaurant she worked at for six years; this was her green.
recommendations.quote: They served this broccoli rob that was served with these very finely sliced chillies and a pressed, salted ricotta cheese.
recommendations.speaker: Sara Barron

recommendations.item: Espresso martini at 1pm on Christmas Eve
recommendations.reason: Her two favourite things are coffee and strong booze, and the timing has to be right.
recommendations.quote: my two favourite things are coffee, a good coffee, but then some very, very strong alcohol.
recommendations.speaker: Sara Barron

recommendations.item: Lemon ice cream with coconut ice cream in a frozen lemon shell
recommendations.reason: Recreates the childhood magic of lemon sorbet served in a lemon, but with ice cream because sorbet alone does not cut it.
recommendations.quote: I felt like a princess eating lemon sorbet out of a lemon. Now, I want that magic in my life as an adult.
recommendations.speaker: Sara Barron

recommendations.item: Sandwiches
recommendations.reason: Her brother's Chicago sandwich shop and truck, which she grudgingly plugs.
recommendations.quote: everyone go to his sandwich shop in Chicago, it's very, very good
recommendations.speaker: Sara Barron

recommendations.item: Artichoke Caesar salad
recommendations.reason: James's go-to Deliveroo order: an amazing artichoke Caesar salad plus a tofu rice bowl.
recommendations.quote: Mildreds do this amazing artichoke Caesar salad
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Barbecue ribs and takeaway daiquiris
recommendations.reason: Some of the best ribs James has had, plus boozy rainbow takeaway daiquiris.
recommendations.quote: some of the best ribs I've ever had in my life. Then they were doing takeaway Daiquris
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Seafood and champagne
recommendations.reason: Ed and his wife's pre-Christmas tradition of seafood and champagne.
recommendations.quote: normally at Bentley's and eat seafood and drink champagne
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

episodes.title: Ep 245: Tommy Tiernan (Live in Dublin)
episodes.summary: Tommy Tiernan's absurdist live Dublin menu: lithium-rich water from the Valley of the Mad, a hint of poppadom, the smell of his own brain frying, burnt roast veg with a baby-shaped chicken, a magic mushroom pizza, fruity poitin and honeycomb ice cream.

recommendations.item: Water from the river in Gleann na nGealt (Valley of the Mad), plus tonic water
recommendations.reason: Natural lithium in the river water was historically believed to cure the mad, and he likes the bitterness of tonic water.
recommendations.quote: if you could get me a glass of water from the river that flows through the Valley of the Mad, I'd have a glass of that.
recommendations.speaker: Tommy Tiernan

recommendations.item: A hint of a poppadum with all the dips (loves peshwari naan)
recommendations.reason: He fills up quickly and wants only something vague and tempting, not filling.
recommendations.quote: I'd get a shard, a dust cloud of poppadums. Something vague and tempting, but not filling.
recommendations.speaker: Tommy Tiernan

recommendations.item: The smell of his own brain sizzling in a pan
recommendations.reason: Irish people do not do starters, so he wants just a whiff from the kitchen.
recommendations.quote: we're not used to starters in Ireland. We weren't reared with starters
recommendations.speaker: Tommy Tiernan

recommendations.item: Burnt roast potatoes, parsnips and honey carrots with a baby-shaped chicken
recommendations.reason: He loves roast potatoes and deliberately over-roasted vegetables, plus an unreasonably expensive whiskey.
recommendations.quote: I fucking love roast potatoes.
recommendations.speaker: Tommy Tiernan

recommendations.item: Mushroom pizza (poisonous or magic)
recommendations.reason: His last-meal fantasy; he also once sold mushrooms as a teenager in Navan.
recommendations.quote: The side dish would be some sort of mushroom. I do love mushrooms.
recommendations.speaker: Tommy Tiernan

recommendations.item: Fruity poitin
recommendations.reason: Illegal Irish hooch that has become beautiful in recent years, best given by a friend as a favour.
recommendations.quote: A glass of fruity poitín would be my ideal drink.
recommendations.speaker: Tommy Tiernan

recommendations.item: Honeycomb ice cream
recommendations.reason: He cannot face rhubarb any more (he had been peeing on it), so he picks plain honeycomb ice cream.
recommendations.quote: I'd be really boring and just have a bowl of honeycomb ice cream, please.
recommendations.speaker: Tommy Tiernan

recommendations.item: Chips on Friday evenings
recommendations.reason: A dark-wood winter chipper where his dad brought the kids every Friday; the one food memory that felt like being loved.
recommendations.quote: It was like being loved... like chips in a wardrobe. The smell of vinegar and salt and love
recommendations.speaker: Tommy Tiernan

recommendations.item: Tacos
recommendations.reason: James and Ed ate here on their first night in Dublin and rated the tacos.
recommendations.quote: We had a lovely meal at Masa.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Pint of Guinness
recommendations.reason: The hosts went for a Guinness here after dinner on arriving in Dublin.
recommendations.quote: Went from there over to Whelan's, to get a Guinness. It was a very nice feeling
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

episodes.title: Ep 246: Karan Gokani
episodes.summary: Hoppers chef Karan Gokani orders sparkling water with bitters, black-pepper papads with coriander-yoghurt chutney, Bungay butter bread, duck pancakes, lamprais (with a biriyani and margherita pizza for Ed), crinkle-cut Shake Shack fries, and a giant brownie-and-cashew sundae.

recommendations.item: Sparkling water with bitters and a grapefruit wedge
recommendations.reason: Not drinking at the moment, so wants fizz with a bitter edge that is not sweet like pop.
recommendations.quote: It's just nice fizz on your terms.
recommendations.speaker: Karan Gokani

recommendations.item: Roasted black lentil and black pepper papad with coriander chutney mixed into yoghurt; sourdough with Bungay butter
recommendations.reason: Loves roasted urad dal papads and a yoghurt-and-chutney hack, with good sourdough and Bungay butter as the alternative.
recommendations.quote: ask for some yoghurt, mix it through and you've got this lovely yoghurt-y coriander chutney to dip into
recommendations.speaker: Karan Gokani

recommendations.item: Duck pancakes with hoisin, chilli oil and fresh chillies in soy
recommendations.reason: Moreish like pani puri, built in the hand with chilli oil and chopped red chillies.
recommendations.quote: It's one of those you can never get enough.
recommendations.speaker: Karan Gokani

recommendations.item: Margherita pizza with chilli oil and dried chilli (ordered for Ed)
recommendations.reason: He is obsessed with pizza and favours a simple margherita.
recommendations.quote: I'm obsessed with pizza.
recommendations.speaker: Karan Gokani

recommendations.item: Lamprais (Sri Lankan Dutch Burgher rice parcel in banana leaf)
recommendations.reason: A full feast in a banana-leaf parcel of three meats, stock-cooked rice, aubergine pickle, egg and cutlet; not pretty but insanely flavourful.
recommendations.quote: it's hard to make it look visually pleasing, but the flavours are insane.
recommendations.speaker: Karan Gokani

recommendations.item: Lamb shank dum biriyani (for Ed)
recommendations.reason: Ideal one-pot dinner-party dish with a raita; Hoppers does a fall-off-the-bone lamb shank version.
recommendations.quote: a nice lamb shank biriyani. We do it at Hoppers.
recommendations.speaker: Karan Gokani

recommendations.item: Pot of yoghurt, and crinkle-cut chilli cheese fries
recommendations.reason: Simple yoghurt balances the main; Shake Shack has the best crinkle-cut fries and they did chilli cheese fries in his collab.
recommendations.quote: They do the best French fries.
recommendations.speaker: Karan Gokani

recommendations.item: A sip of Ed's Negroni (or non-alcoholic beer)
recommendations.reason: He has stopped drinking but loves a Negroni and takes sips from others.
recommendations.quote: I love a bloody Negroni.
recommendations.speaker: Karan Gokani

recommendations.item: Massive sundae with ice cream, hot fudge, brownies, cookies and salted cashews
recommendations.reason: Craves lots of texture rather than clean ice cream.
recommendations.quote: I think clean ice cream doesn't do it for me. You need the texture.
recommendations.speaker: Karan Gokani

recommendations.item: Sizzling chocolate brownie with ice cream
recommendations.reason: Karan's local Indian spot that serves the sizzling brownie he grew up loving.
recommendations.quote: They do, like, a sizzling chocolate brownie. It's like they bring a brownie on a sizzling platter and you dump hot fudge sauce on top.
recommendations.speaker: Karan Gokani

recommendations.item: Pizza (LA-style, semolina crust)
recommendations.location: The Treehouse Hotel, Langham Place, London, UK
recommendations.reason: His go-to London pizza, Nancy Silverton's place by the BBC studios, best at the counter.
recommendations.quote: in London, my go to place is Mozza
recommendations.speaker: Karan Gokani

recommendations.item: Rose Smash cocktail and the full menu
recommendations.reason: James's beloved Sri Lankan restaurant; he has been countless times and loved the Rose Smash.
recommendations.quote: I've lost count of the amount of times I have been to Hoppers.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Hoppers sister site
recommendations.reason: Third and largest Hoppers site with a big bar.
recommendations.quote: our most recent, King's Cross, our third site is about four times the size of Soho.
recommendations.speaker: Karan Gokani

recommendations.item: Pizza
recommendations.reason: Karan says Pilgrims does a good pizza and admires their story.
recommendations.quote: Even Pilgrims does a good pizza.
recommendations.speaker: Karan Gokani

episodes.title: Ep 247: Ardal O’Hanlon (Live in Dublin)
episodes.summary: Ardal O'Hanlon (live in Dublin) picks still water in a hefty glass, poppadom-sized Skips, 24 oysters, his wife's scallops on Clonakilty black pudding, 'stinky' roast beef with all the trimmings, roast sprouts, a 1965 Chateau Latour, then rhubarb crumble and a cheeseboard.

recommendations.item: Still water in a heavy glass with girth, heft and a good lip
recommendations.reason: He dislikes bubbles and the sound of fizzy drinks; what matters most is the weight and feel of the glass.
recommendations.quote: I don't like bubbles, don't like the sound... you just want girth. Girth, heft, weight.
recommendations.speaker: Ardal O'Hanlon

recommendations.item: Poppadom-sized Skips (prawn cocktail crisps)
recommendations.reason: He loves crunch; Skips are a staple at home, a large bag a day, needing no dips.
recommendations.quote: Skips are a big thing in our house... A large bag a day.
recommendations.speaker: Ardal O'Hanlon

recommendations.item: 24 oysters with shallot and red wine vinegar (pre-starter)
recommendations.venue: A restaurant in Boston owned by a man called Frank
recommendations.reason: He loves oysters, kept minimal to taste the sea; a generous restaurant owner once laid out about 60 for him and his wife.
recommendations.quote: You want to taste the sea and hear the sea.
recommendations.speaker: Ardal O'Hanlon

recommendations.item: Scallops on Clonakilty black pudding with minty pea puree, fried apple and a fried quail's egg
recommendations.reason: His wife's dinner-party speciality; three scallops per person, with the black pudding improving everything.
recommendations.quote: Everything is instantly improved by putting black pudding in there. Clonakilty black pudding would be the one.
recommendations.speaker: Ardal O'Hanlon

recommendations.item: 'Stinky' fermented roast beef with normal roast trimmings (cauliflower cheese, honey-glazed carrots, Yorkshire pudding)
recommendations.reason: He loves roast beef but wants a new sensation after trying stink beans and durian in Hong Kong; the hosts invent a stinky beef.
recommendations.quote: I pride myself on being adventurous... you've got to try everything.
recommendations.speaker: Ardal O'Hanlon

recommendations.item: Roasted Brussels sprouts with Parmesan and balsamic
recommendations.reason: He wants to champion sprouts, which should be roasted, not boiled.
recommendations.quote: Roasted in the oven with parmesan and balsamic, nothing else.
recommendations.speaker: Ardal O'Hanlon

recommendations.item: 1965 Chateau Latour red Bordeaux
recommendations.reason: The best drinking experience of his life: a properly stored Latour from a wealthy acquaintance's cellar near Regent's Park.
recommendations.quote: We took a bottle of Chateau Latour and it was the most amazing drinking experience I think I've ever had.
recommendations.speaker: Ardal O'Hanlon

recommendations.item: Rhubarb crumble with rhubarb ice cream, then a cheeseboard (aged Gouda, Stilton, Mont d'Or)
recommendations.reason: His mother's rhubarb crumble, with a modern pink peppercorn version in mind; he prefers cheese so adds a cheeseboard.
recommendations.quote: My mother made a fabulous rhubarb... she made a really good crumble and I always loved it.
recommendations.speaker: Ardal O'Hanlon

episodes.title: Ep 248: Huge Davies
episodes.summary: Huge Davies picks still water, Pizza Express dough balls, takeaway crispy aromatic duck pancakes, his own bolognese, a Greggs festive bake, Lilt and a battered peanut butter KitKat Chunky with ice cream.

recommendations.item: Still water
recommendations.reason: Thinks sparkling water tastes of nothing and everything at once, so still every time.
recommendations.quote: I honestly think people who have sparkling water are insane.
recommendations.speaker: Huge Davies

recommendations.item: Pizza Express dough balls (double portion)
recommendations.reason: A classic he came up with on the way in, and he has introduced Australian dates to them; he would happily eat a doppio portion.
recommendations.quote: I'm having dough balls from Pizza Express.
recommendations.speaker: Huge Davies

recommendations.item: Crispy aromatic duck pancakes
recommendations.reason: He thinks no flavour combination beats duck, pancake, hoisin, cucumber and spring onion, and he will happily eat a whole duck after a gig.
recommendations.quote: I just think there's no better combination of flavours.
recommendations.speaker: Huge Davies

recommendations.item: Homemade spaghetti bolognese
recommendations.reason: His long-cooked batch recipe with pork and beef mince, tomato puree, red wine and a secret ketchup, which he eats in huge quantities.
recommendations.quote: I think it's so comforting. I just love it.
recommendations.speaker: Huge Davies

recommendations.item: Festive bake
recommendations.reason: A turkey, stuffing and cranberry bake he eats daily through the Christmas season, even walking half an hour for it.
recommendations.quote: I go to Greggs every single day for-,
recommendations.speaker: Huge Davies

recommendations.item: Lilt in a cold can
recommendations.reason: His favourite fizzy drink; he is upset it is being rebranded as Fanta pineapple and grapefruit.
recommendations.quote: I think I've settled on Lilt. Lilt is the best one.
recommendations.speaker: Huge Davies

recommendations.item: Battered KitKat Chunky Peanut Butter with vanilla ice cream
recommendations.venue: local chippy near his old school
recommendations.reason: Inspired by a chippy near school that would batter any chocolate bar you brought in; he's never had the peanut butter KitKat version.
recommendations.quote: I would then now take that into that shop, then get battered and then I would have that with ice-cream.
recommendations.speaker: Huge Davies

recommendations.item: Garlic bread with cheese and Marmite pizza
recommendations.reason: Ed counts the garlic bread, cheese and Marmite pizza from there as his bread course hack.
recommendations.quote: I had the garlic bread with cheese and marmite from Yard Sale which is in a pizza format.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

episodes.title: Ep 249: Rhys Nicholson
episodes.summary: Rhys Nicholson builds a Melbourne-heavy menu: pint of sparkling water with lime, warm sourdough with brown butter, anchovy toast with an oyster and half Martini, a fried chicken burger with curly fries, a green salad, Austrian Riesling and a mouthful of everyone else's dessert.

recommendations.item: Pint glass of very cold sparkling water with lime
recommendations.reason: He loves sparkling ('spicy water') and still feels rich helping himself from the bubbly water tap at his own venue.
recommendations.quote: A really big pint glass of very cold spicy water with some lime in it.
recommendations.speaker: Rhys Nicholson

recommendations.item: Warm (not toasted) sourdough with whipped brown butter and salt
recommendations.reason: His go-to local after being away; a relaxed fine-dining spot where the staff know them and the aerated, nutty brown butter is spectacular.
recommendations.quote: they have this burnt or browned butter with the salt through it... it's super light and it just spreads over and it's real good and it's kind of nutty.
recommendations.speaker: Rhys Nicholson

recommendations.item: Anchovy toast (whipped ricotta, pickled gherkin coins, anchovy)
recommendations.reason: His first ever anchovy toast, crisp and creamy with crunchy gherkin; it is now what he makes to open dinner parties though he can't quite replicate it.
recommendations.quote: very thin toasted kind of grilled bread, kind of crispy and then, it's like, there's whipped ricotta on it
recommendations.speaker: Rhys Nicholson

recommendations.item: Oyster and a half Martini
recommendations.reason: They serve half Martinis, a perfect way to start a meal without going in too hot, paired with an oyster.
recommendations.quote: they do, like, half Martinis when you get there and it's just a perfect way to-, with, like, a little entre and maybe like an oyster.
recommendations.speaker: Rhys Nicholson

recommendations.item: Fried chicken burger with slaw, chipotle mayo, pickles, potato bun and thick curly fries
recommendations.reason: What he truly wants to eat at any hour; he even ate one every day on a Palm Springs trip, and has recreated it at home with a buttermilk brine.
recommendations.quote: I just want a fried chicken burger.
recommendations.speaker: Rhys Nicholson

recommendations.item: Restaurant-style green salad (butter lettuce, herbs, shallot vinaigrette) and cucumber salad
recommendations.reason: Acidic, crunchy palate-cleansers between bites of the heavy burger, inspired by a cucumber salad at a vegetarian Indian restaurant in Newcastle.
recommendations.quote: just, like, resetting your mouth every time... It's helping the other dish.
recommendations.speaker: Rhys Nicholson

recommendations.item: Very cold, dry Austrian Riesling
recommendations.reason: A bitey Riesling cuts through whatever he's eating and is pleasingly gulpable.
recommendations.quote: my actual dream drink is a very cold Austrian, like, a bitey Riesling to cut through whatever really.
recommendations.speaker: Rhys Nicholson

recommendations.item: Pecorino brulee (blow-torched brown sugar on slices of pecorino)
recommendations.reason: A wildly good, simple Italian dish he stumbled into in London that bridges the cheese and dessert dilemma.
recommendations.quote: a pecorino brulee type of thing and it was wildly good.
recommendations.speaker: Rhys Nicholson

recommendations.item: A mouthful of everyone else's dessert (via an anteater tongue) and a mint Fernet-Branca digestif
recommendations.reason: Not a dessert person, he wants bits of everyone else's and usually finishes with an amaro or Fernet; he'd also like a rum baba like the one at Carlton Wine Room.
recommendations.quote: I just want a spoon and I just want little bits of everyone else's, whatever else they've ordered.
recommendations.speaker: Rhys Nicholson

recommendations.item: Lasagna with rolled pasta and bechamel
recommendations.reason: Ben Shewry's new main, a lasagna rolled like a cinnamon roll, left the whole table silent.
recommendations.quote: you eat it and everyone goes quiet for a little while, like, no one's talking.
recommendations.speaker: Rhys Nicholson

recommendations.item: Whole-menu dinner
recommendations.reason: He and Ed ordered the entire menu at an amazing dinner there.
recommendations.quote: We went to St James... Ordered the whole menu.
recommendations.speaker: Rhys Nicholson

recommendations.item: Steakhouse dinner
recommendations.reason: He loves classic old steakhouses with veteran wait staff that give a sense of history and respect for hospitality.
recommendations.quote: Musso and Frank's particularly, like, 'Oh, this guy has worked here.'
recommendations.speaker: Rhys Nicholson

recommendations.item: Martini-led dinner
recommendations.reason: A Melbourne restaurant where he and Ed had a long, boozy meal starting with Martinis.
recommendations.quote: we went to Gimlet in Melbourne and that was a similar thing
recommendations.speaker: Rhys Nicholson

episodes.title: Ep 250: Patti Harrison
episodes.summary: Patti Harrison, in a chaotic episode, picks sparkling water, the outsides of sourdough, spaghetti with red sauce, 3D-printed chicken congee, crispy fingerling potatoes, an enormous bloody Mary and a savoury meatloaf disguised as cake.

recommendations.item: Sparkling water
recommendations.reason: She normally orders still, but this time goes for sparkling, which she jokes is so heavy it is practically food.
recommendations.quote: Sparkling water is like the meatloaf of drinks, that are water.
recommendations.speaker: Patti Harrison

recommendations.item: Outside crust of sourdough (insides scooped out)
recommendations.reason: She likes the crust more than the soft inside, and would have the insides dramatically thrown in a skip outside.
recommendations.quote: I just like when it's, like, sourdough maybe... I think I like the outside more than I like the inside.
recommendations.speaker: Patti Harrison

recommendations.item: Spaghetti with a red sauce (arrabiata or puttanesca)
recommendations.reason: A simple, not-too-spicy red sauce spaghetti.
recommendations.quote: Arrabiata. Puttanesca. A red sauce. It doesn't matter if it's spicy or not, I don't really like spicy food.
recommendations.speaker: Patti Harrison

recommendations.item: Congee made with lab-grown chicken
recommendations.reason: Congee is her mum's Vietnamese comfort food; she is now pescatarian, so the dream version uses cultured chicken with no animals harmed.
recommendations.quote: My mum's from Vietnam and there's a lot of comfort foods that she would make kind of weekly that were always on the stove.
recommendations.speaker: Patti Harrison

recommendations.item: Crispy fingerling potatoes with garlic
recommendations.reason: Her one sincere answer: very crispy, crunchy potatoes, never mushy inside.
recommendations.quote: I like the crunch. I like when it's like yes, where the skin is just, like, flaking off and it's burnt.
recommendations.speaker: Patti Harrison

recommendations.item: Bloody Mary with a 30-inch skewer of cornichons, pickled onions, lab-grown shrimp, cocktail sauce and curly fries
recommendations.reason: A savoury, spicy-but-not-nose-running bloody Mary piled with pickles, with a phone holder built into the garnish.
recommendations.quote: I would say some sort of bloody Mary. I love the, again, tomato sauce, anything savoury.
recommendations.speaker: Patti Harrison

recommendations.item: Savoury cake that looks like red velvet but is meatloaf (read back as tapioca)
recommendations.reason: She prefers savoury food even at dessert, so the cake secretly turns out to be meatloaf.
recommendations.quote: Some sort of savoury cake that looks like it's going be a slice of red velvet cake and then you cut into it and you're like, 'Holy crap, that is a meatloaf.'
recommendations.speaker: Patti Harrison

episodes.title: Ep 251: Helen Skelton
episodes.summary: Helen Skelton picks melted South Pole ice water, poppadoms with lots of mango chutney, an old-school frozen-prawn cocktail, a roast chicken dinner with separate stuffing, corn on the cob, a Kir Royale with her friends, and her gran's tangerine jelly.

recommendations.item: Melted ice water from the South Pole
recommendations.reason: The best water she's had was melted from ice on her Antarctic expedition, made satisfying by the effort of producing it.
recommendations.quote: water that someone has really put their effort into.
recommendations.speaker: Helen Skelton

recommendations.item: Five poppadoms with mango chutney only
recommendations.reason: She loves poppadoms and goes through more mango chutney than poppadom, ignoring the other dips.
recommendations.quote: more chutney than poppadom to be fair.
recommendations.speaker: Helen Skelton

recommendations.item: Old-school prawn cocktail with small frozen prawns, mayo and ketchup sauce, soggy lettuce
recommendations.reason: She wants the nostalgic version her mum made, with tiny defrosted prawns rather than fancy shell-on ones.
recommendations.quote: I like the small frozen prawns that have been defrosted in a sieve under hot water.
recommendations.speaker: Helen Skelton

recommendations.item: Roast chicken dinner with separate stuffing, roast parsnips and loads of gravy (no Yorkshire pudding)
recommendations.reason: A classic roast, with stuffing in a big separate bowl and no Yorkshire pudding.
recommendations.quote: Proper chicken, loads of stuffing, like, in a big bowl
recommendations.speaker: Helen Skelton

recommendations.item: Corn on the cob with butter
recommendations.reason: She doesn't care that corn on the cob is undignified to eat; boiled or barbecued with butter.
recommendations.quote: Boil it or grill it, also on the barbecue.
recommendations.speaker: Helen Skelton

recommendations.item: Kir Royale
recommendations.reason: A special-occasion, Christmas-style drink she'd share with her group of friends (and a slip and slide).
recommendations.quote: It's a Christmas drink. It's a 'girls are round' drink
recommendations.speaker: Helen Skelton

recommendations.item: Jelly with tangerine segments suspended in it (plus butterscotch Angel Delight)
recommendations.reason: Comfort food from childhood; she thinks grown-up desserts look underwhelming compared with a jelly with fruit suspended inside.
recommendations.quote: Grown-up desserts are so, I don't know, I just think they're underwhelming... And jelly looks good.
recommendations.speaker: Helen Skelton

recommendations.item: Meal
recommendations.reason: James had an amazing meal there on a trip to Leeds.
recommendations.quote: I had an amazing meal at a place called Ox Club.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Dagel (savoury bagel doughnut)
recommendations.reason: James called the savoury bagel-doughnut one of the best things he's eaten.
recommendations.quote: they do a savoury doughnut which is a bagel doughnut called a dagel and that is one of the best things I've ever eaten.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

episodes.title: Ep 252: Jason Mantzoukas
episodes.summary: Egg-allergic Jason Mantzoukas builds a main steakhouse menu plus a lighter Greek 'shadow' menu: lemonade and still water, sourdough, shrimp cocktail, Steve Coogan's daughter's pasta, fillet steak, his grandmother's lemon potatoes, rose, vegan ice cream and coffee.

recommendations.item: Still water, with a lemonade to start
recommendations.reason: Still water because bubbles make him gassy, preceded by a lemon water/lemonade to kick-start hydration, a tip from Katie Dippold.
recommendations.quote: I'd like still water. I don't like bubbles. It makes me gassy.
recommendations.speaker: Jason Mantzoukas

recommendations.item: Egg-free sourdough (shadow: poppadoms)
recommendations.reason: Safe sourdough because his egg allergy rules out brioche and challah.
recommendations.quote: Sourdough, traditionally safe, you know.
recommendations.speaker: Jason Mantzoukas

recommendations.item: Shrimp cocktail (shadow: Greek horiatiki salad with block of feta)
recommendations.reason: Shrimp cocktail is his classic steakhouse starter; he singles out Keens in New York, an old smoking house with clay pipes on the ceiling, as his favourite steakhouse.
recommendations.quote: My favourite of that kind of steakhouse is Keens in New York... a turn of the last century smoking house that has pipes fixed to the ceiling.
recommendations.speaker: Jason Mantzoukas

recommendations.item: Steve Coogan's daughter's light greens pasta (secondi)
recommendations.reason: A light aglio e olio-style pasta with greens borrowed from Steve Coogan's Off Menu episode, as a mid-meal course.
recommendations.quote: I would like the pasta that Steve Coogan's daughter makes... light and clean, perfect for a mid-meal plate.
recommendations.speaker: Jason Mantzoukas

recommendations.item: Fillet steak, medium rare, salt and pepper
recommendations.reason: A plain fillet is what he thinks of as 'a steak', with no sauce; Keens would be a great place for it.
recommendations.quote: I would get a fillet, medium-rare, nothing really fancy about it.
recommendations.speaker: Jason Mantzoukas

recommendations.item: Pork shoulder / shank (shadow main)
recommendations.reason: His shadow Greek main: a fantastic pork shank at a Greek restaurant in New York.
recommendations.quote: There is a Greek restaurant in New York called, Pylos, that makes a pork shoulder, pork shank main that is fantastic.
recommendations.speaker: Jason Mantzoukas

recommendations.item: Grandmother's lemon potatoes
recommendations.reason: Roasted lemon-and-oil potato wedges from his Greek grandmother's kitchen that he has chased for years without finding the same taste.
recommendations.quote: my grandmother's lemon potatoes... I have been chasing those lemon potatoes forever.
recommendations.speaker: Jason Mantzoukas

recommendations.item: Mother's Greek Thanksgiving stuffing (ground beef, rice, chestnuts)
recommendations.reason: A slightly sweet nostalgic family stuffing his mum makes for American Thanksgiving.
recommendations.quote: Greek stuffing that my mother makes for American Thanksgiving... it's comfort, it's like the food of my childhood.
recommendations.speaker: Jason Mantzoukas

recommendations.item: Grilled broccoli
recommendations.reason: Simple grilled green vegetable to balance the meal.
recommendations.quote: just like broccoli, grill it up for a couple of minutes.
recommendations.speaker: Jason Mantzoukas

recommendations.item: Light dry rose Greek wine (shadow: white wine)
recommendations.reason: Red wine upsets his stomach, so a drier, light rose, ideally Greek.
recommendations.quote: I guess a rose, I'll take a rose. Something leaning towards red but still light and easy.
recommendations.speaker: Jason Mantzoukas

recommendations.item: Vegan ice cream (vanilla and chocolate) or sorbet
recommendations.reason: Because egg is in most desserts, he loves the modern vegan ice creams from US chains like Jeni's and Van Leeuwen, simply vanilla and chocolate.
recommendations.quote: Jeni's is one, Van Leeuwen is another... I like just a plain vanilla scoop and a chocolate scoop.
recommendations.speaker: Jason Mantzoukas

recommendations.item: Coffee after dinner
recommendations.reason: A coffee with dessert for energy to walk home.
recommendations.quote: I'm going to have a cup of coffee after dinner.
recommendations.speaker: Jason Mantzoukas

recommendations.item: Grilled cabbage with tahini
recommendations.reason: Jason ate at this Ottolenghi restaurant the night before and loved the grilled cabbage with tahini.
recommendations.quote: I just went to Rovi last night, one of the Ottolenghi restaurants and had a grilled cabbage tahini with it and it was fantastic.
recommendations.speaker: Jason Mantzoukas

recommendations.item: Hispi cabbage with cashew nut butter
recommendations.reason: Ed recommends this Asian-fusion place for its charred hispi cabbage wedge with cashew nut butter.
recommendations.quote: Called Kapow which is excellent, it's like, sort of, Asian fusion cuisine.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Shrimp cocktail and steak
recommendations.reason: Ed recalls a happy honeymoon night in the pink-and-gold steakhouse with a mad carpet and shrimp cocktail.
recommendations.quote: They have a steakhouse there that's all pink and gold. With a mad carpet.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

episodes.title: Ep 253: Sophie Willan
episodes.summary: A very Bolton, carb-heavy menu: sparkling water, Greenhalgh's crumpet loaf, potato cake and pasties from Ye Olde Pasty Shop, steak pudding from Olympus Chippy, black peas, a Mallorca margarita with tequila rose, and her granddad's bread and butter pudding.

recommendations.item: Sparkling water
recommendations.reason: She finds still water horrible and always opts for fizzy; her grandma carried Tizer or dandelion and burdock instead of water.
recommendations.quote: Not wavering, I actually find still water horrible.
recommendations.speaker: Sophie Willan

recommendations.item: Crumpet loaf (sliced, toasted, with butter)
recommendations.reason: A loaf with crumpet texture that you slice and toast, perfect comfort food when run down; it has to be served with proper butter.
recommendations.quote: It's got a lovely texture to it, because it's obviously like a crumpet, but it's also a loaf.
recommendations.speaker: Sophie Willan

recommendations.item: Potato cake
recommendations.reason: Fresh homemade Lancashire potato cakes, toasted until crisp with butter melted through. The shop is a centuries-old business in a Tudor listed building run by the lovely Mary, with a queue round the road.
recommendations.quote: you put them in the toaster and they're nice and crispy on top, very soft in the middle with loads of butter
recommendations.speaker: Sophie Willan

recommendations.item: Cheese and potato pasty and meat and potato pasty
recommendations.reason: She says they make the best pasties in the world, with very thin soft pastry; she bought them in bulk for the whole crew while filming Alma's Not Normal.
recommendations.quote: Very thin pastry. You've never known anything like it. It's soft and thin.
recommendations.speaker: Sophie Willan

recommendations.item: Steak pudding, chips, mushy peas, red cabbage and gravy
recommendations.reason: A proper chippy with a daytime restaurant and an elderly pianist; her favourite meal of suet-pastry steak pudding, only to be ordered from a chippy.
recommendations.quote: in Bolton, you get the best of both because they've got a place called Olympus Chippy, which has a restaurant and it's a chip shop
recommendations.speaker: Sophie Willan

recommendations.item: Fizzy Vimto with the main
recommendations.reason: The classic chippy drink to go with steak pudding.
recommendations.quote: Dandelion and burdock or a fizzy vimto.
recommendations.speaker: Sophie Willan

recommendations.item: Black peas
recommendations.reason: A salty Bonfire Night Lancashire treat served in a cup that you can sip like soup; no specific venue given.
recommendations.quote: They're delicious, salty.
recommendations.speaker: Sophie Willan

recommendations.item: Margarita (classic, salt rim, no ice) plus a shot of tequila rose
recommendations.reason: A former boat hotel turned cocktail bar near her granddad's home, with sunrise views and great tequilas and margaritas.
recommendations.quote: They do great tequilas and margaritas. Fabulous.
recommendations.speaker: Sophie Willan

recommendations.item: Bread and butter pudding
recommendations.reason: Her granddad, a fierce and talented cook who once worked as a saucier, makes it with sliced white bread, full cream milk and currants and raisins.
recommendations.quote: My granddad is a really good cook and he used to make bread and butter puddings when I was little.
recommendations.speaker: Sophie Willan

episodes.title: Ep 254: Michelle de Swarte
episodes.summary: Michelle de Swarte, an ex-model, chooses still water in a glass bottle, poppadoms and bread, a triple melon vape with cappuccinos by the Trevi Fountain, Southern mac and cheese, diner-style chips, orange Lucozade and a cheeseboard.

recommendations.item: Still water in a glass bottle
recommendations.reason: She says water tastes better from a glass bottle.
recommendations.quote: a glass bottle is nice though. It tastes different, doesn't it?
recommendations.speaker: Michelle de Swarte

recommendations.item: Complimentary poppadoms with all the dips, plus bread and butter
recommendations.reason: Poppadoms if they arrive free, bread and butter if she is ordering.
recommendations.quote: if poppadom's came to the table complimentary, I'd be like, this is lovely, nice touch. Can I have all the dips, please?
recommendations.speaker: Michelle de Swarte

recommendations.item: Triple melon vape and three cappuccinos at the Trevi Fountain
recommendations.reason: She does not like starters; she wants a vape and Roman afternoon coffees served by an easily convinced waiter.
recommendations.quote: it would be a triple melon, Lost Mary vape and a cup of coffee.
recommendations.speaker: Michelle de Swarte

recommendations.item: American Southern mac and cheese
recommendations.reason: Five cheeses, creamy but stringy, crispy brown on top, inspired by friends' versions in Tulsa, Oklahoma.
recommendations.quote: some of my best mates live in Tulsa, Oklahoma, and they just make banging mac and cheese.
recommendations.speaker: Michelle de Swarte

recommendations.item: Skin-on diner-style chips
recommendations.reason: Medium American diner fries with skin on, not skinny and not chip shop chips.
recommendations.quote: a decent American diner style chip.
recommendations.speaker: Michelle de Swarte

recommendations.item: Orange Lucozade
recommendations.reason: Refreshing and a hangover or sick-day favourite; also a glass of white wine with the cheeseboard.
recommendations.quote: It's just so delicious and lovely and refreshing.
recommendations.speaker: Michelle de Swarte

recommendations.item: Cheeseboard with crackers, bread and white wine
recommendations.reason: She does not care about dessert; she likes both soft and stinky cheeses, with a little jam.
recommendations.quote: I love all the cheeses.
recommendations.speaker: Michelle de Swarte

recommendations.item: Five Guys burger
recommendations.reason: She only discovered Five Guys a year ago, when Felicity Ward insisted, and now loves the burger.
recommendations.quote: I love a Five Guys burger.
recommendations.speaker: Michelle de Swarte

episodes.title: Ep 255: Saoirse-Monica Jackson
episodes.summary: Saoirse-Monica Jackson picks sparkling water, poppadoms with lots of dips, oysters with Italian Fish Club vinaigrette and langoustines, lamb chops from The Devonshire with sides and a First Aid Box Bloody Mary, truffle jalapeno mac and cheese, Montepulciano, and a Knickerbocker Glory from Florentini's in Derry.

recommendations.item: Sparkling water
recommendations.reason: She likes the scratchy tingle in her mouth.
recommendations.quote: Sparkling. I like to get the mouth scratched.
recommendations.speaker: Saoirse-Monica Jackson

recommendations.item: Poppadoms with dips (Frank's buffalo sauce, green chutney, lime pickle, yoghurt, sanbal)
recommendations.reason: Poppadoms are a better vehicle for dips and add crunch; she loves hot sauce and spice.
recommendations.quote: I go for poppadoms because I think that it's a better vehicle for dips, and I'm all about dips.
recommendations.speaker: Saoirse-Monica Jackson

recommendations.item: Six Irish oysters with vinaigrette and three Tabascos, plus langoustines in garlic butter
recommendations.reason: Wants the oysters served with their very vinegary vinaigrette with plenty of tiny onions, which she shots at the end with Tabasco.
recommendations.quote: their vinaigrette, my oh my it's so vinegary and they're not stingy in the amount of those wee tiny bits of onions you get in it.
recommendations.speaker: Saoirse-Monica Jackson

recommendations.item: Lamb chops with herby sauce, cheesy leeks, goose-fat chips and rocket
recommendations.reason: Visited the week before; her friend's lamb was the most succulent and tasty she has had, with a great atmosphere, and the cheesy leeks (white part) were a revelation.
recommendations.quote: I honestly have never tasted something as succulent and tasty. It didn't dribble. It wasn't greasy
recommendations.speaker: Saoirse-Monica Jackson

recommendations.item: Clarified Bloody Mary made with yellow tomatoes
recommendations.reason: The one great Bloody Mary she has had: thin, sweet, tomatoey, jalapeno and citrus, not like thick cold soup.
recommendations.quote: This was like what you really want from a Bloody Mary. It was thin, but tomatoe-y and sweet, and just light
recommendations.speaker: Saoirse-Monica Jackson

recommendations.item: Truffle jalapeno mac and cheese
recommendations.reason: A wild-card pasta side; she always wishes truffle mac and cheese were spicy.
recommendations.quote: I always think when I'm having truffle, 'Fuck, I wish this was spicy.'
recommendations.speaker: Saoirse-Monica Jackson

recommendations.item: Bottle of Montepulciano
recommendations.reason: A thin, lighter-bodied Italian red that goes with most dishes and does not stick to lipstick; Spanish wines upset her stomach.
recommendations.quote: I like Montepulciano because it's thin, it doesn't catch to your lipstick
recommendations.speaker: Saoirse-Monica Jackson

recommendations.item: Knickerbocker Glory with soft-serve, jelly, sauces and Flakes
recommendations.reason: A famous, very old Derry ice cream parlour that features in her earliest memories; the sundae has soft-serve, jelly, three sauces and two Flakes.
recommendations.quote: one of the most staple memories, all my early memories
recommendations.speaker: Saoirse-Monica Jackson

episodes.title: Ep 256: Hammed Animashaun
episodes.summary: Hammed has still water, warm white sourdough with salted butter, chilli-salted corn ribs, his own beef Wellington with mash and tenderstem, a mango salad, Guinness (then an Old Fashioned) and Mr Kipling apple pies with hot custard.

recommendations.item: Still water
recommendations.reason: He can't stand sparkling water and distrusts people who drink it.
recommendations.quote: Always. I can't stand sparkling water.
recommendations.speaker: Hammed Animashaun

recommendations.item: Warm white sourdough with salted butter
recommendations.reason: He loves white sourdough, buys it from Sainsbury's, and wants it warm with salted butter.
recommendations.quote: Warm, with butter. Yes, salted.
recommendations.speaker: Hammed Animashaun

recommendations.item: Chilli-salted corn ribs
recommendations.reason: He first tried corn ribs on a date night with his wife, probably at Wahaca, and has loved them since.
recommendations.quote: me and my wife went out for dinner, and we saw it on the menu, 'Corn ribs'... Mate, we-, it's so good.
recommendations.speaker: Hammed Animashaun

recommendations.item: Beef Wellington with mash, tenderstem broccoli and red wine gravy
recommendations.reason: Inspired by watching Hell's Kitchen, he plans to master his own Wellington for Christmas for his mum and family.
recommendations.quote: I just became obsessed with beef Wellington, so I'm going to attempt to try and make one for Christmas.
recommendations.speaker: Hammed Animashaun

recommendations.item: Mango salad (mango, pomegranate, lettuce, red onion, olive oil)
recommendations.reason: The best mango salad he's had is the Kiss Me Kale salad at the Barbican, where he's performing; fresh and fruity against the rich main.
recommendations.quote: The Barbican bar and grill. They have a kale salad. It's called a Kiss Me Kale salad... with, like, mango and it's just... it's so nice.
recommendations.speaker: Hammed Animashaun

recommendations.item: Guinness, poured properly, then an Old Fashioned
recommendations.reason: Guinness is now his go-to drink after an initial bad first sip; he wants it poured slowly and settled, with an Old Fashioned afterwards.
recommendations.quote: with Guinness you've got to take your time. It's a slow drink... You've got to let it settle.
recommendations.speaker: Hammed Animashaun

recommendations.item: Two Mr Kipling apple pies, warmed, with hot custard
recommendations.reason: Simple nostalgic comfort: little shop-bought apple pies, warmed, with hot custard.
recommendations.quote: Yes, Mr Kipling's... the little ones, and you have maybe, like, two, and you warm them up, and some custard on top.
recommendations.speaker: Hammed Animashaun

recommendations.item: Gymkhana (sauces and tasting)
recommendations.reason: Ed calls it still one of his favourite London restaurants, now two Michelin-starred and hard to book. (Name transcribed as 'Jim Karner'.)
recommendations.quote: still one of my favourite restaurants in London. If I could get a bloody booking, I would go.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

episodes.title: Ep 257: Amy Annette
episodes.summary: Free tap water, Honey & Co's bread platter, mortadella three ways, buttery pasta, beef tartare, grape salad supreme, Sicilian white wine, and a Hampstead banana-and-chocolate crepe with an espresso martini.

recommendations.item: Tap water
recommendations.reason: Insists on free still tap water, loving the thrill of getting things for free.
recommendations.quote: Still water, and tap, please. I'm not paying.
recommendations.speaker: Amy Annette

recommendations.item: Honey & Co mezze bread platter with salted butter and labneh
recommendations.reason: Astonishing assortment of breads, including a sweet loaf and plump pitta, that keep arriving at the table; she adds salted butter.
recommendations.quote: You don't really understand that these breads could exist, that's how I feel every time I have them.
recommendations.speaker: Amy Annette

recommendations.item: Mortadella cicchetti (first of three mortadella ways)
recommendations.venue: Bar Allolocroco (as transcribed; exact name unconfirmed)
recommendations.reason: Tiny breads topped with sliced mortadella at a Venice cicchetti bar recommended by a friend, served with white wine.
recommendations.quote: you go up and then, you try to speak a bit of Italian and then, they immediately speak English to you, it's so nice.
recommendations.speaker: Amy Annette

recommendations.item: Mortadella sandwich on focaccia (second mortadella way, modelled on their roast chicken sandwich)
recommendations.reason: Famously overstuffed focaccia sandwiches that change often, with a succulent roast chicken version that she'd swap for mortadella.
recommendations.quote: I would buy a ticket for this sandwich any day
recommendations.speaker: Amy Annette

recommendations.item: Mortadella rolled into roses on a charcuterie board
recommendations.reason: Her third way: artfully rolled mortadella and other cured meats on a platter.
recommendations.quote: they roll up the meat, they make it look like a rose.
recommendations.speaker: Amy Annette

recommendations.item: Buttery pasta (pasta course)
recommendations.reason: A childhood comfort from her vegetarian phase; plain buttery angel hair.
recommendations.quote: find a way to eat buttery pasta at every meal
recommendations.speaker: Amy Annette

recommendations.item: Beef tartare with thin toast and chips
recommendations.reason: Finely chopped raw beef, minimal seasoning with egg yolk, served with bread, chips and a punchy salad.
recommendations.quote: I like it raw.
recommendations.speaker: Amy Annette

recommendations.item: Grape salad supreme
recommendations.reason: Her American family's Thanksgiving side of grapes, tinned pineapple, whipped cream and mayonnaise.
recommendations.quote: It is a side dish at my family's Thanksgiving
recommendations.speaker: Amy Annette

recommendations.item: Sicilian white wine (e.g. Catarratto)
recommendations.reason: Wants a not-too-dry Sicilian white, which also solves the sommelier word game.
recommendations.quote: Sicilian white which I think there's one called, like, Catarratto which is quite nice.
recommendations.speaker: Amy Annette

recommendations.item: Mixed chocolate and banana crepe
recommendations.reason: A light, crisp-edged, buttery crepe from a French-run street cart with melted milk and white chocolate buttons and sliced banana; she'd pair it with an espresso martini.
recommendations.quote: The crepe is so good, it's so light and, kind of, crispy on the edges.
recommendations.speaker: Amy Annette

recommendations.item: Espresso martini with the crepe
recommendations.reason: Adds a grown-up touch to scoffing a crepe by hand.
recommendations.quote: I'd like to have an espresso martini with my crepe
recommendations.speaker: Amy Annette

recommendations.item: Full English breakfast and orange squash
recommendations.reason: Her honourable mention: a gruff, busy old-school Pimlico caff with queue-and-shout ordering, great sausages and tea from an urn.
recommendations.quote: The food is so good, the orange squash to die for. Tea in a big urn.
recommendations.speaker: Amy Annette

recommendations.item: Burgers, chips and mac and cheese balls
recommendations.reason: Honourable mention for nostalgic burger deliveries from Parsons Green.
recommendations.quote: The burgers, the chips were really good, the mac and cheese balls were really good as well.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Tiramisu made with panettone
recommendations.reason: James raves about a Christmas-pudding-style panettone tiramisu he had there, though it was a one-off special.
recommendations.quote: one of the best desserts I've ever had anywhere.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Beef-rice dish with raw beef and egg
recommendations.reason: Amy describes a rice ball topped with raw beef slices and egg that Ed wants to try.
recommendations.quote: Oh, got to go get that.
recommendations.speaker: Amy Annette

recommendations.item: Meat rices and wine
recommendations.reason: Amy recently enjoyed it and calls it delicious.
recommendations.quote: it is delicious.
recommendations.speaker: Amy Annette

recommendations.item: Wine
recommendations.reason: Amy says she went on Ed's recommendation and loved the huge wine list.
recommendations.quote: it was so nice and they have a crazy wine list
recommendations.speaker: Amy Annette

episodes.title: Ep 258: Phil Dunster
episodes.summary: Phil Dunster's crowd-pleasing menu: sparkling water, garlic and rosemary cheesy bread, wedding burrata from Genoa, his mum's Rapid Ragu, smushed roast potatoes, a carefully poured Coke Zero and country pub sticky toffee pudding with hot custard.

recommendations.item: Sparkling water
recommendations.reason: He likes a bit of fizz and pizazz to start a meal.
recommendations.quote: I just like a bit of pizazz at the start of the meal. It sets me up right. I like a bit of fizz.
recommendations.speaker: Phil Dunster

recommendations.item: Garlicky cheesy bread with rosemary
recommendations.reason: He wants garlic cheese bread with rosemary as his bread course.
recommendations.quote: can I have garlic-y cheesy bread with some rosemary on them?
recommendations.speaker: Phil Dunster

recommendations.item: Fresh burrata, served plain
recommendations.reason: Eaten at a wedding in Genoa where a man made the burrata in front of guests; creamy, milky and fresh, best without rocket or balsamic.
recommendations.quote: he was bulging burrata there before your very eyes. And, my oh my, it was creamy, it was milky, it was delicious.
recommendations.speaker: Phil Dunster

recommendations.item: Rapid Ragu (Nigella recipe with lamb, pancetta and Marsala) made by his mum Pam
recommendations.reason: A comfort dish from his mum that he'd come home to after rugby, battered and showered.
recommendations.quote: It's actually a Pam Dunster, a.k.a. Mum, special. It's one of those real comfort foods.
recommendations.speaker: Phil Dunster

recommendations.item: Smushed roast potatoes, crispy outside and fluffy inside
recommendations.reason: Crunchy, salty smashed roasties with a fluffy middle, like the ASMR videos.
recommendations.quote: I like my tater, like, when it's got that crispy crunch... But it's fluffy on the inside.
recommendations.speaker: Phil Dunster

recommendations.item: Coke Zero from a can, poured gently over ice
recommendations.reason: Finds it more refreshing than wine or cocktails, as long as it is poured carefully so it keeps its fizz.
recommendations.quote: there's margarita, okay, there's home-made lemonade, it's just not as good as Coke Zero.
recommendations.speaker: Phil Dunster

recommendations.item: Sticky toffee pudding with dates and hot custard (vanilla pods)
recommendations.venue: Country pub near his mum's home, Reading (unnamed)
recommendations.reason: A proper tray-baked sticky toffee pud with date and tangy toffee flavour, served with hot vanilla custard on the side; the pub is not named.
recommendations.quote: There's a pub near where my mum lived in Reading. It's out in the countryside, it's a country pub, sticky toffee pud.
recommendations.speaker: Phil Dunster

episodes.title: Ep 259: Will Ospreay
episodes.summary: Wrestler Will Ospreay picks still water, poppadoms with smooth mango chutney, a tear-and-share garlic flatbread, A5 steak from Las Vegas and Wolfgang's Steakhouse in Tokyo, his partner's sweet potato mash, double vodka and Coke Zero, and brownie with vanilla ice cream.

recommendations.item: Still water
recommendations.reason: He simply dislikes sparkling water.
recommendations.quote: Still, I can't do sparkling.
recommendations.speaker: Will Ospreay

recommendations.item: Poppadoms with smooth mango chutney
recommendations.reason: A family-curry-night favourite; the mango chutney is the star, with memories of post-backyard-wrestling Indian meals in Rainham.
recommendations.quote: that mango chutney sets my world on fire, bruv.
recommendations.speaker: Will Ospreay

recommendations.item: Garlic flatbread, torn at the table
recommendations.reason: A pizza-style garlic flatbread served on a wooden board that tears easily and melts in the mouth, with only a hint of garlic butter; he can't remember the London restaurant.
recommendations.quote: it tore off so easy, it just, kind of, melted in your mouth
recommendations.speaker: Will Ospreay

recommendations.item: Japanese A5 strip steak
recommendations.reason: Melt-in-the-mouth steak at a sponsor meal in Tokyo that became a favourite; he took his parents there before leaving for AEW. He also loved an A5 strip in Las Vegas.
recommendations.quote: It just melts into your mouth, it melts like butter bruv
recommendations.speaker: Will Ospreay

recommendations.item: Sweet potato mash
recommendations.reason: His partner's incredible sweet potato mash.
recommendations.quote: my missus made this incredible sweet potato mash
recommendations.speaker: Will Ospreay

recommendations.item: Double vodka and Coke Zero
recommendations.reason: His safe go-to drink; whiskey, tequila and red wine all cause trouble.
recommendations.quote: I'm just double vodka, Coke Zero, just like I'm easy with that.
recommendations.speaker: Will Ospreay

recommendations.item: Chocolate brownie with vanilla ice cream
recommendations.reason: Crisp on top and gooey in the middle, with plain vanilla ice cream.
recommendations.quote: I don't like a hard brownie, I like it when it's just a little bit hard on the outside, but, smooth on the inside
recommendations.speaker: Will Ospreay

recommendations.item: Peri-peri chicken, creamy mash, peri chips, spicy rice
recommendations.reason: Wrestling's staple meal; his move is called Cheeky Nando's.
recommendations.quote: a main diet for every pro wrestler, especially in this country, is definitely go and get a Nando's for yourself, mate.
recommendations.speaker: Will Ospreay

episodes.title: Ep 260: Rachel Stevens
episodes.summary: Rachel Stevens picks icy still water, toasted sourdough with salted butter, burrata with balsamic, air-fried lobster and chips, charred tenderstem broccoli, a glass of white wine with an ice cube, and both apple crumble with hot custard and sticky toffee pudding with cold ice cream.

recommendations.item: Still water with ice, freezing cold
recommendations.reason: She finds sparkling water tastes like dissolved paracetamol and likes cold drinks to be freezing cold.
recommendations.quote: I've got this funny thing that, if I have a cold drink, it has to be freezing cold, or if I have a hot drink, it has to be boiling hot.
recommendations.speaker: Rachel Stevens

recommendations.item: Toasted sourdough dripping with salted butter and extra salt flakes
recommendations.reason: She chooses bread over poppadoms and says you can't be healthy when you want proper hot, buttery, salty bread.
recommendations.quote: I do love a sourdough, toasted, with just-, dripping with proper, proper salted butter, with a bit of salt on it.
recommendations.speaker: Rachel Stevens

recommendations.item: Burrata with balsamic glaze, fresh tomatoes and basil
recommendations.reason: Her favourite starter, ideally served whole so you get to cut into the creamy centre; she and bandmate Jo used to share it in their LA days.
recommendations.quote: favourite starter, burrata with balsamic glaze. With fresh tomatoes, a bit of basil, delicious.
recommendations.speaker: Rachel Stevens

recommendations.item: Lobster and chips, steamed then lightly grilled
recommendations.reason: Her dream main; she likes lobster steamed and then lightly charred.
recommendations.quote: I like it steamed and then lightly grilled.
recommendations.speaker: Rachel Stevens

recommendations.item: Charred tenderstem broccoli with chilli and garlic
recommendations.reason: A simple charred green side; she gets similar results at home in her air fryer.
recommendations.quote: Broccoli, but, charred with chilli, garlic.
recommendations.speaker: Rachel Stevens

recommendations.item: Glass of white wine with a little ice
recommendations.reason: She likes a well-rounded, really cold white wine with a cube of ice, and has come to love wine more with age.
recommendations.quote: just a nice, well rounded glass of white wine.
recommendations.speaker: Rachel Stevens

recommendations.item: Apple crumble with boiling hot custard, and sticky toffee pudding with freezing cold vanilla ice cream
recommendations.reason: Two British classics, each with an extreme temperature contrast, eaten dipping between the two.
recommendations.quote: So apple crumble, with boiling hot custard... Or a sticky toffee pudding with freezing cold vanilla ice cream. Classics.
recommendations.speaker: Rachel Stevens

recommendations.item: New Year's Eve tasting menu with wine pairing and cocktails
recommendations.reason: Ed calls it an absolutely amazing restaurant, where he and James spent New Year's Eve with wine pairings and cocktails.
recommendations.quote: We went to a restaurant called L'Enclume in the Lake District, which is an absolutely amazing restaurant. It's fantastic
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

episodes.title: Ep 261: Natalie Cassidy
episodes.summary: Natalie Cassidy's menu runs from sparkling San Pellegrino with lime and bolognese arancini, through a bacon roll with her dad's tea, lobster chilli tagliolini and a rib-eye with dauphinoise, to Meursault and a cheeseboard with port instead of dessert (much to James's fury).

recommendations.item: Very fizzy sparkling water (San Pellegrino) with a wedge of lime
recommendations.reason: She wants proper fizz, so San Pellegrino, with a lime wedge bobbing in it.
recommendations.quote: it has got to be a very, very fizzy water. You know, some are awful, so you need a San Pelle.
recommendations.speaker: Natalie Cassidy

recommendations.item: Deep-fried bolognese arancini in a truffle butter sauce
recommendations.reason: Swapping poppadoms or bread for a small snack of crisp arancini filled with bolognese in a truffley buttery sauce.
recommendations.quote: I'd like some arancini balls, some deep-friend arancini balls that sit in, kind of, a truffley, buttery sauce.
recommendations.speaker: Natalie Cassidy

recommendations.item: Bacon roll: crusty white bakers' roll, salted butter, three rashers of thick unsmoked back bacon, tomato sauce and mayo
recommendations.reason: A nostalgic, messy comfort roll tied to her mum sending her to the bakers; she rates The Ginger Pig's thick, crispy back bacon. Served with her dad's strong Yorkshire Gold tea.
recommendations.quote: I like The Ginger Pig. I think The Ginger Pig do excellent bacon.
recommendations.speaker: Natalie Cassidy

recommendations.item: Lobster and chilli tagliolini (pasta course)
recommendations.location: Hyatt Regency London, Seymour Street, Marylebone, London, UK
recommendations.reason: A light oil, lemon and black pepper lobster pasta with chunky lobster; she says Giorgio Locatelli's restaurant does a lovely lobster spaghetti and recommends it for the bread basket and pasta.
recommendations.quote: Locanda Locatelli does a lovely lobster spaghetti.
recommendations.speaker: Natalie Cassidy

recommendations.item: Rib-eye steak, medium, with rocket and parmesan salad
recommendations.reason: She rates rib-eye for flavour and wants it cooked through enough that no blood runs onto the plate, with a peppery rocket salad.
recommendations.quote: I don't think you can beat the flavour of a rib-eye.
recommendations.speaker: Natalie Cassidy

recommendations.item: Dauphinoise potatoes
recommendations.reason: A dish she loves but rarely makes because it is such a faff.
recommendations.quote: it's something I don't cook a lot because it's a ball ache to make.
recommendations.speaker: Natalie Cassidy

recommendations.item: Cold glass of Meursault, and her dad's builder's tea
recommendations.reason: A rich, creamy white she buys once a year for Christmas Day, plus a nostalgic strong Yorkshire Gold tea like her late dad used to make.
recommendations.quote: It's quite a rich and creamy wine. It reminds me of Christmas.
recommendations.speaker: Natalie Cassidy

recommendations.item: Cheeseboard (Cornish Crunch, Stilton, Gorgonzola, Wensleydale with cranberries) with fig, crackers and a glass of port
recommendations.reason: Not a dessert person, she picks savoury; the cheddar is M&S's Cornish Crunch.
recommendations.quote: I'd go a Cornish Crunch from Marks when I'm buying.
recommendations.speaker: Natalie Cassidy

recommendations.item: Tasting-menu dining
recommendations.reason: She and Ed both name it as a favourite restaurant; she recalls its cheese course there.
recommendations.quote: Wonderful restaurant, by the way.
recommendations.speaker: Natalie Cassidy

episodes.title: Ep 262: Joe Locke
episodes.summary: Joe Locke goes Italian: oily focaccia, Dishoom pav bhaji, Don Angie lasagna rolls, citrusy broccolini, Aperol Spritz and M&S tiramisu.

recommendations.item: Sparkling San Pellegrino with lime, lemon and every citrus
recommendations.reason: He finds still water boring and likes San Pellegrino with plenty of citrus, ranking lime first.
recommendations.quote: I find water boring, so the sparkling water gives it, like, some energy, some fizz.
recommendations.speaker: Joe Locke

recommendations.item: Very oily focaccia with garlic and rosemary, with olive oil and balsamic
recommendations.reason: An Italian-style focaccia that juices when you bite it, dipped in olive oil and sharp balsamic.
recommendations.quote: Focaccia needs to, like, juice when you bite into it.
recommendations.speaker: Joe Locke

recommendations.item: Pav bhaji
recommendations.reason: He ordered it almost weekly by Deliveroo after first trying it; blended spiced vegetables with bread for dipping.
recommendations.quote: It's the pav bhaji from Dishoom... it is the most delicious thing ever
recommendations.speaker: Joe Locke

recommendations.item: Lasagna rolls
recommendations.reason: The nicest thing he has ever eaten: rolled and sliced lasagna baked with extra sauce and cheese at this Italian-American spot he got in via his fake assistant Lisa Fox.
recommendations.quote: it's the nicest thing I've ever eaten in my life.
recommendations.speaker: Joe Locke

recommendations.item: Garlicky, citrusy broccolini
recommendations.reason: Broccolini so garlicky and lemony it hurts, with whole limes or lemons to squeeze on.
recommendations.quote: really garlicky, citrusy, broccolini... so garlicky and citrusy that it hurts
recommendations.speaker: Joe Locke

recommendations.item: Aperol Spritz
recommendations.reason: His favourite Italian drink, with proper soda so it can be glugged.
recommendations.quote: I could drink it like juice. I do drink it like juice in the summer.
recommendations.speaker: Joe Locke

recommendations.item: M&S tiramisu (the tray one)
recommendations.reason: Creamy, coffee-y supermarket tiramisu he could eat a whole tray of, despite being lactose intolerant.
recommendations.quote: I love the M&S tiramisu.
recommendations.speaker: Joe Locke

recommendations.item: Pizza
recommendations.reason: The nicest pizza he has ever had, booked via his fake assistant email (name not given).
recommendations.quote: It was the nicest pizza I've ever had in my life.
recommendations.speaker: Joe Locke

recommendations.item: Salted caramel brownie bites
recommendations.reason: Ed praises this new Hackney coffee place's layered brownie and salted caramel bites as dangerously good.
recommendations.quote: they've got these little brownie bites, these salted caramel ones... They're dangerously good.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

episodes.title: Ep 263: Josh Widdicombe
episodes.summary: Vegetarian, tea-obsessed Josh Widdicombe goes for sparkling water, a pile of 1990s-style curry house poppadoms, two slices of homemade toast, Franco Manca's number five pizza, saag paneer, tea, and Christmas chocolates.

recommendations.item: Sparkling water
recommendations.reason: He loves fizzy water and makes his own with a home carbonator; he enjoys trying to 'beat the bubbles' and finds it more fun than still.
recommendations.quote: I love sparkling. I've got a thing at home, so that you can have sparkling water without the guilt of the plastics.
recommendations.speaker: Josh Widdicombe

recommendations.item: Pile of plain poppadoms with yogurt dip (plus lime pickle and mango chutney)
recommendations.reason: He wants the classic British Indian restaurant poppadom with dips, like in a 1990s curry house, with the yogurt one the clear favourite; he dislikes fancy Indian places that replace poppadoms.
recommendations.quote: I like a classic, you know, British Indian restaurant poppadom in the classic manner with the dips. Yogurt-y one best.
recommendations.speaker: Josh Widdicombe

recommendations.item: Two slices of granary toast, self-sliced: one with butter and Marmite, one with marmalade
recommendations.reason: Toast is his safe, homely treat; he wants to slice his own thick granary and have Marmite as a savoury course and marmalade as pudding.
recommendations.quote: there's a homeliness to it, isn't there? There's a feeling of safety. There's a feeling of security of being at home. I love it.
recommendations.speaker: Josh Widdicombe

recommendations.item: Number five pizza (olives, capers, garlic, no anchovies, with added chilli) plus the side salad
recommendations.reason: He was an early fan from when it was a tiny pizza place in Brixton market, and the pizza has stayed good as the chain has grown; he also likes the salad with olives and sun-dried tomato.
recommendations.quote: It was in Brixton market, and it was just like a small pizza place where the waiters were overburdened and there were only about ten tables and then now it's everywhere.
recommendations.speaker: Josh Widdicombe

recommendations.item: Saag paneer
recommendations.reason: As a vegetarian he sees paneer as a relief for the loss of meat, with a big, dominant texture.
recommendations.quote: paneer along with halloumi is an absolute relief to a vegetarian.
recommendations.speaker: Josh Widdicombe

recommendations.item: Tea (plain PG Tips, Yorkshire or Twinings, with milk), a second cup with dessert
recommendations.reason: He drinks tea constantly since giving up alcohol and wants simple, normal tea, not Starbucks tea.
recommendations.quote: I find it difficult to go a long period without tea.
recommendations.speaker: Josh Widdicombe

recommendations.item: Christmas chocolates: Lindt balls (mixed, white favourite), After Eights, Matchmakers, Celebrations and a foot-long Toblerone
recommendations.reason: He is not a sweet boy, but Christmas chocolates, especially Lindt balls, are the best bit of Christmas for him.
recommendations.quote: we only really get them at Christmas, and it's the best bit of Christmas.
recommendations.speaker: Josh Widdicombe

episodes.title: Ep 264: Rukmini Iyer
episodes.summary: Cookbook author Rukmini's dream menu: San Pellegrino, pain d'epi and chilli-crab buns, a deep-fried platter, salmon with hollandaise and asparagus, dauphinoise with greens, red wine with sparkling water and Tangfastics, and a layered raspberry-passion fruit chocolate 'cake mousse'.

recommendations.item: San Pellegrino sparkling water
recommendations.reason: Converted to sparkling by her sister's advice and drank a bottle a day in lockdown.
recommendations.quote: she, in the nicest possible way, was like, 'You know, if you order sparkling water, you don't have to have wine every lunchtime.'
recommendations.speaker: Rukmini Iyer

recommendations.item: Pain d'epi and fluffy fried buns for Singapore chilli crab
recommendations.reason: Wants crusty-outside, fluffy-inside bread with salted British butter, plus the soft sweet buns served for mopping up chilli crab sauce.
recommendations.quote: you then get these little buns to mop up the sauce. I could leave the crab for you guys and I could just have a bucket of that.
recommendations.speaker: Rukmini Iyer

recommendations.item: Deep-fried platter: pakoras, zucchini fries, tempura prawns with coriander chutney
recommendations.reason: Wants restaurant food she wouldn't bother making at home; compares crunch levels of different batters.
recommendations.quote: I like restaurant food to be something I wouldn't make at home, or wouldn't expect a mate to make for me.
recommendations.speaker: Rukmini Iyer

recommendations.item: Salmon with hollandaise and asparagus
recommendations.reason: Wants it to taste like the first time she had hollandaise as a teenager on holiday, when she asked the chef for the recipe.
recommendations.quote: I just remember taking one forkfull and just going, 'What is this?'
recommendations.speaker: Rukmini Iyer

recommendations.item: Dauphinoise, kale and buttered cabbage with Sichuan peppercorns
recommendations.reason: Loves a double carb and has grown into loving greens.
recommendations.quote: dauphinoise because I like to double carb
recommendations.speaker: Rukmini Iyer

recommendations.item: Red wine and sparkling water, with Haribo Tangfastics
recommendations.reason: Recalls drinking it in a Moroccan riad courtyard while working on a film; Tangfastics came from a theatre trip with red wine.
recommendations.quote: sparkling water and red wine are a really nice combo.
recommendations.speaker: Rukmini Iyer

recommendations.item: Layered chocolate, raspberry and passion fruit mousse cake ('Cake Mousse')
recommendations.reason: Invented dessert of dense sponge layered with chocolate, raspberry and passion fruit mousse, topped with shaved chocolate.
recommendations.quote: I really love raspberry and passion fruit with chocolate. I think it's the nicest combination
recommendations.speaker: Rukmini Iyer

episodes.title: Ep 265: Rick Astley
episodes.summary: Rick Astley builds an all-Italian beachside meal: Italian bread and olive oil, swordfish carpaccio, spaghetti vongole with bottarga, rocket and parmesan, Antinori Chardonnay, then tiramisu and an espresso.

recommendations.item: Still tap water
recommendations.reason: Still water to cleanse the palate and stay hydrated alongside wine; fizzy water affects the taste of food.
recommendations.quote: The water is to, perhaps, cleanse your palate a bit, but also just to keep you hydrated with the lovely wine we're about to drink.
recommendations.speaker: Rick Astley

recommendations.item: Italian focaccia-style bread with very good olive oil
recommendations.reason: His dream restaurant is an unpretentious Italian beach spot; with good olive oil, even reasonable bread is enough.
recommendations.quote: If you've got, even reasonable bread, good olive oil and you're away, aren't you?
recommendations.speaker: Rick Astley

recommendations.item: Swordfish carpaccio
recommendations.reason: Thinly sliced swordfish with olive oil, a light starter he orders when the olive oil impresses him.
recommendations.quote: you've really got to be as thin as you can be, and almost see through it
recommendations.speaker: Rick Astley

recommendations.item: Spaghetti vongole with bottarga
recommendations.reason: Tied to happy family holidays by the sea in Sardinia, with salty cured fish roe adding another dimension.
recommendations.quote: throwing the bottarga on top just adds this other dimension to it ... I think it's happy memories of being on holidays with your kids
recommendations.speaker: Rick Astley

recommendations.item: Rocket and Parmesan
recommendations.reason: Peppery rocket and Parmesan, a big thing in his house, and his wife often asks for a block of Parmesan instead of dessert.
recommendations.quote: when it's good, it's amazing. It's almost breath-taking.
recommendations.speaker: Rick Astley

recommendations.item: Antinori Chardonnay
recommendations.reason: His favourite wine is Chardonnay, and this ludicrously expensive Italian one is a dream treat.
recommendations.quote: my favourite wine, anyway, is Chardonnay ... it is phenomenal this wine
recommendations.speaker: Rick Astley

recommendations.item: Tiramisu
recommendations.reason: A good tiramisu is wonderful and part of the fabric of Italian life; he never skips dessert.
recommendations.quote: A good Tiramisu is a pretty amazing wonderful thing.
recommendations.speaker: Rick Astley

recommendations.item: Espresso at the end of the meal
recommendations.reason: He loves rounding off a meal with an espresso, as in Italian bars.
recommendations.quote: I can't finish today without having an espresso you see.
recommendations.speaker: Rick Astley

recommendations.item: Panettone tiramisu
recommendations.reason: James had the best tiramisu of his life here as a one-day special using panettone.
recommendations.quote: Did a Sicilian-style Tiramisu where instead of sponge fingers they used panettone.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Tiramisu on a tasting menu
recommendations.reason: Ed's best tiramisu: chef Tom Barnes serves a generous coffee-infused one he used to make for his dad.
