recommendations.quote: a big helping of this Tiramisu that he used to make for his dad ... I think the cream is infused with coffee as well
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Craft beer bars
recommendations.reason: Rick is involved in a couple of London bars from the Danish brewery; Ed and James praise the beer.
recommendations.quote: a couple of bars in London that we're involved with from one of the places called Mikkeller.
recommendations.speaker: Rick Astley

episodes.title: Ep 266: Ella Purnell
episodes.summary: Ella Purnell's playful menu: tap water, warm sourdough with Marmite butter from Heaneys, Joe's Shanghai soup dumplings, a misremembered Spy Kids burger, cheap prawn crackers, Diet Coke and Adventure Island doughnuts.

recommendations.item: Tap water (mixer tap, cold)
recommendations.reason: She hates sparkling water, which she finds sour and bitter, and does not mind tap over still.
recommendations.quote: it doesn't taste anything like water... It's sour, I hate it
recommendations.speaker: Ella Purnell

recommendations.item: Warm sourdough with Marmite butter
recommendations.reason: She loves Marmite butter with sourdough here, used as an edible spoon, and once asked for three extra pots to take away.
recommendations.quote: they do marmite butter with sourdough and it's unbelievable.
recommendations.speaker: Ella Purnell

recommendations.item: Pork soup dumplings (xiao long bao)
recommendations.reason: She loves the interactive ritual of biting the top off and drinking the soup, and likes watching others eat them.
recommendations.quote: there's a very specific way you have to eat them as instructed by me and I get to watch you eat them.
recommendations.speaker: Ella Purnell

recommendations.item: Remembered Spy Kids burger
recommendations.reason: An idealised burger from the film that turned out to be a Big Mac, so she picks the version in her head.
recommendations.quote: imagine the best burger you could ever possibly imagine. That's what it was in my head.
recommendations.speaker: Ella Purnell

recommendations.item: Cheap supermarket prawn crackers, plus the concept of a salad
recommendations.reason: She wants greasy 60p prawn crackers rather than fancy restaurant ones.
recommendations.quote: I want them to be really greasy, I want them to make my fingers feel bad after I've eaten them.
recommendations.speaker: Ella Purnell

recommendations.item: Diet Coke
recommendations.reason: She calls it the cure for hangovers, nausea and even norovirus.
recommendations.quote: it is the cure for a hangover, and nausea.
recommendations.speaker: Ella Purnell

recommendations.item: Hot sugared mini doughnuts
recommendations.reason: A nostalgic seaside theme-park treat from childhood, including her ninth birthday, bought as twelve hot sugary doughnuts in a bag.
recommendations.quote: You get twelve little ones in a bag... it's nostalgic, and I guess the sugar high combined with the roller-coasters
recommendations.speaker: Ella Purnell

episodes.title: Ep 267: Danny Dyer
episodes.summary: Danny Dyer's nostalgic menu: chilled sparkling water, poppadoms with the dips (no salad), a lobster prawn cocktail with crab sticks, a whole leg of lamb roast, chip shop chips and curry sauce, ice-cold lager, and a Wimpy knickerbocker glory.

recommendations.item: Chilled sparkling water, straight
recommendations.reason: Perrier was out of reach in the 80s, so fizzy water still feels like making it, and he hates lemon and pips in it.
recommendations.quote: I feel like I'm in an important meeting somewhere, some sort of boardroom.
recommendations.speaker: Danny Dyer

recommendations.item: Poppadoms with mango, onion and lime pickle (no lettuce)
recommendations.reason: Likes the posh spinning tray of dips and the hot lime pickle, but no salad on a poppadom.
recommendations.quote: I like the shit you put on them.
recommendations.speaker: Danny Dyer

recommendations.item: Prawn cocktail with lobster, paprika and crab sticks dipped in Marie Rose sauce
recommendations.reason: Loves the Marie Rose sauce and the classic Christmas starter, upgraded with lobster and cherry tomatoes in a cocktail glass.
recommendations.quote: I think it's the sauce that I love.
recommendations.speaker: Danny Dyer

recommendations.item: Whole roast leg of lamb with roast potatoes in goose fat
recommendations.reason: Memories of his nan's leg of lamb and fighting his brother for the bone; he roasts one just for himself.
recommendations.quote: I want a whole leg, I want that to myself.
recommendations.speaker: Danny Dyer

recommendations.item: Chip shop chips drowned in curry sauce, with a paper fork
recommendations.reason: Takes him back to teenage Chinese takeaway nights on the estate; must be proper chip shop chips, not fries.
recommendations.quote: You can't have curry sauce on fries.
recommendations.speaker: Danny Dyer

recommendations.item: Ice-cold Stella lager from the corner garage fridge
recommendations.reason: Loves lager at the perfect temperature, especially in a beer garden; the local petrol garage fridge is unnamed.
recommendations.quote: I do love an ice cold lager.
recommendations.speaker: Danny Dyer

recommendations.item: Knickerbocker glory
recommendations.reason: A childhood aspiration he could never afford; he still has a Wimpy near him and feels he should go back.
recommendations.quote: I would look at people in there that had got the knickerbocker glory and thought, 'Fucking hell, what a life you lead.'
recommendations.speaker: Danny Dyer

recommendations.item: Chips
recommendations.reason: A good chip shop near his home.
recommendations.quote: There's one near me now called Wilson's, which is a good one.
recommendations.speaker: Danny Dyer

episodes.title: Ep 268: Jessica Hynes
episodes.summary: Jessica Hynes, craving healthy food after flu, picks sparkling water with lemon, poppadoms with all the dips, a Budapest-inspired Syrian lentil soup, artichoke tempura with a finely chopped salad and dips, fried halloumi with sweet chilli, sparkling lime water, then a mango lassi, banana split and alcohol-free Guinness.

recommendations.item: Sparkling water with lemon
recommendations.reason: Sparkling is a treat when out, and lemons feature in nearly everything she cooks at home.
recommendations.quote: Sparkling, if I'm out. I mean, it's a treat.
recommendations.speaker: Jessica Hynes

recommendations.item: Poppadoms with all the dips, piled on like a pizza
recommendations.reason: She falls on the poppadoms at an Indian restaurant, loading them with every dip and onion salad.
recommendations.quote: Always the dips with the poppadoms... you're literally treating the poppadom like it's a pizza.
recommendations.speaker: Jessica Hynes

recommendations.item: Syrian-style lentil soup with lemon, cumin and garam masala
recommendations.venue: A Syrian restaurant opposite her hotel in Budapest
recommendations.reason: The best lentil soup she has had changed her mind about lentil soup; she now recreates it at home with plenty of lemon. The restaurant is not named.
recommendations.quote: There was a Syrian restaurant opposite my hotel and they did the most delicious lentil soup I've ever had.
recommendations.speaker: Jessica Hynes

recommendations.item: Artichoke tempura with a finely chopped kale and walnut salad, baba ghanoush and hummus (with brown rice)
recommendations.reason: A lockdown invention using a big cash-and-carry jar of artichokes, served with a lemony finely chopped salad and dips.
recommendations.quote: Artichoke tempura, why wouldn't you? ... it was out of this world.
recommendations.speaker: Jessica Hynes

recommendations.item: Fried halloumi with sweet chilli sauce
recommendations.reason: Juicy, crispy fried halloumi that she cannot resist dipping in sweet chilli sauce, despite Ed's objections.
recommendations.quote: There's no way I'm not going to dip that halloumi in there.
recommendations.speaker: Jessica Hynes

recommendations.item: Sparkling water with a big squeeze of lime
recommendations.reason: Doesn't drink alcohol; her favourite meal drink, with a mango lassi bridging into dessert and an alcohol-free Guinness later.
recommendations.quote: I love a sparkling water with a bit of squeeze of lime.
recommendations.speaker: Jessica Hynes

recommendations.item: Mango lassi made with fresh mango and kefir; alcohol-free Guinness at the pub afterwards
recommendations.reason: A bridge drink into dessert and a post-meal pub pint of Guinness 0.0, a gift since she gave up drinking seven years ago.
recommendations.quote: Fresh mango whizzed up with kefir, that is a delicious drink.
recommendations.speaker: Jessica Hynes

recommendations.item: Banana split with exotic 'treat fruits'
recommendations.reason: A nostalgic childhood treat, alongside papaya, mango and dragon fruit; a banana split at the end of a meal out was the best day.
recommendations.quote: As a child, that was the ultimate treat. If you've got a banana split at the end of a meal out, that was the best day of your life.
recommendations.speaker: Jessica Hynes

recommendations.item: Creamy Holle live yoghurt
recommendations.reason: A Nepalese-run local shop in Folkestone stocking a delicious live yoghurt she loves.
recommendations.quote: An amazing shop where I live... run by the local Nepalese community in Folkestone, and they have an amazing yoghurt there called Creamy Holle.
recommendations.speaker: Jessica Hynes

recommendations.item: Fried halloumi block with black seed honey
recommendations.reason: Ed recommends this vegetarian restaurant's perfectly fried block of halloumi with honey as a starter.
recommendations.quote: It's a vegetarian restaurant in Soho. One of their starters is this whole block of fried halloumi and... black seed honey. It's absolutely delicious.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Curry
recommendations.reason: James's childhood curry house, one of two excellent rivals in Kettering; they give him freebies.
recommendations.quote: They're both great places. I love going to them equally, although The Raj are the one that gives me freebies.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Curry
recommendations.reason: The other main curry house in James's hometown, two doors from The Raj, also called excellent.
recommendations.quote: They're the two main curry houses... and they're both excellent.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

episodes.title: Ep 269: Robert Popper
episodes.summary: Picky eater Robert Popper builds a dreamlike meal: tap water, toasted challah, cereal in place of a starter, his grandma's paprika steak, raw carrots, invented Seamower and Laross drinks, and a dessert trolley including Bistro Aix's warm blueberry tart with lavender ice cream.

recommendations.item: Tap water
recommendations.reason: Dislikes the metallic bite of sparkling water, so plain tap water.
recommendations.quote: I'm having still water... I'm going to have tap water.
recommendations.speaker: Robert Popper

recommendations.item: Toasted challah with butter, from his own table toaster
recommendations.reason: His favourite bread, which he insists on toasting himself on a low setting because the sugar makes it burn.
recommendations.quote: That's my favourite bread. It's beautiful.
recommendations.speaker: Robert Popper

recommendations.item: Bowl of half cornflakes, half Rice Krispies with honey and cold oat milk
recommendations.reason: He skips starters but has this cereal at 6pm at home, served while replica Mick Hucknalls and Alastair Campbells watch.
recommendations.quote: I'm going to have a bowl of cereal. I'm going to have a bowl, right, with 50% Cornflakes, they go in first, 50% Rice Krispies.
recommendations.speaker: Robert Popper

recommendations.item: Square paprika-crusted steak with little potatoes and green beans
recommendations.reason: His late grandma's comfort meal, a floured, paprika-crusted square steak cooked in a cast iron pan, eaten in her flat.
recommendations.quote: she'd make these square steaks... loads of paprika and flour. There'd be, like, a crust. Oh, it was so good
recommendations.speaker: Robert Popper

recommendations.item: Bowl of raw carrots
recommendations.reason: His favourite snack, crunchy and sweet, served in a bowl with the offcuts going to his dog.
recommendations.quote: I think it's, like, the tastiest food in the world, raw carrot.
recommendations.speaker: Robert Popper

recommendations.item: Seamower (Coke and lemonade) and Laross (ginger ale and lemonade)
recommendations.reason: Made-up cocktail names he and his brother used to order at family parties to confuse the barman.
recommendations.quote: 'One Seamower, one Laross.'
recommendations.speaker: Robert Popper

recommendations.item: Warm blueberry tart with lavender ice cream
recommendations.reason: His favourite restaurant dessert, a warm blueberry tart with lavender ice cream at a romantic French bistro; he's furious when it's off the menu.
recommendations.quote: it's the nicest dessert I've ever had in a restaurant. It is warm blueberry tart, here's the genius, lavender ice cream.
recommendations.speaker: Robert Popper

recommendations.item: Pyramid of profiteroles with cream and hot chocolate sauce, plus homemade meringues
recommendations.reason: Profiteroles are his favourite dessert, made by his mum with cream rather than ice cream.
recommendations.quote: Profiteroles, my favourite dessert.
recommendations.speaker: Robert Popper

recommendations.item: Tominto (tomato juice and creme de menthe)
recommendations.reason: He and friends tried their invented, foul curdled cocktail there and the landlord obliged, a jokey rather than genuine recommendation.
recommendations.quote: 'Hello, a pint of lager, please, and a tominto.'
recommendations.speaker: Robert Popper

episodes.title: Ep 270: Sebastian Stan
episodes.summary: Sebastian Stan picks sparkling water, naan, Via Carota's anchovy toast, spaghetti and meatballs, fries with butter lettuce salad, an Empress Gin martini and a bowl of Jeni's ice cream.

recommendations.item: Sparkling water, fridge-cold
recommendations.reason: He finds sparkling refreshing and satisfying when ice cold from the fridge.
recommendations.quote: It's refreshing... sparkling water has to be out of a fridge.
recommendations.speaker: Sebastian Stan

recommendations.item: Naan
recommendations.reason: He could eat naan all the time and loves bread and butter as the greatest food.
recommendations.quote: bread and butter is the greatest food you can ever have.
recommendations.speaker: Sebastian Stan

recommendations.item: Toasted bread with butter, anchovies and salt
recommendations.location: West Village, New York City, USA
recommendations.reason: Well known in New York and a worthwhile splurge; he has taken many people, including his mom, to try the buttery anchovy toast.
recommendations.quote: they do these little toasted bread, like, with butter and anchovies with salt on it as a starter... And that is, like, the best.
recommendations.speaker: Sebastian Stan

recommendations.item: Spaghetti and meatballs
recommendations.reason: Easy to enjoy any day of the week, and the ideal glorious cheat-day lunch.
recommendations.quote: is there anything better than, like, spaghetti and meatballs?
recommendations.speaker: Sebastian Stan

recommendations.item: Crispy fries and a butter lettuce salad with olive oil, salt, pumpkin seeds and avocado
recommendations.reason: Fries always win; the simple butter lettuce salad adds a fresh counterpoint.
recommendations.quote: Fries. Definitely. Always wins. Like, really crispy fries
recommendations.speaker: Sebastian Stan

recommendations.item: Chilled Empress Gin martini with a twist (or Empress gin and tonic)
recommendations.reason: He likes a cold gin martini or Negroni, and Empress Gin is a favourite that turns purple when tonic hits it.
recommendations.quote: Empress Gin with tonic is really good... this one, sort of, turns purple when you pour it in there.
recommendations.speaker: Sebastian Stan

recommendations.item: Jeni's ice cream (peanut butter chocolate, brownie swirl, rocky road)
recommendations.reason: The best ice cream he has ever had; he wants a bowl of different scoops with big mix-ins.
recommendations.quote: In the US, there's something called Jeni's Ice Cream. I don't know why, it's phenomenal.
recommendations.speaker: Sebastian Stan

recommendations.item: Warm loaf of bread as a starter
recommendations.reason: He recommends its warm, steamy loaf of bread served as a starter.
recommendations.quote: The Dean Street Townhouse by the way... has that loaf of bread that's pretty great as a starter.
recommendations.speaker: Sebastian Stan

episodes.title: Ep 271: Olga Koch
episodes.summary: Olga Koch goes global: blackcurrant Schorle, a giant ghee dosa from CTR Bangalore, an enormous US-style prawn cocktail, slow-cooked Somali lamb from Al Kahf, Bulgarian shopska salad, a giant Dunkin' cold brew and a Golden Gaytime ice cream cake.

recommendations.item: Blackcurrant Schorle (sparkling water with juice)
recommendations.reason: She is a sparkling water fan and loves the German habit of mixing sparkling water half and half with juice, learnt from her parents in Germany.
recommendations.quote: I do love a blackcurrant Schorle.
recommendations.speaker: Olga Koch

recommendations.item: Butter dosa and kvass
recommendations.reason: The shiny, huge butter dosa, crisp on one side and chewy on the other, was a highlight of her first trip to Bangalore. She'd also add bread-tasting Russian kvass.
recommendations.quote: They make a butter dosa that is so big but also so shiny because of the ghee that they put on it.
recommendations.speaker: Olga Koch

recommendations.item: Prawn cocktail with huge tail-on prawns and horseradish-heavy US-style sauce
recommendations.reason: A fancy, old-school American prawn cocktail with big prawns and punchy red horseradish sauce, rather than the British mayo version; she tours a show called Prawn Cocktail.
recommendations.quote: I want them huge. I want the tails to still be on... I like the horseradish red one that they served in America.
recommendations.speaker: Olga Koch

recommendations.item: Xaniid (slow-cooked Somali lamb)
recommendations.reason: Melt-in-the-mouth lamb that is mainly just meat, which reminded her of her Kazakh grandmother's beshbarmak.
recommendations.quote: The most delicious has to be the lamb at Al Kahf, in Whitechapel, which is a Somali restaurant.
recommendations.speaker: Olga Koch

recommendations.item: Bulgarian shopska salad with grated feta
recommendations.reason: The Bulgarian cucumber, pepper, tomato and olive salad with grated feta so every bite has some cheese, which she thinks beats the Greek version.
recommendations.quote: They grate the feta so it mixes in, in a way that you never get with a Greek salad.
recommendations.speaker: Olga Koch

recommendations.item: Giant iced Dunkin' Donuts cold brew
recommendations.reason: Cold black coffee in the biggest cup possible, used in a road-trip game with friends of drinking it between gas stations and then comparing how much you pee out.
recommendations.quote: The biggest possible cup of iced Dunkin' Donut cold brew that you could find.
recommendations.speaker: Olga Koch

recommendations.item: Golden Gaytime ice cream cake, a Golden Gaytime on the side and a Golden Gaytini
recommendations.reason: She has a tattoo of the Australian Golden Gaytime and loves its biscuit crumb and balance of flavours.
recommendations.quote: It's the Golden Gaytime, I want a Golden Gaytime.
recommendations.speaker: Olga Koch

recommendations.item: Sweetcorn tartlet dessert
recommendations.reason: Her honourable mention for dessert: a dessert that made her and her friends nearly cry because it tasted like childhood cinema popcorn.
recommendations.quote: We all ate it at the same time and we all nearly burst into tears.
recommendations.speaker: Olga Koch

recommendations.item: Corned beef on rye
recommendations.reason: The first meat she ate after seven years vegetarian, and a memorable return to eating meat.
recommendations.quote: My very first one that I broke the lent with was... the corned beef on rye at Katz's.
recommendations.speaker: Olga Koch

recommendations.item: Duck press with duck sauce
recommendations.reason: A dramatic duck press that squeezes the bones into sauce was a formative experience in coming back to meat.
recommendations.quote: They brought out something called a duck press, which was absolutely nuts.
recommendations.speaker: Olga Koch

recommendations.item: Weird-flavour ice cream (e.g. Vegemite and white chocolate)
recommendations.reason: Ed loved the deliberately odd flavours; the Vegemite cut through the sweet white chocolate.
recommendations.quote: All the flavours are deliberately weird, but it was absolutely delicious.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

episodes.title: Ep 272: Derren Brown
episodes.summary: Derren Brown imagines a relaxed Italian dinner at home: Tommy's Margarita, tepid still water, Dusty Knuckle-style sourdough, parmesan and red wine, lobster risotto, perfect meatballs, rocket salad, Brunello, apple crumble, a salted caramel truffle and a dry Martini.

recommendations.item: Still water, not too cold, nothing plopping in it
recommendations.reason: He wants simple tepid still water, partly because cold water shocks the throat before shows, and hates ice-and-lemon jugs.
recommendations.quote: It should be a simple act of hydration, not a surprise sneezing fit.
recommendations.speaker: Derren Brown

recommendations.item: Warm sourdough with butter and cracked salt
recommendations.reason: He fell in love with the bakery's sourdough when he lived near Dalston; the bakery employs ex-prisoners and the bread is superb.
recommendations.quote: I found out many years later that they employ... ex-prisoners perhaps... But it doesn't. The bread's amazing.
recommendations.speaker: Derren Brown

recommendations.item: Sourdough and sausage rolls
recommendations.location: Under Temple Meads station, Bristol, UK
recommendations.reason: He has been in Bristol a lot lately and rates its sourdough; James adds the sausage rolls are great.
recommendations.quote: Hart's bakery in Bristol also does a very good-,
recommendations.speaker: Derren Brown

recommendations.item: Lobster risotto (bisque-based, tipping like lava)
recommendations.venue: Home cooking (recipe from chef Will Parks)
recommendations.reason: A risotto he makes himself from a chef's recipe, with a lobster-shell bisque, and a loose texture that moves like lava.
recommendations.quote: it should tip like hot lava.
recommendations.speaker: Derren Brown

recommendations.item: Chunks of well-aged parmesan with red wine (Sangiovese)
recommendations.reason: A welcome snack on the table, inspired by Christopher Walken's favourite snack and a 50-month-aged parmesan he had in Venice.
recommendations.quote: parmesan and red wine... that with a good Sangiovese perhaps is phenomenal.
recommendations.speaker: Derren Brown

recommendations.item: Perfect meatballs in tomato sauce with thick spaghetti
recommendations.venue: Home cooking (learned from Mama Agata, Ravello)
recommendations.reason: Social, round-table comfort food as the opposite of a fussy tasting menu; his own beef and pork meatballs with fennel, chilli and garlic.
recommendations.quote: it's comfort food and it's that social experience and everything that's the opposite of a fucking tasting menu.
recommendations.speaker: Derren Brown

recommendations.item: Rocket salad with parmesan, balsamic and olive oil
recommendations.reason: A simple peppery salad to go with the meatballs.
recommendations.quote: Rocket salad with some of that Parmesan and perhaps a nice balsamic, nice olive oil.
recommendations.speaker: Derren Brown

recommendations.item: Brunello di Montalcino, a glass and a half
recommendations.reason: His favourite red, first loved on holiday in Tuscany; he keeps to a glass and a half so he can still have a Martini.
recommendations.quote: Maybe a Brunello di Montalcino which is probably my favourite red.
recommendations.speaker: Derren Brown

recommendations.item: Tommy's Margarita as a welcome drink
recommendations.reason: Tequila, lime and agave with no triple sec, which he says leaves no bad hangover; he learned to love tequila through his friend Cleo Rocos.
recommendations.quote: it is just tequila, a good 100% agave tequila, not the horrible stuff, and, lime and agave.
recommendations.speaker: Derren Brown

recommendations.item: Extra dry vodka Martini with a twist (Konik's Tail)
recommendations.reason: His closing drink, painfully dry, as a digestif.
recommendations.quote: an extra dry, painfully brutally dry vodka Martini.
recommendations.speaker: Derren Brown

recommendations.item: Apple crumble with oats, hot custard
recommendations.reason: Pure comfort food, with oats like his mum makes it, though he'd happily have vanilla ice cream with chocolate Swiss roll too.
recommendations.quote: it's all comfort food for me.
recommendations.speaker: Derren Brown

recommendations.item: Salted caramel truffle
recommendations.reason: At home he savours one from a big pot on the mantelpiece after dinner; he has it after the crumble in the dream meal.
recommendations.quote: a single Charbonnel et Walker salted caramel truffle.
recommendations.speaker: Derren Brown

recommendations.item: Greengrocer
recommendations.reason: Derren calls it the world's greatest greengrocer.
recommendations.quote: Reg the Veg which is the world's greatest greengrocers.
recommendations.speaker: Derren Brown

episodes.title: Ep 273: Rose Matafeo (Christmas Special)
episodes.summary: In a Christmas episode, Rose Matafeo panics her way to still water, poppadoms with chutney and raita, a Japanese wax-food demonstration as a starter, all-you-can-eat yum cha, a New Zealand summer Christmas dinner, a potato trolley, a Coke 'spider' and every Australian Women's Weekly kids' cake.

recommendations.item: Still water, slightly above room temperature
recommendations.reason: Still because sparkling makes her burpy and reminds her of Willy Wonka's fizzy lifting drink, slightly warmer than cold.
recommendations.quote: I'm a big fan of still. You know, sparkling makes me burpy.
recommendations.speaker: Rose Matafeo

recommendations.item: Poppadoms with mango chutney and raita piled on top
recommendations.reason: She prefers crunchy, salty poppadoms to bread and layers mango chutney then raita rather than dipping.
recommendations.quote: the crunch, the taste, the salt, the volume, the amount you can eat.
recommendations.speaker: Rose Matafeo

recommendations.item: A craftsman making a wax food replica of a lettuce (Japanese fake food)
recommendations.reason: She does not believe in starters, so asks for a Japanese food-model maker to build and slice a wax lettuce while a crowd applauds.
recommendations.quote: I choose a Japanese wax figure of food.
recommendations.speaker: Rose Matafeo

recommendations.item: All-you-can-eat yum cha with trolleys (prawn dumplings, shumai, soup dumplings, chicken feet, egg tarts)
recommendations.reason: She loves the variety, speed and unknown prices of trolley-service yum cha, a big thing in New Zealand, with small bites of everything.
recommendations.quote: I like eating food having lots of different options... yum cha's perfect because it's small bits of every single delicious thing.
recommendations.speaker: Rose Matafeo

recommendations.item: New Zealand summer Christmas dinner: glazed ham, lamb, salads, chop suey, taro, roast potatoes, four-flavour jelly, marinated fish
recommendations.reason: Her family Christmas is a southern-hemisphere smorgasbord, with her nan's raw fish in cream and Rose's jellies.
recommendations.quote: it's summer. We're talking summer salads... ham... chop suey and taro, which is a Samoan food, which my dad would make.
recommendations.speaker: Rose Matafeo

recommendations.item: Potato trolley: dauphinoise, chips, mash, patatas bravas, roast potatoes, with all the sauces
recommendations.reason: She gravitates to potatoes in every form, with unlimited aioli, bearnaise and soy and vinegar.
recommendations.quote: Potatoes every way... This is the side trolley of potatoes.
recommendations.speaker: Rose Matafeo

recommendations.item: Spider (Coke float)
recommendations.reason: A novelty non-alcoholic Coke with ice cream, as in New Zealand kids' parties, rather than getting drunk.
recommendations.quote: Coke with ice cream in it... We call that a spider in New Zealand.
recommendations.speaker: Rose Matafeo

recommendations.item: Every cake from the Australian Woman's Weekly children's cake book (train cake, pool cake, Dolly Varden), coconut base
recommendations.reason: Nostalgic novelty kids' birthday cakes from the 90s cookbook, like the Dolly Varden her nan made her aged five.
recommendations.quote: every mother in the '90s had it, and you would get a cake from that recipe book.
recommendations.speaker: Rose Matafeo

recommendations.item: Coconut cake
recommendations.reason: Rose says the coconut cake there is one of her favourite cakes on earth; the bakery made a wedding cake for Meghan Markle.
recommendations.quote: I think a coconut cake from Violet Bakery is one of my favourite cakes on earth.
recommendations.speaker: Rose Matafeo

recommendations.item: Spicy soup dumplings
recommendations.reason: She loves its soup dumplings, which come warm enough to eat whole, and its spicy ones right now; Ed adds a shout out.
recommendations.quote: certain ones like Dumpling Legend, they come a little bit not burning hot, so you can put the whole thing in.
recommendations.speaker: Rose Matafeo

recommendations.item: Tripe and hotpot dishes
recommendations.reason: Rose and Ed ate good tripe there together; Ed says they work hard to take out the farmyard flavour.
recommendations.quote: tripe at Mountain, the restaurant Mountain, that we've been to together. That tripe was really good.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Confit potatoes
recommendations.reason: Ed names its confit potatoes, fried slices of layered potato, as his number one potato dish.
recommendations.quote: The confit potatoes at The Quality Chop House... So good, so good.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Poutine, chicken salad cheese toastie, root beer float
recommendations.reason: Rose praises its root beer float, chicken salad toastie, lemon sole and steak; Ed liked the pastrami.
recommendations.quote: Federal Deli does a good root beer float, which is delicious.
recommendations.speaker: Rose Matafeo

recommendations.item: Fish sliders and oysters
recommendations.reason: Rose and Ed rave about the fish sliders at this Auckland restaurant next to Federal Delicatessen.
recommendations.quote: Fish sliders, they are so good.
recommendations.speaker: Rose Matafeo

recommendations.item: Aubergine parm sandwich
recommendations.reason: Rose and Ed both loved the aubergine parmigiana sandwich; venue name uncertain as transcribed.
recommendations.quote: Yes, the aubergine parm sandwich, that was so good.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Custard slice
recommendations.reason: Rose once flew a frozen custard slice from there all the way to London, calling it the most delicious custard slice ever.
recommendations.quote: Denheath's custard slice from Christchurch. It's the most delicious custard slice ever.
recommendations.speaker: Rose Matafeo

recommendations.item: Coke floats
recommendations.reason: Rose says it serves good Coke floats.
recommendations.quote: Coke floats at the City Diner in Edinburgh. City Restaurant, sorry. Good coke floats.
recommendations.speaker: Rose Matafeo

episodes.title: Ep 274: Andy Zaltzman (Christmas Special)
episodes.summary: Cricket stats man Andy Zaltzman's Christmas menu: sparkling water, poppadoms with every chutney, Kastoori-style dahi puri, his wife's venison Wellington, a whole mozzarella, rare leaf tea, and Giolitti pistachio gelato plus a Chez Bruce cheese trolley.

recommendations.item: Sparkling water
recommendations.reason: He argues bubbles capture carbon dioxide, so sparkling is the environmentally responsible choice.
recommendations.quote: I've got to go for sparkling because, you know, I'm a big fan of the environment.
recommendations.speaker: Andy Zaltzman

recommendations.item: Poppadoms (about two and a half) with mango chutney, sweet plum chutney, raw onion, hot pickle and yoghurt 'grasshopper sauce'
recommendations.reason: Crunchy and not too filling, with a full range of chutney options; he follows a 'two X plus two' rule for how many to order.
recommendations.quote: I think I'd go with poppadoms because you don't want to fill up.
recommendations.speaker: Andy Zaltzman

recommendations.item: Dahi puri (six)
recommendations.reason: He first had dahi puri at this South Indian vegetarian restaurant in Tooting, which has since closed. He calls it the perfect mouthful, with crunch, sharp, sweet and sour in one bite.
recommendations.quote: I don't think it's possible in this universe, or any other universe, to come up with a better mouthful than a Dahi puri.
recommendations.speaker: Andy Zaltzman

recommendations.item: Venison Wellington
recommendations.reason: His wife made it for a New Year's Eve dinner party in 2008, wrapped in wild mushroom and chicken liver pate, Parma ham and pastry with a fruity sauce.
recommendations.quote: And it was absolutely spectacular.
recommendations.speaker: Andy Zaltzman

recommendations.item: Christmas 2021 five-course lunch (charcuterie, prawn and lobster risotto, Japanese salmon, chocolate and passion fruit mousse, cheese)
recommendations.reason: He cooked it himself in a hotel apartment while in Australia for the cricket, shopping at the market for ingredients.
recommendations.quote: I went up to the Victoria market in Melbourne, which you've probably both been-, amazing market.
recommendations.speaker: Andy Zaltzman

recommendations.item: Whole mozzarella with tomatoes and olive oil (served on a picture of David Gower's cover drive)
recommendations.venue: Agriturismo attached to a buffalo farm, Italy (unnamed)
recommendations.reason: He remembers eating pure, gloopy fresh mozzarella at an Italian farm stay with his wife. He picked it over pulpo a la gallega from Pontevedra in Galicia.
recommendations.quote: a good mozzarella is, I think, one of the purest delights.
recommendations.speaker: Andy Zaltzman

recommendations.item: Opium Hill blue tea (Thai oolong), with Muddy Waters' Folk Singer
recommendations.reason: He bought Opium Hill at this Paris tea shop and says it affects him deeply, ideally drunk at a cricket tea interval. He also praised honey hong cha black tea from Imperial Teas of Lincoln.
recommendations.quote: that is like drinking liquefied truth.
recommendations.speaker: Andy Zaltzman

recommendations.item: Leaf tea (honey hong cha and others)
recommendations.reason: His chosen supplier of top-quality leaf tea, with a great website and essays on each tea.
recommendations.quote: my chosen supplier of class-A tea is Imperial Teas in Lincoln.
recommendations.speaker: Andy Zaltzman

recommendations.item: Pistachio ice cream in a cup (with a fruit sorbet)
recommendations.reason: A family memory of eating ice cream beside the Pantheon; he thinks pistachio is the true test of an ice cream shop.
recommendations.quote: I think a good test of a pistachio ice cream is a good test of an ice cream shop.
recommendations.speaker: Andy Zaltzman

recommendations.item: Vanilla ice cream with Pedro Ximenez sherry
recommendations.reason: One of the best ice creams he ever had, simple but divine; he was not certain of the restaurant.
recommendations.quote: vanilla ice cream at a restaurant in London, possibly Andrew Edmonds? And it just had Pedro Ximinez sherry poured on the top
recommendations.speaker: Andy Zaltzman

recommendations.item: Cheese trolley
recommendations.reason: They celebrated finding out his wife was pregnant there, and he happily gorged on unpasteurised cheeses she could not eat.
recommendations.quote: One of my favourite ever cheese boards was in the Wandsworth restaurant Chez Bruce.
recommendations.speaker: Andy Zaltzman

episodes.title: Ep 275: Harris Dickinson
episodes.summary: Harris Dickinson picks San Pellegrino, Guinness bread from Cafe Cecilia, a ham-and-marmalade bread starter from Whyte's, short rib and sausage ragu with pappardelle inspired by his dad's spag bol, Caesar salad with gherkins, tea plus a New York whisky sour, and a Basque cheesecake.

recommendations.item: San Pellegrino sparkling water
recommendations.reason: He likes sparkling water as a treat; a film-job driver used to leave him a bottle each day.
recommendations.quote: I do like sparkling, yes, that's my bag.
recommendations.speaker: Harris Dickinson

recommendations.item: Guinness bread with whipped butter
recommendations.reason: Dense, dark Guinness bread with a generous knob of soft whipped butter; James notes the restaurant also makes ice cream from it.
recommendations.quote: Guinness bread with lots of butter, soft butter, you know. Whipped butter.
recommendations.speaker: Harris Dickinson

recommendations.item: Bread, honey roast ham, marmalade and warm butter
recommendations.reason: A hearty, leftovers-style Christmas starter in an open-kitchen restaurant that reminded him of family Christmas ham.
recommendations.quote: It was bread, honey roast ham, marmalade and butter... It reminded me of, like, leftovers.
recommendations.speaker: Harris Dickinson

recommendations.item: Short rib and sausage ragu with pappardelle
recommendations.reason: Based on his dad's ad hoc spag bol with German-style sausage and red wine, upgraded with slow-cooked short rib, pappardelle and lots of Parmesan.
recommendations.quote: I do that like a short rib ragu with that sausage, and then I'll do it with a nice pappardelle.
recommendations.speaker: Harris Dickinson

recommendations.item: Caesar salad (anchovies in the dressing only) with a jar of gherkins
recommendations.reason: A cheesy, creamy green side to balance the pasta, plus gherkins to nibble as a palate cleanser.
recommendations.quote: I don't really want the anchovies on top for this plate. I don't mind them in the sauce.
recommendations.speaker: Harris Dickinson

recommendations.item: Breakfast tea with one sugar or honey
recommendations.reason: Tea was the answer to every occasion in the house he grew up in.
recommendations.quote: I grew up in a household where tea was very important for any occasion
recommendations.speaker: Harris Dickinson

recommendations.item: Whisky sour
recommendations.reason: Excellent whisky sours at a low-lit New York piano bar he refuses to name because the staff were snobbish about his clothes.
recommendations.quote: the drinks were wonderful, I will say they were lovely, whisky sour, amaretto sour, beautiful.
recommendations.speaker: Harris Dickinson

recommendations.item: Basque cheesecake
recommendations.reason: He had a slice of this burnt Basque cheesecake at a Japanese patisserie after dim sum and brought a whole one to the studio; he likes cheesecake plain, without Oreo or KitKat.
recommendations.quote: I love just a standard cheesecake... without all of the frills
recommendations.speaker: Harris Dickinson

recommendations.item: Roast dinner
recommendations.reason: A good-sized roast that leaves you feeling decent rather than stuffed.
recommendations.quote: There's a good roast at the Marksman in Hackney.
recommendations.speaker: Harris Dickinson

recommendations.item: Artichoke Caesar salad
recommendations.reason: James orders their Caesar variant with artichokes and crispy kale.
recommendations.quote: At Mildred's I get the artichoke one. It's got these artichokes in it, Caesar salad.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

episodes.title: Ep 276: Emily Campbell
episodes.summary: Olympic weightlifter Emily Campbell picks double-strength orange and pineapple squash, warm ciabatta and focaccia with butter, honey-sriracha chicken strips and wings, a seafood boil, baked Caribbean-style mac and cheese, a mango daiquiri mocktail and New York cheesecake with berry compote.

recommendations.item: Orange and pineapple squash, double strength
recommendations.reason: Finds water boring and has drunk very sweet squash all her life.
recommendations.quote: I'd rather drink squash then drink water. Water's just boring, isn't it? It's just there for hydration.
recommendations.speaker: Emily Campbell

recommendations.item: Warm ciabatta and focaccia basket with butter
recommendations.reason: Prefers bread and butter to bread and oil, as long as it is warm so the butter melts straight in.
recommendations.quote: it's got to be warm, warm, put the butter on straight away, it melts
recommendations.speaker: Emily Campbell

recommendations.item: Buttermilk-breaded chicken strips and wings in honey and sriracha, with garlic dip
recommendations.reason: Her own home recipe: fried, well seasoned and tossed in a hot butter, sriracha and honey sauce, inspired by mango habanero wings she had in America.
recommendations.quote: it's something I make at home all the time
recommendations.speaker: Emily Campbell

recommendations.item: Seafood boil with lobster, crab, king prawns, mussels, potatoes, eggs and corn, with garlic butter
recommendations.reason: Loves messy seafood to crack open with a bib on and garlic butter for dipping.
recommendations.quote: Proper messy but it just tastes so good. Loads of, like, garlic butter to dip your lobster and your crab
recommendations.speaker: Emily Campbell

recommendations.item: Baked Caribbean-style mac and cheese
recommendations.reason: Her own recipe: set like a pie with breadcrumbs, a hot sauce in a properly made roux cheese sauce.
recommendations.quote: in the Caribbean we have it like a pie, essentially. Good breadcrumbs on the top, nice melt
recommendations.speaker: Emily Campbell

recommendations.item: Mango daiquiri mocktail
recommendations.reason: She rarely drinks alcohol and loves fruity tropical mocktails; she drank a lot of mango daiquiris in Jamaica.
recommendations.quote: Mango daiquiri's a strong one, I was drinking that in Jamaica quite a lot.
recommendations.speaker: Emily Campbell

recommendations.item: New York cheesecake with berry compote and ice cream
recommendations.reason: Has a sweet tooth but dislikes chocolate; wants plain cheesecake with fresh strawberry or raspberry compote.
recommendations.quote: I think my dessert would be a cheesecake. So, plain and simple, New York cheesecake with fresh fruit or fresh compote.
recommendations.speaker: Emily Campbell

recommendations.item: Home seafood boil kits and pop-ups
recommendations.reason: Ed recommends his friend Tom's company that delivers seafood boil kits with instructions and does pop-ups.
recommendations.quote: My friend Tom does seafood boils for delivery and then it has, like, the instructions... Decatur is the name of the company.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Caribbean hot sauce
recommendations.venue: Nottingham Christmas Market hot sauce stall (unnamed)
recommendations.reason: A sweet and spicy Caribbean hot sauce from a stall she loves for her mac and cheese; she wants the seller to come back.
recommendations.quote: it's a Caribbean hot sauce. But it's got a little bit sweet, bit of spicy and it's really nice. It really compliments the mac and cheese well.
recommendations.speaker: Emily Campbell

episodes.title: Ep 277: Mo Gilligan
episodes.summary: Mo picks sparkling water, bread with salted butter, proper sushi, his mum's Caribbean curry chicken and rice, Japanese ramen, homemade-style Sarsaparilla, and Bagel King's 90% crumble apple crumble with hot custard.

recommendations.item: Sparkling water
recommendations.reason: He loves it with a meal because it cleans the palate and feels fancy, despite teasing from friends who prefer still.
recommendations.quote: It feels like it cleans my palette... when you sit down, you feel fancy.
recommendations.speaker: Mo Gilligan

recommendations.item: Bread with olive oil, salted butter and Pizza Express-style garlic butter dough balls
recommendations.reason: He enjoys the ritual of a bread basket and rates Pizza Express dough balls with garlic butter; any bread but not rye.
recommendations.quote: If you ever go to Pizza Express they have this garlic butter. So, you get these little dough balls... Sensational man.
recommendations.speaker: Mo Gilligan

recommendations.item: Real sushi (nigiri and sashimi: yellowtail, fatty tuna, salmon)
recommendations.reason: Learning proper sushi made him feel he'd 'made it'; Roka is a favourite where he lets the chef choose, and the best was in Japan.
recommendations.quote: Like, I go to Roka. That's one of my favourites... 'What's the chef's selection of the six?' ... 'Surprise me.'
recommendations.speaker: Mo Gilligan

recommendations.item: His mum's slow-cooked curry chicken and rice with coleslaw
recommendations.reason: The taste of his childhood: Caribbean curry chicken cooked down in a Dutchie pot, served with basmati and coleslaw, instantly recognisable as his mum's.
recommendations.quote: you could blindfold me and give me 50 dishes and I would always spot my mum's one out of it because the taste is... trade-marked by my mum.
recommendations.speaker: Mo Gilligan

recommendations.item: Ramen from Japan
recommendations.reason: A ramen shop on his Japan trip became his go-to; he loves the egg, pork, noodles and the slurp, and seeks out ramen whenever he travels.
recommendations.quote: ramen is, like, it's become one of my, kind of, go-to staples, like, when I'm travelling now.
recommendations.speaker: Mo Gilligan

recommendations.item: Sarsaparilla (made up in a jug with ice and lemon)
recommendations.reason: A sweet Caribbean-style cordial he mixes in a jug, best with Sunday chicken and rice; sold in corner shops and world-food aisles. He also loves lychee mojitos and pornstar martinis.
recommendations.quote: Sarsaparilla, top tier drink, man.
recommendations.speaker: Mo Gilligan

recommendations.item: Apple crumble (90% crumble) with hot custard
recommendations.reason: The 24/7 post-rave hangout of his youth, serving hot crumble and custard at 4am alongside chicken escalope in cocoa bread.
recommendations.quote: Bagel King is open 24/7... you can get cake and custard at this time. They make it for you hot.
recommendations.speaker: Mo Gilligan

recommendations.item: Lychee mojito
recommendations.reason: He fell for the lychee mojito at Soho House and calls it his favourite cocktail.
recommendations.quote: They do a lychee mojito. Sensational, man.
recommendations.speaker: Mo Gilligan

recommendations.item: Honey pepper chicken, egg fried rice and lychees
recommendations.reason: A Chinese restaurant where he and fellow young comics went after The Sunday Show, loving the unique honey pepper chicken and bowl of lychees.
recommendations.quote: they did this honey pepper chicken, which I have never got anywhere else... as a dessert, they would do a bowl of lychees.
recommendations.speaker: Mo Gilligan

episodes.title: Ep 278: John Kearns (Tasting Menu)
episodes.summary: Tasting-menu format: John Kearns eats Miriam Margolyes' dream menu - cucumber water, soda/brown bread, Panzer's chopped liver, matzo ball soup, her mum's fried plaice with roast potatoes, then coffee and dark chocolate ice cream from Nardulli.

recommendations.item: Still water with cucumber or lemon
recommendations.reason: Miriam's opening water; John chose cucumber, picturing a big jug like his mum made in summer.
recommendations.quote: it feels posh... like a big plastic jug.
recommendations.speaker: John Kearns

recommendations.item: Heavy sourdough or brown bread (soda bread)
recommendations.reason: Miriam's bread with no butter; John fondly recalled his Irish nan's soda bread.
recommendations.quote: My nan used to make... soda bread.
recommendations.speaker: John Kearns

recommendations.item: Chopped liver with Ikea round crispbread
recommendations.reason: Miriam's starter of chopped liver from a North London Jewish deli, paired by Ed with black coffee; John likes a pate-like liver.
recommendations.quote: Like a chicken liver pate, sounds lovely.
recommendations.speaker: John Kearns

recommendations.item: Chicken soup with matzo balls, carrot, celery and onion
recommendations.reason: Miriam's added soup course, a fortifying, very salty chicken soup with matzo dumplings.
recommendations.quote: a fortifying bowl of lovely chicken soup with some of those balls.
recommendations.speaker: John Kearns

recommendations.item: Mummy's fried plaice with olive oil and matzo meal
recommendations.reason: Miriam's mother's simple fried flat fish coated in matzo meal and olive oil.
recommendations.quote: Miriam Margolyes' mummy's fried plaice
recommendations.speaker: John Kearns

recommendations.item: Roast potatoes, small frozen peas, braised celery and braised carrots
recommendations.reason: Miriam's homely sides; John enjoyed discussing roast potato technique.
recommendations.quote: It's very comforting though, isn't it. It's very homely.
recommendations.speaker: John Kearns

recommendations.item: Green salad (romaine, endive, rocket) with French dressing
recommendations.reason: Added salad course; John said he wouldn't eat it alongside hot roast potatoes.
recommendations.quote: I'm not eating the salad.
recommendations.speaker: John Kearns

recommendations.item: Virgin Mary with plenty of Worcestershire sauce, lemon and celery
recommendations.reason: Miriam's alcohol-free dream drink; John liked the Worcester sauce but wanted ice.
recommendations.quote: Worcester sauce, great, plenty, yes, I love that.
recommendations.speaker: John Kearns

recommendations.item: Coffee and dark chocolate ice cream
recommendations.reason: Miriam's favourite dessert in the world: a scoop each of coffee and dark chocolate from Nardulli.
recommendations.quote: Miriam Margolyes says it's the best ice-cream.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

episodes.title: Ep 279: Stephen Graham
episodes.summary: Stephen Graham's menu mixes New York memories and Liverpool childhood: Rovaniemi tap water, poppadoms, a perfect Chinatown wonton soup, lobster with Auntie Vera's chips, Schofield's pineapple lemonade, and a Wolseley mille-feuille plus his nana's apple crumble.

recommendations.item: Still tap water from Rovaniemi, Finland
recommendations.reason: He and his wife were told at their tree-house hotel that the local tap water is the purest in the world, and he found it gorgeous.
recommendations.quote: She said, 'Rovaniemi has the most purest water in the world'... I had a sip, and I was like, 'Oh, Hannah, she's right'
recommendations.speaker: Stephen Graham

recommendations.item: Poppadoms
recommendations.reason: Chose poppadoms over bread with no elaboration.
recommendations.quote: I'll have poppadoms, please.
recommendations.speaker: Stephen Graham

recommendations.item: Wonton soup
recommendations.venue: Chinese restaurant up some stairs in Chinatown, New York (name forgotten)
recommendations.reason: He found the perfect wonton soup while filming Boardwalk Empire; he and his mum judged Chinese restaurants by their wonton soup, and this was the Holy Grail with generously filled wontons, bok choy and spring onion.
recommendations.quote: it was like I'd found the Holy Grail. It was this gorgeous bowl... the dumplings, just floating in it just right.
recommendations.speaker: Stephen Graham

recommendations.item: Lobster boiled with potatoes, with a squeeze of lemon
recommendations.venue: Fish market at Chelsea Harbour, New York
recommendations.reason: Memory of buying huge lobsters at a New York fish market with his mate Buck and cooking them in a big pot.
recommendations.quote: we bought lobsters... two big, massive lobsters, huge lobsters... Lobster's my favourite, it's delicious.
recommendations.speaker: Stephen Graham

recommendations.item: Auntie Vera's chips, long-stem broccoli with chilli and parmesan, and garlic spinach
recommendations.reason: His auntie's chip-pan chips were thick, crispy and soft in the middle, better than any chippy; plus greens alongside the lobster.
recommendations.quote: Better than chippy chips... They were thick, crispy, crunchy, but dead soft in the middle. They were the perfect chip.
recommendations.speaker: Stephen Graham

recommendations.item: Schofield's pineapple lemonade
recommendations.reason: Childhood summers grabbing bright yellow pineapple lemo from his nana's fridge after the weekly lemo van delivery.
recommendations.quote: it was Schofield's lemonade, and it was the pineapple flavour.
recommendations.speaker: Stephen Graham

recommendations.item: Mille-feuille
recommendations.reason: The mille-feuille at The Wolseley is his poncy favourite, with crisp puff pastry and cream.
recommendations.quote: it's in the Wolseley which is a really lovely establishment... it is a mille-feuille... it's absolutely delicious.
recommendations.speaker: Stephen Graham

recommendations.item: Nana's apple crumble with homemade custard
recommendations.reason: Thick crumble, soft apples and always homemade custard, tied up with memories of Sundays in his nana's kitchen.
recommendations.quote: her apple crumble was unbelievable. Absolutely unbelievable... the custard was always, always home-made.
recommendations.speaker: Stephen Graham

episodes.title: Ep 280: Robert De Niro
episodes.summary: Robert De Niro has no fixed favourites, so the hosts pick for him: still water, bread, Nobu's miso black cod, a wagyu Wellington inspired by Ron Gastrobar, duck brains, crickets and ants as sides, a dry gin Martini with cucumber, and pistachio ice cream, River Cafe lemon tart and cheese.

recommendations.item: Still water
recommendations.reason: He has become more of a still-water drinker.
recommendations.quote: Sparkling is good too but I've, sort of, been more a still guy these days.
recommendations.speaker: Robert De Niro

recommendations.item: Bread (whatever is put in front of him)
recommendations.reason: He is easygoing and likes whatever is served as long as it is good.
recommendations.quote: I'm easy. I like whatever they put in front of me, as long as it's good.
recommendations.speaker: Robert De Niro

recommendations.item: Miso black cod
recommendations.reason: Ed suggests the famous Nobu dish, and De Niro, who co-founded Nobu after being introduced to Matsuhisa, approves; he says anything at Nobu is always great.
recommendations.quote: anything that Nobu has is always great.
recommendations.speaker: Robert De Niro

recommendations.item: Wagyu beef Wellington
recommendations.reason: James's own dream main, a perfectly cooked beef Wellington with crisp pastry and subtle gravy, upgraded to wagyu for De Niro, who says it sounds good.
recommendations.quote: Sounds good. Wagyu wellington.
recommendations.speaker: Robert De Niro

recommendations.item: Duck brains (in the original skull), crickets and ants
recommendations.reason: He is happy to try exotic food if it is good and prepared well, so the hosts add adventurous sides.
recommendations.quote: If it's good, okay. Depends if it's good and how it's prepared.
recommendations.speaker: Robert De Niro

recommendations.item: Dry gin Martini with cucumber, no vermouth, plus good wine
recommendations.reason: He likes one Martini at the beginning of a meal and good red or white wine.
recommendations.quote: Dry, cucumber. That's it. No Vermouth.
recommendations.speaker: Robert De Niro

recommendations.item: Lemon tart
recommendations.reason: Ed and James propose the River Cafe's lemon tart alongside pistachio ice cream and a cheeseboard; De Niro agrees if it is a restaurant's signature.
recommendations.quote: The restaurant is known for this lemon tart. Okay.
recommendations.speaker: Robert De Niro

recommendations.item: Pistachio ice cream and cheeseboard
recommendations.reason: He likes pistachio ice cream and often has cheese rather than a full dessert.
recommendations.quote: I like pistachio.
recommendations.speaker: Robert De Niro

recommendations.item: Hotel restaurant food
recommendations.reason: When in London for press he eats where he stays and says whatever they have is good.
recommendations.quote: Just whatever they have is all good.
recommendations.speaker: Robert De Niro

recommendations.item: Ant snacks and test kitchen tasting
recommendations.reason: Ed praises the Mexican chef Santiago Lastra, whose test kitchen served them dry-roasted ants as an opening snack.
recommendations.quote: a brilliant Mexican chef who's got a restaurant in London, he's called Santiago Lastra.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

episodes.title: Ep 281: David Tennant
episodes.summary: David Tennant chooses still water with ice and Dr Pepper on tap, all the bread with butter, escargot, a fancy chef's-choice haggis with neeps and tatties, his wife's roasted new potatoes, a bottle of Travaglini Gattinara, and butterscotch Angel Delight with chopped Mars bar.

recommendations.item: Still water with ice, plus Dr Pepper on tap (with a slice)
recommendations.reason: He sees no point in sparkling water and would rather have still; Dr Pepper is his favourite fizzy pop.
recommendations.quote: I don't understand the point of sparkling water... when I have a fizzy liquid in my mouth, I'm wanting it to taste like some sort of fizzy pop.
recommendations.speaker: David Tennant

recommendations.item: All the breads, all the time, warm with lashings of butter
recommendations.reason: He prefers the variety of bread to poppadoms, especially a warm buttered roll or baguette section that oozes when pulled apart.
recommendations.quote: a slightly warmed bread with lashings of butter just melting in the middle. Ah, come on.
recommendations.speaker: David Tennant

recommendations.item: Escargot in garlic butter
recommendations.reason: He loves the ceremony of the snail plate and tiny fork, and mopping up the garlic butter with bread.
recommendations.quote: I love the ceremony of it. I mean, basically, it's just a vessel for eating garlic butter isn't it?
recommendations.speaker: David Tennant

recommendations.item: Fancy haggis dish in whisky cream sauce with neeps and tatties, chef's choice (Nick Nairn)
recommendations.reason: As a proud Scot he loves haggis and enjoys how modern restaurants now treat it as a delicacy, with the chef surprising him.
recommendations.quote: Some sort of high end haggis recreation... something maybe in some sort of whisky cream sauce
recommendations.speaker: David Tennant

recommendations.item: Roasted new potatoes with salt, chilli and oil
recommendations.reason: A post-Christmas leftovers experiment by his wife that he calls the most extraordinary thing he has eaten, with crispy salty skins.
recommendations.quote: my wife took some new potatoes and covered them in salt and a little bit of chilli... And they were just about the most extraordinary thing I've ever eaten.
recommendations.speaker: David Tennant

recommendations.item: Bottle of Travaglini Gattinara (red wine)
recommendations.reason: Recommended by Stanley Tucci; very drinkable, light and dry.
recommendations.quote: It's very drinkable, very easy, very light, very dry. Beautiful.
recommendations.speaker: David Tennant

recommendations.item: Butterscotch Angel Delight with chopped Mars bar mixed in (or Celebrations)
recommendations.reason: A nostalgic childhood treat his mum made; finding a chunk of Mars bar in each spoonful was a special surprise.
recommendations.quote: This was our dessert of choice as children... it was a very special day if we had the Angel Delight, butterscotch Angel Delight with Mars bar mixed through it.
recommendations.speaker: David Tennant

episodes.title: Ep 282: Ellie Taylor
episodes.summary: Ellie Taylor starts with three pre-dinner drinks at The Langham bar, then has warm baguette, jamon croquetas from Jose, rigatoni with her husband's Phil's special sauce, Kellogg's Start cereal, a Shelly Beach chocolate milkshake, tiramisu, Betty Crocker icing and Yorkshire Biscuit Tea.

recommendations.item: Double vodka and Diet Coke, Robinsons Fruit and Barley (orange) and a Kir Royale (pre-dinner drinks)
recommendations.reason: Her ideal start is a dark, fancy hotel bar seat with a heavy crystal glass; she picked The Langham because it is where she most recently drank.
recommendations.quote: do you know the bar at The Langham, the fancy hotel in London? It's very dark.
recommendations.speaker: Ellie Taylor

recommendations.item: Sparkling water (topped up with barley water)
recommendations.reason: Sparkling feels like an occasion when she is eating with someone; she would normally just have tap alone.
recommendations.quote: I feel like sparkling is more of an occasion.
recommendations.speaker: Ellie Taylor

recommendations.item: Warm French baguette with very salty butter, plus olive oil and balsamic
recommendations.reason: She wants warm baguette, and she insists on biting the end off on the way home.
recommendations.quote: I want some nice, like, French bread. I want it to be warm and I want a lot of salty, salty butter.
recommendations.speaker: Ellie Taylor

recommendations.item: Jamon croquetas with aioli, plus jamon and Comte
recommendations.reason: Her former local on Bermondsey Street and her favourite restaurant in London, small and no-reservations; she wants its croquetas and jamon with a generous sauce ratio.
recommendations.quote: José was our little local that we would go to too much and I love it. And it's my favourite restaurant in London
recommendations.speaker: Ellie Taylor

recommendations.item: Potato skins with cheese and ham
recommendations.reason: A childhood birthday treat she remembers fondly, and wants as part of her shared starters.
recommendations.quote: I have lovely memories as a kid of going to TGI Friday's for, like, a birthday or something, and you'd get the potato skins with cheese and ham in.
recommendations.speaker: Ellie Taylor

recommendations.item: Big fat rigatoni with Phil's special sauce
recommendations.reason: Her husband Phil's first pasta sauce for her, a simple tomato and veg sauce with lots of parmesan; she thinks restaurant pasta is rarely better than home-made.
recommendations.quote: it's so tasty, it's so delicious with loads and loads of parmesan on top.
recommendations.speaker: Ellie Taylor

recommendations.item: Kellogg's Start cereal, dry, with cold whole milk on the side
recommendations.reason: Her all-time favourite discontinued cereal, malty honeycomb pieces, nibbled as a bridge between main and dessert.
recommendations.quote: it was malty and delicious
recommendations.speaker: Ellie Taylor

recommendations.item: Thick chocolate milkshake in a teddy-bear glass
recommendations.reason: A thick chocolate milkshake from her family's favourite beach spot in Sydney; kids' ones come in a teddy-bear glass.
recommendations.quote: their chocolate milkshakes are lovely. And the kids' ones come in a glass that's in the shape of a bear
recommendations.speaker: Ellie Taylor

recommendations.item: Tiramisu, and Betty Crocker icing by the pot
recommendations.reason: She orders tiramisu whenever it is on a menu, and has a guilty love of Betty Crocker icing eaten with a spoon.
recommendations.quote: Whenever there's tiramisu on a menu, I'll have it. It's my baked Alaska.
recommendations.speaker: Ellie Taylor

recommendations.item: Yorkshire Biscuit Tea
recommendations.reason: Biscuit-flavoured Yorkshire Tea that tastes malty and warming; she carries teabags in a Tupperware to restaurants.
recommendations.quote: It's like a Rich Tea's been dunked in it and let to, like, marinate.
recommendations.speaker: Ellie Taylor

recommendations.item: Starter and baked Alaska
recommendations.reason: James praises it as a quality restaurant that sends over a great starter and does a different baked Alaska each day.
recommendations.quote: the place is, like, quality and they had a baked Alaska.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Panettone tiramisu
recommendations.reason: James says their tiramisu made with panettone instead of sponge fingers tasted like Christmas pudding and was one of the best things he has eaten.
recommendations.quote: it tasted like Christmas pudding tiramisu. And it's one of the best things I've ever eaten.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Tiramisu at the end of a tasting menu
recommendations.reason: Ed calls its tiramisu, served after a long tasting menu, the best he has had.
recommendations.quote: It is genuinely the best tiramisu I've ever had.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

episodes.title: Ep 283: Antoni Porowski
episodes.summary: Antoni Porowski's menu starts with caviar and crisps, then poppadoms, Montreal mozzarella in carrozza and arancini, a monster charcuterie board, mac and cheese, shrubs and sticky toffee pudding.

recommendations.item: Caviar with Breton ridged crisps (chef's welcome)
recommendations.reason: A luxurious opener of cold caviar dipped with sturdy salty crisps, with crème fraîche and chives.
recommendations.quote: caviar is something that's so delicious, and luxe, and oceanic, and it's creamy when it's done right.
recommendations.speaker: Antoni Porowski

recommendations.item: Still tap water with lots of ice (New York tap water)
recommendations.reason: He prefers still water, ice-cold in the American style, and rates New York tap water.
recommendations.quote: In reality, ice. Ice cold.
recommendations.speaker: Antoni Porowski

recommendations.item: Poppadoms with all the dips
recommendations.reason: Poppadoms with every chutney, raita and tamarind water; he also loves Dishoom and Darjeeling Express when in the UK.
recommendations.quote: All the dips. Everything.
recommendations.speaker: Antoni Porowski

recommendations.item: Mozzarella in carrozza and arancini with marinara
recommendations.reason: A childhood hole-in-the-wall after Polish school on Saturdays: fried mozzarella sandwich in sweet marinara, now run by a Chinese team trained by the original Italian owners.
recommendations.quote: the food is fucking delicious.
recommendations.speaker: Antoni Porowski

recommendations.item: Dream cheese and charcuterie board (Ibérico ham, L'Etivaz, Vermont cheddar, Époisses, kabanos, cheese curds, olives)
recommendations.reason: An enormous board of cured meats, cheeses, nuts and honeycomb reflecting his Polish and Québécois roots.
recommendations.quote: I want my dream cheese and charcuterie board.
recommendations.speaker: Antoni Porowski

recommendations.item: Mac and cheese with ground beef
recommendations.reason: His lazy-Sunday vat of baked mac and cheese with crispy edges, a boxed-food treat he was denied growing up.
recommendations.quote: to make a vat of mac and cheese using all my favourite cheeses
recommendations.speaker: Antoni Porowski

recommendations.item: Blueberry-mint apple cider vinegar shrub (plus Shirley Temple and lemongrass soda)
recommendations.reason: Sour, refreshing homemade shrubs, with a Shirley Temple and a lemongrass soda also on the list.
recommendations.quote: I love a good shrub.
recommendations.speaker: Antoni Porowski

recommendations.item: Sticky toffee pudding with caramel sauce and melting vanilla ice cream
recommendations.reason: He loves the warm sponge soaked in sauce; the best he has had was via room service at The London hotel in LA.
recommendations.quote: Room service at a hotel in LA. I'm embarrassed to say, but it's really good.
recommendations.speaker: Antoni Porowski

recommendations.item: Pav bhaji, Britannia biryani and Black Daal
recommendations.reason: His go-to for Indian food in the UK; the Britannia Biryani and Black Daal have his heart.
recommendations.quote: The Britannia Biryani really has my heart, along with the Black Dall.
recommendations.speaker: Antoni Porowski

recommendations.item: Indian food
recommendations.reason: Asma Khan's restaurant he loves; advises going at lunch with friends to try many dishes.
recommendations.quote: Asma Khan is a national treasure who needs to be protected at all costs.
recommendations.speaker: Antoni Porowski

recommendations.item: Arancini with nduja and parmesan; anchovy bread
recommendations.reason: His favourite arancini in New York, dry and salty with spicy nduja; also mentions its anchovies on bread.
recommendations.quote: They have my favourite arancini in the city.
recommendations.speaker: Antoni Porowski

recommendations.item: Seeded crackers with pistachio whipped dip
recommendations.reason: A healthy snack of pistachio dip with seed-only crackers that he had the night before.
recommendations.quote: I was at Chiltern Firehouse last night, and they have this... pistachio whipped dip
recommendations.speaker: Antoni Porowski

recommendations.item: Green olives
recommendations.reason: He is obsessed with Nando's olives and says you can ask to take a tub away.
recommendations.quote: I'm obsessed with the Nando's olives.
recommendations.speaker: Antoni Porowski

recommendations.item: Lobster spaghetti
recommendations.reason: Ed and James ate here in Montreal; Antoni calls it an institution.
recommendations.quote: Joe Beef is, like, it's an institution at this point.
recommendations.speaker: Antoni Porowski

recommendations.item: Poutine
recommendations.reason: The Montreal restaurant Ed went to for a confit duck poutine, and Antoni recalls its foie gras version.
recommendations.quote: They put foie gras
recommendations.speaker: Antoni Porowski

recommendations.item: Hard-boiled egg pots
recommendations.reason: His travel go-to: two hard-boiled eggs with spinach, salt and pepper.
recommendations.quote: It's protein, it keeps you full for a long time. I support it.
recommendations.speaker: Antoni Porowski

episodes.title: Ep 284: Meera Sodha
episodes.summary: Chef Meera Sodha chooses sparkling water, tandoor naan from her local kebab shop, Mumbai panipuri, a Sri Lankan curry and rice feast from Samakanda, sliced tomatoes with a spiced tarka, a Naked and Famous cocktail, and a River Cafe lemon tart topped with Elio's meringue.

recommendations.item: Sparkling water without ice (plus a cup of tea)
recommendations.reason: She admits she has to force herself to drink water, so she opts for sparkling and, at home, mostly tea.
recommendations.quote: Sparkles, for sure. But without the ice.
recommendations.speaker: Meera Sodha

recommendations.item: Freshly made tandoor naan, 50p each, with garlic butter if you like
recommendations.reason: The naan from the tandoor at her local kebab shop is plump, charred, crisp underneath and bubbly on top; she and her husband keep a naan jar of coins to fund naan runs, and she chose naan over poppadoms after a bad experience in Goa.
recommendations.quote: this heavenly, plump, charred, semi-crispy on the bottom, bubbly on top, plied with garlic butter if you wish, 50p a pop.
recommendations.speaker: Meera Sodha

recommendations.item: Panipuri
recommendations.reason: Her dream starter is crisp semolina shells filled with chickpeas, sprouted mung and chutney, then flooded with herby pani. Her best ever was at this busy Mumbai stall where a man squirts the pani from a backpack.
recommendations.quote: it's, like, the ultimate high-risk, all-in one mouthful, and so it's really fun.
recommendations.speaker: Meera Sodha

recommendations.item: Sri Lankan curry and rice (young jackfruit curry with goraka, garlic curry, cashew curry, pol sambol, rice), eaten with naan
recommendations.reason: On their honeymoon, after a snake scare, local cooks made them a clay-pot curry and rice feast over cinnamon bark fires at this tea plantation and rainforest sanctuary; the most sensational meal she's ever had.
recommendations.quote: It's the most sensational meal I've ever had, it was so good
recommendations.speaker: Meera Sodha

recommendations.item: Sliced tomatoes with crunchy salt and a hot spiced tarka (coconut oil, mustard seeds, garlic, curry leaves, lime) to scoop with naan
recommendations.reason: After rich Sri Lankan food she craves something fresh and crunchy; tomatoes are her love language.
recommendations.quote: my love language is tomatoes.
recommendations.speaker: Meera Sodha

recommendations.item: Naked and Famous cocktail (equal parts mezcal, lime juice, Aperol and Yellow Chartreuse)
recommendations.reason: A smoky, sour, bright, complex drink she first got by accident when a bar served it instead of a non-alcoholic order; the best cocktail she's found.
recommendations.quote: I haven't had my mind blown like that by a drink ever, I don't think
recommendations.speaker: Meera Sodha

recommendations.item: Lemon meringue tart: River Cafe's lemon tart with Elio's whippy meringue on top
recommendations.reason: She grew up loving the lemon meringue tart at Elio's, a long-closed Italian in Barton-upon-Humber, and finds the River Cafe's zingy lemon tart with thin, flaky pastry the closest match, adding meringue for the dream version.
recommendations.quote: The closest I've come to it is The River Café, they do an astounding lemon tart, which is beauty and grace
recommendations.speaker: Meera Sodha

recommendations.item: Lemon meringue tart (nostalgic childhood restaurant)
recommendations.reason: The most exciting night of her teens was dinner at this old-school Italian near the Humber Bridge, with a tomato spaghetti shared with her sister then the lemon meringue tart.
recommendations.quote: the most exciting thing in the most exciting restaurant was the lemon meringue tart.
recommendations.speaker: Meera Sodha

recommendations.item: Seafood and fish curry
recommendations.reason: A Goan seafood restaurant recommended for the best fish curry; she calls the display of fresh seafood an Aladdin's cave, though she and Hugh had filled up on poppadoms in the bar beforehand.
recommendations.quote: this is, like, the Aladdin's cave of sea food, this stuff is so fresh it's practically jumped into the restaurant
recommendations.speaker: Meera Sodha

episodes.title: Ep 285: Sally Phillips
episodes.summary: Sally's whimsical foraging-themed menu: fizzy cucumber water in a water demon's skull, breads of the world, hay-smoked lettuce inspired by Ekstedt, beach-cooked fish, toddler-grown veg, a big girl cocktail and porcini chocolate fondant with wild strawberries.

recommendations.item: Fizzy cucumber water in the skull of a Japanese water demon
recommendations.reason: Sparkling because it feels posh; cucumber because carving your name on one placates a kappa water demon.
recommendations.quote: I will have fizzing cucumber water. From the skull of a Japanese water demon, please.
recommendations.speaker: Sally Phillips

recommendations.item: Breads of the world: Peshwari naan, Mother's Pride, Swedish orange-cardamom bread, hot cross bun
recommendations.reason: A basket of every kind of bread, from supermarket sliced white to Swedish citrus bread.
recommendations.quote: Breads of the world. Peshwari naan, obviously. The bounty of breads.
recommendations.speaker: Sally Phillips

recommendations.item: Hay-smoked grilled lettuce with smoked butter and edible flowers
recommendations.reason: Based on the most beautiful meal she has ever eaten at Ekstedt, a fire-cooking Swedish restaurant, imagined here as foraged food served outdoors with festoon lights.
recommendations.quote: It's the most beautiful meal I've ever eaten. ... things, sort of, arriving on bits of moss with tiny flowers.
recommendations.speaker: Sally Phillips

recommendations.item: Fresh fish cooked on a fire on a beach
recommendations.reason: Remembers sushi straight from the ocean, caught by her ex-husband and eaten within half an hour of its death; swapped in over a tagine.
recommendations.quote: Fresh fish on a beach, cooked in a fire.
recommendations.speaker: Sally Phillips

recommendations.item: Toddler veg (tiny home-dug carrots and potatoes)
recommendations.reason: Vegetables grown and dug up too early by toddlers are tiny and sweet, and bring back happy memories of her sons.
recommendations.quote: they're so sweet, these little things. And they taste delicious.
recommendations.speaker: Sally Phillips

recommendations.item: Big bucket of rainbow 'girl drink' cocktail
recommendations.reason: A colourful, tasty cocktail delivered by monkeys on the beach; she also recalls an espresso martini at a school PTA night.
recommendations.quote: an entirely new alcohol, made from a surprising, non-poisonous ingredient. It's delicious.
recommendations.speaker: Sally Phillips

recommendations.item: Hot chocolate and porcini fondant with wild strawberries
recommendations.reason: Based on porcini chocolate truffles from her mushroom supper club, served in Heidi's house on the Matterhorn.
recommendations.quote: dark chocolate truffles with porcini mushrooms, absolutely delicious.
recommendations.speaker: Sally Phillips

episodes.title: Ep 287: Santiago Lastra
episodes.summary: Chef Santiago Lastra imagines a fantasy feast of khachapuri with sea urchin, Baja lobster tacos, bonfire Patagonian lamb, Criollo avocado guacamole, endless mezcal and his teenage cheesecake.

recommendations.item: Half still, half sparkling water with a dash of sea buckthorn juice
recommendations.reason: Sparkling adds a pleasing acidity, so he mixes it with still and adds sour sea buckthorn juice.
recommendations.quote: I would do is to have still water with a little bit of sparkling water. Like, half and half, and a dash of Sea Buckthorn juice.
recommendations.speaker: Santiago Lastra

recommendations.item: Khachapuri topped with sea urchin
recommendations.reason: Georgian boat-shaped cheese bread with egg yolk and clarified butter, pimped up with sea urchin for extra creaminess and sea flavour.
recommendations.quote: if you haven't had a khachapuri, I recommend you to because it's life changing.
recommendations.speaker: Santiago Lastra

recommendations.item: Lobster tacos cooked on the beach
recommendations.reason: Whole lobsters fried in pork fat over open fire, served with flour tortillas, rice, beans and salsa: one of his best eating experiences.
recommendations.quote: One of the best experiences I ever had. ... you cry, basically. ... tears of joy.
recommendations.speaker: Santiago Lastra

recommendations.item: Aguachile with pink conch
recommendations.reason: A fresh seafood aguachile with the creamy melon-like flesh of pink conch alongside the lobster.
recommendations.quote: the flesh is pink. And the texture is like having, like the creamiest melon
recommendations.speaker: Santiago Lastra

recommendations.item: Whole lamb roasted on a Patagonian cross over a bonfire, with tacos or mash and purple cabbage
recommendations.reason: His favourite thing to cook: slow-roasted whole lamb with crispy skin and juicy meat pulled for tacos.
recommendations.quote: you press it and you hear the crackling, but also all the juices are dripping down.
recommendations.speaker: Santiago Lastra

recommendations.item: Criollo avocado guacamole with tostadas
recommendations.reason: A simple, dairy-free guacamole using the edible-skinned Criollo avocado, which tastes of liquorice.
recommendations.quote: a really beautiful guacamole. ... the skin tastes like liquorice.
recommendations.speaker: Santiago Lastra

recommendations.item: Mezcal (including Pechuga)
recommendations.reason: Mezcal makes you feel joyful and open and goes with food; a turkey-breast Pechuga mezcal is the celebratory choice.
recommendations.quote: mezcal makes you feel joy, also it gives you a boost of energy, and it also allows you to be more open in your conversation
recommendations.speaker: Santiago Lastra

recommendations.item: Santiago's baked cheesecake with blackberry jam
