recommendations.reason: A recipe he sold at school aged 14; it is now on the menu at Fonda.
recommendations.quote: I used to sell cheesecake when I was fifteen years old ... now we're doing this cheesecake actually in Fonda
recommendations.speaker: Santiago Lastra

recommendations.item: Watermelon slice at the after-party
recommendations.reason: Fond memories of free street watermelon parties in Spain.
recommendations.quote: they put a big table, they cut the watermelons in big slices and then you just eat it ... it's just incredible
recommendations.speaker: Santiago Lastra

recommendations.item: Mexican fine dining tasting menu
recommendations.reason: His own acclaimed Mexican restaurant using almost entirely British ingredients, praised by Ed and James.
recommendations.quote: I'll say we love your food. The skate wing tacos have been shouted out more than once
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Casual regional Mexican dishes
recommendations.reason: His new, more casual a la carte restaurant, with quesadillas, gringas, fish tacos and his cheesecake.
recommendations.quote: Fonda is the food that I would make in my house here, in London, basically.
recommendations.speaker: Santiago Lastra

episodes.title: Ep 288: Bridget Christie (Tasting Menu)
episodes.summary: Tasting-menu episode: Bridget Christie is served Nick Mohammed's notoriously odd dream menu (orange and mango squash water, poppadoms, tortilla lasagne, a Christmas roast with rice and leftover Chinese, Riesling and Coke, microwaved chocolate fondant with Terry's Chocolate Orange) and mostly rejects it.

recommendations.item: Poppadoms with all the dips and onion salad
recommendations.reason: The one course she happily accepted from Nick's menu, enjoying mango chutney, raita and onion salad.
recommendations.quote: Well, I like the mango chutney. I like the-, what's the yoghurty with little green bits?... Love that.
recommendations.speaker: Bridget Christie

recommendations.item: Tortilla lasagne (layered baked nachos with beef chilli)
recommendations.reason: Nick's homemade layered nachos; Bridget found it too messy and meaty to enjoy.
recommendations.quote: I mean, I'll have it, you know. It's just a bit of a mess.
recommendations.speaker: Bridget Christie

recommendations.item: Christmas roast with veg, Yorkshire pudding and sloppy stuffing
recommendations.reason: She kept the vegetables, roast potatoes, raw onion and sloppy stuffing, refusing the lamb, rice and stuffed vine leaves.
recommendations.quote: Okay, I'll have the sloppy-,
recommendations.speaker: Bridget Christie

recommendations.item: Very cold Riesling (declined the Coca-Cola)
recommendations.reason: She would drink the wine but not the fizzy, sweet Coke.
recommendations.quote: With food, it's water or a nice wine, I think.
recommendations.speaker: Bridget Christie

recommendations.item: Microwaved chocolate fondant with Terry's Chocolate Orange
recommendations.reason: Nick's invention; she objected to the synthetic orange flavour and preferred a boiled-orange cake.
recommendations.quote: You don't need the Terry's in a chocolate fondant dessert.
recommendations.speaker: Bridget Christie

episodes.title: Ep 289: Jeff Goldblum
episodes.summary: Jeff Goldblum rambles through still water with ice, baked poppadoms with chutney, briny oysters, a constantly changing round-the-world pasta, well-cooked spiced vegetables, a spicy Virgin Mary and a dessert buffet, with the hosts finalising the menu.

recommendations.item: Still water with ice (or a fizzy mocktail)
recommendations.reason: Prefers mostly flat water but it must be icy; sparkling only if it is cold and flavoured.
recommendations.quote: I'd say mostly flat, but it has to have ice in it.
recommendations.speaker: Jeff Goldblum

recommendations.item: Baked poppadoms with chutney
recommendations.reason: Loves crunchy snacks and Indian flavours, and asks for poppadoms baked rather than fried.
recommendations.quote: I love poppadom, especially when it's well done, and I tell them, 'Hey, these days can you not fry it, can you bake it?'
recommendations.speaker: Jeff Goldblum

recommendations.item: Oysters with lemon, mignonette and Tabasco (briny, well shucked)
recommendations.reason: Wants salty, briny oysters that remind him of the ocean, shucked free of the shell and slurped straight down.
recommendations.quote: I want to be reminded of the ocean... the brinier the better.
recommendations.speaker: Jeff Goldblum

recommendations.item: Round-the-world pasta, from seafood linguine to spaghetti bolognese
recommendations.reason: Nostalgic for his mum's spaghetti with meat sauce and keen on spicy seafood pasta, always kept at the perfect temperature.
recommendations.quote: I like a seafood, spicy seafood linguine.
recommendations.speaker: Jeff Goldblum

recommendations.item: Well-cooked spiced vegetables, salad and sandwiches
recommendations.reason: Likes soft, well-cooked vegetables with garlic, cilantro and spice, plus baked potatoes.
recommendations.quote: I like a well cooked vegetable. Not soggy.
recommendations.speaker: Jeff Goldblum

recommendations.item: Spicy Virgin Mary with lots of ice
recommendations.reason: A Bloody Mary without the alcohol taste, tabascoey and horseradishy.
recommendations.quote: A spicy Virgin Mary... It's the Bloody Mary without that awful alcohol taste.
recommendations.speaker: Jeff Goldblum

recommendations.item: Buffet of every dessert: gelato, pies, ice cream, pudding
recommendations.reason: Has a sweet tooth and does not want to limit his choices.
recommendations.quote: Please give me a buffet. I want a choice.
recommendations.speaker: Jeff Goldblum

recommendations.item: Home-made curry and chutney, plus Tuscan dishes
recommendations.reason: He and his family love this Florence restaurant and recommended it to Wes Anderson; it surprisingly has great curries and home-made chutney.
recommendations.quote: there's a restaurant called Cammillo's, which we like very, very much.
recommendations.speaker: Jeff Goldblum

recommendations.item: Dosa (Indian pizza-bread)
recommendations.reason: He used to eat there between matinee and evening shows when doing a play downtown.
recommendations.quote: in New York there's a place called the Hampton Chutney Company that I used to pass every day
recommendations.speaker: Jeff Goldblum

recommendations.item: Tinned fish
recommendations.reason: Mentions this tinned-fish restaurant, with its list of 100 tins, as somewhere he enjoys.
recommendations.quote: There's a place called Saltie Girl in Los Angeles now... They have, you know, tins. A list of 100 tins.
recommendations.speaker: Jeff Goldblum

recommendations.item: Tinned fish
recommendations.reason: Another LA seafood place he likes for its tinned-fish selection.
recommendations.quote: Connie and Ted's. They have, you know, tins.
recommendations.speaker: Jeff Goldblum

episodes.title: Ep 297: Joanne McNally
episodes.summary: Joanne McNally goes for an immature-palate dream night: sparkling water, bowls of Irish and 10p crisps, club sandwich (no bacon), a potato waffle boat of two-minute noodles on a butter river, coleslaw and tequila shots, an espresso martini, and a Tom Hardy-delivered dessert selection, with Pinot Grigio throughout.

recommendations.item: Sparkling water, no ice or lemon
recommendations.reason: Fizzy water feels like an occasion and a flex now that she can afford it; she likes San Pellegrino in the bottle.
recommendations.quote: There's a sense of occasion to it I feel... now I think it's a bit of a flex being, like, 'I'll take the sparkly.'
recommendations.speaker: Joanne McNally

recommendations.item: Bowls of crisps (Tayto sour cream and onion, Banshee Bones, Wheelies, Pringles, Hot Lips, Hunky Dorys) with an ice-cold Pinot Grigio
recommendations.reason: She swaps poppadoms for the nostalgic Irish crisps of her after-school pound, calling it a 21st-birthday-party buffet.
recommendations.quote: If I was brought to a 21st birthday party and it's bread, that would be my ideal meal... goujons and shit crisps, basically.
recommendations.speaker: Joanne McNally

recommendations.item: Club sandwich (no bacon) with chips and loads of mayo and salt
recommendations.reason: Her favourite meal, reliable on any hotel room-service menu, essentially mayo with a side of sandwich.
recommendations.quote: You can't go wrong with the club sandwich... It's my favourite meal, and chips.
recommendations.speaker: Joanne McNally

recommendations.item: Potato waffle boat filled with two-minute chicken/curry noodles, floating on a river of butter with a goujon anchor and Pringle sail
recommendations.reason: Warm reassuring comfort food in a spectacle presentation, paired with a Negroni with frozen Haribo and a Ferrero Rocher.
recommendations.quote: I love warm reassuring food... I love two-minute noodles. And I love potato waffles.
recommendations.speaker: Joanne McNally

recommendations.item: Coleslaw, blown out of hollowed pool noodles; plus a round of tequila shots
recommendations.reason: She grew up on tubs of coleslaw her mum bought for the week and can't be trusted around it.
recommendations.quote: You'd find me dead, face down in a sea of coleslaw. Can't be trusted with the stuff, I love it.
recommendations.speaker: Joanne McNally

recommendations.item: Pinot Grigio (ice cold); Espresso Martini paired with another Pinot Grigio
recommendations.reason: Pinot Grigio is her ride-or-die drink and tour theme (Barefoot is a go-to), served very cold; an espresso martini perks the night up.
recommendations.quote: Technically Pinot Grigio is my favourite drink... if there was a gun to my head, it would be Pinot.
recommendations.speaker: Joanne McNally

recommendations.item: Dessert selection delivered by topless Tom Hardy on a penny farthing: macaroons, French fancies, gelato, profiteroles and chocolate biscuit cake
recommendations.reason: A hen-party-style choice of sweets with a sense of occasion; chocolate biscuit cake is a childhood school treat.
recommendations.quote: Think very much like hen party desserts... I love a profiterole and some chocolate biscuit cake.
recommendations.speaker: Joanne McNally

episodes.title: Ep 298: James Norton (in partnership with Dexcom)
episodes.summary: Perfectionist James Norton's dream menu: hot sourdough with three butters, Colonsay oysters, best-in-the-world asparagus with a tiny scotch egg, wood-grilled fish on a Jamaican beach at GoldenEye, salad and chips with all the condiments, Casa Belfi frizzante and a dark chocolate cremeux.

recommendations.item: Sparkling water
recommendations.reason: Sparkling all the way; he has a fizzy water machine at home and finds still water slightly lacking.
recommendations.quote: Sparkling all the way. Every time.
recommendations.speaker: James Norton

recommendations.item: Steaming hot sourdough with salted, truffle and genie's choice butters
recommendations.reason: Crusty, hot sourdough with soft centre and thick unwhipped butters; he loves bread as much as he finds it admin as a type 1 diabetic.
recommendations.quote: steaming hot sourdough with soft centre, very crusty. Can I have three different types of butter, please?
recommendations.speaker: James Norton

recommendations.item: A dozen oysters from Colonsay (snacks loophole)
recommendations.reason: Oysters he has eaten on the beach on Colonsay on holiday, shared for the table.
recommendations.quote: They're from an island off the west coast of Scotland, called Colonsay.
recommendations.speaker: James Norton

recommendations.item: Best steamed asparagus with parmesan, olive oil, black truffle and a tiny scotch egg
recommendations.reason: A fibre-first starter, perfected to the best of everything, inspired by a memory of asparagus with a tiny runny scotch egg.
recommendations.quote: I'm going to order the best asparagus, in season asparagus in the world, cooked, steamed to perfection, with the best parmesan in the world
recommendations.speaker: James Norton

recommendations.item: Wood-flame grilled halibut, prawns and scallops with mango salsa, on a beach
recommendations.reason: He wants his barbecue-style fish eaten with his hands on the beach at GoldenEye, the Jamaican resort owned by Chris Blackwell.
recommendations.quote: I'll take a beach in GoldenEye.
recommendations.speaker: James Norton

recommendations.item: Green salad with seeds and chips with vinegar, ketchup, mayo and Tabasco
recommendations.reason: A simple seedy salad plus thin malt-vinegar chips and a full condiment set 'just in case'.
recommendations.quote: the key thing for me in this whole meal is the vinegar on the fries
recommendations.speaker: James Norton

recommendations.item: Casa Belfi bianco frizzante (natural pet nat white)
recommendations.reason: A cold, crisp natural frizzante that cuts through the oily fish and reminds him of lockdown in Peckham.
recommendations.quote: Crisp, cuts through the oil of the fish. Just a bottle of that, I think, please.
recommendations.speaker: James Norton

recommendations.item: 80% dark chocolate cremeux with chilli, cacao nibs, vanilla gelato and raspberry coulis, with Americano and grappa
recommendations.reason: He prefers bitter over sweet and keeps a chocolate drawer at home, so a thick dark mousse with a sweet scoop and tart fruit.
recommendations.quote: So, my dessert will be a, sort of, chocolate mousse, but thick, not too much air in it. With 80% minimum cocoa, and a little bit of chilli.
recommendations.speaker: James Norton

recommendations.item: Jerk chicken, rice and peas from a riverside shack (Belinda's)
recommendations.location: Rio Grande, near Port Antonio, Jamaica
recommendations.reason: One of his best ever meals: jerk chicken at a shack run by a lady called Belinda after rafting down the river.
recommendations.quote: I had one of the best meals I've ever had in Jamaica, Rio Grande.
recommendations.speaker: James Norton

recommendations.item: Freshly baked bread with a slight Marmite flavour
recommendations.reason: He had lunch there the same day and loved the bread, and even got vinegar fetched for his fries.
recommendations.quote: I had lunch at the Ham Yard today, and I think their bread has a very slight Marmite taste to it. It was absolutely delicious.
recommendations.speaker: James Norton

recommendations.item: Bread, dips and flatbreads
recommendations.reason: Ed recommends it for amazing dips such as baba ganoush and tarama with garlic-butter bagel bread and flatbreads.
recommendations.quote: Huge, huge shout out to the bread at Oma.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Bread
recommendations.reason: Mentioned on the podcast before and praised for bread served hot and fresh from the oven.
recommendations.quote: I've heard Dean Street Townhouse bread mentioned on here a couple of times, which is a very good bread.
recommendations.speaker: James Norton

recommendations.item: Creamed spinach
recommendations.reason: Ed's go-to creamed spinach.
recommendations.quote: Hawksmoor creamed spinach.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

episodes.title: Ep 299: Katherine Parkinson (Live in London)
episodes.summary: Katherine Parkinson (live at the Palladium) picks still water, warm walnut bread, her mother-in-law's mackerel pate, Dover sole off the bone with skinny chips and mayo, champagne and a chocolate fondant from a fancy Bath restaurant.

recommendations.item: Still water
recommendations.reason: She dislikes the taste of the gas in sparkling water.
recommendations.quote: I really like still water. I really dislike the taste of sparkling water.
recommendations.speaker: Katherine Parkinson

recommendations.item: Warm walnut bread with melty butter
recommendations.reason: She loves bread and puts walnuts in her bread-maker loaves, but wants a better one (imagined as made by Meghan Markle), served warm.
recommendations.quote: I could actually get quite emotional about bread. I love bread.
recommendations.speaker: Katherine Parkinson

recommendations.item: Mackerel pate with toast
recommendations.reason: The only mackerel pate she has truly liked is made by her husband's mum.
recommendations.quote: I haven't really liked any one but my mother-in-law's mackerel pâté.
recommendations.speaker: Katherine Parkinson

recommendations.item: Dover sole off the bone with creamed spinach
recommendations.location: West Street, Covent Garden, London, UK
recommendations.reason: She first ordered it at The Ivy at a work event as the most expensive dish, pretending to be sophisticated, and came to love it; it feels glamorous without being too filling.
recommendations.quote: It was The Ivy West Street, and it was a work thing... it's such a lovely meal because you don't feel too full, you feel sated
recommendations.speaker: Katherine Parkinson

recommendations.item: Skinny fries with mayonnaise
recommendations.reason: She'd like to say green beans but really she pigs out on skinny chips with mayo.
recommendations.quote: I really do like a skinny chip with mayonnaise
recommendations.speaker: Katherine Parkinson

recommendations.item: Champagne (cheapest in the restaurant is fine)
recommendations.reason: She used to order white wine and a Fanta to seem classy; now she wants fizzy champagne, though Prosecco is a fine second best.
recommendations.quote: As long as it's fizzy and not Prosecco.
recommendations.speaker: Katherine Parkinson

recommendations.item: Chocolate fondant with molten chocolate poured over
recommendations.reason: A fancy meal with her husband where one waiter removed the sponge's top and another poured in molten chocolate; it was unforgettable and made her go cross-eyed.
recommendations.quote: one person came and took the head off the chocolate sponge, and another person poured molten chocolate into it
recommendations.speaker: Katherine Parkinson

episodes.title: Ben Schwartz
episodes.summary: Ben Schwartz picks still water, bread and butter, sweetcorn ravioli from Capo, a sushi omakase at Sushi Bar in Encino, crispy okra from Kann in Portland, an old-fashioned then a gin and tonic, and a classic ice cream sundae.

recommendations.item: Still water
recommendations.reason: Sparkling water gives him acid reflux and fills him up, so he goes still.
recommendations.quote: Still. Can't do sparkling, acid reflux bubbles up my stomach.
recommendations.speaker: Ben Schwartz

recommendations.item: Bread and butter (wholewheat, or a croissant when in England)
recommendations.reason: He loves the bread, butter and marmalade culture in England and likes dunking bread in an Italian restaurant.
recommendations.quote: But bread and butter I usually always start-, always have a little bit.
recommendations.speaker: Ben Schwartz

recommendations.item: Sweetcorn ravioli
recommendations.reason: A decadent, beautiful small starter at a fancy Los Angeles Italian restaurant that he counts as one of his favourite dishes ever.
recommendations.quote: It's sweetcorn ravioli, and it's just like a decadent beautiful little way to start, and it's one of my favourite dishes ever in the universe.
recommendations.speaker: Ben Schwartz

recommendations.item: Sushi omakase
recommendations.reason: Intimate, utensil-free omakase in a speakeasy-style room where each piece comes with its own special sauce; he likes letting the chef decide.
recommendations.quote: It's in Encino. It's like in a little speakeasy... They give you one piece of sushi on rice, but they put, like, different special sauces on it.
recommendations.speaker: Ben Schwartz

recommendations.item: Crispy okra
recommendations.reason: A side dish from one of the best meals of his life, at a Haitian-influenced restaurant in Portland, Oregon; he had never really had okra before.
recommendations.quote: This is one of my favourite meals I've ever eaten in my life... that side dish was amazing, and I'd never really had okra before.
recommendations.speaker: Ben Schwartz

recommendations.item: Old fashioned at the start, gin and tonic at the end
recommendations.reason: He saves most of his drinking for the end of the meal and gets a gin and tonic when in England.
recommendations.quote: I'd probably take an Old fashioned, then a gin and tonic to end.
recommendations.speaker: Ben Schwartz

recommendations.item: Classic ice cream sundae (cookies and cream or vanilla, chocolate syrup, marshmallow, cherry, nuts)
recommendations.reason: A classic sundae he loves despite being lactose intolerant; the dish is nostalgic and he likes choosing each spoonful.
recommendations.quote: I love a classic sundae, ice cream sundae. I want either cookies and cream ice cream or vanilla ice cream.
recommendations.speaker: other

recommendations.item: Ice cream with caviar (tasting-menu style dishes)
recommendations.reason: Matty Matheson's Toronto restaurant where Ben and his improv troupe tasted dishes none of them had tried before, such as caviar on ice cream.
recommendations.quote: He has one called Prime Seafood Palace, and one of the dishes was I believe ice-cream with caviar on it.
recommendations.speaker: Ben Schwartz

recommendations.item: Cheeseburger, fries, barbecue sauce and ginger ale
recommendations.reason: His comfort road-trip meal; he names this place as one he rates for a burger.
recommendations.quote: There's a place called Burgers Never Say Die that's really good.
recommendations.speaker: Ben Schwartz

recommendations.item: Omakase with a whole bluefin tuna brought in and carved
recommendations.reason: Ed's recent night: a single-sitting sushi experience in a supermarket where a whole tuna is wheeled in; fresh and delicious, if a bit like watching an autopsy.
recommendations.quote: It was just so fresh. It was mad.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

episodes.title: Sharon Wanjohi
episodes.summary: Comedian Sharon Wanjohi picks sparkling water, hard bread with butter licked from a cow's udder, soft bruschetta bread, her mum's Kenyan cooking from 2007, cold drunk-night chips and nuggets, pre-sugar-tax Ribena, and fried-chicken-shaped ice cream with a brownie.

recommendations.item: Sparkling water, ideally an obscure brand that tastes like TV static, with no giant ice cubes
recommendations.reason: She loves the whimsy of fizzy water and dislikes oversized ice cubes.
recommendations.quote: I like it when it's a brand you've never heard of before, and it's at the back of the fridge... and it just tastes like TV static. Put that inside me.
recommendations.speaker: Sharon Wanjohi

recommendations.item: Hard, mediocre bread with soft creamy butter licked straight from a cow's udder
recommendations.reason: Bread is just a vehicle for butter; she'd rather eat the butter with a spoon, and here wants it fresh from a cow called Penelope.
recommendations.quote: I think bread is a vehicle for butter. If I could say to the waiter, 'Hey, just bring me a spoon and I'll get on with the butter,' if that was socially acceptable, I would.
recommendations.speaker: Sharon Wanjohi

recommendations.item: Bruschetta on soft, good bread made by an old Italian man
recommendations.reason: Soft bread topped with tomato, olive oil and garlic, with the imagined flavour of a jolly Italian baker whose son Mario is struggling at uni.
recommendations.quote: Good bread has to be soft. In my mind, when I'm eating it, I want to see an old Italian man who just loves his kids
recommendations.speaker: Sharon Wanjohi

recommendations.item: Her mum's Kenyan cooking from summer 2007 (mukimo, chapati, beef stew)
recommendations.reason: Earthy, maize-y Kenyan food from her childhood, specifically from 2007, so every bite brings the nostalgia flooding back.
recommendations.quote: I want to taste the recession, I want to taste Groovy Chick, I want to taste Basil Brush.
recommendations.speaker: Sharon Wanjohi

recommendations.item: Cold congealed chips and 5.5 nuggets from a drunken night out
recommendations.reason: Not about taste but about the happy memory of a chaotic night out and waking up to cold takeaway chips.
recommendations.quote: You wake up an hour and a half later... you're like, 'I didn't eat my chips,' and they're kind of congealed and cold... They always slap.
recommendations.speaker: Sharon Wanjohi

recommendations.item: Strawberry Ribena from before the sugar reduction
recommendations.reason: Nostalgia for the full-sugar childhood original.
recommendations.quote: I want the strawberry Ribena from pre-... who made sugar evil?
recommendations.speaker: Sharon Wanjohi

recommendations.item: Watermelon Elf bar vape as a palate cleanser after the meal
recommendations.reason: She pairs vape flavours with courses and uses one to finish the meal.
recommendations.quote: You finish the meal, so you have the full experience, and then you go in with an Elf bar, just to palate-cleanse.
recommendations.speaker: Sharon Wanjohi

recommendations.item: Fried chicken ice cream in a bucket, then a classic brownie
recommendations.reason: She loves desserts disguised as savoury food, using the trick of eating a fake savoury course before the real dessert.
recommendations.quote: I like the desserts that look like food, but they're cold, like the ice cream fried chicken, or a sweet pasta spaghetti bolognese.
recommendations.speaker: Sharon Wanjohi

episodes.title: Stevie Martin
episodes.summary: Stevie Martin, a vegan, picks flat sparkling water, a French baguette with salted vegan butter, a full roast dinner starter, home-style vegan nachos, Padron pepper poppers, a Stevie Martini (plus a calimocho) and vegan apple pie with cold custard.

recommendations.item: Flat sparkling water
recommendations.reason: She likes sparkling water once it has gone flat and lost its spikiness.
recommendations.quote: I quite like it when it goes flat because it doesn't taste like still water.
recommendations.speaker: Stevie Martin

recommendations.item: French baguette with salted vegan butter and gingham napkin
recommendations.reason: Warm, cheap white baguette in a basket; she does not care where it comes from.
recommendations.quote: Bread. French baguette in a basket with the little gingham serviette.
recommendations.speaker: Stevie Martin

recommendations.item: Full-size vegan roast dinner with Bisto gravy
recommendations.reason: After wobbling between a bread platter and a vegan cheeseboard, she settled on a roast dinner as her starter.
recommendations.quote: Full size roast dinner and then-, oh my God, that's amazing, thank you.
recommendations.speaker: Stevie Martin

recommendations.item: Vegan nachos
recommendations.reason: Her own method: layered, reduced chilli with Moving Mountains mince and Violife cheddar, grilled, with guac and sour cream on the side so every chip has the right ratio.
recommendations.quote: I make excellent nachos. It's the only thing I've ever served people when they've come around for dinner.
recommendations.speaker: Stevie Martin

recommendations.item: Padron pepper poppers
recommendations.reason: An invented dish of breadcrumbed Padron peppers stuffed with vegan cream cheese.
recommendations.quote: I'll go Padron pepper poppers.
recommendations.speaker: Stevie Martin

recommendations.item: Extra dry, dirty vodka martini (the Stevie Martini)
recommendations.reason: Her go-to bar order: barely any vermouth and lots of olive brine; she served them at her wedding party.
recommendations.quote: I really like vodka martinis that are extra dry. Like, very little vermouth... really dirty with loads of olive brine in it
recommendations.speaker: Stevie Martin

recommendations.item: Calimocho (red wine and cola)
recommendations.reason: A uni-days favourite, ordered at the start of the meal before the martini.
recommendations.quote: I think I'll start with a calimocho and then go into the vodka martini later.
recommendations.speaker: Stevie Martin

recommendations.item: Vegan apple pie with cold vegan custard
recommendations.reason: Inspired by a deep-dish vegan apple pie in a package-holiday canteen; she wants it lukewarm with cold vegan custard.
recommendations.quote: old style deep dish, chunky apple, sweet but not-, you've got a bit of the sour notes coming through
recommendations.speaker: Stevie Martin

recommendations.item: Nachos and Mexican food in booths
recommendations.reason: The model for her dream restaurant, with booths where you can linger, and one of the few places that does nachos well.
recommendations.quote: El Camion does a good job, actually.
recommendations.speaker: Stevie Martin

recommendations.item: Giant vegan nachos
recommendations.reason: Edinburgh Festival pub with huge nachos, including vegan ones; the only place that served what she expects.
recommendations.quote: That's the only place I've been where I've been like, 'That is what I expect.'
recommendations.speaker: Stevie Martin

episodes.title: Jonny Pelham
episodes.summary: Bradford comedian Jonny Pelham picks still water, a buttery French baguette, a legendary Florence carbonara, lamb makhani and fish pakora from his local Habib's, a Manchester margarita, and microwaved sticky toffee puddings from childhood.

recommendations.item: Still water
recommendations.reason: He loves other fizzy drinks but has never liked sparkling water.
recommendations.quote: I genuinely am not a fussy drinker or eater, particularly, but just do not like sparkling water, at all.
recommendations.speaker: Jonny Pelham

recommendations.item: French baguette with far too much butter
recommendations.reason: He loves plain bread and butter, the sort you would dip in soup, with more butter than is socially acceptable.
recommendations.quote: I love bread and butter. I think bread and butter's really underrated
recommendations.speaker: Jonny Pelham

recommendations.item: Spaghetti carbonara
recommendations.venue: Unnamed restaurant on a side street in Florence
recommendations.reason: He ate it on his 18th birthday on his first trip to Italy; light, al dente and salty, it set a standard no carbonara has matched since. He does not remember the name of the place.
recommendations.quote: I had a carbonara that was so delightful that it, sort of, ruined food for me for the next fifteen years
recommendations.speaker: Jonny Pelham

recommendations.item: Lamb makhani with chapati and pilau rice
recommendations.reason: His family's local curry house all his life, where they know every order. Their yellow, creamy, mild makhani with a little pineapple and tender lamb is the best curry he has had.
recommendations.quote: It's just such good curry... it's, like, yellow, but it's so delicious.
recommendations.speaker: Jonny Pelham

recommendations.item: Fish pakora
recommendations.reason: Lightly fried and lightly spiced white fish pakoras where you can really taste the fish; his dad switched his order to them a few years ago.
recommendations.quote: They're like lightly fried... and you can still taste the fish.
recommendations.speaker: Jonny Pelham

recommendations.item: Margarita (classic, salt rim)
recommendations.reason: The best margarita he can remember, though in his dream he drinks it on a high balcony overlooking London.
recommendations.quote: There was a place, I think it's called, like, 20 Stories High... in Manchester. That was good.
recommendations.speaker: Jonny Pelham

recommendations.item: Two sticky toffee puddings, microwaved
recommendations.reason: At ten he walked home alone and microwaved two supermarket sticky toffee puddings, a moment that felt like life would be okay.
recommendations.quote: you could get two sticky toffee puddings for, like, £1.50 or something... from Tesco
recommendations.speaker: Jonny Pelham

episodes.title: Will Sharpe
episodes.summary: Will Sharpe orders mountain tap water, Olympic Provisions focaccia, Greek-style fried small fish, a high-and-low Japanese kaiseki tray, a Tokyo American Club club sandwich, a CC Lemon and Japanese lager shandy, a chocolate torte with a lemon tart and big fruit, and a Fernet-Branca.

recommendations.item: Cold tap water from a mountain wall
recommendations.reason: He defaults to table tap water, as in Japan, but wants it to come from a special mountain that forms the restaurant wall.
recommendations.quote: I'm normally just tap... the default is just tap water, because it's just, like, less admin.
recommendations.speaker: Will Sharpe

recommendations.item: Focaccia
recommendations.reason: On a US west coast trip, tired and hungry after a long walk, he found their focaccia the best bread he has ever eaten and quizzed the kitchen about it.
recommendations.quote: because we were so exhausted, and so hungry, it was just the most delicious bread I've ever eaten
recommendations.speaker: Will Sharpe

recommendations.item: Deep-fried small fish (gavros) with lemon
recommendations.reason: A memory of a greasy bag of crunchy little fish from a seaside cafe in Greece after a hot day swimming.
recommendations.quote: just a greasy bag of little fishes, and they're very crispy. It's not too bony.
recommendations.speaker: Will Sharpe

recommendations.item: High and low Japanese kaiseki-style tray (pickles, grilled white fish or unagi, cold soba, natto, small okonomiyaki, Japanese cereal and snacks)
recommendations.reason: A tray of many small dishes mixing refined seasonal Japanese food with nostalgic convenience-store snacks from his time living in Japan.
recommendations.quote: High and low kaiseki tray, please.
recommendations.speaker: Will Sharpe

recommendations.item: Club sandwich with a toothpick flag
recommendations.reason: Nostalgia for the 1990s club sandwich at the Tokyo American Club, where they also rented VHS films and went bowling.
recommendations.quote: Club sandwich from the Tokyo American Club, in the '90s.
recommendations.speaker: Will Sharpe

recommendations.item: CC Lemon and Japanese lager shandy
recommendations.reason: CC Lemon recalls summer football with his brother and a vending-machine can; mixed with a cold Japanese beer like Kirin for a hot-day shandy.
recommendations.quote: Like a Japanese beer on a hot day, and a bit of C.C. Lemon.
recommendations.speaker: Will Sharpe

recommendations.item: Flourless dense chocolate torte with matcha ice cream and berries
recommendations.reason: He prefers dense flourless chocolate over fluffy sponge.
recommendations.quote: I basically, like to feel like I'm being punched in the face by the chocolate.
recommendations.speaker: Will Sharpe

recommendations.item: Grandma's lemon tart with vanilla ice cream and Ice Magic
recommendations.reason: An early memory of making lemon tart with his late British grandma, served with shop-bought ice cream and hardening chocolate sauce.
recommendations.quote: learning how to make a lemon tart with her
recommendations.speaker: Will Sharpe

recommendations.item: A big, perfect Japanese melon or strawberry
recommendations.reason: Fruit as dessert, as at his Japanese grandma's house.
recommendations.quote: a really good piece of fruit, like melon or a strawberry that's really big.
recommendations.speaker: Will Sharpe

recommendations.item: Fernet-Branca digestif
recommendations.reason: A bitter amaro to finish, which Ed says helps digestion.
recommendations.quote: one of those bitter Amaro-y Fernet-Branca.
recommendations.speaker: Will Sharpe

recommendations.item: Razor clams and moo krob (crispy pork)
recommendations.reason: A tiny Thai cafe in Leytonstone run by a chef and his mum, famous for razor clams and crunchy moo krob; Ed calls it phenomenal and it has moved to Shoreditch.
recommendations.quote: They were famous for their razor clams, but they also had something called moo krob
recommendations.speaker: Will Sharpe

episodes.title: Marian Keyes
episodes.summary: Marian Keyes (teetotal, vegetarian) picks sparkling water, treacle and Guinness bread from Hotel Europe in Killarney with Kerrygold butter, her husband's heritage tomato salad, roast butternut squash and chickpea stew from Woodruff in Dublin, hasselback potatoes, still water with lime, and her mother's trifle without sherry.

recommendations.item: Sparkling water
recommendations.reason: As a non-drinker she takes her thrills where she can, so sparkling feels like a special treat.
recommendations.quote: I'll have sparkling because it's a special time. Because I don't drink, so, I have to, kind of, take my thrills where I get them.
recommendations.speaker: Marian Keyes

recommendations.item: Warm treacle and Guinness bread with Kerrygold butter
recommendations.reason: She goes every Easter with her family to the hotel, which has an Easter bunny hunt; she would happily eat the bread as her whole dinner.
recommendations.quote: they have a treacle and Guinness bread and I swear to god, I mean, I would just eat that for my entire dinner.
recommendations.speaker: Marian Keyes

recommendations.item: Heritage tomato salad with Manchego, coriander seed, lemon oil and sourdough croutons
recommendations.reason: Her husband makes it at home; flavourful coloured tomatoes, toasted coriander seed and croutons soaked in olive oil make it like a jewel box.
recommendations.quote: it's like a jewel box. And everything is delicious and fresh and tastes of things.
recommendations.speaker: Marian Keyes

recommendations.item: Roast butternut squash and chickpea stew with ras el hanout
recommendations.reason: A vegetarian dish that is not an afterthought: caramelised, almost sweet squash with Moroccan spices; a small, friendly restaurant that plays 80s music like The Jam and The Cure.
recommendations.quote: Instead of, kind of, the misery of vegetarian food, which is usually such an after thought.
recommendations.speaker: Marian Keyes

recommendations.item: Hasselback potatoes with Kerrygold butter and big salt crystals
recommendations.reason: A very long potato sliced into a fan with butter in every slit; her husband is brilliant at making them.
recommendations.quote: Salt and butter is all you need. You know, why ruin something that's already magnificent, perfect.
recommendations.speaker: Marian Keyes

recommendations.item: Still mineral water with a wedge of lime
recommendations.reason: She does not drink alcohol and is genuinely happy with water; lime not lemon.
recommendations.quote: Lemon is cruel and harsh and lime is friendly and sweeter and just better.
recommendations.speaker: Marian Keyes

recommendations.item: Her mother's Christmas trifle without sherry, with chocolate sauce
recommendations.reason: Her mother makes it once a year with sherry to be defiant; the trifle stands for her mother's tough love and she adores custard.
recommendations.quote: it's a substitute for love... it would feel like love if my mother made it.
recommendations.speaker: Marian Keyes

episodes.title: Phil Ellis
episodes.summary: Phil goes for tap water, a sausage and egg baton from a Lake District deli, Aldi tinned oxtail soup with the carrots removed, a tomahawk steak from Lake Garda, a poached egg on toast, Malbec with Wetherspoons Pinot Grigio and Guinness taps, and a Sara Lee triple chocolate gateau.

recommendations.item: Still tap water
recommendations.reason: He dislikes sparkling water because it never quenches his thirst.
recommendations.quote: Yeah, still water, please.
recommendations.speaker: Phil Ellis

recommendations.item: Sausage and egg baton (soft white roll, split pork sausages, egg cracked in)
recommendations.reason: The best bread he's ever had was a soft white baton from a deli in the Lake District, filled with sausage and egg.
recommendations.quote: they had this nice baton, and I said, 'Can I have a sausage and egg'. And it was the nicest thing. My mouth's watering now.
recommendations.speaker: Phil Ellis

recommendations.item: Oxtail soup (Aldi's own tinned, carrots scooped out, microwaved 2.5 minutes)
recommendations.reason: His comfort-food staple; he avoids Heinz because of tomato bits and likes little chunks of oxtail as a surprise.
recommendations.quote: the tin oxtail I get, luckily the bits of carrot in it, which ruin it, all float to the top... you can scoop all of them out before you start.
recommendations.speaker: Phil Ellis

recommendations.item: Tomahawk steak, medium rare, with nothing else
recommendations.reason: A perfectly cooked tomahawk on a competition-won trip to Lake Garda moved him; he wants it salty and unadorned.
recommendations.quote: I had one once, and it was so well cooked and everything that I got really emotional.
recommendations.speaker: Phil Ellis

recommendations.item: Poached egg on white toast
recommendations.reason: Simple egg on Aldi white toast with salt and pepper; to him the egg is its own sauce.
recommendations.quote: Is a poached egg a side?... I'll have a nice poached egg, please.
recommendations.speaker: Phil Ellis

recommendations.item: Malbec, plus Wetherspoons Pinot Grigio and Guinness taps (and a Coca-Cola)
recommendations.reason: Wetherspoons wine and Guinness alternated at the table, because it's cheap (two for one on Friday); he'd also have a Malbec.
recommendations.quote: a nice Wetherspoons Pinot Grigio, please. From the tap.
recommendations.speaker: Phil Ellis

recommendations.item: Sara Lee triple chocolate gateau, all to himself
recommendations.reason: His childhood favourite: soft, rich, mousse-y, and a lesson in patience while it defrosts.
recommendations.quote: It was always my favourite growing up... the Sara Lee triple chocolate gateau, please.
recommendations.speaker: Phil Ellis

recommendations.item: Wetherspoons breakfast
recommendations.reason: Phil's regular breakfast spot for the bottomless coffee at about 1.70 pounds and the jovial atmosphere.
recommendations.quote: do the cafes do a bottomless coffee for £1.70?... Do they have the atmosphere, the jovial warm atmosphere of a Wetherspoon's?
recommendations.speaker: Phil Ellis

recommendations.item: 600g rib-eye with blue cheese hollandaise
recommendations.reason: Ed enjoyed a solo 600g rib-eye with blue cheese hollandaise there; Phil also likes Hawksmoor.
recommendations.quote: I had a nice blue cheese hollandaise at Hawksmoor the other day with a steak... It was lovely. I had a 600-gram rib-eye.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

episodes.title: Laura Smyth
episodes.summary: Spring water from the Birks of Aberfeldy, unlimited poppadoms, garlic prawns with bread to dunk, whole soy roast chicken on rice, morning glory, the most expensive red wine plus a vodka martini, and steamed jam sponge with custard and ice cream.

recommendations.item: Spring water from the Birks of Aberfeldy
recommendations.reason: Remembers drinking from a real spring in the Scottish glen and it being wonderful.
recommendations.quote: I drank water from a real spring. That's well nice.
recommendations.speaker: Laura Smyth

recommendations.item: Unlimited poppadoms with all the dips
recommendations.reason: Poppadoms are calorie-free in her mind, so she can eat endless crunchy bits; she loves the endless poppadoms at Tayyabs.
recommendations.quote: I love Tayyabs in Whitechapel... there is not a limit to the number of poppadoms I will smash.
recommendations.speaker: Laura Smyth

recommendations.item: Garlic butter prawns with bread for dunking (tunkol)
recommendations.reason: Big charred prawns in super garlicky butter with wilted tomatoes, with bread for the Hungarian-style dunking stage; reminds her of old-school Italian restaurants.
recommendations.quote: I want to be garlicky up to the eyeballs
recommendations.speaker: Laura Smyth

recommendations.item: Whole soy roast chicken on boiled rice
recommendations.reason: Chinatown-style poached, soy-glazed chicken with ginger and spring onion; she loved the idea of a whole chicken as the youngest of a big family.
recommendations.quote: I actually want a whole soy roast chicken on just boiled rice.
recommendations.speaker: Laura Smyth

recommendations.item: Morning glory with garlic and sesame oil
recommendations.reason: Simply done Chinese greens; the best she ever had was somewhere in China she can't recall.
recommendations.quote: I once had the most perfect morning glory.
recommendations.speaker: Laura Smyth

recommendations.item: Most expensive red wine on the menu, plus a vodka martini with a twist as an aperitif
recommendations.reason: Dream-restaurant curiosity about what a creamy, truly expensive red tastes like; a vodka martini to start.
recommendations.quote: give me the most expensive red on the menu.
recommendations.speaker: Laura Smyth

recommendations.item: Steamed jam sponge with custard and ice cream, plus an affogato
recommendations.reason: Nostalgic raspberry jam sponge with both custard and ice cream; she can't choose just one.
recommendations.quote: a steamed jam sponge, custard, and ice cream.
recommendations.speaker: Laura Smyth

recommendations.item: Brioche bread with melted bacon butter and shrimp butter
recommendations.reason: Ed raves about the bread served with little pans of melted butters, which fits Laura's love of dunking.
recommendations.quote: It's all about the tunkol.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Aubergine and pork hot pot
recommendations.reason: James's go-to in Chinatown; the hearty, warming hot pot has him craving it for days.
recommendations.quote: My go-to in Chinatown now is Cafe TPT.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Wine tasting menu
recommendations.reason: Laura's anniversary tasting menu with wine matching and a knowledgeable server at an off-grid vineyard.
recommendations.quote: It was like poetic.
recommendations.speaker: Laura Smyth

episodes.title: Sindhu Vee (Tasting Menu)
episodes.summary: Tasting Menu episode: Sindhu Vee reacts to Richard Herring's dream menu (Fountain of Youth water, table-sized injera, 1990s vs present Kettle Chips, a singing blackbird pie, student van jacket potato, holiday beer, Bella's pudding) and recalls her own original menu of whitefish ceviche and Bella Pasta's Godfather dessert.

recommendations.item: Water from the Fountain of Youth (Big John, Little John) - Richard Herring's menu; she would only wash her hair in it
recommendations.reason: She refuses to drink it as she hated being eight, but would happily wash her hair in it.
recommendations.quote: I don't want to be eight again. I had a terrible... Then I'd have great hair.
recommendations.speaker: Sindhu Vee

recommendations.item: Papad (her own choice); injera bread the size of a table (Richard Herring's menu)
recommendations.reason: She picks papad over bread, then enthusiastically agrees to try the giant injera she has never eaten.
recommendations.quote: I have never eaten it, and regardless of the size of this parachute of bread that we have, I will have some.
recommendations.speaker: Sindhu Vee

recommendations.item: Salt and vinegar Kettle Chips from 1990 and from today (Richard Herring's menu)
recommendations.reason: Salt and vinegar is her favourite crisp flavour and she would love to taste the 1990 version, having arrived in Britain in 1991.
recommendations.quote: my favourite crisp is salt and vinegar... I could now find out what they tasted in 1990
recommendations.speaker: Sindhu Vee

recommendations.item: Four-and-twenty live blackbird pie, swapped by her for tiny owls (Richard Herring's menu)
recommendations.reason: She would rather the live singing birds in the pie be tiny owls, which she loves.
recommendations.quote: I would love it instead of four and 20 blackbirds... if it had four and 20 owls. I love owls.
recommendations.speaker: Sindhu Vee

recommendations.item: Student-van jacket potato with coleslaw, chilli sauce, garlic mayo, cheese and butter (Richard Herring's menu); she'd also take dauphinoise potatoes
recommendations.venue: Doner kebab van, UK university town
recommendations.reason: Reminds her of her first jacket potato from a van at university; she would push the cold coleslaw and mayo aside and focus on the butter and chilli.
recommendations.quote: I would focus my mind on the butter, and because butter and chilli is quite a combination.
recommendations.speaker: Sindhu Vee

recommendations.item: Local beer on holiday (Richard Herring's menu); her own go-to now is neat vodka or Japanese whisky
recommendations.reason: She has never drunk beer but would sip it; she has returned to neat vodka on ice and Japanese whisky.
recommendations.quote: I would drink some of that beer, especially if it had the frothy stuff on top.
recommendations.speaker: Sindhu Vee

recommendations.item: The Godfather ice-cream dessert with sparklers (her original dessert)
recommendations.reason: A youthful treat: she would go alone to Bella Pasta and order the dessert topped with fireworks, a vivid part of her early years in London.
recommendations.quote: Remember when you would go alone? You would take money out of the ATM and go alone and sit in Bella Pasta and order that dessert with the fireworks on the top.
recommendations.speaker: Sindhu Vee (relaying a friend)

recommendations.item: Bella's pudding: caramel base without the eggy meringue (Richard Herring's menu)
recommendations.reason: She'd happily eat three versions of the caramel bottom, like the creme caramel her mother made in the Philippines, scraping off the meringue.
recommendations.quote: we eat the caramel... I will eat three of those, no problem, and I would scrape off the eggy meringue.
recommendations.speaker: Sindhu Vee

episodes.title: Jinkx Monsoon
episodes.summary: Jinkx Monsoon (who eats no mammals and no longer drinks) picks still water, Cheesecake Factory brown bread, Brasserie Zedel's carrot salad and coconut shrimp, steamed lobster and cold crab with black tobiko, dauphinoise potatoes and beet salad, alcohol-free Kylie champagne and Big Gulp Diet Dr Pepper, and sticky toffee pudding.

recommendations.item: Still water
recommendations.reason: She likes fizzy drinks but finds flavoured sparkling water pointless and suspicious.
recommendations.quote: I like carbonated drinks, but my water should be still.
recommendations.speaker: Jinkx Monsoon

recommendations.item: Brown wheat bread with oats on top and room-temperature butter
recommendations.reason: A broke-college-student treat with bottomless bread, later where she took her roommates after winning Drag Race the first time; she thinks it tastes better than any other bread.
recommendations.quote: it just tastes better than every other bread. It's probably not even bread. It's probably cake.
recommendations.speaker: Jinkx Monsoon

recommendations.item: Carrot salad
recommendations.reason: Her favourite London restaurant, a time-capsule French brasserie with a shaved-carrot salad she can't replicate at home; she has had favourite meals there with favourite people.
recommendations.quote: they have a carrot salad... and I can't get enough of it.
recommendations.speaker: Jinkx Monsoon

recommendations.item: Coconut shrimp with sweet chilli sauce
recommendations.reason: A deliberately tacky favourite, best with real coconut in the batter.
recommendations.quote: I don't care how tacky it is. I really love coconut shrimp
recommendations.speaker: Jinkx Monsoon

recommendations.item: Steamed lobster and cold crab with drawn butter and black tobiko
recommendations.reason: She enjoys the ritual of cracking shellfish and a pile of black tobiko caviar as palate cleanser; a sampling of the sea reflecting childhood buffet outings.
recommendations.quote: I like crab cold and I like lobster hot.
recommendations.speaker: Jinkx Monsoon

recommendations.item: Dauphinoise potatoes and a beet salad with goat's cheese and nuts
recommendations.reason: Dauphinoise replaced her grandma's boxed scalloped potatoes as the proper version.
recommendations.quote: scalloped potatoes were no good to me. Now it has to be dauphinoise.
recommendations.speaker: Jinkx Monsoon

recommendations.item: Alcohol-free Kylie Minogue sparkling wine and a Big Gulp of Diet Dr Pepper on lots of ice
recommendations.reason: She no longer drinks, so a Kylie alcohol-free sparkling plus a huge ice-filled Diet Dr Pepper stand in for her planned vodka martinis.
recommendations.quote: I really like the alcohol-free Kylie Minogue champagne.
recommendations.speaker: Jinkx Monsoon

recommendations.item: Sticky toffee pudding with vanilla ice cream and caramel sauce
recommendations.reason: She calls it the perfect dessert, with ice cream melting to replace custard.
recommendations.quote: It is the perfect dessert.
recommendations.speaker: Jinkx Monsoon

episodes.title: Bella Ramsey
episodes.summary: Bella Ramsey picks sparkling water, sourdough from a crew friend, buttered raspberry-jam toast and bruschetta with lots of black pepper, her mum's school-lunch pasta salad, crispy rice with avocado, a litre of fresh orange juice, and a coffee-on-coffee affogato cake.

recommendations.item: Sparkling water
recommendations.reason: She finds sparkling water seems to help her digestion, even if that may be a myth.
recommendations.quote: I think it's maybe a myth that it helps with digestion, but it seems to help me.
recommendations.speaker: Bella Ramsey

recommendations.item: Sourdough baked by Chris Rufus, The Last of Us script supervisor
recommendations.reason: A crew colleague used to bring in homemade sourdough to hand out on set and she remembers it as really good.
recommendations.quote: there's a script supervisor on The Last of Us, called Chris Rufus, and he would bring in sourdough just to give out, and that was really good.
recommendations.speaker: Bella Ramsey

recommendations.item: Toast with proper butter and seedy raspberry jam, plus bruschetta, all with black pepper
recommendations.reason: She wants a simple double-toast starter with fruity raspberry jam whose seeds crunch, and black pepper on everything.
recommendations.quote: I like jam that tastes like proper like fruity.
recommendations.speaker: Bella Ramsey

recommendations.item: Cold pasta salad with mayonnaise, cucumber, pepper and lots of black pepper, eaten from a Tupperware with a spork
recommendations.reason: Her mum's school-lunch pasta salad is her nostalgic favourite, which she would sneak a bite of before even leaving for school.
recommendations.quote: pasta salad that my mum used to make for me when I used to go to school back in the day... in a Tupperware with a spork.
recommendations.speaker: Bella Ramsey

recommendations.item: Crispy rice with avocado
recommendations.reason: She had this once at a random spot, a deep-fried square of rice, soft inside and crisp outside, topped with avocado.
recommendations.quote: It's a little square of rice that's deep-fried, and so it's like soft and squidgy in the middle, crispy rice with avocado.
recommendations.speaker: Bella Ramsey

recommendations.item: A litre of freshly squeezed orange juice
recommendations.reason: She would love it in a dream where her stomach issues do not exist; she likes juice squeezed by hand at home.
recommendations.quote: Fresh orange juice… freshly squeezed... maybe like a litre of fresh orange juice, freshly squeezed.
recommendations.speaker: Bella Ramsey

recommendations.item: Coffee ice cream on coffee cake with espresso (affogato) and chocolate-covered coffee beans
recommendations.reason: An invented all-coffee dessert; she loves coffee flavour and has never had these elements together.
recommendations.quote: coffee ice cream on coffee cake with a sort of espresso, so like affogato, with coffee ice cream on coffee cake with chocolate-covered coffee beans on top.
recommendations.speaker: Bella Ramsey

recommendations.item: Cashew chilli crispy tofu
recommendations.reason: Bella recommends this Chinese restaurant in Vancouver, where she filmed The Last of Us, for its crispy tofu.
recommendations.quote: There's also a really good Chinese restaurant in Vancouver called Mott 32, which then they do cashew chilli crispy toff-oo.
recommendations.speaker: Bella Ramsey

recommendations.item: Blueberry balsamic ice cream
recommendations.reason: James calls it one of the all-time great ice cream places, praising the unique blueberry balsamic scoop; Bella agrees it's really good.
recommendations.quote: 'Rain or Shine' is one of the all-time great ice cream places.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Almond croissant bread pudding and coffee
recommendations.reason: James had great coffee there and he and Joe Lycett lost their minds over the almond croissant bread pudding.
recommendations.quote: The almond croissant bread pudding at Faculty. Really, really good.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

episodes.title: Mark Gatiss
episodes.summary: Mark Gatiss goes working-class comfort: sparkling water, white crusty bloomer with balsamic, a prawn cocktail, matinee-day chicken Milanese, fattoush, Lacryma Christi white wine, and pavlova plus a Wagamama ginger and white chocolate cheesecake, with beans on toast as his true last meal.

recommendations.item: Sparkling water
recommendations.reason: Fizzy water feels slightly exotic and pop-like to him, so he favours it over plain still.
recommendations.quote: fizzy weirdly still feels a bit exotic and like pop. So I always favour it.
recommendations.speaker: Mark Gatiss

recommendations.item: White crusty bloomer with balsamic vinegar (and oil) to soak it up
recommendations.reason: He loves crusty white bread and has adored dunking it in balsamic since discovering it in Vancouver 30 years ago.
recommendations.quote: I love a white crusty bloomer.
recommendations.speaker: Mark Gatiss

recommendations.item: Prawn cocktail with plenty of Marie Rose sauce on iceberg lettuce
recommendations.reason: An old-school prawn cocktail is a constant draw; he picked it over a pear, walnut and gorgonzola salad and doesn't want big prawns with faces.
recommendations.quote: I'm constantly drawn ... to a prawn cocktail. I love prawn cocktail.
recommendations.speaker: Mark Gatiss

recommendations.item: Chicken Milanese with rosemary potatoes and green salad
recommendations.reason: His go-to meal between matinee and evening shows at the RSC in Stratford, at a place that came to know his order; protein without being too heavy.
recommendations.quote: on a matinee day with two shows, that is the perfect meal for me.
recommendations.speaker: Mark Gatiss

recommendations.item: Fattoush
recommendations.reason: He loves the freshness of Lebanese food: toasted pitta, lemon, pomegranate and herbs.
recommendations.quote: I love the freshness of it. When you have those little bits of toasted pitter with lemon juice, and pomegranate.
recommendations.speaker: Mark Gatiss

recommendations.item: Lacryma Christi white wine
recommendations.reason: A crisp white from the slopes of Vesuvius drunk in modern Pompeii on a sunny day, followed by a private tour of the ruins.
recommendations.quote: it is called Lacryma Christi, the Tears of Christ. That was a good one. And it was a beautiful day.
recommendations.speaker: Mark Gatiss

recommendations.item: Pavlova (or Eton mess)
recommendations.reason: He loves crisp meringue with cream and raspberries, a taste going back to the meringue man's baker's van of his childhood.
recommendations.quote: my absolute favourite is ... pavlova, and I love meringue.
recommendations.speaker: Mark Gatiss

recommendations.item: Ginger and white chocolate cheesecake with chilli
recommendations.reason: A former Wagamama dessert that tasted just like his mum's cake mixture scraped from the bowl.
recommendations.quote: It tasted exactly like when my mum used to make cakes.
recommendations.speaker: Mark Gatiss

recommendations.item: Beans on toast
recommendations.reason: He names it his real last meal: sugared tinned beans on buttered white toast, a Sunday-tea classic.
recommendations.quote: my last meal, is beans on toast.
recommendations.speaker: Mark Gatiss

recommendations.item: Shakshouka with toasted sourdough
recommendations.reason: He often has shakshouka for lunch at a local restaurant; the tomato and yolk taste like childhood bacon and egg with tinned tomato.
recommendations.quote: it tastes like something I had when I was eight, and that's why I like it.
recommendations.speaker: Mark Gatiss

recommendations.item: Fish and chips with scraps
recommendations.venue: Fish and chip shop on Gillespie Road
recommendations.reason: His first night in London he found a chippy opposite Arsenal run by a north-easterner that sold scraps; the venue name is not given.
recommendations.quote: it turned out that the owner was from the Northeast. And it was like heaven sent.
recommendations.speaker: Mark Gatiss

episodes.title: Kaya Scodelario
episodes.summary: Kaya Scodelario goes comforting and Brazilian: pão de queijo, a naff prawn cocktail, a rodízio, cauliflower cheese, cold blonde lager and sticky toffee pudding.

recommendations.item: Big bottle of plain sparkling water ('bubble water')
recommendations.reason: She discovered sparkling water as a stand-in for beer on planes and wants a proper big bottle with no flavours.
recommendations.quote: give me a big bottle of sparkling water, and my kids drink it, and they call it bubble water
recommendations.speaker: Kaya Scodelario

recommendations.item: Pão de queijo (Brazilian cheese bread balls)
recommendations.reason: Cheesy Brazilian bread balls she cooks in the air fryer, sometimes in the middle of the night.
recommendations.quote: Particularly Brazilian cheese ball bread, pão de queijo.
recommendations.speaker: Kaya Scodelario

recommendations.item: Prawn cocktail, proper cheap 1980s British style
recommendations.reason: She loves a deliberately basic prawn cocktail with little chewy prawns and shredded lettuce, not the over-the-top seafood-tower version she had in New York.
recommendations.quote: Little frozen chewy prawns.
recommendations.speaker: Kaya Scodelario

recommendations.item: Rodízio (Brazilian all-you-can-eat meat on swords)
recommendations.reason: A traditional Brazilian Sunday meal with rice, beans, snacks and endless carved meats like picanha, her idea of heaven.
recommendations.quote: you sit there for three hours, slowly comatose-ing yourself... And it's my idea of heaven.
recommendations.speaker: Kaya Scodelario

recommendations.item: Cauliflower cheese with grilled almonds
recommendations.reason: A proper roux-based cauliflower cheese, the best version from her unnamed local pub.
recommendations.quote: a really good cauliflower cheese, not the shitty ones... Like you actually make a roux
recommendations.speaker: Kaya Scodelario

recommendations.item: Ice-cold, high-percentage blonde lager (or a crisp gin and tonic)
recommendations.reason: A cold pint in a pub garden with friends is her happy place.
recommendations.quote: Being in like a pub garden with someone you fancy, having a lovely pint of lager is probably my happy place.
recommendations.speaker: Kaya Scodelario

recommendations.item: Sticky toffee pudding with vanilla ice cream, no fruit
recommendations.reason: Moist sticky toffee pudding, nothing microwaved, no raisins and no crème fraîche; she orders it after every roast.
recommendations.quote: I think sticky toffee pudding is superior. But it's got to be done well.
recommendations.speaker: Kaya Scodelario

recommendations.item: Rodízio / Brazilian steakhouse
recommendations.reason: Ed's example of a chain rodízio he has visited in the US; Kaya corrects his pronunciation.
recommendations.quote: Fogo de Chão. That's one in the states. That's a chain.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Brazilian food
recommendations.venue: Brazilian stall at The Grove (name not given)
recommendations.reason: She says a tiny Brazilian market stall there serves the best Brazilian food in America.
recommendations.quote: Best Brazilian food in America.
recommendations.speaker: Kaya Scodelario

recommendations.item: Pub food
recommendations.reason: Guy Ritchie's pub: tiny, a bit Mayfair, but the food, wine and staff were incredible when she visited.
recommendations.quote: the food is incredible. The staff are amazing.
recommendations.speaker: Kaya Scodelario

recommendations.item: Coffee
recommendations.reason: Where the show's producer Benito buys the beans for the great coffee the hosts praised.
recommendations.quote: he genuinely buys it from there.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

episodes.title: Tessa Coates
episodes.summary: Tessa Coates builds a multi-location dream meal: Weeki Wachee spring water, date bread from Perilla, a Keens Steakhouse Cobb salad, fish and chips on Colwyn Bay pier with a battered sausage, mashed potato, a childhood cruise pina colada, and a three-way dessert platter featuring a battered Mars bar and Escocesa's blueberry cheesecake.

recommendations.item: Spring water from Weeki Wachee (the mermaid spring water)
recommendations.reason: Professional mermaids who swam in the spring spoke so wide-eyed about the water's peace that she wants to taste it; tap water otherwise.
recommendations.quote: There's something in this water, and that is the water I'd like to drink, please.
recommendations.speaker: Tessa Coates

recommendations.item: Warm homemade date bread with salted homemade butter
recommendations.reason: Her tasting menu there started with this warm date bread and butter with salt on top; a candlelit, high-quality place that is more affordable than other tasting menus unless you add the drinks pairing.
recommendations.quote: Can I have a warm, homemade date bread? That I had once, in a restaurant, and a homemade butter with salt on top.
recommendations.speaker: Tessa Coates

recommendations.item: Cobb salad with a dry martini with a twist
recommendations.location: Midtown Manhattan, New York City, USA
recommendations.reason: A walk-in at the bar where a long-serving waiter in a red waistcoat recommended it; an apparently boring Cobb salad that was sensationally delicious, in a historic room with clay pipes on the ceiling.
recommendations.quote: Sounds boring as hell. It was the most delicious thing I've ever had.
recommendations.speaker: Tessa Coates

recommendations.item: Cod and chips with plenty of salt and vinegar, plus a battered sausage, eaten on the pier
recommendations.reason: She wants it sitting with her legs dangling over the pier with family and a curated group of friends after doing a small quest, such as helping put up a marquee before her wedding; no specific chip shop named.
recommendations.quote: I think fish and chips is like most enjoyed when you've done an activity or a thing.
recommendations.speaker: Tessa Coates

recommendations.item: Mashed potato (whipped and buttery)
recommendations.reason: She cannot resist mash on a menu and names Brasserie Zedel, whose butter-rich whipped mash is her favourite.
recommendations.quote: With more of a whip. Gun to my head, Brasserie Zedel.
recommendations.speaker: Tessa Coates

recommendations.item: Pina colada in a fancy glass with a cocktail umbrella (and original Coca-Cola with cocaine, or a Mexican Coke, with the main)
recommendations.reason: A virgin pina colada on a family cruise at age 11, after her grandparents sold their business, blew her mind; she also loves a lava flow.
recommendations.quote: my dream drink is a pina colada that I had age 11 on... my grandparents sold their business.
recommendations.speaker: Tessa Coates

recommendations.item: Baked blueberry cheesecake with banana ice cream
recommendations.reason: A tapas restaurant with great vibes whose cheesecake pudding was so good she has been back just for dessert.
recommendations.quote: this dessert, mamma mia! I have been back since just to have pudding in there. It was incredible
recommendations.speaker: Tessa Coates

recommendations.item: Battered Mars bar
recommendations.reason: First part of her three-way dessert platter, alongside a cartoon-style banana split sundae.
recommendations.quote: battered Mars bar from the Royal Mile in Edinburgh.
recommendations.speaker: Tessa Coates

episodes.title: Jacqueline Novak
episodes.summary: Jacqueline's chaotic, shifting menu: Acqua Panna, rain-soaked fought-over bread, rocket salad, creamy tomato soup, puttanesca-style pasta with plain spinach, a peach margarita and dirty martini, and affogato with a half-remembered strawberry dessert.

recommendations.item: Acqua Panna still water
recommendations.reason: Likes still first so she isn't filled with bubbles, and loves the peach-tinted bottle.
recommendations.quote: The colour of the bottle, I find very pleasing.
recommendations.speaker: Jacqueline Novak

recommendations.item: Plain bread dropped on the floor and fought over
recommendations.reason: Her fantasy of roughing-it food: stolen or scarce bread tastes the best, like her plain-bread night in.
recommendations.quote: It makes it like you're starving, and you just found a loaf of bread
recommendations.speaker: Jacqueline Novak

recommendations.item: Rocket salad and slightly creamy tomato soup with a hand-torn crouton
recommendations.reason: Wants a tangy light salad and a rustic, comforting tomato soup in the style of a tavern meal.
recommendations.quote: What about an ever so slightly creamy tomato? ... a giant crouton that's like not crassly square.
recommendations.speaker: Jacqueline Novak

recommendations.item: Tomato pasta with anchovies, olives and capers (puttanesca)
recommendations.reason: Loves tangy tomato sauce with plenty of extra sauce on the side.
recommendations.quote: I want a tangy pasta. A lot of tomato sauce. This is my classic.
recommendations.speaker: Jacqueline Novak

recommendations.item: Plain wilted spinach
recommendations.reason: A 'cruel vegetable' to cut through the rich pasta.
recommendations.quote: I kind of like just a cruel vegetable on the side.
recommendations.speaker: Jacqueline Novak

recommendations.item: Small tart peach spicy margarita, then a dirty vodka martini
recommendations.reason: A spicy tequila cocktail with tiny tart stolen peaches in a coupe glass, followed by a dirty martini with two or three olives.
recommendations.quote: Fuck it, I'm getting a martini. No, this meal is chaos, and I'm gonna allow it.
recommendations.speaker: Jacqueline Novak

recommendations.item: Affogato, lemon tart and a half-remembered strawberry cream dessert
recommendations.reason: Loves how an affogato unfolds over time; also craves tart lemon desserts and a New York strawberry dessert she can't name.
recommendations.quote: it's an experience because it's not like a unified thing you're eating, right?
recommendations.speaker: Jacqueline Novak

recommendations.item: Vegan restaurant she visited nightly in Los Angeles
recommendations.reason: She became a regular, returning nightly despite nut allergy reactions until the cashews came off the menu.
recommendations.quote: Crossroads. It's vegan.
recommendations.speaker: Jacqueline Novak

recommendations.item: Clarified coffee Negroni
recommendations.reason: Ed raves about a clarified coffee Negroni he had at an early lunch there.
recommendations.quote: I had a cocktail recently, which I really loved at a restaurant called Cornus. It was a clarified coffee Negroni.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Espresso affogato with salted caramel ice cream and oyster shell martini
recommendations.reason: James tells her to go for the excellent salted caramel affogato and the oyster shell martini.
recommendations.quote: They do an excellent espresso affogato with salted caramel ice cream, and the espresso over the top is amazing.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

episodes.title: Sanjeev Bhaskar
episodes.summary: Sanjeev Bhaskar's Indian-led menu combines Jikoni's prawn Scotch egg, Gymkhana butter chicken, his mum's aloo parathas, Dishoom black dhal, Pisco sour, mango lassi, Concorde red wine and banoffee pie, mango Eton mess and halwa.

recommendations.item: Robinsons mint and lime squash with sparkling water
recommendations.reason: Sparkling water felt like a treat growing up; he still likes a mint and lime squash.
recommendations.quote: Sparkling... it felt like it was kind of a treat, and it was special.
recommendations.speaker: Sanjeev Bhaskar

recommendations.item: Poppadoms, mix of spicy and plain, with all the dips
recommendations.reason: Goes with the Asian-themed family meal; he likes mixing plain and spicy poppadoms with all the condiments.
recommendations.quote: I like to mix the two.
recommendations.speaker: Sanjeev Bhaskar

recommendations.item: Prawn Scotch egg with banana ketchup
recommendations.reason: Incredible crumb-fried prawn Scotch eggs with soft-boiled egg and banana ketchup, from a restaurant with great service.
recommendations.quote: prawn Scotch eggs- That Jikoni, a restaurant in London, does which are incredible. Absolutely amazing.
recommendations.speaker: Sanjeev Bhaskar

recommendations.item: Papri chaat
recommendations.reason: Indian street-food chaat of crisp wafers, chickpeas, potato, yoghurt and tamarind that Meera makes brilliantly.
recommendations.quote: Meera makes one, which is amazing.
recommendations.speaker: Sanjeev Bhaskar

recommendations.item: Butter chicken masala
recommendations.reason: Pretty fantastic butter chicken with just the right amount of heat, served with vegetable pilau or biryani.
recommendations.quote: butter chicken masala from Gymkhana restaurant in London. Pretty fantastic. It's got just the right amount of heat on it.
recommendations.speaker: Sanjeev Bhaskar

recommendations.item: Aloo parathas
recommendations.reason: Potato-stuffed flatbreads made by his mother, his comfort food since childhood.
recommendations.quote: specifically my mum's, because that's for me comfort food from sort of childhood
recommendations.speaker: Sanjeev Bhaskar

recommendations.item: Black dhal (dal makhani)
recommendations.reason: One of Dishoom's classics, substantial rather than watery.
recommendations.quote: The black dahl, dahl makhani from Dishoom. ... one of their classics and is brilliant.
recommendations.speaker: Sanjeev Bhaskar

recommendations.item: Pav bhaji
recommendations.reason: Mumbai street food of buttered buns with spiced vegetable mash, made well by Meera.
recommendations.quote: So Meera's is amazing.
recommendations.speaker: Sanjeev Bhaskar

recommendations.item: Hispi cabbage
recommendations.reason: Sri Lankan restaurant whose roasted hispi cabbage in a sauce changed his view of cabbage.
recommendations.quote: a hispi cabbage made by Hoppers, Sri Lankan restaurant, which is also incredible.
recommendations.speaker: Sanjeev Bhaskar

recommendations.item: Costas salad with fruit and honey dressing
recommendations.reason: A salad of lettuce, cherry tomatoes and fruit with honey dressing, ordered on each of three relaxing holidays at the same spot.
recommendations.quote: that's incredible. So whenever I go there, I'll order that with anything else on the menu.
recommendations.speaker: Sanjeev Bhaskar

recommendations.item: Pisco sour (pre-meal)
recommendations.reason: His pre-dinner cocktail choice.
recommendations.quote: Pisco Sour as your pre drink. So good.
recommendations.speaker: Sanjeev Bhaskar

recommendations.item: Thick, ice-cold mango lassi
recommendations.reason: The right drink with an Indian meal, thick rather than watery.
recommendations.quote: a nice cold one. And a little bit on the thick side, as opposed to a thin watery one.
recommendations.speaker: Sanjeev Bhaskar

recommendations.item: Nuits-Saint-Georges red wine
recommendations.reason: Served on a surprise Concorde flight home from New York; he remembers it as the best red wine he has had.
recommendations.quote: they served a Nuits Saint Georges, and I remember thinking, 'This is the best red wine I've ever had.'
recommendations.speaker: Sanjeev Bhaskar

recommendations.item: Banoffee pie
recommendations.reason: He cannot resist banoffee pie, despite a film-set apple-sponge disappointment.
recommendations.quote: Cannot resist banoffee pie whenever I see it.
recommendations.speaker: Sanjeev Bhaskar

recommendations.item: Eton mess with fresh Alphonso mango
recommendations.reason: Mango in place of strawberries, with Alphonso the king of mangoes.
recommendations.quote: Eton Mess. But with fresh mango. Instead of strawberry.
recommendations.speaker: Sanjeev Bhaskar

recommendations.item: Halwa (semolina)
recommendations.reason: Semolina cooked with ghee, sugar and milk, topped with pistachios and almonds; his mum made it for celebrations.
recommendations.quote: my mum's is again something as a throwback ... comfort food from being a kid.
recommendations.speaker: Sanjeev Bhaskar

recommendations.item: Curry with famously folded poppadoms
recommendations.reason: James loves their folded poppadoms and the restaurant has put his picture in the window.
recommendations.quote: there's a place called Namaste Kathmandu. Go there and get a curry. Their poppadoms are the best ones.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Pig's head Scotch egg
recommendations.reason: James loves their Scotch egg made from pig's head meat with a soft yolk.
recommendations.quote: it's delicious, and it's made with the pig's head, the meat from the pig's head.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Butter chicken wings
recommendations.reason: Ed thinks about their butter chicken wings every day.
recommendations.quote: Brigadiers do the butter chicken wings, which I pretty much I think about every day.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

episodes.title: Pierre Novellie
episodes.summary: Pierre Novellie's nostalgic menu: de-fizzed mineral sparkling water, a warm bread basket with Isle of Man butter, South African cheese-on-toast and frankfurter bites, a full braai platter, Sichuan salt and pepper chicken, a wine pairing from friends, and Champers' coconut cream cake in Barbados.

recommendations.item: Sparkling water, slightly de-fizzed and minerally
recommendations.reason: He likes it to taste of a cave, but dislikes too much fizz (a mouth-texture thing) and shakes it flat.
recommendations.quote: I would like it to taste like a cave... There's minerality.
recommendations.speaker: Pierre Novellie

recommendations.item: Warm basket of mixed breads with whipped anchovy butter and plain Isle of Man butter
recommendations.reason: He grew up on the Isle of Man and wants the plain butter from there, which he rates as highly as Irish people rate Kerrygold, with the whole basket left on the table.
recommendations.quote: the normal, the plain butter to be from Isle of Man Creameries... it's as good in my head as Irish butter is to Irish people.
recommendations.speaker: Pierre Novellie

recommendations.item: South African 'Clairebit': cheese on toast with oregano and symmetrically arranged frankfurter slices
recommendations.reason: A childhood dish his mum Claire made, with oregano as his potions-kid magic herb and a ketchup dot on each frankfurter square.
recommendations.quote: my mum would always make me an in hindsight autistically specific type of cheese on toast.
recommendations.speaker: Pierre Novellie

recommendations.item: South African braai platter (sosaties, boerewors, lamb chops, peri peri, pap, chakalaka, Mrs Balls chutney)
recommendations.reason: A social barbecue sharing platter he wants with coal-singed meat and lamb crackling, shared with a party of Brians.
recommendations.quote: I would like a kind of general sort of sharing platter of all the things that you would get on a braai.
recommendations.speaker: Pierre Novellie

recommendations.item: Sichuan chilli salt and pepper chicken
recommendations.reason: Inspired by a Chinese place from his uni days with Phil Wang; he wants it with numbing Sichuan chilli.
recommendations.quote: I want the Sichuan chilli salt and pepper chicken.
recommendations.speaker: Pierre Novellie

recommendations.item: Wine pairing chosen by friends Ollie and Freddie (initially ice-cold Diet Coke)
